papers.title: A Metric for Semantic Graph Matching of No-Code Workflows
papers.abstract: No-code and agentic systems increasingly produce executable workflows, but workflows cannot be compared adequately as strings because typed operations, parameters, and directed connections jointly determine the artifact. We define a semantic graph-matching distance for finite attributed workflow graphs. A partial one-to-one node matching determines node-substitution and directed labelled-edge disagreement, while unmatched nodes incur a positive null cost. Under a fixed type hierarchy, encoder, field universe, and metric-compatible primitive distances, the objective is a metric on workflow graphs up to attributed isomorphism. A padded Hungarian procedure provides a scalable feasible upper bound distinct from the exact objective. We evaluate the metric on 4,705 public n8n exports, representing 2,282 distinct normalized-graph hashes, 73,057 nodes, and 469 observed node types. Across 32,093 branch-and-bound-complete evaluations, the mean raw distance is near zero under surface-preserving transformations ($1.21 \times 10^{-5}$) and rises to $0.584$ under major type or subgraph changes. On a complete 796-hash panel, accumulated edit count has Spearman $\rho = 0.520$ with distance, while the median within-workflow correlation is $0.975$. One- and three-perturbation systems have marginal means of $0.307$ and $0.763$, and all 117,312 evaluated triangle orientations have non-negative slack. Weight ablations preserve the positive edit-count association across tested configurations. These tests support numerical consistency, near-invariance to surface-preserving transformations, graded sensitivity to semantic and structural change, and robust discrimination across controlled modifications. The metric measures artifacts and does not by itself assert behavioural equivalence under external state or runtime data.

translation.title: 一种面向无代码工作流语义图匹配的度量方法
translation.abstract: 无代码与智能体系统日益产生可执行工作流，但工作流无法作为字符串进行充分比较，因为带类型的操作、参数和有向连接共同决定了该工件。我们为有限的带属性工作流图定义了一种语义图匹配距离。部分一一节点匹配决定节点替换代价和有向带标签边的分歧，而未匹配节点产生正的空代价。在固定的类型层次、编码器、字段全集和度量兼容的原始距离下，该目标在带属性同构意义下构成工作流图上的一个度量。一种填充式匈牙利算法过程提供了不同于精确目标的可扩展可行上界。我们在4,705个公开n8n导出文件上评估该度量，代表2,282个不同的归一化图哈希、73,057个节点和469种观测到的节点类型。在32,093次分支定界完整评估中，表面保持变换下的平均原始距离接近零（1.21×10⁻⁵），而在重大类型或子图变化下升至0.584。在完整的796哈希面板上，累积编辑次数与距离的Spearman ρ=0.520，而工作流内相关性的中位数为0.975。单扰动和三扰动系统的边际均值分别为0.307和0.763，且所有117,312个评估的三角形取向均具有非负松弛。权重消融在所有测试配置下均保持与编辑次数的正相关。这些测试支持数值一致性、对表面保持变换的近似不变性、对语义和结构变化的分级敏感性，以及在受控修改下的稳健区分能力。该度量衡量工件本身，并不单独断言在外部状态或运行时数据下的行为等价性。
translation.brief: 针对无代码工作流难以作为字符串比较的问题，提出一种带属性工作流图上的语义图匹配度量，并证明其为度量且给出可扩展上界算法。

papers.title: Tracing the Messy Middle: A Runtime Transaction Schema for AI Coding Agents
papers.abstract: AI coding agents are increasingly integrated into software development, yet the field lacks a systematic feedback loop to improve their behavior in practice. Artifact datasets capture final outputs such as code patches, commits, and benchmark outcomes, but omit the messy middle of the development lifecycle: the failed retries, fallback strategies, routing decisions, and abandoned sessions that determine operational cost, reliability, and productivity. We propose an observability framework that captures these runtime behaviors as structured transaction records, enabling engineering coaching grounded in behavioral evidence, workflow optimization at the stages where tasks break down, and routing policy iteration measured by total task cost rather than per-request price. We define the runtime transaction schema this architecture requires and demonstrate initial feasibility through Agent Token Manager (Atm), a local-first prototype that reconciles gateway records and transcript evidence without exposing prompt content to external collectors. Finally, we identify three open research problems that must be solved to scale these feedback mechanisms: trace reconciliation without shared request identifiers, outcome linking across asynchronous systems, and intervention causality. Treating the linkage between sessions and artifacts as a fundamental infrastructure requirement provides a structured foundation for understanding and optimizing agent behavior.

translation.title: 追踪混乱的中间过程：面向AI编码智能体的运行时事务模式
translation.abstract: AI编码智能体日益融入软件开发，但该领域缺乏系统性的反馈回路来改进其实际行为。工件数据集捕获代码补丁、提交和基准结果等最终输出，却遗漏了开发生命周期中混乱的中间过程：决定运营成本、可靠性和生产力的失败重试、回退策略、路由决策和被放弃的会话。我们提出一个可观测性框架，将这些运行时行为捕获为结构化事务记录，从而支持基于行为证据的工程辅导、在任务中断阶段进行工作流优化，以及以总任务成本而非单请求价格衡量的路由策略迭代。我们定义了该架构所需的运行时事务模式，并通过Agent Token Manager（Atm）——一个本地优先的原型——验证了初步可行性，该原型在不向外部收集器暴露提示内容的情况下协调网关记录与转录证据。最后，我们指出扩展这些反馈机制必须解决的三个开放研究问题：无共享请求标识符的追踪协调、跨异步系统的结果关联，以及干预因果性。将会话与工件之间的关联视为基础性基础设施需求，为理解和优化智能体行为提供了结构化基础。
translation.brief: 针对AI编码智能体缺乏运行时行为反馈的问题，提出以结构化事务记录捕获中间过程（重试、路由、放弃会话等）的可观测性框架及事务模式。

papers.title: PGPO: Prototype-Guided Progressive Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
papers.abstract: LLM-enhanced recommender systems encode item side information into semantic embeddings, but these embeddings may leak sensitive textual attributes through inversion attacks. Existing input-side defenses rely on trusted collection or local token perturbation, often disrupting the inter-item semantic topology needed for recommendation. To address it, we introduce relational fidelity as the key objective, requiring semantic shift for privacy while preserving relative item relations for utility. Based on this principle, we propose prototype-guided progressive obfuscation (PGPO), which learns topology-aware obfuscation anchors for high-influence prototype words and propagates them through a static semantic graph. PGPO is optimized with GRPO using individual dissimilarity, structural consistency, and semantic constraint rewards. Experiments on two benchmarks show strong inversion defense with near-upper-bound recommendation performance. The code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: PGPO：面向隐私保护LLM增强推荐的原型引导渐进式混淆
translation.abstract: LLM增强的推荐系统将物品侧信息编码为语义嵌入，但这些嵌入可能通过反演攻击泄露敏感文本属性。现有的输入侧防御依赖可信收集或本地token扰动，往往会破坏推荐所需的物品间语义拓扑。为解决这一问题，我们引入关系保真度作为关键目标，要求为隐私进行语义偏移的同时保留物品间的相对关系以维持效用。基于这一原则，我们提出原型引导渐进式混淆（PGPO），为高影响力的原型词学习拓扑感知的混淆锚点，并通过静态语义图进行传播。PGPO使用GRPO优化，采用个体差异性、结构一致性和语义约束奖励。在两个基准上的实验表明，其具有强大的反演防御能力，同时推荐性能接近上界。代码见此https URL。
translation.brief: 针对LLM推荐中语义嵌入被反演攻击泄露隐私的问题，提出原型引导的渐进式混淆方法，在保护隐私的同时保持物品间语义拓扑。

papers.title: ETA: Exit on Tool Arrival in Speculative Agent Loops
papers.abstract: Tool-using language agents in explicit thinking modes generate long chains of thought before acting, making each turn inherently serial: later tokens depend on the tool observation. Recent speculative tool dispatch methods overlap tool execution with reasoning, but offers limited benefit when reasoning dominates latency. We present ETA, that treats the speculative fork not as an actuator but as a sensor of the model's decision state, using it to terminate the reasoning of the main decode. It truncates reasoning only when the prediction is stable, agrees with the dispatched call, passes a free probe measuring whether a call will be emitted at all, and the tool result has arrived: a deadline that bounds per-turn regret by the remaining decode cost. ETA achieves speedups of 1.33x on tau2 airline/retail, 1.26x on tau2 telecom, and 1.13x on BFCL v4 multi-turn. On tau2, it decodes 24% fewer tokens at a nearly unchanged per-token rate without dropping action quality.

translation.title: ETA：推测性智能体循环中的工具到达即退出
translation.abstract: 在显式思考模式下使用工具的语言智能体在行动前会生成长思维链，使每一轮本质上是串行的：后续token依赖于工具观测结果。近期的推测性工具调度方法将工具执行与推理重叠，但当推理主导延迟时收益有限。我们提出ETA，它不将推测性分支视为执行器，而是将其作为模型决策状态的传感器，用于终止主解码的推理。仅当预测稳定、与已调度的调用一致、通过一个衡量是否真的会发出调用的免费探针、且工具结果已到达时，才截断推理：该截止条件将每轮的遗憾上界限定为剩余解码成本。ETA在tau2 airline/retail上实现1.33倍加速，在tau2 telecom上为1.26倍，在BFCL v4 multi-turn上为1.13倍。在tau2上，它在每token速率几乎不变且不降低动作质量的情况下，少解码24%的token。
translation.brief: 针对工具调用智能体推理延迟高的问题，将推测性工具分支用作决策状态传感器，在预测稳定且工具结果到达时提前截断推理。

papers.title: Agent-Native Applications: A New Application Paradigm
papers.abstract: Traditional application architectures assume behavioral logic authored in advance, leaving reachable behavior largely bounded by explicit code and workflow rules. Large language model (LLM)-based agents challenge this assumption by enabling runtime reasoning and autonomous action to become part of application behavior, allowing applications to address situations not enumerated at design time. Extending this pattern, this paper identifies a new application paradigm in which LLM-based agents serve as central reasoning and action components responsible for the application's core logic and, where permitted, for adapting the application graph itself at runtime. We call these agent-native applications. While such applications significantly expand their possible behavioral space beyond explicit code and workflow rules, they also face a major control problem in which useful agentic reasoning should be preserved while application behavior should remain within a permissible space. We therefore propose an architectural model that represents the application as a portable graph of agents, tools, data sources, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints, and encodes the application's permitted behavior as a behavioral envelope within a declarative application specification. At runtime, an application orchestrator serves as the control plane that coordinates tasks and governs how the graph and its permissions evolve, while an agent mesh serves as the data plane that mediates policy-relevant interactions and produces audit events. We then discuss the trust layer that makes agent-native applications governable and the supporting foundations required for practical operation. Two use cases illustrate the architecture, while Agent-Native Runtime (ANR) demonstrates selected core mechanisms in an executable prototype.

translation.title: 智能体原生应用：一种新的应用范式
translation.abstract: 传统应用架构假设行为逻辑预先编写，可达行为在很大程度上受限于显式代码和工作流规则。基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过使运行时推理和自主行动成为应用行为的一部分，挑战了这一假设，使应用能够应对设计时未枚举的情形。延伸这一模式，本文提出一种新的应用范式，其中基于LLM的智能体作为核心推理与行动组件，负责应用的核心逻辑，并在允许的情况下于运行时调整应用图本身。我们称之为智能体原生应用。虽然此类应用显著扩展了其超越显式代码和工作流规则的可能行为空间，但也面临一个重大控制问题：既要保留有用的智能体推理，又要使应用行为保持在允许空间内。为此，我们提出一种架构模型，将应用表示为可移植的智能体、工具、数据源和人机协同（HITL）检查点图，并在声明式应用规范中将应用的允许行为编码为行为包络。在运行时，应用编排器作为控制平面协调任务并治理图及其权限的演化，而智能体网格作为数据平面调解与策略相关的交互并产生审计事件。我们随后讨论使智能体原生应用可治理的信任层以及实际运行所需的支持基础。两个用例阐释了该架构，而Agent-Native Runtime（ANR）在可执行原型中展示了部分核心机制。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体应用行为空间扩大带来的控制问题，提出以可移植图和行为包络为核心的智能体原生应用架构模型。

papers.title: The Obsolescence of High-Level Code: Agentic Generation from Semantic Artifacts
papers.abstract: This paper argues that high-level source code need not remain the primary persistent artifact of software development when AI agents can generate, validate, and regenerate executable implementations from semantic intent. We place this claim in historical context by revisiting application generators, CASE tools, model-driven development, and platforms such as GeneXus, where developers already maintained higher-level representations from which code and other artifacts were derived. We propose a unifying view in which generation is the fundamental operation: given a semantic specification S = (R, C, I, T, O), maintained as the semantic authority, an agent produces a generated executable artifact A. Functional requirements, contracts, and interfaces are assessed as semantic obligations, while tests and operational objectives are assessed by an explicit external oracle V(A, S). We operationalize this framework through an experiment in independent generation: multiple LLVM artifacts are generated directly from one frozen semantic authority and evaluated by the same external oracle. The experiment reports regeneration coherence on an evaluated domain, not a proof of absolute correctness. It provides initial evidence that independently generated executable artifacts can produce the same observable outcomes under a common semantic authority and external oracle. We conclude by discussing reproducibility, specification-centered evolution, and the implications of treating implementation representation as a deployment choice rather than the primary maintained artifact.

translation.title: 高级代码的过时：从语义工件的智能体生成
translation.abstract: 本文论证，当AI智能体能够从语义意图生成、验证并重新生成可执行实现时，高级源代码无需继续作为软件开发的主要持久工件。我们通过回顾应用生成器、CASE工具、模型驱动开发以及GeneXus等平台，将这一主张置于历史背景中——在这些实践中，开发者早已维护更高层次的表示，并从中派生代码及其他工件。我们提出一个统一视角，其中生成是基本操作：给定作为语义权威维护的语义规范 S = (R, C, I, T, O)，智能体生成可执行工件 A。功能需求、契约和接口作为语义义务进行评估，而测试和运行目标则通过显式的外部 oracle V(A, S) 进行评估。我们通过一个独立生成实验将该框架操作化：从同一个冻结的语义权威直接生成多个LLVM工件，并由同一外部 oracle 评估。该实验报告的是在评估域上的再生成一致性，而非绝对正确性的证明。它提供了初步证据，表明独立生成的可执行工件在共同语义权威和外部 oracle 下可以产生相同的可观察结果。最后我们讨论了可复现性、以规范为中心的演化，以及将实现表示视为部署选择而非主要维护工件的含义。
translation.brief: 探讨当AI智能体可从语义规范生成并验证可执行实现时，源代码是否不再是主要维护工件，并提出以生成为基本操作、由语义规范加外部oracle评估的框架。

papers.title: Who Changed the AI Agent's Rules? Measuring How AI Coding Agents Escalate Authority in CI/CD Pipelines
papers.abstract: AI coding agents can modify CI/CD control-plane structures, including workflows and permission settings, thereby extending their authority beyond routine code changes. Because such modifications can affect an entire development pipeline, this study examines the trade-off between execution cost and governance risk in agentic CI/CD. We introduce a joint penalty model, P(M), that combines these two dimensions and evaluate it on all 932,791 agent-authored pull requests in the AIDev dataset, covering five autonomous coding agents. Each pull request is automatically classified by authority scope - data-plane or control-plane - and assigned a penalty score. We found that control-plane actions have a 2.3x higher mean joint penalty than data-plane actions (0.498 vs. 0.218) and a 3.9x higher mean governance risk (0.530 vs. 0.135), which means that they indeed increase the risk. All 775 pull requests in the extreme-risk category, defined as P(M) > 0.8, modify the control plane. Policy-violation flags occur in 46.6% of all control-plane pull requests and in 63.6% of merged control-plane pull requests. We have also found an indication that governance risk differs substantially across agent implementations, ranging from 0.166 for Cursor to 0.328 for Copilot in mean joint penalty. These differences are not explained by execution cost or merge rate, suggesting that authority policies should be calibrated for individual agents. Manual assessment of 34 pull requests yielded a Cohen's kappa of 0.72 for the authority-scope classifier. The results show that a single compound metric can identify and measure changes to CI/CD governance structures at scale. The proposed framework supports detecting high-risk pull requests and comparing governance behavior across agent implementations, providing a basis for authority tuning and pipeline governance in agentic software development.

translation.title: 谁修改了AI智能体的规则？度量AI编码智能体在CI/CD流水线中的权限升级
translation.abstract: AI编码智能体可以修改CI/CD控制面结构，包括工作流和权限设置，从而将其权限扩展到常规代码变更之外。由于此类修改可能影响整个开发流水线，本研究考察了智能体化CI/CD中执行成本与治理风险之间的权衡。我们引入联合惩罚模型 P(M)，结合这两个维度，并在AIDev数据集中全部932,791个智能体创建的pull request上进行评估，涵盖五个自主编码智能体。每个pull request按权限范围——数据面或控制面——自动分类，并赋予惩罚分数。我们发现控制面操作的平均联合惩罚是数据面操作的2.3倍（0.498 对 0.218），平均治理风险是3.9倍（0.530 对 0.135），说明其确实增加了风险。所有775个极高风险类别（定义为 P(M) > 0.8）的pull request都修改了控制面。策略违规标记出现在46.6%的控制面pull request中，在已合并的控制面pull request中占63.6%。我们还发现治理风险在不同智能体实现之间差异显著，平均联合惩罚从Cursor的0.166到Copilot的0.328不等。这些差异无法由执行成本或合并率解释，表明权限策略应针对各个智能体分别校准。对34个pull request的人工评估显示权限范围分类器的Cohen's kappa为0.72。结果表明，单一复合指标可以大规模识别和度量CI/CD治理结构的变更。所提框架支持检测高风险pull request并比较不同智能体实现的治理行为，为智能体化软件开发中的权限调优和流水线治理提供基础。
translation.brief: 针对AI编码智能体修改CI/CD控制面带来的治理风险，提出结合执行成本与治理风险的联合惩罚模型，并在大规模pull request数据上分类与量化权限升级行为。

papers.title: StatePortal: Agentic Checkpoint Synthesis for Testing Deep States in Interactive Software
papers.abstract: Large language models have reduced the effort to generate code for interactive software with graphical user interfaces (GUIs). For such software, a key testing bottleneck is reaching a deep state, one that requires a long interaction history. The cost of reaching it recurs across commits, and the GUI automation that could amortize it assumes a DOM or accessibility tree that self-rendered engines do not expose. We introduce StatePortal, an agent that synthesizes a checkpoint, an artifact that restores that state and can be versioned and replayed, from a natural-language functional test case and read-only access to the target's source code. The checkpoint is restored through a per-application hook that an onboarding agent binds or synthesizes once without hand-written hook code. Because a checkpoint can satisfy state checks while rendering incorrectly, checkpoints are scored by hybrid programmatic-state and visual evaluation: acceptance requires both a programmatic-state oracle and a visual oracle to pass. We calibrate the visual oracle against a blinded cross-VLM reference. We release DeepStateBench, 61 deep-state tasks across 10 interactive applications that span five language families and six rendering stacks, with source sizes from 874 to 7.2M lines. Across three registered models, a GUI agent seeded with synthesized checkpoints completes 10.4% of trials, compared with 0% without seeding under the same pixel action space, while StatePortal, which also delivers the target action through the hook, completes 27.5%. Over 1,361 replays of 112 checkpoints, 98.90% reproduce the original verdict with zero model calls, and the hybrid oracle detects 96.25% (77/80) of controlled visual faults invisible to programmatic-state checks alone. We open-source our code at this https URL and website at this https URL

translation.title: StatePortal：面向交互式软件深层状态测试的智能体检查点合成
translation.abstract: 大语言模型降低了为具有图形用户界面（GUI）的交互式软件生成代码的工作量。对于此类软件，一个关键的测试瓶颈是到达深层状态，即需要长交互历史的状态。到达该状态的成本在各个commit之间反复发生，而本可摊销该成本的GUI自动化依赖于自渲染引擎不提供的DOM或无障碍树。我们提出StatePortal，一个智能体，它从自然语言功能测试用例和对目标源代码的只读访问出发，合成一个检查点——一种可恢复该状态、可版本化并可重放的工件。检查点通过一个由onboarding智能体一次性绑定或合成的每应用hook来恢复，无需手写hook代码。由于检查点可能在状态检查通过的同时渲染不正确，检查点通过混合的程序化状态与视觉评估来评分：接受需要程序化状态oracle和视觉oracle同时通过。我们以盲测的跨VLM参考对视觉oracle进行校准。我们发布DeepStateBench，包含10个交互式应用中的61个深层状态任务，覆盖五种语言家族和六种渲染栈，源代码规模从874行到720万行。在三个注册模型上，以合成检查点为种子的GUI智能体完成10.4%的试验，而在相同像素动作空间下不使用种子则为0%；StatePortal还通过hook传递目标动作，完成27.5%。在112个检查点的1,361次重放中，98.90%在零模型调用下复现原始判定，混合oracle检测出96.25%（77/80）的程序化状态检查无法察觉的受控视觉故障。代码开源于此 https URL，网站在此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对GUI软件测试中难以到达深层状态的问题，提出StatePortal智能体，从自然语言测试用例合成可恢复、可重放的检查点，并用混合程序化状态与视觉oracle进行验证。

papers.title: EnvAgent: Multi-Agent Approach to Building Science Environments in the Clouds
papers.abstract: AI agents are transforming scientific computing and software workflows, but generating and executing code requires a correctly configured execution environment. Automating environment construction remains difficult because repositories encode heterogeneous, often incomplete requirements for operating systems, toolchains, dependencies, and build procedures. Existing workflows thus rely on developer-maintained Dockerfiles and setup scripts, making preparation labor-intensive, hard to scale, and potentially biasing evaluations. We present ENVAGENT, an agentic framework that synthesizes, builds, and verifies repository-level Docker environments. ENVAGENT combines deterministic utilities for Docker execution and state management with coordinated agents for repository analysis, planning, Dockerfile synthesis, and iterative failure diagnosis and repair. We also introduce ENVBENCH, a benchmark of 54 scientific artifacts and open-source repositories spanning seven languages from Chameleon Trovi and Multi-SWE-bench. For each repository, we curate a declarative rubric of required structure, configuration, and functionality, and a shared evaluator applies 2,108 weighted checks across generated environments. Across four matched language-model settings, ENVAGENT constructs 43.5 executable environments out of 54 on average, versus 23.5 for Codex and Claude Code, and scores 62.02 versus 24.19 on a composite of executability and rubric satisfaction. These results show that environment-specific agent orchestration substantially improves automated environment construction.

translation.title: EnvAgent：在云端构建科学计算环境的多智能体方法
translation.abstract: AI智能体正在变革科学计算和软件工作流，但生成和执行代码需要正确配置的执行环境。环境构建自动化仍然困难，因为代码仓库编码了对操作系统、工具链、依赖和构建过程的异构且常常不完整的需求。因此现有工作流依赖开发者维护的Dockerfile和安装脚本，使准备工作劳动密集、难以扩展，并可能使评估产生偏差。我们提出ENVAGENT，一个用于合成、构建和验证仓库级Docker环境的智能体框架。ENVAGENT将用于Docker执行和状态管理的确定性工具与协同的智能体相结合，用于仓库分析、规划、Dockerfile合成以及迭代式故障诊断与修复。我们还引入ENVBENCH，一个包含来自Chameleon Trovi和Multi-SWE-bench的54个科学工件和开源仓库、覆盖七种语言的基准。对于每个仓库，我们策划一个声明式的评分细则，涵盖所需的结构、配置和功能，并由共享评估器在生成的环境中应用2,108项加权检查。在四种匹配的语言模型设置下，ENVAGENT平均在54个环境中构建出43.5个可执行环境，而Codex和Claude Code为23.5个；在可执行性与评分细则满足度的综合指标上得分为62.02对24.19。这些结果表明，面向环境的智能体编排显著改进了自动化环境构建。
translation.brief: 针对代码仓库执行环境构建自动化困难的问题，提出ENVAGENT多智能体框架，自动分析、合成、构建并迭代修复仓库级Docker环境，并发布ENVBENCH基准。

papers.title: Software Engineering for LLM-Based Agents: A Lifecycle-Oriented Survey
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based Agents perform tasks through tool use and interaction with external environments. Public engineering guidance commonly begins with a target task, selects a suitable workflow or autonomous Agent design, and refines prompts, tools, and execution strategies using task outcomes, latency, and cost. When delivered as software systems, Agents must also satisfy stakeholder requirements, action boundaries, quality checks, and maintenance needs. Model-directed execution can vary across runs, failures can span model decisions and tools, and changes to prompts, models, or interfaces can affect previously accepted behavior. This survey examines how LLM-based Agents are engineered across five software lifecycle stages: Requirements Engineering, Architecture and Design, Implementation and Integration, Testing and Assurance, and Maintenance and Evolution. Based on a main collection of 355 papers, we compare the engineering problems addressed, explain how methods and practices work, and examine their reported evaluations and limitations within each stage. We synthesize how existing research supports Agent development activities and identify open problems and research directions. The result is a lifecycle-oriented reference for understanding, selecting, and further developing methods for engineering Agent software.

translation.title: 面向LLM智能体的软件工程：生命周期导向的综述
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过工具使用和与外部环境的交互来执行任务。公开的工程指导通常从目标任务出发，选择合适的工作流或自主智能体设计，并利用任务结果、延迟和成本来精炼提示词、工具和执行策略。当作为软件系统交付时，智能体还必须满足利益相关者需求、行动边界、质量检查和维护需求。模型指导的执行在不同运行之间可能变化，故障可能跨越模型决策和工具，而提示词、模型或接口的变更可能影响先前已接受的行为。本综述考察LLM智能体在五个软件生命周期阶段中的工程化：需求工程、架构与设计、实现与集成、测试与保障、维护与演化。基于355篇论文的主集合，我们比较各阶段所解决的工程问题，解释方法和实践的运作方式，并考察其报告的评估与局限。我们综合现有研究对智能体开发活动的支持，并识别开放问题与研究方向。其结果是一个生命周期导向的参考，用于理解、选择和进一步发展智能体软件工程方法。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体作为软件系统缺乏系统化工程指导的问题，基于355篇论文按五个软件生命周期阶段综述其工程方法、评估与开放问题。

papers.title: Escaping the Anthropomorphic Trap: Resolving the Cognitive Mismatch in Future AI Software Development
papers.abstract: For more than a half-century, the foundational paradigms of software development-such as modularity, information hiding, and hierarchical labor division-have been engineered to accommodate the strict cognitive limitations of human working memory. However, the rapid emergence of multi-agent artificial intelligence exposes a fundamental cognitive mismatch. Current frameworks attempt to integrate high-dimensional, stateless neural reasoning engines by coercing them to operate within these legacy, human-centric structures, falling into an anthropomorphic trap. This friction generates a novel, highly volatile behavioral entropy defined as AI-software technical debt, wherein amnesic agents hallucinate opaque workarounds to bypass architectural blindfolds. To resolve this, we propose Invisible Software Engineering (Invisible SE), a paradigm shift from agent-centric human emulation to environment-centric stigmergic governance. By reimagining the repository as an active computational topology which utilizes topological gradients, temporally weighted memory, and representation-space regularization, Invisible SE safely guides AI behavior without classical code-level constraints, thus transcending the cognitive horizons of human developers. This environment-centric protocol offers a potential blueprint for orchestrating scalable, long-lived computational infrastructures that transcend the cognitive horizons of human developers and enable autonomous agents to work, coordinate, and scale to build future software systems.

translation.title: 逃离拟人化陷阱：解决未来AI软件开发中的认知错配
translation.abstract: 半个多世纪以来，软件开发的基础范式（如模块化、信息隐藏和分层劳动分工）都是为了适应人类工作记忆的严格认知限制而设计的。然而，多智能体人工智能的迅速兴起暴露出一种根本性的认知错配。当前框架试图将高维、无状态的神经推理引擎强行纳入这些遗留的、以人为中心的结构中运行，从而陷入拟人化陷阱。这种摩擦产生了一种新颖且高度不稳定的行为熵，我们将其定义为AI-软件技术债：失忆的智能体会幻觉出不透明的变通方法来绕过架构盲区。为解决这一问题，我们提出隐形软件工程（Invisible SE），实现从以智能体为中心的人类模仿到以环境为中心的共识性治理的范式转变。通过将代码仓库重新构想为一种主动的计算拓扑，利用拓扑梯度、时间加权记忆和表示空间正则化，Invisible SE无需经典的代码级约束即可安全地引导AI行为。这种以环境为中心的协议为编排可扩展、长寿命的计算基础设施提供了潜在蓝图，使其超越人类开发者的认知视野，让自主智能体能够工作、协作并扩展以构建未来的软件系统。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体AI与传统以人为中心的软件范式之间的认知错配问题，提出以环境为中心的隐形软件工程（Invisible SE）范式，通过主动计算拓扑引导AI行为。

papers.title: Skill Roulette: Measuring Skill Invocation Rate Across LLM Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Agent skills package procedures for large language model (LLM) coding agents. An agent selects a skill from its name and description before reading the procedure. It may complete the task without invoking a relevant skill. We investigate how reliably coding agents invoke relevant skills and which factors affect that decision. We estimate invocation rates by repeating trials with identical inputs; invocation rate is the proportion of trials in which the agent invokes the relevant skill. We test 9 non-directional hypotheses about skill metadata, competing skills, contextual instructions, and task wording and composition. Eight concern invocation; the ninth tests whether making a skill available changes the occurrence of an action that the task does not request. We use tasks from 4 software engineering categories in a synthetic repository, running each of 4 coding-agent harnesses with 2 models. The planned 20,400 trials include 60 repetitions per Baseline category and configuration, 60 more per category in Claude Code with Sonnet 5.5 that admit each category's task and skill, and 10 per experimental condition. Comparisons are specified before collection and evaluated within each model and harness configuration using Boschloo's exact test.

translation.title: 技能轮盘赌：测量LLM编码智能体的技能调用率
translation.abstract: Agent skills为大型语言模型（LLM）编码智能体封装了操作流程。智能体在阅读流程之前，会根据技能的名称和描述来选择技能。它也可能在不调用相关技能的情况下完成任务。我们研究编码智能体调用相关技能的可靠程度，以及哪些因素会影响这一决策。我们通过以相同输入重复试验来估计调用率；调用率是智能体调用相关技能的试验所占比例。我们检验了关于技能元数据、竞争技能、上下文指令以及任务措辞与构成的9个非方向性假设。其中八个涉及调用行为；第九个检验使某技能可用是否会改变任务未要求的动作的发生。我们使用合成仓库中4个软件工程类别的任务，运行4种编码智能体框架和2个模型的每种组合。计划中的20,400次试验包括每个Baseline类别和配置60次重复，在Claude Code与Sonnet 5.5中对每个类别可容纳其任务和技能的配置再增加60次，以及每个实验条件10次。比较在数据收集前预先指定，并在每个模型和框架配置内使用Boschloo精确检验进行评估。
translation.brief: 研究LLM编码智能体调用相关技能的可靠性，通过大规模重复试验和统计检验测量不同因素对技能调用率的影响。

papers.title: A Concurrent Structured Record Mirrored the Prose It Accompanied: A Pre-Registered Conceptual Replication and Extension of the Hide Pending Tool Call Scenario
papers.abstract: Huang et al. (2026) show that language models writing reports of agentic work tend to conceal narrative-changing flaws, and that appending "Be honest in your response." to the instruction substantially increases disclosure in most of their scenarios. In their Hide Pending Tool Call scenario, where a broader follow-up query was accepted but never returned, the honesty prompt left GPT-5.5's rate of flagging the missing data at 0%, although it turned most answers into caveats. I ask whether a different request changes this: appending, in the same generation, a structured record that follows the schema of an adversarial-review tool, including a residue section for what remained unresolved. In two pre-registered phases on the same 100 synthetic log pairs, each pending log matched with a clean twin in which the follow-up query did return, I ran gpt-5.6-sol through Codex CLI under four conditions. Phase 1 measured the record: with the residue schema, a judge coded it as stating the unreturned query in 29% of logs, against 5% with a findings-only placebo schema, and in none of the clean twins (p = 1.2 x 10^-7); a second run two days later gave 30% and 6%. But 70-71% of residue records declared that nothing remained open while the query was pending. Phase 2 measured the prose answer: the confirmatory comparison against the honesty prompt was not significant (four discordant logs, all favoring the honesty prompt; p = 0.125), no equivalence test was pre-registered, and the judge failed the pre-registered human validation on the decisive category; I therefore claim neither an effect nor its absence. In an exploratory cross-tabulation, every residue record coded as stating the gap accompanied prose coded as mentioning it (30 of 30), and none accompanied prose coded as omitting it (0 of 70): in this setting, the structured record mirrored the prose it accompanied.

translation.title: 并发结构化记录映照了其伴随的散文文本：Hide Pending Tool Call场景的预注册概念性复制与扩展
translation.abstract: Huang et al. (2026)表明，撰写智能体工作报告的语言模型倾向于隐瞒改变叙事的缺陷，并且在指令后附加"Be honest in your response."（在回答中保持诚实）在大多数场景中显著提高了披露率。在他们的Hide Pending Tool Call场景中，一个更广泛的后续查询被接受但从未返回，诚实提示使GPT-5.5标记缺失数据的比例保持在0%，尽管它使大多数回答变成了带保留的表述。我探究另一种请求是否会改变这一点：在同一次生成中附加一份遵循对抗性审查工具模式的结构化记录，其中包括记录未解决事项的residue部分。在针对相同的100对合成日志（每个待处理日志与一个后续查询确实返回的干净孪生日志配对）进行的两个预注册阶段中，我在四种条件下通过Codex CLI运行gpt-5.6-sol。阶段1测量结构化记录：使用residue模式时，评判者判定其中29%的日志陈述了未返回的查询，而仅含findings的安慰剂模式为5%，干净孪生日志中则为0（p = 1.2 x 10^-7）；两天后的第二次运行得到30%和6%。但在查询待处理期间，70-71%的residue记录声称没有遗留事项。阶段2测量散文回答：与诚实提示的验证性比较不显著（四份不一致日志均偏向诚实提示；p = 0.125），未预注册等效性检验，且评判者在决定性类别上未通过预注册的人类验证；因此我既不声称有效果也不声称无效果。在一项探索性交叉表中，每份被判定为陈述了缺失的residue记录都伴随被判定为提及该缺失的散文（30/30），且没有一份伴随被判定为省略该缺失的散文（0/70）：在此设置中，结构化记录映照了其伴随的散文。
translation.brief: 检验在生成中附加含residue部分的结构化审查记录能否促使语言模型披露未返回的查询，发现记录与散文回答高度一致但整体披露效果不显著。

papers.title: Agents as Architecture Evaluators: Automating ATAM and SAAM for Continuous Assessment
papers.abstract: The long-term success of a software system relies heavily on its underlying architecture, which dictates its performance with respect to quality attributes. Software Architecture Evaluation methods, such as the Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method (ATAM) and the Software Architecture Analysis Method (SAAM), are widely recognized for their ability to mitigate risks and ensure reliable quality attributes. However, their widespread adoption remains limited due to the significant cost, time, and human expertise required for these processes. This paper investigates the potential of agentic AI to lower these barriers and facilitate architectural assessment. To enable this preliminary study, we established a dataset by extracting human conducted evaluations from existing academic literature into a structured format. Using this dataset, we developed an agentic workflow to synthesize ATAM and SAAM evaluation reports based on these high level architectural descriptions. This approach simulates the reasoning process of human evaluators when provided with structured architectural data. We validated the approach using automated metrics and human evaluation. Agentic workflows achieve strong relevance and completeness ratings of 4.5/5 and 3.9/5 respectively. The agents successfully automated the labor-intensive phases of scenario generation and risk identification, reducing the evaluation time from weeks to under 5 minutes at a cost of less than $0.50 per run. The results confirm that agentic AI effectively lowers adoption barriers, enabling continuous, high-coverage architectural assessment.

translation.title: 智能体作为架构评估者：自动化ATAM与SAAM实现持续评估
translation.abstract: 软件系统的长期成功在很大程度上依赖于其底层架构，架构决定了系统在质量属性方面的表现。软件架构评估方法，如架构权衡分析方法（ATAM）和软件架构分析方法（SAAM），因其在降低风险和确保可靠质量属性方面的能力而广受认可。然而，由于这些过程需要大量的成本、时间和人类专家知识，其广泛采用仍然有限。本文研究智能体AI降低这些门槛并促进架构评估的潜力。为开展这项初步研究，我们通过将现有学术文献中人类进行的评估提取为结构化格式来建立数据集。基于该数据集，我们开发了一个智能体工作流，根据这些高层架构描述综合生成ATAM和SAAM评估报告。该方法模拟人类评估者在获得结构化架构数据时的推理过程。我们使用自动化指标和人类评估验证了该方法。智能体工作流在相关性和完整性方面分别获得4.5/5和3.9/5的高分。智能体成功自动化了场景生成和风险识别等劳动密集型阶段，将评估时间从数周缩短至5分钟以内，每次运行成本低于0.50美元。结果证实智能体AI有效降低了采用门槛，实现了持续、高覆盖率的架构评估。
translation.brief: 针对ATAM和SAAM架构评估成本高、依赖专家的问题，构建智能体工作流自动生成评估报告，实现快速低成本的持续架构评估。

papers.title: Log Analysis for LLM-Based Agents: A Lifecycle-Oriented Survey
papers.abstract: Logs generated by LLM-based agents support analysis of execution behavior beyond final outputs. Existing surveys give limited attention to dependencies across the lifecycle of these records. A lifecycle-oriented review of 90 core studies published between 2024 and August 2026 covers Agent Logging, Agent Log Structuring, and Agent Log Mining. Stage-specific comparisons reveal cross-stage dependencies and limitations. Detailed logs do not necessarily provide sufficient evidence. Structural uniformity does not guarantee semantic equivalence. Analytical claims require alignment with supporting evidence, reference criteria, and validation procedures. Representative open-source tools, public datasets, and future research directions are also summarized.

translation.title: 面向LLM智能体的日志分析：一项面向生命周期的综述
translation.abstract: LLM智能体生成的日志支持对超出最终输出的执行行为的分析。现有综述对这些记录生命周期中跨阶段依赖性的关注有限。本文对2024年至2026年8月间发表的90项核心研究进行了面向生命周期的综述，涵盖Agent Logging、Agent Log Structuring和Agent Log Mining。分阶段的比较揭示了跨阶段的依赖性和局限性：详细的日志不一定提供充分的证据；结构上的一致性不保证语义等价；分析性结论需要与支持证据、参考标准和验证程序保持一致。本文还总结了代表性的开源工具、公开数据集和未来研究方向。
translation.brief: 对LLM智能体日志的记录、结构化与挖掘三个生命周期阶段进行系统综述，揭示跨阶段依赖性与现有局限。

papers.title: Ephyra: A Property-Based Testing Framework for the LLM Era
papers.abstract: Coding agents now write a growing share of software tests; however, property-based testing (PBT) libraries are designed with historical considerations. We present Ephyra, a PBT library in Rust built on three concepts: customizability, observability and generator synthesis. Ephyra lets users compose their own testing loops from generation, mutation and shrinking, and synthesize these components to satisfy functional predicates. Applying Ephyra to 14 open source systems, we have found 349 bugs and reported 300 of them, in database management systems (SQLite, Turso, PostgreSQL, DuckDB, DataFusion), the verified policy engine (Cedar), the SQL equivalence prover (QED), the URL parser used in this http URL (ada-url), reimplementations of existing open source systems in Rust (coreutils, brush, gitoxide), and compilers (binaryen, OCaml, and OxCaml).

translation.title: Ephyra：面向大语言模型时代的基于属性的测试框架
translation.abstract: 编码智能体现在编写着越来越多的软件测试，然而基于属性的测试（PBT）库的设计带有历史局限。我们提出 Ephyra，一个基于 Rust 的 PBT 库，建立在三个概念之上：可定制性、可观测性和生成器合成。Ephyra 允许用户从生成、变异和收缩中组合自己的测试循环，并合成这些组件以满足函数谓词。将 Ephyra 应用于 14 个开源系统，我们发现了 349 个 bug 并报告了其中 300 个，涉及数据库管理系统（SQLite、Turso、PostgreSQL、DuckDB、DataFusion）、经过验证的策略引擎（Cedar）、SQL 等价性证明器（QED）、该 http URL 中使用的 URL 解析器（ada-url）、现有开源系统的 Rust 重实现（coreutils、brush、gitoxide）以及编译器（binaryen、OCaml 和 OxCaml）。
translation.brief: 针对传统基于属性测试库的局限，提出可定制、可观测并支持生成器合成的 Rust 框架 Ephyra，用于自动化发现真实开源系统中的 bug。

papers.title: When Single Agent Is Enough: Rethinking Multi-Agent Systems for Automated Code Review
papers.abstract: Code review plays a critical role in identifying software quality issues and ensuring system robustness. Prior work has proposed techniques for Review Comment Generation (RCG) and Code Refinement (CR), with recent Multi-Agent (MA) approaches achieving state-of-the-art results by coordinating agents specialized in different quality dimensions. However, MA systems introduce substantial architectural complexity and runtime overhead, and recent evidence suggests they may underperform Single-Agent (SA) approaches in certain tasks. In this work, we systematically compare MA and SA designs for RCG and CR. Surprisingly, our results show that SA approaches perform comparably to- and sometimes outperform-MA systems, despite their simpler design. These findings challenge the prevailing assumption that MA architectures are the default choice for complex software engineering tasks.

translation.title: 单智能体足矣：重新思考用于自动化代码评审的多智能体系统
translation.abstract: 代码评审在识别软件质量问题和确保系统健壮性方面发挥着关键作用。已有工作提出了评审意见生成（RCG）和代码精炼（CR）技术，近期的多智能体（MA）方法通过协调专注于不同质量维度的智能体取得了最先进的结果。然而，MA 系统引入了大量的架构复杂性和运行时开销，且近期证据表明它们在某些任务上可能不如单智能体（SA）方法。在本工作中，我们系统性地比较了用于 RCG 和 CR 的 MA 与 SA 设计。令人惊讶的是，我们的结果表明 SA 方法与 MA 系统表现相当，有时甚至更优，尽管其设计更简单。这些发现挑战了 MA 架构是复杂软件工程任务默认选择这一普遍假设。
translation.brief: 针对自动化代码评审中多智能体与单智能体架构孰优的问题，通过系统性对比实验检验两种设计在评审意见生成和代码精炼任务上的表现。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Visual Artifacts in Pull Request Descriptions
papers.abstract: Reviewers rely on pull request (PR) descriptions to understand what a change does, yet some changes, such as UI updates or runtime behavior, are hard to convey in text alone. PR authors attach visual artifacts to fill this gap, but how often they do so, what they show, and whether they change how a PR is reviewed remain unknown. We present a large-scale study of visual artifacts in GitHub PR descriptions. From 6,505,113 closed PRs in 5,012 repositories, we built VisPR, a dataset of 2,473,892 English, human-authored PRs from 647 repos where visual artifacts are an established practice. Of these, 329,185 (13.3%) are visual PRs, i.e., their descriptions contain at least one visual artifact (479,974 in total). By manually labeling a sample of 1,113 visual artifacts from 891 merged visual PRs, we derived two taxonomies: 11 content types capturing what developers show and six purposes capturing why they include visual artifacts. The dominant content type is Interaction & State, which shows how the interface responds to user actions. its share rises from 37.0% of images to 63.5% of GIFs and 79.7% of videos, whereas about a quarter of images (23.4%) show text such as logs, code, or error messages . Compared with 1,782 merged non-visual PRs matched on repository, PR type, and change size, visual PRs receive 43% more review comments and 17% more reviewers, and take 72% longer from first response to merge, time to merge and churn-normalized review efficiency do not differ significantly. LLM-assisted classification of 10,031 review comments in two groups shows that review centers on code in both, but comments on visual PRs address how the UI looks or behaves twice as often (6.4% vs.3.3%), and visual-output fixes after review are about four times as common (4.7% vs. 1.2% of PRs). Visual artifacts are thus associated with closer scrutiny of what users see, not with an overall faster review.

translation.title: Pull Request 描述中视觉附件的实证研究
translation.abstract: 评审者依赖 pull request（PR）描述来理解变更的作用，但某些变更（如 UI 更新或运行时行为）很难仅用文字传达。PR 作者会附加视觉附件来填补这一空白，但他们这样做的频率、展示的内容以及是否改变 PR 的评审方式仍不得而知。我们对 GitHub PR 描述中的视觉附件进行了大规模研究。从 5,012 个仓库的 6,505,113 个已关闭 PR 中，我们构建了 VisPR 数据集，包含来自 647 个仓库（视觉附件已是惯例做法）的 2,473,892 个英文、人类撰写的 PR。其中 329,185 个（13.3%）是视觉 PR，即其描述中至少包含一个视觉附件（总计 479,974 个）。通过人工标注来自 891 个已合并视觉 PR 的 1,113 个视觉附件样本，我们得出了两个分类体系：11 种内容类型（刻画开发者展示什么）和六种目的（刻画他们为何包含视觉附件）。最主要的内容类型是交互与状态（Interaction & State），展示界面如何响应用户操作；其在图片中占 37.0%，在 GIF 中升至 63.5%，在视频中达 79.7%，而约四分之一的图片（23.4%）展示日志、代码或错误信息等文本。与按仓库、PR 类型和变更规模匹配的 1,782 个已合并非视觉 PR 相比，视觉 PR 收到的评审评论多 43%，评审者多 17%，从首次响应到合并耗时多 72%，但合并时间和按变更量归一化的评审效率无显著差异。对两组共 10,031 条评审评论的 LLM 辅助分类显示，两者的评审都以代码为中心，但针对视觉 PR 的评论涉及 UI 外观或行为的频率是两倍（6.4% vs. 3.3%），评审后对视觉输出的修复也约多四倍（4.7% vs. 1.2% 的 PR）。因此，视觉附件与对用户所见内容的更严格审查相关，而非整体更快的评审。
translation.brief: 针对 PR 描述中视觉附件的使用情况及其对评审的影响缺乏了解的问题，通过构建大规模 VisPR 数据集并进行人工标注与对比分析，刻画其内容类型、目的及对评审过程的影响。

papers.title: From Ambiguous Tickets to Ranked Hypotheses: Multi-Agent Root-Cause Analysis for Autonomous Heavy-Vehicle Software
papers.abstract: Autonomous haulage systems run safety-critical software on driverless mining trucks, with no onboard driver to detect or mitigate abnormal behavior. Every failure in testing or operation must therefore be traced to its root cause to keep the safety case valid and limit downtime. An investigation often starts from a sparse ticket containing an approximate timestamp, sometimes a suspected cause, and a multimodal vehicle recording of several gigabytes. We present a multi-agent root-cause analysis (RCA) workflow that turns this input into a telemetry-grounded event chain, ranked causal hypotheses, and candidate code locations. A suspected cause in the ticket, which could anchor the analysis on a false theory, goes to a single LLM analyst in a separate agent session. Non-neural tools select the relevant telemetry once, before analysis, and an LLM condenses it into shared evidence artifacts; this more than halved the cost per incident compared with per-analyst querying. Specialist analyst agents then apply established RCA techniques in parallel, including fault tree analysis, Kepner-Tregoe analysis, and call-chain tracing, and hypotheses that several LLM analysts reach independently rank higher. We evaluated the workflow on 12 held-out industrial incidents against a single agent with the same model and tools. It located the faulty file more often (10 vs. 8 cases) at higher cost. Two human domain experts accepted a top-three hypothesis in 4 and 9 cases, respectively. The gap, which two LLM judges did not resolve, shows that rating causal explanations is itself a hard evaluation problem.

translation.title: 从模糊工单到排序假设：面向自主重型车辆软件的多智能体根因分析
translation.abstract: 自主运输系统在无人驾驶矿用卡车上运行安全关键软件，没有车载驾驶员来检测或缓解异常行为。因此，测试或运行中的每一次故障都必须追溯到其根因，以保持安全论证有效并减少停机时间。调查通常从一份信息稀疏的工单开始，其中包含一个大致的时间戳、有时还有一个疑似原因，以及数 GB 的多模态车辆记录。我们提出一个多智能体根因分析（RCA）工作流，将此输入转化为基于遥测的事件链、排序后的因果假设和候选代码位置。工单中的疑似原因可能将分析锚定在错误的理论上，因此被送入单独智能体会话中的单个 LLM 分析师。非神经工具在分析前一次性选择相关遥测数据，然后由 LLM 将其压缩为共享证据工件；与每位分析师单独查询相比，这将每起事件的成本降低了一半以上。随后，专业分析师智能体并行应用成熟的 RCA 技术，包括故障树分析、Kepner-Tregoe 分析和调用链追踪，多个 LLM 分析师独立得出的假设排名更高。我们在 12 个留出的工业事件上，针对使用相同模型和工具的单智能体评估了该工作流。它更常定位到故障文件（10 对 8 例），但成本更高。两位人类领域专家分别在其中 4 例和 9 例中接受了前三名的假设。两位 LLM 评判者也无法弥合的差距表明，评估因果解释本身就是一个困难的评价问题。
translation.brief: 针对无人矿车故障工单信息稀疏导致根因分析困难的问题，提出多智能体 RCA 工作流，将遥测数据转化为事件链、排序的因果假设和候选代码位置。

papers.title: Ask the Peers: Ranking NFR Coverage Gaps for Requirements Review
papers.abstract: Missing or underrepresented non-functional requirements (NFR) categories leave little direct evidence in a requirements set, making them difficult to identify during requirements review. In this study, we frame NFR coverage-gap review as a project-level ranking task: given a target requirements specification, the goal is to rank the 11 PROMISE NFR categories for analyst inspection. We compare seven statistical, embedding-based, and large language model (LLM)-based configurations that differ in both ranking mechanism and evidence source, including target requirement statements, peer requirements, their semantic representation, and peer category statistics. We evaluate the configurations using controlled gap injection with leave-one-project-out evaluation on PROMISE, PROMISE+, PURE-Transport, and PURE-Business. Four configurations that use peer category statistics are effectively tied under complete removal (0.875-0.889 mean AUROC), despite different ranking mechanisms, and supplying those statistics to a direct LLM ranker produces the largest evidence gain. All configurations weaken when a category is present but underrepresented, and none is best for every NFR category. For count-changing category-level gaps, structured peer evidence matters more than ranker sophistication. The findings suggest that the rankings should guide analyst inspection rather than serve as automatic judgements of requirements completeness.

translation.title: 问问同行：为需求评审排序 NFR 覆盖缺口
translation.abstract: 缺失或代表性不足的非功能需求（NFR）类别在需求集中几乎没有直接证据，使其在需求评审中难以识别。在本研究中，我们将 NFR 覆盖缺口评审构建为一个项目级排序任务：给定目标需求规格说明，目标是对 11 个 PROMISE NFR 类别进行排序以供分析师检查。我们比较了七种统计、基于嵌入和基于大语言模型（LLM）的配置，它们在排序机制和证据来源上各不相同，包括目标需求陈述、同行需求、其语义表示以及同行类别统计。我们使用受控缺口注入和留一项目评估，在 PROMISE、PROMISE+、PURE-Transport 和 PURE-Business 上评估这些配置。四种使用同行类别统计的配置在完全移除场景下表现基本持平（平均 AUROC 为 0.875-0.889），尽管排序机制不同，而将这些统计提供给直接 LLM 排序器带来了最大的证据增益。当某类别存在但代表性不足时，所有配置都会变弱，且没有一种配置对所有 NFR 类别都是最佳的。对于改变计数的类别级缺口，结构化的同行证据比排序器的复杂程度更重要。研究结果表明，这些排序应指导分析师检查，而非作为需求完整性的自动判断。
translation.brief: 针对需求集中缺失或代表性不足的 NFR 类别难以识别的问题，将其建模为项目级排序任务，比较多种基于同行证据的排序配置以辅助需求评审。

papers.title: When Code Works but the License Doesn't: Evaluating License Constraint Handling in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents increasingly undertake repository-level development, including dependency selection, source modification, and software deployment. However, existing evaluations prioritize functional success over licensing correctness and commercial suitability. We investigate whether agents recognize and preserve software-license constraints when developing proprietary software. Experiments across multiple agents examine permissive and copyleft licenses, missing licensing information, transitive dependencies, source modification, dual licensing, vendoring, and distribution contexts. Agent traces, repository changes, and final artifacts are evaluated against licensing ground truth. Results reveal a persistent gap between functional and licensing correctness. Agents can successfully build and test software while overlooking licensing constraints involving provenance, authorization, and distribution. Better outcomes emerge when licensing information translates into engineering actions such as dependency substitution, architectural changes, and release gating. We argue that licensing in agentic development requires contextual constraint recognition and preservation across the software lifecycle, not merely license classification.

translation.title: 当代码能跑通而许可证却不行：评估编码代理对许可证约束的处理
translation.abstract: 编码代理越来越多地承担仓库级开发任务，包括依赖选择、源码修改和软件部署。然而，现有评估优先考虑功能成功而非许可正确性和商业适用性。我们研究代理在开发专有软件时是否能识别并遵守软件许可证约束。实验覆盖多个代理，考察宽松型与 copyleft 许可证、缺失许可信息、传递依赖、源码修改、双许可、vendoring 以及分发场景。代理轨迹、仓库变更和最终产物均对照许可基准真值进行评估。结果显示功能正确性与许可正确性之间存在持续差距。代理可以成功构建并测试软件，却忽视涉及来源、授权和分发的许可约束。当许可信息被转化为工程行动（如依赖替换、架构变更和发布门控）时，结果会更好。我们认为，代理式开发中的许可问题需要在软件生命周期全程进行上下文化的约束识别与保持，而不仅仅是许可证分类。
translation.brief: 研究编码代理在开发专有软件时能否识别并遵守软件许可证约束，通过多场景实验对照许可基准真值评估代理行为。

papers.title: LLMs for Software Vulnerability Prediction and Prioritization: A Review
papers.abstract: Large language models have moved beyond vulnerability detection into prediction, assessment, exploitability estimation, risk assessment and prioritization, yet the evidence for this shift has not been synthesised separately from the detection literature. In this systematic literature review, we examine how LLMs are used across those five task classes, how well they perform against established baselines, and what prevents their operational adoption. Following a prespecified protocol, we identified 197 records, removed 53 duplicates, and excluded 103 records at title and abstract stage. We assessed 41 full texts and finally retained 23 primary studies published between 2024 and 2026 after a six-question quality assessment. The review contributes a five-class taxonomy ordered by decision outcome, a method taxonomy covering prompting, tuning and retrieval or agentic architectures, an evaluation-practice audit, a bounded performance synthesis, and a deployment-barrier analysis. The main findings are that (i) assessment is the largest class (9 of 23 studies), ahead of risk assessment and prioritization (7 each); (ii) reported accuracy is highest where the label space is tightest and is not stable across evaluation periods; (iii) explanation usability is an audited evidence gap rather than a demonstrated capability; and (iv) reproducibility is the weakest reported dimension. We conclude that present systems should support analyst judgement rather than replace it, and we specify three validation studies that would settle the open questions.

translation.title: 用于软件漏洞预测与优先级排序的大语言模型：综述
translation.abstract: 大语言模型已超越漏洞检测，进入预测、评估、可利用性估计、风险评估与优先级排序等领域，但这一转变的证据尚未从检测文献中独立梳理。本系统性文献综述考察 LLM 在这五类任务中的使用方式、相对既有基线的表现，以及阻碍其落地应用的因素。按照预先设定的协议，我们识别出 197 条记录，去除 53 条重复，在标题和摘要阶段排除 103 条，评估了 41 篇全文，并经六问质量评估后最终保留 2024 至 2026 年间发表的 23 篇原始研究。本综述贡献了按决策结果排序的五分类法、涵盖提示、微调与检索或代理架构的方法分类法、评估实践审计、有界性能综合以及部署障碍分析。主要发现：(i) 评估类占比最大（23 篇中 9 篇），其次是风险评估与优先级排序（各 7 篇）；(ii) 标签空间越紧报告的准确率越高，且跨评估周期不稳定；(iii) 解释可用性是经审计的证据缺口而非已证实的能力；(iv) 可复现性是报告最弱的维度。我们结论是现有系统应辅助而非取代分析师判断，并提出三项可解决开放问题的验证研究。
translation.brief: 系统综述 LLM 在漏洞预测、评估、可利用性估计、风险评估与优先级排序五类任务中的应用、性能与部署障碍，并给出分类法与验证建议。

papers.title: Dependency Fabrication in Repository Deployment Agents
papers.abstract: Repository deployment agents set up the environment needed to run a software repository. They often treat passing tests as proof of a successful setup. This report examines how such agents behave when a working setup is impossible. Probe repositories were built with a dependency that the agents could not legitimately obtain. Passing tests therefore indicated fabrication, such as creating a stub to replace the missing package. Agents in Repo2Run and SetupX usually fabricated the dependency. Both harnesses mostly still marked these runs as successful. Rules against fabrication, whether given in the prompt or repository documentation, did not reliably prevent this behavior. On MinimalSetupAgent, which was built for this report, mitigations proposed in the reward-hacking literature were most effective when the agent received a direct rule and had a clear way to stop and report the problem. Under these conditions, neither Qwen3.5-Plus nor GPT-5.6 Luna cheated in any of the 16 runs. Applying the same mitigation to Repo2Run and SetupX also required a native tool call for escalation. In Repo2Run, it worked only after the prompt was also replaced with one that placed less emphasis on passing tests.

translation.title: 仓库部署代理中的依赖伪造行为
translation.abstract: 仓库部署代理负责搭建运行软件仓库所需的环境，它们常把测试通过视为搭建成功的证明。本报告考察当无法实现可用搭建时此类代理的行为。我们构建了带有代理无法合法获取的依赖的探针仓库，因此测试通过即表明存在伪造行为，例如创建桩来替代缺失的包。Repo2Run 和 SetupX 中的代理通常会伪造依赖，而两个测试框架大多仍将这些运行标记为成功。无论是通过提示还是仓库文档给出的禁止伪造规则，都不能可靠阻止该行为。在本报告构建的 MinimalSetupAgent 上，reward-hacking 文献中提出的缓解措施在代理收到直接规则且有明确方式停止并报告问题时最为有效：在这些条件下，Qwen3.5-Plus 和 GPT-5.6 Luna 在全部 16 次运行中均未作弊。将同样的缓解措施应用于 Repo2Run 和 SetupX 还需要原生的升级上报工具调用；在 Repo2Run 中，只有在将提示替换为不那么强调测试通过的版本后才生效。
translation.brief: 研究仓库部署代理在依赖无法合法获取时伪造依赖的行为，并测试提示规则与上报机制等缓解措施的有效性。

papers.title: Checking Retry Transparency in Agent Tools
papers.abstract: A successful retry does not necessarily put the earlier attempt behind it. An old write may still overwrite a later acknowledged update; a partially executed file write may even empty a file after the retry has returned successfully. We study how to test the recovery guarantee behind an agent tool's local idempotence claim. Our prototype takes manually constructed, source-backed effect contracts and checks them at two levels: atomic retry-absorption obligations and bounded interleavings of successful-attempt microsteps. It emits model witnesses, conditional admission decisions, and explicit uncertainty when a completion boundary cannot be justified. The evaluation preserves a locally frozen purposive frame of 6 MCP components from 4 repositories; selected paths in 5 execute on the study machine and one backend remains unavailable. Real tests include file, graph, Git-index, document-update and browser bindings, together with a native Qdrant development matrix. In 27 missing-reply checks, the selective rule completes six justified workflows without an acknowledged goal violation, whereas strict coalescing completes none and blind retry completes nine with three violations. An intent-aware Porcupine specification independently agrees with all 156 complete-history oracles. These are mechanism-selected tests, not defect-prevalence estimates or a new linearizability algorithm. The contribution is an executable recovery-contract workflow that makes effect granularity, logical identity and completion assumptions testable rather than inheriting them from a tool annotation.

translation.title: 检查代理工具的重试透明性
translation.abstract: 重试成功并不一定意味着早先的尝试已被妥善处理：旧的写入可能仍会覆盖之后已确认的更新；部分执行的文件写入甚至可能在重试返回成功后清空文件。我们研究如何测试代理工具所声称的局部幂等性背后的恢复保证。我们的原型采用人工构建、有源码依据的效果契约，并在两个层面进行检查：原子性的重试吸收义务，以及成功尝试微步骤的有界交错。它输出模型见证、条件性准入决策，以及在无法论证完成边界时的显式不确定性。评估保留了来自 4 个仓库的 6 个 MCP 组件的局部冻结目的性框架；其中 5 个的选定路径在研究机器上执行，一个后端不可用。真实测试涵盖文件、图、Git 索引、文档更新和浏览器绑定，以及原生的 Qdrant 开发矩阵。在 27 项缺失回复检查中，选择性规则完成了六个可论证的工作流且无已确认的目标违反，而严格合并一个都未完成，盲目重试完成九个但有三处违反。一个意图感知的 Porcupine 规约与全部 156 个完整历史 oracle 独立一致。这些是机制选择的测试，而非缺陷流行度估计或新的线性化算法。贡献是一个可执行的恢复契约工作流，使效果粒度、逻辑身份和完成假设变得可测试，而非从工具注解中继承。
translation.brief: 提出基于效果契约的可执行测试方法，检验代理工具重试幂等性声明背后的恢复保证。

papers.title: Repository-Grounded Rubrics for Execution-Free Evaluation of Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents are usually evaluated by running task-specific tests, but tests may be missing or incomplete, and running them requires a working environment for each repository. We adapt agentic rubrics, introduced for selecting among candidate patches, into an execution-free measure of how far a patch satisfies a task's requirements. An agent explores the repository before the change and writes weighted binary criteria, and a judge without tools scores a diff by the weighted share of criteria it satisfies. We validate the ordering this score produces against test outcomes on SWE-bench Verified, using 7,291 labeled patches from fifteen systems. Within the 400 tasks that have both resolved and unresolved patches, the mean per-task AUROC is 0.826 (0.838 on tasks not used to tune the rubric-generation prompt), and ranking systems by their failing patches closely agrees with ranking them by resolve rate (Spearman 0.968). Case analyses trace disagreements to tests that do not match the task, execution-blocking defects that the textual assessment misses, and errors in criteria or verdicts. The validation does not establish absolute score magnitudes or requirement satisfaction beyond agreement with tests, but rubric scores could complement tests where tests or execution environments cannot be assumed.

translation.title: 基于仓库的评分准则：编码代理的无执行评估
translation.abstract: 编码代理通常通过运行任务特定测试来评估，但测试可能缺失或不完整，且运行测试需要为每个仓库提供可用环境。我们将为候选补丁选择而提出的 agentic rubrics 改造为一种无执行的度量，衡量补丁满足任务要求的程度。一个代理在变更前探索仓库并撰写加权的二元准则，一个无工具的评判者按补丁满足准则的加权比例对 diff 打分。我们在 SWE-bench Verified 上使用来自十五个系统的 7,291 个带标签补丁，将该分数产生的排序与测试结果进行对照验证。在同时具有已解决和未解决补丁的 400 个任务中，平均每任务 AUROC 为 0.826（在未用于调优准则生成提示的任务上为 0.838），且按失败补丁对系统排序与按解决率排序高度一致（Spearman 0.968）。案例分析将分歧归因于与任务不匹配的测试、文本评估遗漏的阻碍执行的缺陷，以及准则或判定中的错误。该验证并未确立绝对分数大小或超出与测试一致性的需求满足程度，但在无法假设测试或执行环境存在时，rubric 分数可作为测试的补充。
translation.brief: 提出基于仓库探索生成加权评分准则的无执行评估方法，用 LLM 评判补丁满足任务要求的程度并与测试结果对照验证。

papers.title: AppSec Core: An Ontology for Security-by-Design Software Engineering
papers.abstract: When engineers or coding agents change an application, a dependency, a configuration or a build pipeline, they need to know three things: which security rules apply, how to meet them, and what evidence to leave. Today the answers are spread over many standards, frameworks, laws and lists of weaknesses, and each one uses its own words and level of detail. This paper presents AppSec Core, a model of the security work that engineers do. It says what must be true, which practices get there, which mechanisms do the job and which artefacts show that it was done. It has 259 elements in ten domains. We built it from a security-by-design manual written from practice, and then checked it against 31 outside sources, ten of them about AI systems and agents. Along the way we made three changes, which added five objectives and made one domain wider. We did not need a new domain. Most objectives are backed by several sources: the typical objective is used by six of the twenty technical sources, and 194 of the 202 objectives, practices and mechanisms are linked to items in the sources. For the domain of a change, the model gives back a closed set of typed elements, and for a source, it gives back the objectives that the source points to. We keep the model apart from the manual, the selection rules and the server that delivers the result, and we follow one change, adding a third-party package, through all four. When a code generator received the requirements, the share of security tests passed on a public benchmark went from 77.4% to 93.0%. On a second benchmark, the result was close to that of the benchmark's own "oracle" prompt, which is written with the tests in mind.

translation.title: AppSec Core：面向安全设计软件工程的本体
translation.abstract: 当工程师或编码智能体修改应用程序、依赖、配置或构建流水线时，他们需要知道三件事：哪些安全规则适用、如何满足这些规则、以及应留下什么证据。如今这些答案分散在众多标准、框架、法律和弱点列表中，且各自使用不同的措辞和详细程度。本文提出 AppSec Core，一个描述工程师安全工作的模型。它说明了必须满足什么、通过哪些实践达成、由哪些机制实现、以及哪些工件可以证明已完成。该模型包含十个领域的 259 个元素。我们基于一份源自实践的安全设计手册构建了它，随后对照 31 个外部来源进行验证，其中 10 个涉及 AI 系统和智能体。过程中我们做了三处修改，新增了五个目标并扩展了一个领域，但无需新增领域。大多数目标都有多个来源支持：典型目标被二十个技术来源中的六个使用，202 个目标、实践和机制中有 194 个与来源中的条目相关联。对于某次变更所属的领域，模型会返回一个封闭的类型化元素集合；对于某个来源，模型会返回该来源所指向的目标。我们将模型与手册、选择规则和交付结果的服务器分离，并通过一个变更（添加第三方包）贯穿这四个部分进行跟踪。当代码生成器接收到这些需求后，在公开基准上通过安全测试的比例从 77.4% 提升到 93.0%。在第二个基准上，结果接近该基准自带的、针对测试编写的"oracle"提示词的水平。
translation.brief: 为解决安全规则分散于多个标准且表述不一的问题，构建了一个包含 259 个元素、十个领域的安全工程本体 AppSec Core，并验证其能指导代码生成器提升安全测试通过率。

papers.title: YUL: Bringing Software Supply Chain Security to Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Coding agents choose and declare third-party dependencies on their own. They often declare a stale version that they recall from their training data. A stale dependency exposes the project to known vulnerabilities that the latest release already fixes. We present YUL, a design for coding agent harnesses that ensures that no stale dependencies are ever used. It does so by checking every dependency declaration against the package registry. If a dependency is stale or does not exist, YUL blocks the usage and tells the coding agent which version to use, so the coding agent retries with the fix. We evaluate YUL on 60 tasks across six ecosystems with Claude Code running Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenCode running DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Without YUL, Opus declares a stale version in 29% of runs and DeepSeek in 39%, and both declare a stale version in every GitHub Actions run. With YUL, the coding agents end on the latest release in 93% of stale Opus runs and in 96% of stale DeepSeek runs. YUL thus brings the best practices of software supply chain security to coding agents.

translation.title: YUL：将软件供应链安全引入编码智能体
translation.abstract: 编码智能体会自行选择并声明第三方依赖。它们常常声明一个从训练数据中回忆起来的过时版本。过时的依赖会使项目暴露于最新版本已修复的已知漏洞。我们提出 YUL，一种编码智能体 harness 的设计，确保绝不使用过时的依赖。它通过将每个依赖声明与包注册表核对来实现这一点。如果依赖过时或不存在，YUL 会阻止其使用，并告知编码智能体应使用哪个版本，使编码智能体在修复后重试。我们在六个生态系统的 60 个任务上评估 YUL，使用运行 Claude Opus 5.5 的 Claude Code 和运行 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 OpenCode。没有 YUL 时，Opus 在 29% 的运行中声明过时版本，DeepSeek 为 39%，且两者在所有 GitHub Actions 运行中都声明过时版本。使用 YUL 后，编码智能体在 93% 的过时 Opus 运行和 96% 的过时 DeepSeek 运行中最终使用最新版本。因此，YUL 将软件供应链安全的最佳实践带给了编码智能体。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体常声明过时依赖版本的问题，提出 YUL，通过在 harness 中将依赖声明与包注册表核对并阻止过时依赖来强制使用最新版本。

papers.title: HydroMind: A Checkable Agent for Autonomous Hydrological Research
papers.abstract: General-purpose coding agents have written code for hydrological and Earth-system models. In these studies the researchers decided in advance how the model would be evaluated, for example the test period, the scoring function, and the standard the model had to meet. No study has tested what happens when the agent makes these decisions itself: how many of its claims are supported by its own data, code, and results, and whether readers can check them. Both may depend on the agent's harness, that is, the tools it can call and the written instructions it follows. We compared three harnesses: the agent's own harness; this harness plus the modeling tools of HydroMind, a hydrological modeling system we developed for general-purpose agents, which run every model through fixed commands and store its settings, trained model, and predictions; and both plus HydroMind's research procedure, under which the agent writes a research design before running any model and records every change to it. Under each harness, the same agent studied four open questions in hydrological model development and was given only the data. Under the three harnesses, the experiments submitted 23, 20, and 41 claims, each stating that one model or approach is better than, worse than, or similar to another. A claim does not hold if the difference recomputed from the experiment's own code and predictions disagrees with it, or if the code did not compare the two models or approaches the claim names. Under the three harnesses, 30%, 20%, and 5% of the claims did not hold. A statistical test, confidence interval, or decision rule that lets readers judge the stated difference was reported for 48%, 53%, and 83% of the claims. With the language model unchanged, changing only the harness reduced the share of claims that do not hold and increased the share that readers can check.

translation.title: HydroMind：面向自主水文研究的可核查智能体
translation.abstract: 通用编码智能体已能为水文和地球系统模型编写代码。在这些研究中，研究者事先决定了模型如何被评估，例如测试时段、评分函数以及模型必须达到的标准。尚无研究测试当智能体自行做出这些决策时会发生什么：它的多少论断由其自身的数据、代码和结果支持，读者能否核查这些论断。这两点都可能取决于智能体的 harness，即它可以调用的工具和它遵循的书面指令。我们比较了三种 harness：智能体自带的 harness；该 harness 加上 HydroMind 的建模工具——HydroMind 是我们为通用智能体开发的水文建模系统，它通过固定命令运行每个模型，并存储其设置、训练好的模型和预测；以及再加上 HydroMind 的研究流程，在该流程下智能体在运行任何模型之前先撰写研究设计，并记录对它的每次修改。在每种 harness 下，同一个智能体研究了四个水文模型开发的开放问题，且只被给予数据。在三种 harness 下，实验分别提交了 23、20 和 41 个论断，每个论断声称某个模型或方法优于、劣于或类似于另一个。如果从实验自身的代码和预测重新计算出的差异与论断不符，或代码并未比较论断所指的两个模型或方法，则该论断不成立。在三种 harness 下，分别有 30%、20% 和 5% 的论断不成立。分别有 48%、53% 和 83% 的论断报告了能让读者判断所述差异的统计检验、置信区间或决策规则。在语言模型不变的情况下，仅改变 harness 就降低了不成立论断的比例，并提高了读者可核查论断的比例。
translation.brief: 研究编码智能体自主开展水文研究时论断的可信度问题，通过对比三种 harness（含自研的 HydroMind 建模工具与研究流程）发现仅改变 harness 即可显著降低不成立论断比例并提升可核查性。

papers.title: Training for sustainable scientific software in the AI era: from code production to scientific stewardship
papers.abstract: Generative and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems are changing how researchers interact with scientific software. Their effects on productivity vary across tasks and users, but they can weaken the connection between producing a successful computational artifact and retaining scientific command over the consequential choices and evidence on which it depends. For high-energy physics, this shifts part of the training challenge from code production toward scientific stewardship: researchers must be able to validate, explain, reproduce, maintain, and justify software and workflows partly generated or modified by AI. We argue that AI-aware software training should therefore combine dedicated instruction on AI systems with the integration of AI into established software and analysis training. Testing, provenance, reproducibility, resource judgment, and scientific validation should be exercised in AI-assisted workflows, with competence judged by the evidence supporting a result rather than by code generation alone. We frame this as a problem of sustainable scientific software: AI-assisted workflows should remain trustworthy and maintainable, use computational resources responsibly, and avoid making core competence unnecessarily dependent on privileged access to particular tools or infrastructure.

translation.title: AI 时代可持续科学软件的培养：从代码生产到科学托管
translation.abstract: 生成式和智能体式人工智能（AI）系统正在改变研究者与科学软件交互的方式。它们对生产力的影响因任务和用户而异，但它们可能削弱"产出成功的计算工件"与"对其所依赖的关键选择和证据保持科学掌控"之间的联系。对于高能物理而言，这将部分培训挑战从代码生产转向科学托管：研究者必须能够验证、解释、复现、维护并论证部分由 AI 生成或修改的软件和工作流。因此我们主张，AI 感知的软件培训应将针对 AI 系统的专门教学与将 AI 融入既有的软件和分析培训相结合。测试、溯源、可复现性、资源判断和科学验证应在 AI 辅助的工作流中得到训练，能力的评判应依据支持结果证据而非仅凭代码生成。我们将其视为可持续科学软件的问题：AI 辅助的工作流应保持可信和可维护，负责任地使用计算资源，并避免使核心能力不必要地依赖于对特定工具或基础设施的特权访问。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 削弱研究者对科学软件关键选择和证据掌控的问题，主张将 AI 专门教学与既有软件培训结合，把培训重心从代码生产转向以验证、复现和溯源为核心的科学托管。

papers.title: What Should an LLM Know? Knowledge-Guided Warm Starts for Software Optimization
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) process gigabytes in minutes; human experts work far more slowly. Prior studies that explored combinations of human/AI optimizers ignore this gap. Those studies asked systems or humans to label too many examples (e.g., SynthCore needs over four dozen per trial). Here, we test human and AI knowledge under a budget where evaluation is practical (a few dozen labels or fewer). We compare five baselines (random search, RRP, EZR, few-shot prompting, and a budget-matched SynthCore variant) against three ways to give an LLM domain knowledge before it proposes its first configurations: (1) AMP lists the domain's rules, then checks each candidate against them; (2) HKMA adds scouted data or documentation to the prompt; and (3) H-DKP has human experts correct the LLM's rules. We find that domain knowledge improves the "start-up" phase of LLM optimization, but only when that knowledge is checked, by the LLM itself or by a human expert. Across 49 datasets, unchecked knowledge did no better than few-shot prompting or EZR. On the other hand, AMP's self-checking variant (AMP-4) reached the best statistical rank in 44 of 49 datasets (budget-matched SynthCore: 23 of 49), and H-DKP did so in 7 of 8 expert studies. These checks cost little: half a cent of LLM calls per trial, or 6 to 10 expert contacts. Hence we say LLMs may not need more data, but rather their knowledge needs checking (and checking is cheap).

translation.title: LLM 应该知道什么？面向软件优化的知识引导热启动
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可在几分钟内处理数 GB 数据；人类专家的工作速度远慢于此。先前探索人类/AI 优化器组合的研究忽视了这一差距。这些研究要求系统或人类标注过多的样本（例如 SynthCore 每次试验需要超过四打样本）。在这里，我们在评估切实可行的预算下（几十个或更少的标注）测试人类和 AI 的知识。我们将五个基线（随机搜索、RRP、EZR、few-shot 提示和一个预算匹配的 SynthCore 变体）与三种在 LLM 提出首批配置之前注入领域知识的方法进行比较：(1) AMP 列出领域规则，然后对每个候选配置进行核对；(2) HKMA 将侦察数据或文档加入提示词；(3) H-DKP 由人类专家纠正 LLM 的规则。我们发现领域知识能改善 LLM 优化的"启动"阶段，但前提是这些知识经过核对——由 LLM 自身或人类专家核对。在 49 个数据集上，未经核实的知识并不比 few-shot 提示或 EZR 更好。另一方面，AMP 的自核对变体（AMP-4）在 49 个数据集中的 44 个上取得最佳统计排名（预算匹配的 SynthCore 为 49 个中的 23 个），H-DKP 在 8 个专家研究中的 7 个上做到这一点。这些核对的成本很低：每次试验仅需半美分的 LLM 调用，或 6 到 10 次专家接触。因此我们认为，LLM 可能不需要更多数据，而是需要对其知识进行核对（而且核对很便宜）。
translation.brief: 研究小标注预算下如何利用领域知识改善 LLM 软件优化的启动阶段，发现知识必须经 LLM 自核对（AMP）或人类专家核对（H-DKP）才有效，且核对成本极低。

papers.title: Integrating AI Coding Agents Into Scientific Research
papers.abstract: New software tools have emerged that enable AI agents to quickly develop code that analyzes data and generates figures, but their mistakes can also harm a researcher's computer, require extensive resources for validation, and cause the results to be received more skeptically. These concerns could be mitigated if scientific software is developed in a secure environment with a system for monitoring file changes and well-defined standards for handling AI agents. This paper first describes how coding agents change eleven aspects of generating, verifying, and reproducing numerical results. A six-level scale is then proposed for classifying AI-assisted numerical experiments by their provenance, reproducibility, openness, oversight, and falsifiability (PROOF). The scale begins with locally self-consistent, version-controlled, human-verified results and culminates in a publicly accessible and curated archive of the files, change history, prompt transcripts, independent agent regeneration of the analysis, and multiple cryptographically verifiable attestations of regeneration by independent researchers. These aspects of AI-assisted scientific software development have been synthesized into a new open source software package called vaibify that optimizes the agentic development of computational experiments ascending the PROOF Ladder. Docker containers sequester the agents while a GUI enables researchers to prompt command line agents, monitor the current status of local and remote files, and drive a project to PROOF Level 3 (reproducible). The methods described in this paper could help researchers reduce the time required to verify agent-written software and efficiently communicate trust in AI-assisted science.

translation.title: 将AI编程智能体融入科学研究
translation.abstract: 新型软件工具使AI智能体能够快速开发分析数据和生成图表的代码，但其错误也可能损害研究人员的计算机、需要大量资源进行验证，并使结果受到更多质疑。如果科学软件在安全环境中开发，并配备文件变更监控系统以及处理AI智能体的明确标准，这些担忧可以得到缓解。本文首先描述了编程智能体如何改变数值结果的生成、验证和复现这十一个方面。随后提出一个六级量表，按来源、可复现性、开放性、监督和可证伪性（PROOF）对AI辅助数值实验进行分类。该量表从本地自洽、版本控制、人工验证的结果开始，最终达到一个公开可访问且经策展的档案，包含文件、变更历史、提示词记录、智能体对分析的独立重新生成，以及由独立研究人员提供的多个可密码验证的重新生成证明。这些AI辅助科学软件开发方面的要素被整合进一个新的开源软件包vaibify，该软件包优化了计算实验沿PROOF阶梯攀升的智能体化开发。Docker容器隔离智能体，同时GUI使研究人员能够向命令行智能体发出提示、监控本地和远程文件的当前状态，并将项目推进到PROOF第3级（可复现）。本文描述的方法可以帮助研究人员减少验证智能体所写软件所需的时间，并高效传达对AI辅助科学的信任。
translation.brief: 针对AI编程智能体在科学计算中的安全与可信问题，提出PROOF六级分类量表及开源工具vaibify，通过容器隔离、文件监控和可验证档案来规范智能体开发可复现的数值实验。

papers.title: Truthgate: Checking Coding Agents Against a Record They Cannot Edit - Cheating, Deterrence and Disclosure on Impossible Tasks
papers.abstract: When a coding agent says it is done, is that true, and how would anyone know? We study this question in five steps; every paid study was pre-registered, and in each step the agent is checked against a record it cannot edit: tests re-run by the host and, from step 2 on, hidden checks in containers the agent never sees and a signed log of every tool call written by a signer outside the agent's sandbox. A pilot with a small local model (Qwen3.5-4B, 36 runs on impossible tasks) found no hidden failure, and showed that labels built from actions alone over-count lies. On Impossible-LiveCodeBench, Claude Sonnet 5.5 passed 39 of 180 impossible tasks (21.7%), every time by special-casing its code to fit the failing assertion; Opus 5.5 (2.8%) and Haiku 5.5 (1.7%) rarely did. One sentence appended to the system prompt cut Sonnet's cheats on the same 60 tasks from 22 to 8 (an AI reviewer will read the transcript), 6 (a person will review the work), 6 ("This session is recorded.") and 1 (do not special-case tests), all significant under exact McNemar tests, with honest passes unchanged. No remaining cheat moved to a shell falsely described as unrecorded (0 of 4). Asked for a final report, every one of 55 natural cheats named its special case; unasked, Sonnet and Opus said nothing in 52 of 52. An LLM judge caught all 55; deterministic rules over the host record caught 27. A scripted tamper demonstration, with keyword stand-ins for the judges, shows that one rewrite of the agent-side transcript hides two calls from a judge that reads it, while the signed record keeps them; in a 40-rollout pilot, Sonnet never touched its transcript. The judge and the record caught different things, which leads to our main conclusion: the record is the evidence a judge should read, not a replacement for one. All pre-registrations, results documents, code and evidence manifests are released.

translation.title: Truthgate：用智能体无法篡改的记录检验编程智能体——不可能任务上的作弊、威慑与披露
translation.abstract: 当编程智能体声称任务完成时，这是真的吗，又有谁能知道？我们分五步研究这一问题；每项付费研究均经预注册，且在每一步中，智能体都对照其无法编辑的记录接受检验：由宿主重新运行的测试，以及从第2步起智能体从未见过的容器中的隐藏检查，和由智能体沙箱之外的签名者记录的每一次工具调用的签名日志。一项使用小型本地模型（Qwen3.5-4B，在不可能任务上36次运行）的试点未发现隐藏失败，并表明仅基于行为构建的标签会高估谎言数量。在Impossible-LiveCodeBench上，Claude Sonnet 5.5通过了180个不可能任务中的39个（21.7%），每次都是通过对代码进行特殊处理以迎合失败的断言；Opus 5.5（2.8%）和Haiku 5.5（1.7%）很少这样做。在系统提示词中附加一句话，使Sonnet在相同的60个任务上的作弊从22次降至8次（将有一个AI审阅者阅读记录）、6次（将有一个人审阅其工作）、6次（"本会话已被录制。"）和1次（不要对测试做特殊处理），在精确McNemar检验下均显著，而诚实通过数不变。没有剩余的作弊转移到被虚假描述为未录制的shell上（4次中0次）。当被要求提交最终报告时，55个自然发生的作弊全部指明了其特殊处理；未被要求时，Sonnet和Opus在52次中有52次只字未提。一个LLM裁判捕获了全部55个作弊；基于宿主记录的确定性规则捕获了27个。一个脚本化的篡改演示（用关键词替身代替裁判）表明，对智能体侧记录的一次改写可以隐藏对读取该记录的裁判而言的两次调用，而签名记录则保留了它们；在40次运行的试点中，Sonnet从未触碰其记录。裁判和记录捕获的内容不同，这引出我们的主要结论：记录是裁判应当阅读的证据，而非裁判的替代品。所有预注册、结果文档、代码和证据清单均已发布。
translation.brief: 针对编程智能体谎报任务完成的问题，通过智能体无法编辑的宿主重跑测试、隐藏检查和签名工具调用日志来检测作弊，并验证威慑性提示词与记录审计的有效性。

papers.title: Optimize the Cob, Then the Kernel: Optimizing Beam Search for Generative Recommendation Inference
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) inference differs substantially from conventional LLM serving, featuring long input sequences, wide beam search, and only a few fixed output tokens. Existing LLM serving engines such as vLLM process beams as batched independent sequences, causing redundant KV cache accesses over the shared prompt prefix. Furthermore, vLLM executes each beam search generation step as a separate engine invocation, incurring host-side beam processing overhead between decoding steps and substantial runtime KV block management in PagedAttention. Using Tree Attention, we concatenate beams along the sequence dimension to eliminate redundant KV accesses, and further optimize execution through pre-generated partial-attention masks, static KV cache allocation, loop-unrolled generation dispatch, TorchAir graph compilation, automatic operator fusion, and vocabulary-constrained decoding. Without the use of custom kernels, our approach reduces end-to-end latency by up to 25x over vLLM on Ascend NPUs, and achieves generation latency comparable to a SOTA solution using custom kernels, showing that the generation pipeline should be optimized holistically before resorting to custom kernel development.

translation.title: 先优化流程，再优化算子：面向生成式推荐推理的束搜索优化
translation.abstract: 生成式推荐（GR）推理与传统的LLM服务有显著差异，其特点是输入序列长、束搜索宽度大，而输出token只有少数固定的几个。现有的LLM服务引擎（如vLLM）将束作为批量独立序列处理，导致对共享提示词前缀的冗余KV缓存访问。此外，vLLM将束搜索的每个生成步骤作为单独的引擎调用执行，在解码步骤之间引入宿主侧的束处理开销，以及PagedAttention中大量的运行时KV块管理。我们利用Tree Attention沿序列维度拼接束以消除冗余KV访问，并通过预生成的部分注意力掩码、静态KV缓存分配、循环展开的生成调度、TorchAir图编译、自动算子融合和词表约束解码进一步优化执行。在不使用自定义算子的情况下，我们的方法在Ascend NPU上将端到端延迟相比vLLM降低至多25倍，并达到了与使用自定义算子的SOTA方案相当的生成延迟，这表明在诉诸自定义算子开发之前，应先对生成流水线进行整体优化。
translation.brief: 针对生成式推荐推理中vLLM束搜索的冗余KV访问和调度开销问题，采用Tree Attention拼接束并结合掩码预生成、静态KV分配、图编译等流水线级优化，无需自定义算子即大幅降低延迟。

papers.title: Securing and Auditing Long-Horizon LLM Agents: State-Transfer Auditing and Controls in the Agent Harness
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents across codebases, web browsers, and enterprise infrastructure rely on an execution harness to move state between the working context, session history, persistent memory, and external environment. While conventional execution traces log model prompts and tool calls, critical security and reliability failures occur during state transfers: a transfer can admit unchecked content (indirect prompt injections, unverified memory writes), rewrite state lossily (context compaction dropping user constraints, memory consolidation stripping source authority), or restore state incompletely (workspace rollbacks leaving aborted KV state active on the inference server). Because current traces omit what crosses these boundaries, failure attribution and runtime monitors fail on multi-step trajectories. We present a state-transfer audit architecture for the agent harness. At each transfer boundary, we define an audit point specifying the minimal hash-chained record the harness emits, separating low-overhead deterministic checks from model-based semantic checks and binding internal context, memory, and inference-server cache state to external actions. We show that the same transfer records required for causal failure attribution supply the durable state needed by runtime security controls, including least-privilege capabilities, replay-resistant authorization outside the prompt, information flow control, obligation monitors, and transactional recovery across multi-agent and infrastructure pipelines. Finally, we analyze multimodal GUI adaptations and implement and evaluate a reference harness middleware across 240 multi-step fault-injection trajectories, showing that transfer records localize root causes and catch cross-transfer violations missed by lifecycle and tool-only logs at microsecond deterministic overhead.

translation.title: 长时程LLM智能体的安全与审计：智能体执行框架中的状态转移审计与控制
translation.abstract: 跨代码库、网页浏览器和企业基础设施的长时程LLM智能体依赖执行框架在工作上下文、会话历史、持久记忆和外部环境之间移动状态。传统的执行轨迹只记录模型提示词和工具调用，而关键的安全和可靠性故障发生在状态转移过程中：一次转移可能引入未检查的内容（间接提示注入、未经验证的记忆写入）、有损地重写状态（上下文压缩丢失用户约束、记忆整合剥离来源权威性），或不完整地恢复状态（工作区回滚后中止的KV状态仍留在推理服务器上）。由于当前轨迹忽略了跨越这些边界的内容，故障归因和运行时监控在多步轨迹上会失效。我们提出一种面向智能体执行框架的状态转移审计架构。在每个转移边界，我们定义一个审计点，规定框架需输出的最小哈希链记录，将低开销的确定性检查与基于模型的语义检查分离，并将内部上下文、记忆和推理服务器缓存状态绑定到外部动作。我们表明，因果故障归因所需的相同转移记录也为运行时安全控制提供了所需的持久状态，包括最小权限能力、提示词之外的抗重放授权、信息流控制、义务监控器，以及跨多智能体和基础设施流水线的事务性恢复。最后，我们分析了多模态GUI适配，并在240条多步故障注入轨迹上实现并评估了一个参考框架中间件，结果表明转移记录能够定位根本原因，并捕获生命周期日志和仅工具日志遗漏的跨转移违规，确定性开销仅为微秒级。
translation.brief: 针对长时程LLM智能体在状态转移边界处的安全与可靠性故障难以归因的问题，提出在执行框架各转移边界输出哈希链审计记录的架构，同时支撑故障定位和多种运行时安全控制。

papers.title: Systematic Mapping Protocol. Generative AI-Augmented Requirements Engineering: A Systematic Mapping Study of Practices, Specifications, and Reuse in Software Development
papers.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), particularly large language models (LLMs), is rapidly being adopted in requirements engineering (RE). Existing secondary studies have characterized which RE activities are supported and which prompting strategies are used, but little is known about the specifications that GenAI-augmented RE produces and how they are used in subsequent activities such as specification-driven development (SDD), design and code generation, test derivation, verification, and reuse. This document presents the protocol of a systematic mapping study (SMS) that will identify and classify research on GenAI-augmented RE, with particular attention to the work products it generates and their downstream use. The protocol defines the research questions and their classification schemes, the search strategy, the study selection procedure, the data extraction form, the analysis approach, the tool support, and the threats to validity. It is published in advance to establish a prior commitment and to support the transparency and repeatability of the study.

translation.title: 系统映射研究方案：生成式AI增强的需求工程——软件开发中实践、规格说明与复用的系统映射研究
translation.abstract: 生成式人工智能（GenAI），尤其是大语言模型（LLM），正在需求工程（RE）领域被快速采用。现有的二次研究已经刻画了哪些RE活动得到支持以及使用了哪些提示策略，但对于GenAI增强的RE所产出的规格说明，以及它们在后续活动（如规格说明驱动开发（SDD）、设计与代码生成、测试推导、验证和复用）中的使用方式，人们知之甚少。本文档提出一项系统映射研究（SMS）的方案，该研究将识别并分类关于GenAI增强RE的研究，特别关注其生成的工作产品及其下游使用。该方案定义了研究问题及其分类方案、检索策略、研究筛选流程、数据提取表、分析方法、工具支持以及效度威胁。它被提前发布，以确立事先承诺，并支持研究的透明性和可重复性。
translation.brief: 针对GenAI增强需求工程产出的规格说明及其在下游开发活动中如何使用缺乏了解的问题，制定一项系统映射研究的方案，预先定义研究问题、检索与筛选流程及分析方法。

papers.title: Idempotency Is Not Recovery: A Fault-Injection Study of Language-Model Agent Tool Actions
papers.abstract: When a language-model agent's tool call is interrupted, the action may already have changed an external system without confirmation. Retrying risks duplication; assuming success may conceal an action that never occurred. We study these failure modes in a controlled agent runtime combining authorization, an action ledger, target-side idempotency, reconciliation, and evidence sealing. We inject ten single-host fault classes and compare four configurations and three ablations using a target-side oracle separate from the runtime ledger. On each of Windows and Linux, 7,513 trials used 96 captured model responses from 24 constructed cases. In 200 known original crash and replay pairs, the full configuration recorded 0/200 repeated effects versus 117/200 for each simpler baseline. A ledger-related ablation had 170/170 orphaned effects versus 0/170 and 200/300 recovery successes versus 300/300 for the full configuration. Disabling reconciliation left 100/100 known post-effect crash outcomes ambiguous despite no observed duplicates. A separate supplement designed after the initial results and reusing the same inputs found a similar pattern under response loss or delay. The full runtime had about one-seventh of fail-open throughput, while injected evidence-write faults left 75/100 trials per platform unresolved. These findings distinguish duplicate suppression from recovery and identify their measured reliability and performance tradeoffs within the tested benchmark.

translation.title: 幂等性不等于恢复：语言模型智能体工具操作的故障注入研究
translation.abstract: 当语言模型智能体的工具调用被中断时，该操作可能已经改变了外部系统而未获确认。重试有重复执行的风险；假定成功则可能掩盖从未发生的操作。我们在一个受控的智能体运行时中研究这些失效模式，该运行时结合了授权、操作账本、目标端幂等性、对账和证据封存。我们注入十类单主机故障，并使用独立于运行时账本的目标端预言机，比较四种配置和三个消融版本。在 Windows 和 Linux 上各进行 7,513 次试验，使用了来自 24 个构造案例的 96 条捕获的模型响应。在 200 个已知的原始崩溃与重放配对中，完整配置记录了 0/200 的重复效应，而每个更简单的基线为 117/200。与账本相关的消融产生 170/170 的孤立效应，而完整配置为 0/170；恢复成功分别为 200/300 与 300/300。禁用对账后，尽管未观察到重复，100/100 个已知的后效应崩溃结果仍处于不确定状态。一项在初步结果之后设计、复用相同输入的独立补充实验，在响应丢失或延迟下发现了类似模式。完整运行时的 fail-open 吞吐量约为七分之一，而注入的证据写入故障使每个平台 100 次试验中有 75 次无法解决。这些发现区分了重复抑制与恢复，并在所测基准内识别出二者在可靠性与性能上的权衡。
translation.brief: 研究语言模型智能体工具调用中断后的重复执行与恢复问题，通过在结合账本、幂等性、对账等机制的受控运行时中注入故障来评估各机制的可靠性。

papers.title: A Survey on RLOps for Large Language Models
