papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become increasingly important for improving the reasoning, instruction-following, and task-solving capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, scaling RL training exposes failures in distributed execution, feedback computation, and learning dynamics that can waste computational resources, slow training, and undermine model improvements. These challenges have motivated a growing body of techniques for LLM RLOps, which manages the efficiency and reliability of operations throughout the LLM reinforcement learning training lifecycle. Despite growing interest, these techniques remain scattered across research areas, with limited synthesis of their operational roles and interactions. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic survey of LLM RLOps methods. We organize existing approaches into five stages: Training Setup, Experience Collection, Reward Computation, Policy Optimization, and Model Evaluation. Within each stage, we examine operational concerns, management techniques, and evaluation evidence. Building on this taxonomy, we identify open challenges and future directions in training process observability, cross-stage coordination, generalizable RLOps, multi-run management, and RLOps for recursive self-improvement. These directions extend operational management from individual training runs to diverse training settings, shared infrastructure, and successive improvement cycles. We maintain a GitHub repository indexing relevant papers and open resources at this https URL.

translation.title: 大语言模型 RLOps 综述
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）在提升大语言模型（LLM）的推理、指令遵循和任务求解能力方面日益重要。然而，扩展 RL 训练会暴露分布式执行、反馈计算和学习动态中的故障，这些故障会浪费计算资源、拖慢训练并损害模型改进。这些挑战催生了大量 LLM RLOps 技术，用于管理 LLM 强化学习训练全生命周期中运营的效率与可靠性。尽管关注度不断上升，这些技术仍分散在各个研究领域，对其运营角色和相互作用的综合梳理有限。为弥合这一差距，我们对 LLM RLOps 方法进行了系统性综述。我们将现有方法组织为五个阶段：训练准备、经验收集、奖励计算、策略优化和模型评估。在每个阶段内，我们考察运营关注点、管理技术和评估证据。基于该分类体系，我们指出了训练过程可观测性、跨阶段协调、可泛化的 RLOps、多运行管理以及面向递归自我改进的 RLOps 等开放挑战与未来方向。这些方向将运营管理从单次训练运行扩展到多样化训练设置、共享基础设施和持续改进循环。我们在 GitHub 仓库中维护相关论文和开放资源的索引，见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 强化学习训练运营缺乏系统梳理的问题，提出按训练准备、经验收集、奖励计算、策略优化和模型评估五阶段组织的 RLOps 分类综述。

papers.title: Prioritize, Don't Decide: What We Learned Auditing a Deployed Human-in-the-Loop CV Sorter
papers.abstract: A single academic vacancy can draw hundreds of applications, and the first screening round consumes most of a committee's time. We describe a CV Priority Sorter deployed at a national platform for academic vacancies and integrated with its vacancy database. It proposes a reading order for a pile of CVs and leaves every decision to the committee, pairing a frozen multilingual transformer encoder with a per-session linear model that retrains after each label and is discarded when the session ends. It works: on a pool of 300 synthetic CVs, a committee reading in the tool's order reaches 95% of the relevant candidates after half the pile, where an arbitrary order needs almost all of it. This paper is about what we found when we audited that claim, rather than about the system itself. Three findings changed the product. The pool turned out to be sortable by document length alone, which makes precision-style metrics on it uninformative; regenerating it under a shared length budget removes that shortcut and leaves the reading-depth result standing. The four-level agreement score such systems report, ours included, is a binary probability cut at fixed thresholds, so it follows the classifier's confidence rather than its ranking and falls as labels accumulate. And uncertainty sampling, the obvious way to implement a "suggest the next CV" button, leaves model quality intact but raises the committee's total reading load above the no-label baseline, because the CVs it asks about are the ones that would otherwise be skipped. A fourth result shows where to look next: a hosted LLM embedding model lifts zero-label ordinal discrimination from 0.66 to 0.80 under length control, then stops mattering once the session model has two dozen labels; a local cross-encoder matches that cold-start gain without sending data out. We report the fixes each finding forced.

translation.title: 排序而非决策：审计一个已部署的人在回路简历筛选器的经验
translation.abstract: 一个学术职位空缺可能收到数百份申请，而第一轮筛选消耗委员会大部分时间。我们描述了一个部署在国家学术职位平台并与职位数据库集成的简历优先级排序器。它为一堆简历提出阅读顺序，而将所有决策留给委员会，采用冻结的多语言 transformer 编码器配合一个会话级线性模型，该模型在每次获得标签后重新训练并在会话结束时丢弃。它确实有效：在 300 份合成简历的池中，按工具给出的顺序阅读的委员会读完一半即可触达 95% 的相关候选人，而任意顺序几乎需要读完全部。本文关注的是我们审计这一结论时的发现，而非系统本身。三个发现改变了产品。首先，该简历池仅凭文档长度即可排序，使其上的 precision 类指标失去意义；在统一长度预算下重新生成简历池可消除该捷径，并使阅读深度结论依然成立。其次，此类系统（包括我们的）报告的四级一致性评分实际上是固定阈值下的二元概率切分，因此它跟随分类器的置信度而非排序质量，且随标签积累而下降。第三，不确定性采样——实现"推荐下一份简历"按钮的显而易见方式——虽保持模型质量不变，却使委员会的总阅读负担高于无标签基线，因为它询问的正是原本会被跳过的简历。第四个结果指明了下一步方向：一个托管 LLM 嵌入模型在长度控制下将零标签序数判别力从 0.66 提升至 0.80，但一旦会话模型积累了约二十多个标签便不再起作用；本地 cross-encoder 在不外发数据的情况下达到相同的冷启动增益。我们报告了每个发现所催生的修复措施。
translation.brief: 审计一个已部署的简历优先排序系统，发现并修复了长度捷径、评分机制缺陷和不确定性采样增加阅读负担等问题。

papers.title: TRACE-MAS: Diagnosing and Repairing Collaboration Failures in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on not only individual agent behaviors but also the interactions that connect agents, including message exchanges and task dependencies. Existing MAS safeguards mainly perform agent-level anomaly detection, which becomes insufficient when failures originate from agent interactions and detected anomalies do not necessarily reveal their true sources. To address this limitation, we propose \textbf{TRACE-MAS}, a finer-grained framework for diagnosing and repairing MAS failures. TRACE-MAS learns normal collaborative execution patterns from benign trajectories and detects deviations in agent state changes, message transitions, and task dependency evolutions. It further identifies responsible execution elements through source-aware attribution and selects minimal interventions to restore collaboration while preserving task-critical capabilities. Experiments on five MAS benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE-MAS significantly improves root-cause localization accuracy by \textbf{60.2}\% and achieves consistent gains in task recovery over strong MAS safeguards.

translation.title: TRACE-MAS：诊断与修复多智能体系统中的协作失败
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的多智能体系统（MAS）不仅依赖单个智能体的行为，还依赖连接各智能体的交互，包括消息交换和任务依赖。现有 MAS 防护手段主要进行智能体级异常检测，当故障源于智能体交互时便不再足够，且检测到的异常不一定能揭示其真正来源。针对这一局限，我们提出 TRACE-MAS，一个更细粒度的 MAS 故障诊断与修复框架。TRACE-MAS 从良性轨迹中学习正常协作执行模式，并检测智能体状态变化、消息传递和任务依赖演化中的偏差。它进一步通过来源感知归因识别负有责任的执行元素，并选择最小干预来恢复协作，同时保留任务关键能力。在五个 MAS 基准上的实验表明，TRACE-MAS 将根因定位准确率显著提升 60.2%，并在任务恢复方面相对强 MAS 防护手段取得一致增益。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统中源于交互的协作失败难以定位的问题，提出 TRACE-MAS 框架，通过学习正常协作模式检测偏差并进行来源归因与最小干预修复。

papers.title: Where the Tokens Go: Heat, Entropy and Error in Agentic Coding
papers.abstract: Coding agents are billed by the token, yet software engineering says nothing about what a token actually buys. Here we introduce a theory of software thermodynamics. The theory draws analogues from classical and stochastic thermodynamics, extends them, and applies them to modern agentic coding. We count the tokens an agent generates as its cost and divide that cost into work and heat. The test suite acts as a software Maxwell's daemon that judges every coding change. We test the theory with an analogue of the experiments in which a single molecule is pulled open and let fold again: an agent makes a change to a repository (coding) and then undoes it (uncoding), many times over, and we count the tokens of every model call. The cycle returns the requested edits to where they began, with each direction started from a stored reference tree, and the spread of its cost over repeated cycles defines a software temperature, which rose with the sampling temperature of the model. About 80 per cent of the tokens of a successful run are generated in model calls that leave the requested change where it was, and we call these tokens heat. The free energy of a change, which we estimate by analogy with the equality of Jarzynski, is 14 to 22 per cent of the mean cost of a successful coding run. Coding costs 1.1 to 1.5 times as much as uncoding. The daemon is imperfect: the verdict of a test suite varies with its environment, and a suite that accepts a broken change has a cost in tokens. The practical implication of the proposed theory could be new tools for analysing and optimising coding agents through the lens of thermodynamics.

translation.title: Token 去了哪里：智能体编程中的热、熵与误差
translation.abstract: 编程智能体按 token 计费，然而软件工程从未说明一个 token 究竟买到了什么。在此我们提出软件热力学理论。该理论借鉴经典热力学和随机热力学的类比，加以扩展并应用于现代智能体编程。我们将智能体生成的 token 计为其成本，并将该成本划分为功与热。测试套件充当软件麦克斯韦妖，评判每一次代码变更。我们通过一个类似单分子拉伸再折叠实验的方式来检验该理论：智能体对仓库做出一次变更（coding）然后撤销它（uncoding），反复多次，并统计每次模型调用的 token 数。该循环将所请求的编辑恢复到起点，每个方向都从存储的参考树开始，其成本在重复循环上的散布定义了软件温度，该温度随模型采样温度升高而上升。一次成功运行中约 80% 的 token 产生于未使所请求变更发生改变的模型调用，我们称这些 token 为热。通过类比 Jarzynski 等式估计的变更自由能，为成功编程运行平均成本的 14% 至 22%。编程的成本是撤销编程的 1.1 至 1.5 倍。麦克斯韦妖并不完美：测试套件的判定随环境而变，接受错误变更的套件会付出 token 代价。该理论的实践意义可能在于通过热力学视角分析和优化编程智能体的新工具。
translation.brief: 提出软件热力学理论，将编程智能体的 token 成本划分为功与热，并通过 coding-uncoding 循环实验量化其热力学量。

papers.title: QDA: Closed-Loop LLM Quantization Design with Agents
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization is the standard way to serve large language models at low cost. However, the best quantization recipe differs across models and precisions. As a result, experts must redesign it for every new model, which is time-consuming and often sub-optimal. Fortunately, an LLM agent can take over this design by refining the recipe over rounds of building and evaluating candidates, so that more rounds lead to better recipes. However, evaluating one quantized reasoning model takes tens of GPU-hours, and combining methods from different codebases means porting each to the new architecture by hand. We present QDA, a system in which an agent designs the recipe for each model and precision. To make evaluation fast, QDA scores each candidate in minutes by its output KL divergence from the original model on reasoning traces that the agent never sees, and checks promising ones with long generations to catch failures such as repetition loops. To make building fast, QDA provides a library of public PTQ methods that are compatible with one another and with new model architectures. Across four reasoning models, QDA improves accuracy over the strongest public recipe by 0.9, 1.4 and 2.2 percentage points on average at W4A16, W4A8 and W3A16, using 64 GPU-hours per search. On the 320B-parameter MoE model GLM-5.3-Flash at NVFP4 W4A4, it recovers 98.3% of the FP8 model's accuracy, against 96.9% for the best vendor checkpoint. Every QDA checkpoint also runs on existing serving kernels with no inference overhead. We will release the library, the evaluator and the harness.

translation.title: QDA：基于智能体的闭环 LLM 量化设计
translation.abstract: 训练后量化（PTQ）是以低成本部署大语言模型的标准方式。然而，最佳量化配方因模型和精度而异，专家必须为每个新模型重新设计，既耗时又往往非最优。幸运的是，LLM 智能体可以通过多轮构建和评估候选方案来迭代优化配方，轮次越多配方越好。但评估一个量化推理模型需要数十 GPU 小时，且组合不同代码库的方法需要手工将每个方法移植到新架构。我们提出 QDA，一个由智能体为每个模型和精度设计配方的系统。为加速评估，QDA 通过计算候选方案在智能体从未见过的推理轨迹上与原始模型的输出 KL 散度，在几分钟内完成打分，并用长生成检查有希望的候选以捕捉重复循环等失败。为加速构建，QDA 提供了一个相互兼容且兼容新模型架构的公开 PTQ 方法库。在四个推理模型上，QDA 在 W4A16、W4A8 和 W3A16 下平均比最强公开配方提升 0.9、1.4 和 2.2 个百分点，每次搜索仅用 64 GPU 小时。在 320B 参数的 MoE 模型 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 NVFP4 W4A4 下，它恢复了 FP8 模型 98.3% 的精度，而最佳厂商检查点仅为 96.9%。QDA 的每个检查点都可在现有服务内核上运行，无推理开销。我们将发布该库、评估器和工具链。
translation.brief: 针对不同模型和精度需人工重新设计量化配方的问题，提出由 LLM 智能体通过快速 KL 散度评估与兼容方法库进行闭环迭代搜索量化配方的系统 QDA。

papers.title: Tracking Representations in LLM Reasoning Traces for Iterated Games
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents achieve state-of-the-art performance across domains through chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Despite their ubiquitous use, little is understood about the relationship between the externalized trace and the model's actual computation. We address this by investigating how LLM agents make decisions in iterative games with incomplete information. Using a series of mechanistic interpretability techniques, we find that the model forms and iteratively revises an internal representation of the game throughout the CoT. Once the model prematurely commits to an incorrect belief, it rarely recovers. This failure is manifested in both the literal trace and the layer activations. Ultimately, as multi-agent systems are more prevalent, our work opens the door to a more focused diagnosis of their strategic reasoning errors. For illustrative purposes, we offer an interactive visualizer of our methodology on selected sample traces at this https URL

translation.title: 在迭代博弈中追踪 LLM 推理轨迹中的表征
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过思维链（CoT）推理在多个领域取得最先进性能。尽管 CoT 被广泛使用，人们对外化轨迹与模型实际计算之间的关系知之甚少。我们通过研究 LLM 智能体在不完全信息迭代博弈中的决策方式来解决这一问题。利用一系列机制可解释性技术，我们发现模型在整个 CoT 过程中形成并迭代修正对博弈的内部表征。一旦模型过早地固守错误信念，它很少能恢复。这种失败同时体现在字面轨迹和层激活中。最终，随着多智能体系统日益普及，我们的工作为更有针对性地诊断其策略推理错误打开了大门。为便于说明，我们在该网址提供了针对选定样本轨迹的方法交互式可视化工具。
translation.brief: 针对 CoT 轨迹与模型实际计算关系不明的问题，用机制可解释性技术研究 LLM 在不完全信息迭代博弈中的内部博弈表征及其错误信念固化现象。

papers.title: Verifiably Safe Decentralized Control via Event-Triggered Topology Switching
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a decentralized event-triggered topology-switching protocol for multi-agent systems under estimation uncertainty. We consider an intermittent communication setting in which each agent switches between connected and disconnected modes and makes communication decisions using locally computable certificates, while the closed-loop state is required to remain safe. The proposed protocol follows a safety-driven triggering principle in which agents reconnect before their certificates reach the safety boundary and disconnect only after recovering to a stricter bound below the safety limit. Our design enables intermittent connectivity while maintaining the estimation error within a certified safety bound and excluding Zeno behavior. We evaluate the proposed protocol on a quadruple-tank example, showing that it keeps all tank deviations within the safety bound while allowing agents to remain disconnected for most of the run.

translation.title: 通过事件触发拓扑切换实现可验证安全的分散式控制
translation.abstract: 本文提出一种面向估计不确定性下多智能体系统的分散式事件触发拓扑切换协议。我们考虑间歇通信场景：每个智能体在连接与断开模式之间切换，并使用本地可计算的证书做出通信决策，同时要求闭环状态保持安全。所提协议遵循安全驱动的触发原则：智能体在证书到达安全边界之前重新连接，仅在恢复到低于安全限值的更严格界限后才断开。我们的设计在实现间歇连接的同时，将估计误差保持在经认证的安全界限内并排除 Zeno 行为。我们在四水箱示例上评估了该协议，结果表明它使所有水箱偏差保持在安全界限内，同时允许智能体在大部分运行时间内保持断开。
translation.brief: 针对估计不确定性下多智能体间歇通信的安全控制问题，提出基于本地安全证书的事件触发拓扑切换协议，保证状态安全、误差有界且无 Zeno 行为。

papers.title: Reliability by Architecture: Agentic Workflows for Validated Multi-Physics Simulation from Natural Language
papers.abstract: Preparing, executing, and validating strongly coupled multi-physics simulations require expert time. Agentic workflows use large language models (LLMs) to coordinate them from natural-language descriptions, but reliability requires checks of physical consistency and fidelity to the problem description. Our agentic harness implements explicit task allocation: LLMs interpret user requests and simulator diagnostics, generate input components not covered by predefined construction rules, and propose repairs, while deterministic routines construct supported components and check inputs, edits, and results. We evaluate CO2-storage problems using the multi-physics simulator GEOS, from compositional flow to flow-poromechanics with frictional fault contact. In 80 attempts on two flow problems, grounding raises the proportion of structurally valid inputs from 5/20 to 20/20, but acceptance reaches 20/20 only with complete rule-based input preparation. With identical inputs, local repairs correct three seeded defects while preserving valid inputs. Supporting tests identify simulations passing physics checks despite differing from the problem description or reference results.

translation.title: 架构即可靠性：从自然语言到经验证多物理场仿真的智能体工作流
translation.abstract: 准备、执行和验证强耦合多物理场仿真需要专家时间。智能体工作流使用大语言模型（LLM）根据自然语言描述来协调这些工作，但可靠性需要对物理一致性和对问题描述的忠实度进行检查。我们的智能体框架实现了显式任务分配：LLM 解释用户请求和仿真器诊断，生成预定义构建规则未覆盖的输入组件，并提出修复方案；而确定性例程构建受支持的组件并检查输入、编辑和结果。我们使用多物理场仿真器 GEOS 评估 CO2 储存问题，涵盖从组分流动到带摩擦断层接触的流动-孔隙力学。在两个流动问题上的 80 次尝试中，接地（grounding）将结构有效输入的比例从 5/20 提高到 20/20，但只有在完整的基于规则的输入准备下接受率才达到 20/20。在相同输入下，局部修复纠正了三个植入缺陷，同时保持有效输入不变。支持性测试识别出那些通过物理检查但与问题描述或参考结果不符的仿真。
translation.brief: 针对从自然语言生成强耦合多物理场仿真输入的可靠性问题，提出 LLM 与确定性规则例程分工协作、并带物理一致性验证的智能体工作流框架。

papers.title: GUARD: Stabilizing Recursive Self-Improvement with Regret Guidance
papers.abstract: Autonomous AI agents pair a frozen base model with an editable harness of prompts, skills, tool rules, and memory. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) adapts this harness from experience without weight updates, yet self-editing without external graders often backfires: reflection and scalar scores conflate what an edit newly broke with what remains unsolved, causing local regressions, skill forgetting, and memory bloat. We introduce GUARD (Grader-free Unsupervised Environment Design [UED] with Adaptive Rule Distillation), a closed-loop framework for reference-free continual harness evolution. Our key insight is to decompose each task into pre-execution self-checks and guide harness updates via directional regret. Each round grades trajectories against these checks, pinning mastered rules while prioritizing newly broken behaviors, and selects among parallel candidate edits by critic-free group-relative fitness. A Soft-HURT gate then promotes an edit only when gains outweigh regressions, scoping specialized fixes to prevent over-triggering and guaranteeing non-regression on its gated buffer. At test time, one frozen harness runs in a single pass. Across benchmarks on memory, skill evolution, continual task streams, and domain reasoning, GUARD consistently improves performance without catastrophic forgetting or memory pollution while substantially cutting deployment token usage.

translation.title: GUARD：基于遗憾引导的递归自我改进稳定化
translation.abstract: 自主 AI 智能体将冻结的基础模型与可编辑的框架（harness，包括提示、技能、工具规则和记忆）相结合。递归自我改进（RSI）无需权重更新即可从经验中调整该框架，但缺乏外部评分器的自我编辑往往适得其反：反思和标量分数将编辑新破坏的内容与尚未解决的内容混为一谈，导致局部回退、技能遗忘和记忆膨胀。我们提出 GUARD（无评分器的自适应规则蒸馏无监督环境设计 [UED]），一个免参考的持续框架演化闭环框架。我们的关键洞察是将每个任务分解为执行前自检，并通过方向性遗憾引导框架更新。每轮根据这些检查对轨迹进行评分，固定已掌握的规则，同时优先处理新破坏的行为，并通过无评论家的组相对适应度在并行候选编辑中进行选择。随后 Soft-HURT 门控仅在收益超过回退时才采纳编辑，将专门修复限定范围以防止过度触发，并保证在其门控缓冲上不发生回退。测试时，单个冻结框架单次运行即可。在记忆、技能演化、持续任务流和领域推理的基准上，GUARD 持续提升性能且无灾难性遗忘或记忆污染，同时大幅降低部署 token 用量。
translation.brief: 针对无外部评分器时智能体自我编辑导致回退、遗忘和记忆膨胀的问题，提出 GUARD，通过任务自检分解与方向性遗憾引导的闭环框架演化机制实现稳定的递归自我改进。

papers.title: Diagnostic Accuracy and Navigation Behavior of Vision-Language Model Agents Reading Emergency CT and MRI Examinations
papers.abstract: Purpose. To evaluate the diagnostic accuracy and image navigation behavior of vision-language model (VLM) agents under varying exploration strategies. Materials and Methods. In this retrospective study, six VLMs read 100 emergency CT and MRI examinations published in a public archive (March 2025-August 2026) under four conditions (free navigation, navigation from a key slice, and all slices or key slices in a single request), twice each (4800 runs). Nine radiologists read 30 of those cases. A large language model judge validated against two radiologists graded the answers. Conditions were compared with generalized estimating equations clustered by case. Results. Pooled accuracy was lowest under free navigation (32.6%; 391/1200), followed by navigation from a key slice (37.9%; 455/1200; P = .003), and highest with all slices (42.2%; 506/1200) or key slices (42.5%; 510/1200) in one request (both P < .001). On the 30 cases read by radiologists, freely navigating models were correct in 30.0% of runs (108/360) versus 77.0% for radiologists (208/270; P < .001). Models formed a first hypothesis after a median of 10.8% of the slices and kept it in 63.1% of runs (755/1196); final answers were correct in 12.4% of runs after a wrong first hypothesis (110/885) versus 90.4% after a right one (281/311; P < .001). Median stated confidence in the final answers was 90%, whereas 38.9% of them were correct (1861/4778). Conclusion. Across all exploration strategies, VLM agents remained far less accurate than radiologists. They adopted an early hypothesis and usually kept it, seldom correcting a wrong one.

translation.title: 视觉-语言模型智能体阅读急诊CT和MRI检查的诊断准确率与导航行为
translation.abstract: 目的：评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）智能体在不同探索策略下的诊断准确率和图像导航行为。材料与方法：在这项回顾性研究中，六个VLM在四种条件下（自由导航、从关键切片开始导航、单次请求提供全部切片或关键切片）阅读公开档案中发布的100例急诊CT和MRI检查（2025年3月至2026年8月），每种条件各进行两次（共4800次运行）。九名放射科医师阅读其中30例。一个经两名放射科医师验证的大语言模型裁判对答案进行评分。各条件通过按病例聚类的广义估计方程进行比较。结果：自由导航下的合并准确率最低（32.6%；391/1200），其次是从关键切片开始导航（37.9%；455/1200；P = .003），单次请求提供全部切片（42.2%；506/1200）或关键切片（42.5%；510/1200）时最高（均P < .001）。在放射科医师阅读的30例病例上，自由导航的模型正确率为30.0%（108/360），而放射科医师为77.0%（208/270；P < .001）。模型在阅读中位数10.8%的切片后形成首个假设，并在63.1%的运行中保持该假设（755/1196）；首个假设错误时最终答案正确率为12.4%（110/885），而首个假设正确时为90.4%（281/311；P < .001）。最终答案的中位自述置信度为90%，但其中仅38.9%正确（1861/4778）。结论：在所有探索策略下，VLM智能体的准确率仍远低于放射科医师。它们会形成早期假设并通常坚持该假设，很少纠正错误的假设。
translation.brief: 该研究评估VLM智能体阅读急诊CT/MRI的诊断准确率，通过比较自由导航、关键切片导航和单次请求等不同图像探索策略下的表现，发现其准确率远低于放射科医师且倾向于固守早期错误假设。

papers.title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs
papers.abstract: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent's next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent's large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer's reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.

translation.title: SpecLook：通过推测观察位置实现快速可靠的智能体多模态大语言模型
translation.abstract: 以图像思考的智能体多模态大语言模型（MLLM）将推理与放大工具调用交织进行。然而，这种顺序循环速度慢，且其答案没有可靠性评分。以往对token、推理步骤或答案的推测仍保留该循环，而答案推测还会接受自信的错误。我们发现该循环大多只增加一个放大步骤，而在大多数数据集划分上，一个小模型在这一步上领先于智能体。我们的关键洞察是推测智能体的下一次观察，与起草的答案不同，观察可以被验证、纠正并用于检验答案。我们提出SpecLook，一个无需训练的推测-验证框架，包含三个层级。小模型起草一个局部观察（glimpse）并据此重新作答，如果答案不变且置信度高，则问题结束。否则，智能体的大模型在不使用工具的情况下验证并纠正该局部观察，并融合两者的答案。只有仍缺乏证据的问题才会到达智能体，且只需一次前向传播（SpecLook-Fast可跳过），因此没有任何问题需要运行该循环。轨迹（trace）无需标签即可为每个答案评分可靠性。在V*、HR-Bench和POPE上的大量实验表明，两者在每个划分上都比所有基线更准确。SpecLook相对DeepEyes-7B和Thyme-RL智能体分别达到87.2%和86.2%的平均准确率，并带来7.7倍和4.7倍的加速；SpecLook-Fast则达到9.9倍和6.3倍。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体MLLM逐步放大观察循环慢且答案缺乏可靠性评分的问题，提出无需训练的SpecLook推测-验证框架，由小模型推测下一步观察并验证答案，从而大幅提升准确率与速度。

papers.title: Encapsulating Reactive Behaviour in Goal-based Plans for Programming BDI Agents
papers.abstract: Reactive behaviour in BDI-based models and architectures adopted in agent programming is typically specified in terms of reactive plans not bound to any specific goal. In this paper, we present and discuss an extension of the plan model used in BDI programming languages in which goal-based plans encapsulate both proactive and reactive behaviour. This brings important benefits both to the practice of agent programming and in supporting agent reasoning at runtime. The paper first introduces the model formally, abstracting away from particular programming languages. The approach is then evaluated through concrete implementations based on two existing agent programming platforms, namely Jason and ASTRA. The paper reports on experiments showing that the approach provides for elegant programming and can also be efficient.

translation.title: 在基于目标的计划中封装反应式行为以编程BDI智能体
translation.abstract: 在智能体编程采用的基于BDI的模型和架构中，反应式行为通常以不绑定任何特定目标的反应式计划来指定。在本文中，我们提出并讨论对BDI编程语言中计划模型的一种扩展，其中基于目标的计划同时封装主动行为和反应行为。这为智能体编程实践以及支持运行时的智能体推理带来了重要益处。本文首先以形式化方式引入该模型，不依赖特定编程语言。随后通过基于两个现有智能体编程平台（即Jason和ASTRA）的具体实现对该方法进行评估。论文报告的实验表明，该方法提供了优雅的编程方式，并且也可以是高效的。
translation.brief: 该论文解决BDI智能体编程中反应式计划与目标脱节的问题，提出将主动与反应行为统一封装在基于目标的计划中的扩展模型，并在Jason和ASTRA平台上实现验证。

papers.title: MedHarness: A Unified Budgeted Runtime for Reliable Medical Imaging Agents
papers.abstract: Medical imaging agents already return answers on heterogeneous imaging surfaces, yet deployment still faces a limited verification budget where each wrong accept can harm clinical trust. When a thin check and a deeper evidence pass disagree on the same case, deciding when to stop, open more evidence, repair, or reject without a shared controller remains ill-posed. Tool-using workflows often lock a surface-specific evidence order per dataset, or a private always-open full-depth verification path; those pipelines stay costly, leave many wrong accepts, and cannot share one controller across modalities. We present MedHarness, a registered multi-surface runtime reliability layer that reformulates post-answer control as shared decision-object attachment after a proposer's initial prediction. Under Shared Decision Object, Minimum-Sufficient Verification, and Intermediate Repair, one shared policy with surface recipe adapters lets a new imaging surface join the same stop / open-evidence / repair / reject controller by recipe registration. On a 512-case live pool, MedHarness cuts wrong accepts versus a full-verification baseline by about 47% and raises accepted accuracy to 83.2% vs. 72.9% at 86.1% coverage versus full release under that baseline. On a failure-enriched multi-surface stress ranking, the same controller cuts estimated remote service calls per case by about 71% versus that baseline under a matched context-load setting. A held-out three-surface check and an alternate language-model transfer keep the same control ordering. The code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: MedHarness：面向可靠医学影像智能体的统一预算化运行时
translation.abstract: 医学影像智能体已经能够在异构影像界面上返回答案，但部署仍面临验证预算有限的局面，其中每一次错误接受都可能损害临床信任。当浅层检查与更深入的证据核查在同一病例上不一致时，在没有共享控制器的情况下决定何时停止、打开更多证据、修复或拒绝，仍然是一个不适定问题。使用工具的工作流通常为每个数据集锁定特定界面的证据顺序，或采用私有的始终开启的全深度验证路径；这些流水线成本高昂，留下许多错误接受，且无法跨模态共享一个控制器。我们提出MedHarness，一个注册式的多界面运行时可靠性层，它将答案后控制重新表述为在提议者初始预测之后附加共享决策对象。在共享决策对象、最小充分验证和中间修复的原则下，一个带有界面配方适配器的共享策略，使新的影像界面可以通过配方注册加入同一个停止/打开证据/修复/拒绝控制器。在一个512例的实时病例池上，MedHarness相比全验证基线将错误接受减少约47%，并将接受病例的准确率从72.9%提升至83.2%，覆盖率相对该基线的全量放行为86.1%。在一个故障富集的多界面压力排名中，在匹配的上下文负载设置下，同一控制器相比该基线将每例估计的远程服务调用减少约71%。一项留出的三界面检查和另一种语言模型的迁移保持了相同的控制排序。代码可在该https URL获取。
translation.brief: 该论文解决医学影像智能体在有限验证预算下错误接受难以控制的问题，提出MedHarness统一运行时，通过共享决策对象和最小充分验证策略，用单一控制器跨模态执行停止/打开证据/修复/拒绝决策。

papers.title: ACaM: Automated Capability Modeling for Agentic AI Security
papers.abstract: In agentic AI systems, an LLM invokes tools that hold standing access to credentials, private data, filesystems, and external services. Such agents are increasingly deployed without an answer to a basic question: what can an agent access, exfiltrate, and propagate, independent of what it is designed for or is observed to do? The question goes unanswered because existing approaches trust a tool's natural-language description as a proxy for its behavior. But nothing enforces that the description and its implementation agree. This gap is known as Description-Code Inconsistency (DCI). DCI enables a threat class called capability laundering, in which a tool's implementation contains dangerous behavior that its description omits. The behavior may come from incidental drift or a supply-chain compromise. It runs silently whenever an LLM invokes the tool for its stated, benign purpose. We present ACaM, a neurosymbolic approach to capability modeling that derives each tool's capabilities from its code, so a laundered capability cannot hide behind a benign description. In ACaM, static analysis grounds an LLM in code-derived facts, and no LLM output can override a fact that static analysis has established. The LLM supplies only the behavioral meaning that those facts cannot express. ACaM compiles agent source code into the Agent Capability Property Graph (ACPG) and uses it to reconstruct threat chains that span multiple tool calls. We evaluate ACaM on 43 real-world agents, including 9 multi-agent systems. On 24 manually annotated agents, it recovers capability properties with 98.3% macro-F1 and reconstructs injected threat chains with a score of 0.980, 8 points above the strongest baseline. Applied to all 43 unmodified agents, it discovers hundreds of structural vulnerabilities, ten of which we confirm with proof-of-concept exploits.

translation.title: ACaM：面向智能体AI安全的自动化能力建模
translation.abstract: 在智能体AI系统中，LLM调用的工具持有对凭证、私有数据、文件系统和外部服务的常驻访问权限。此类智能体日益被部署，却未回答一个基本问题：一个智能体能够访问、外泄和传播什么，独立于其设计目的或被观察到的行为？这个问题之所以悬而未决，是因为现有方法将工具的自然语言描述作为其行为的代理。但没有任何机制强制描述与实现一致。这一缺口被称为描述-代码不一致（DCI）。DCI催生了一类称为能力洗白（capability laundering）的威胁，即工具的实现中包含其描述所遗漏的危险行为。该行为可能来自偶然的漂移或供应链攻击。只要LLM出于其声明的良性目的调用该工具，它就会静默运行。我们提出ACaM，一种神经符号方法，从工具的代码中推导其能力，使被洗白的能力无法隐藏在良性描述之后。在ACaM中，静态分析将LLM锚定在代码推导的事实上，任何LLM输出都不能覆盖静态分析已确立的事实。LLM仅提供这些事实无法表达的行为语义。ACaM将智能体源代码编译为智能体能力属性图（ACPG），并利用它重建跨越多次工具调用的威胁链。我们在43个真实世界智能体（包括9个多智能体系统）上评估ACaM。在24个手动标注的智能体上，它以98.3%的macro-F1恢复能力属性，并以0.980的分数重建注入的威胁链，比最强基线高8个百分点。应用于全部43个未修改的智能体时，它发现了数百个结构性漏洞，其中十个我们已用概念验证攻击予以确认。
translation.brief: 该论文解决工具描述与代码实现不一致（DCI）导致的能力洗白安全问题，提出神经符号方法ACaM，通过静态分析锚定LLM、从代码推导工具真实能力并构建ACPG图重建威胁链。

papers.title: BOS Summary: The First Token Matters
papers.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) and language models (LLMs) often exhibit attention sinks, whereby particular positions, such as the beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token, receive a disproportionate share of attention. Under standard causal masking, however, the BOS query attends only to itself, so the representation that later tokens repeatedly access carries no information about the input. We introduce BOS Summary, a training-free inference-time method that repurposes this persistent pathway to carry input context. At a single transformer layer during prefill, BOS Summary relaxes the causal constraint for the BOS query row alone, letting BOS aggregate all visual and textual input tokens into a self-derived context representation while every other token retains standard causal attention. The enriched representation then remains accessible to the model throughout decoding, with no additional parameters, auxiliary modules, or decoding-time overhead. Across multiple VLM and LLM families and eight multimodal and text-only benchmarks, BOS Summary improves over direct and Chain-of-Thought prompting and outperforms recent sink-intervention methods on multi-step reasoning tasks. A mechanistic analysis shows that making BOS input-specific also weakens its sink dominance and redistributes attention toward content-bearing prompt tokens, indicating that changing what a sink carries reshapes how later layers allocate attention.

translation.title: BOS Summary：首个Token至关重要
translation.abstract: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）和语言模型（LLM）常表现出注意力汇聚（attention sink）现象，即特定位置（如序列起始BOS token）获得不成比例的注意力。然而在标准因果掩码下，BOS查询只能关注自身，因此后续token反复访问的表示不携带任何输入信息。我们提出BOS Summary，一种无需训练的推理时方法，将这一持久通路重新用于承载输入上下文。在prefill阶段的单个transformer层，BOS Summary仅对BOS查询行放宽因果约束，让BOS将所有视觉和文本输入token聚合为自生成的上下文表示，而其他所有token保持标准因果注意力。增强后的表示在解码全程对模型可用，且无需额外参数、辅助模块或解码时开销。在多个VLM和LLM家族以及八个多模态和纯文本基准上，BOS Summary优于直接提示和思维链提示，并在多步推理任务上超越近期的sink干预方法。机制分析表明，使BOS携带输入特定信息还会削弱其sink主导地位，并将注意力重新分配到承载内容的prompt token上，说明改变sink所承载的内容会重塑后续层的注意力分配。
translation.brief: 解决BOS注意力汇聚位置不携带输入信息的问题，方法是在prefill的单层仅对BOS查询放宽因果掩码，使其聚合全部输入形成上下文表示。

papers.title: GRAFT: Execution-Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design
papers.abstract: Automated agent design searches for executable architectures that improve LLM-based agent performance, with evolutionary methods using language-model crossover to recombine promising mechanisms for task decomposition, model coordination, and verification. This search, however, is typically guided by aggregate fitness alone, which hides the instance-level successes and failures behind each score. We introduce Execution Guided Genetic Recombination for Agent Design (GRAFT), which uses aggregate fitness for selection and survival and parent-specific execution evidence to guide semantic crossover with integrated mutation. Its feedback harness reuses bounded samples of successful and failed runs from fitness evaluation, withholding reference answers and requiring no additional task executions. We evaluate GRAFT across six reasoning and programming settings using open-weight optimizer and executor models. It achieves a mean test accuracy of 82.0%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 9.8% points. Controlled ablations show that adding execution evidence improves test accuracy with initialization, search rules, repair policies, and evaluation budgets held fixed. Our results support the value of parent-specific execution evidence for evolutionary agent design.

translation.title: GRAFT：面向智能体设计的执行引导遗传重组
translation.abstract: 自动化智能体设计搜索可提升基于LLM的智能体性能的可执行架构，进化方法利用语言模型交叉来重组任务分解、模型协调和验证等有前景的机制。然而这种搜索通常仅由聚合适应度引导，掩盖了每个分数背后的实例级成功与失败。我们提出面向智能体设计的执行引导遗传重组（GRAFT），使用聚合适应度进行选择与存活，并利用父代特定的执行证据来引导融合变异的语义交叉。其反馈机制复用适应度评估中有界数量的成功与失败运行样本，不提供参考答案，也无需额外任务执行。我们在六个推理和编程设置上使用开源权重优化器和执行器模型评估GRAFT，平均测试准确率达82.0%，超过最强基线9.8个百分点。受控消融实验表明，在固定初始化、搜索规则、修复策略和评估预算的情况下，加入执行证据可提升测试准确率。结果支持父代特定执行证据对进化式智能体设计的价值。
translation.brief: 解决进化式智能体设计中仅靠聚合适应度无法利用实例级成败信息的问题，方法是用父代执行证据引导语义交叉与变异。

papers.title: Dreaming Up Authors: Factual Prevalence and LLM Hallucinations in Academic Authorship Attribution
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used for question answering but are prone to hallucinations, yet the underlying causes, particularly the role of factual prevalence in training data, remain underexplored. In this work, we study this through academic authorship attribution, hypothesizing that hallucinations are more likely for less prevalent papers. Using citation count as a proxy for factual prevalence, we curate a dataset of 1.92 million papers across eight scientific disciplines with stratified samples by citation level. Experiments on three state-of-the-art LLMs confirm our hypothesis, revealing a robust inverse relationship between hallucination rate and citation count across all models and disciplines, with hallucination rates exceeding 98% for rarely cited papers and falling below 37% for highly cited ones. Our in-depth analysis further shows that these failures primarily reflect retrieval limitations rather than knowledge absence, and hidden-state probing of open-source models shows that factual prevalence is encoded in pre-generation representations, providing convergent mechanistic evidence for the prevalence-hallucination relationship. The code and data are available at this https URL.

translation.title: 凭空想象作者：学术作者归属中的事实普遍性与LLM幻觉
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）广泛用于问答但易产生幻觉，其深层原因，尤其是训练数据中事实普遍性的作用，仍缺乏研究。我们通过学术作者归属来研究这一问题，假设对普遍性较低的论文更容易产生幻觉。以引用量作为事实普遍性的代理，我们构建了覆盖八个学科、192万篇论文的数据集，并按引用层级分层抽样。在三个最先进LLM上的实验证实了我们的假设，揭示幻觉率与引用量之间存在稳健的反向关系：低引用论文的幻觉率超过98%，高引用论文则低于37%。深入分析进一步表明，这些失败主要源于检索局限而非知识缺失；对开源模型的隐状态探测显示，事实普遍性在生成前表示中已被编码，为普遍性-幻觉关系提供了汇聚的机制性证据。代码和数据见此https URL。
translation.brief: 研究事实普遍性对LLM幻觉的影响，方法是以引用量为代理构建分层论文数据集并实验验证幻觉率与引用量的反向关系。

papers.title: Can LLMs Understand What They Predict? Evaluating Latent Causal Structure Inference in Financial Markets
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly evaluated through their ability to predict future outcomes, implicitly assuming that predictive success reflects an understanding of the underlying system. However, accurate predictions can often be achieved without recovering the latent mechanisms that generate observable outcomes. To examine this assumption, we introduce LUCID, a benchmark that evaluates whether models can infer latent market structures from event descriptions and historical financial observations. Models generate event-induced causal graphs representing inferred market structure and are evaluated through a reconstruction-based framework. Our evaluation of 6 open-weight and proprietary LLMs shows that adding their generated graphs generally reduces reconstruction quality compared with using historical observations alone, although a few metrics improve. These findings suggest that inferring informative, event-specific market structures from observable evidence remains challenging for the evaluated LLMs.

translation.title: LLM能理解它们所预测的吗？评估金融市场中的潜在因果结构推断
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地通过预测未来结果的能力来评估，这隐含假设预测成功反映了对底层系统的理解。然而，准确的预测往往无需恢复生成可观测结果的潜在机制。为检验这一假设，我们提出LUCID基准，评估模型能否从事件描述和历史金融观测中推断潜在市场结构。模型生成表示所推断市场结构的事件诱导因果图，并通过基于重构的框架进行评估。对6个开源权重和专有LLM的评估显示，相比仅使用历史观测，加入其生成的图通常会降低重构质量，尽管少数指标有所改善。这些发现表明，从可观测证据中推断有信息量的事件特定市场结构对所评估的LLM而言仍具挑战性。
translation.brief: 检验预测能力是否等于理解潜在机制，方法是构建LUCID基准，让模型从事件与历史数据推断市场因果图并用重构框架评估。

papers.title: Language Models Make New Research Sound Old
papers.abstract: Researchers are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) to validate research questions. We find that LLMs make open research questions sound partly studied and overstate what related papers establish. Models recognize most of these overstatements when asked to check the papers' full texts separately. On 40 questions drawn from newly accepted papers, GPT-6-Astra correctly judges 98% to be unstudied, but states that status plainly in only 8% of ordinary answers. All six frontier systems show reporting gaps of 30-90 percentage points. Across 22 models given identical papers, higher capability is associated with more accurate judgments and larger reporting gaps. This reporting failure is asymmetric: models correctly identify studied questions in 88-100% of ordinary answers when we supply the answering papers. To correct this, we build a fixed answer from each model's judgment and separate checks of cited papers. This raises Astra's clear reporting of open status from 8% to 95%, with improvements in all six systems. Finally, we predict reviewers' novelty grades by combining several models' written ratings with a rule learned from graded examples, reaching the performance range reported by Think-Probe-Respond. Unlike TPR, our approach needs no access to model weights or internal activations, so it also works with closed-weight frontier models.

translation.title: 语言模型让新研究听起来像已被研究过
translation.abstract: 研究者越来越多地使用大语言模型（LLM）来验证研究问题。我们发现LLM会让开放研究问题听起来部分已被研究，并夸大相关论文所确立的内容。当被要求单独检查论文全文时，模型能识别出大部分这类夸大。在取自新录用论文的40个问题上，GPT-6-Astra正确判断98%为未被研究，但在普通回答中仅8%明确陈述该状态。所有六个前沿系统都存在30-90个百分点的报告差距。在给定相同论文的22个模型中，能力越高，判断越准确，但报告差距也越大。这种报告失败是不对称的：当我们提供相关论文时，模型在88-100%的普通回答中能正确识别已被研究的问题。为纠正这一点，我们基于每个模型的判断和对所引论文的独立检查构建固定答案，将Astra对开放状态的明确报告率从8%提升到95%，六个系统均有改进。最后，我们结合多个模型的书面评分与从评分样本中学到的规则来预测审稿人的新颖性评级，达到Think-Probe-Respond报告的性能区间。与TPR不同，我们的方法无需访问模型权重或内部激活，因此也适用于闭源权重的前沿模型。
translation.brief: 解决LLM在验证研究问题时含糊夸大已有研究、不明确报告问题开放状态的问题，方法是将模型判断与对引用论文的独立检查组合成固定答案。

papers.title: Towards Fair Resource Sharing in Agentic LLM Serving
papers.abstract: As LLM agents increasingly execute complex, multi-step tasks on shared inference infrastructure, resource contention across the end-to-end LLM serving stack causes severe and uneven slowdowns across agents. Existing agentic serving systems primarily optimize throughput and latency, with comparatively limited attention to fairness among concurrent agents. Although fairness has been studied in conventional LLM serving at the token and request levels, these approaches do not fully capture cumulative delays and stateful resource dependencies across successive LLM calls within an agent. Moreover, interference spans request routing, runtime scheduling, and hardware resources, making agent-level fairness challenging to define and optimize across an end-to-end serving stack. This paper presents a cross-layer framework to define agent-level fairness, attribute sources of unfairness, and optimize fairness while preserving throughput. To account for agents with widely varying execution demands, we build a theoretical foundation to define fairness using slowdown relative to standalone execution. Our empirical analysis reveals that routing, runtime scheduling, and hardware contention jointly determine fairness, with performance-oriented policies often leading to prolonged queuing delays. To optimize fairness, we introduce Duru, which monitors each agent's slowdown and uses this signal to guide admission and scheduling decisions across the router and runtime. Duru further alleviates starvation through admission exceptions and integrates slowdown-driven autoscaling to adhere to Service-Level Objectives (SLOs). Our evaluation across various benchmarks and hardware platforms shows that Duru reduces 99th-percentile normalized slowdown by a geometric mean of 44.4% (up to 79.5%) while delivering 91.8-127.4% of the state-of-the-art system's throughput.

translation.title: 面向Agentic LLM服务中公平资源共享的研究
translation.abstract: 随着LLM智能体在共享推理基础设施上执行复杂的多步任务，端到端LLM服务栈中的资源争用会导致各智能体出现严重且不均衡的减速。现有的agentic服务系统主要优化吞吐量和延迟，对并发智能体之间的公平性关注相对有限。尽管公平性已在传统LLM服务的token和请求层面得到研究，但这些方法无法充分刻画智能体内连续LLM调用之间的累积延迟和有状态资源依赖。此外，干扰横跨请求路由、运行时调度和硬件资源，使得智能体级公平性在端到端服务栈中难以定义和优化。本文提出一个跨层框架，用于定义智能体级公平性、归因不公平的来源，并在保持吞吐量的同时优化公平性。为考虑执行需求差异巨大的智能体，我们建立了理论基础，以相对于独立执行的减速来定义公平性。实证分析表明，路由、运行时调度和硬件争用共同决定公平性，而面向性能的策略往往导致长时间的排队延迟。为优化公平性，我们提出Duru，它监测每个智能体的减速，并利用该信号指导路由器和运行时的准入与调度决策。Duru还通过准入例外缓解饥饿，并集成减速驱动的自动扩缩容以满足服务级别目标（SLO）。在多种基准和硬件平台上的评估显示，Duru将99分位归一化减速的几何平均值降低44.4%（最高79.5%），同时提供最先进系统91.8-127.4%的吞吐量。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体共享LLM服务栈中智能体间不公平减速的问题，核心方法是以相对独立执行的减速定义智能体级公平性，并构建Duru系统利用减速信号跨路由与运行时进行准入和调度优化。

papers.title: LProp: Propagating Latent Uncertainty through Evidence-Conditioned Belief Revision in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: When LLM agents pass intermediate judgments downstream without uncertainty, later decisions may treat tentative assumptions as facts. Effective uncertainty propagation must preserve information for correction and update inherited beliefs as new evidence arrives. Yet scalar scores omit information needed for revision, while detailed descriptions and reflection incur additional costs. We introduce Latent Uncertainty, a latent-space estimator that preserves uncertainty-relevant information without lengthy descriptions. Building on this, we propose LProp (Latent Uncertainty Propagation), which revises inherited answer distributions using latent representations and new evidence without additional trajectory sampling. We evaluate both methods across multiple-choice, yes/no, open-ended question answering, and mathematical reasoning tasks. Our approach outperforms baselines on most metrics, while LProp achieves the lowest mean inference-token usage in all eight propagation settings. Matched feature ablations further demonstrate that inherited latent content improves error recovery beyond answer probabilities or model capacity alone.

translation.title: LProp：在LLM智能体中通过证据条件信念修正传播潜在不确定性
translation.abstract: 当LLM智能体将中间判断传递给下游而不携带不确定性时，后续决策可能将暂定假设当作事实。有效的不确定性传播必须保留可供修正的信息，并在新证据到来时更新继承的信念。然而，标量分数省略了修正所需的信息，而详细描述和反思则带来额外成本。我们提出潜在不确定性（Latent Uncertainty），一种在潜空间中估计不确定性并保留不确定性相关信息而无需冗长描述的方法。在此基础上，我们提出LProp（潜在不确定性传播），利用潜在表示和新证据修正继承的答案分布，无需额外的轨迹采样。我们在选择题、是非题、开放式问答和数学推理任务上评估这两种方法。我们的方法在大多数指标上优于基线，且LProp在全部八种传播设置中实现了最低的平均推理token用量。匹配特征消融进一步表明，继承的潜在内容在错误恢复上的提升超越了仅依靠答案概率或模型容量。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体间中间判断不确定性丢失导致错误传播的问题，核心方法是在潜空间估计并传播不确定性信息，结合新证据对继承的答案分布进行信念修正。

papers.title: Safe to Omit, Worth Omitting? Keeping the Answer and Cutting Latency When an LLM Agent Skips Another's Message
papers.abstract: In multi-agent systems, a receiver agent often waits for a helper agent's message (text or its latent KV cache), which can improve performance but adds latency. We study when a receiver agent can skip the message safely (the final answer rarely changes) and beneficially (the time saved exceeds the cost of deciding). Our mechanism reads the receiver agent's confidence without the message and uses a finite-sample test to certify a threshold at which, with high probability, at most 5% of skipped answers change; if none passes, the system keeps communicating. We test it on OpenBookQA, ARC-Challenge, and MMLU-Pro with three Qwen model pairs, on cross-family agents, and on SQuAD and GSM8K. Four insights emerge. First, oracle headroom is weak evidence that messages help: control inputs without answer-specific content, matched to change answers as often as real messages, reproduce a median 76% of the oracle's gain. Second, whether a message can be skipped depends on how often and how predictably it alters the answer, not on its accuracy; every certified KV-cache path is less accurate than the receiver agent alone. Third, where text messages help, skipping keeps most of their gain: on unseen questions in the four such settings, the policies skip 59 to 80% and keep an estimated 76 to 95% of the gain. In two prospective tests with all rules fixed in advance, our mechanism skips a three-agent system's verifier on 39.9% of sealed questions, keeping 12.55 of its 12.80-point gain, and a 32B helper on 68.4% of held-out questions, keeping its whole gain. Fourth, safety does not determine efficiency: at batch size one, skipping text saves hundreds of milliseconds per query and skipping KV cache far less. Certification extends to SQuAD but not to GSM8K. In eleven tests on unseen questions, every certified policy we could test kept its change rate's 95% upper bound below 5% under our answer parsers.

translation.title: 可以省略吗，值得省略吗？当LLM智能体跳过他人消息时保留答案并降低延迟
translation.abstract: 在多智能体系统中，接收方智能体常常需要等待辅助智能体的消息（文本或其潜在KV缓存），这可以提升性能但会增加延迟。我们研究接收方智能体何时可以安全地（最终答案很少改变）且有益地（节省的时间超过决策成本）跳过该消息。我们的机制在不读取消息的情况下读取接收方智能体的置信度，并使用有限样本检验来认证一个阈值，在该阈值下可以高概率保证被跳过的答案中至多5%发生改变；若没有通过检验，系统则继续通信。我们在OpenBookQA、ARC-Challenge和MMLU-Pro上使用三对Qwen模型进行测试，并在跨家族智能体以及SQuAD和GSM8K上进行验证。我们得到四点洞察。第一，oracle余量是消息有帮助的弱证据：与真实消息改变答案频率相同的、不含答案特定内容的控制输入，可以复现oracle收益的中位数76%。第二，消息能否被跳过取决于它改变答案的频率和可预测性，而非其准确性；每条被认证的KV缓存路径都比接收方智能体单独工作更不准确。第三，在文本消息有帮助的场景中，跳过能保留其大部分收益：在四个此类设置的未见问题上，策略跳过59%至80%，并保留估计76%至95%的收益。在两项规则预先固定的前瞻性测试中，我们的机制在39.9%的密封问题上跳过三智能体系统的验证器，保留其12.80分收益中的12.55分；在68.4%的留出问题上跳过32B辅助模型，保留其全部收益。第四，安全性并不决定效率：在批大小为1时，跳过文本每次查询可节省数百毫秒，而跳过KV缓存节省的则少得多。认证可扩展至SQuAD但不适用于GSM8K。在针对未见问题的十一项测试中，我们能够测试的每一条被认证策略在其答案解析器下都将变化率的95%上界保持在5%以下。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体系统中接收方等待辅助消息造成不必要延迟的问题，核心方法是基于接收方置信度的有限样本检验认证跳过阈值，在保证答案变化率不超过5%的前提下安全跳过消息。

papers.title: Receiver-Conditioned Clarification for Multi-Agent Food Assistance
papers.abstract: Food insecurity creates a pressing need for guidance that helps households find usable food resources and assess food choices in light of their circumstances. Such guidance must connect eligibility requirements, practical access constraints, and dietary needs rather than return isolated listings or generic nutritional advice. Multi-agent food assistants can coordinate these tasks, with uncertainty indicating when clarification or verification is needed before a recommendation. However, uncertainty can be lost across agent handoffs, allowing tentative interpretations to propagate as facts and obscuring opportunities for correction. Moreover, confidence that a service requirement has been interpreted correctly is not confidence that a recommendation satisfies the user's needs; local confidence cannot simply be reused as downstream reliability. We introduce an inference-time, receiver-conditioned clarification framework that preserves shared premise identities and replays consistent interpretations across dependent agents. Each receiver exposes admissible decisions and remaining evidence obligations, so question relevance reflects both decision changes and missing support. Information questions and user-confirmable fallback adjustments are evaluated together with their anticipated follow-up interactions under shared budgets. This structure connects clarification to jointly supported plans for resource navigation, nutritional reasoning, and supply-side planning.

translation.title: 面向多智能体食品援助的接收方条件澄清机制
translation.abstract: 粮食不安全问题迫切需要能够帮助家庭找到可用食物资源并根据自身情况评估食物选择的指导。此类指导必须将资格要求、实际获取限制和饮食需求联系起来，而不是返回孤立的列表或泛泛的营养建议。多智能体食品助手可以协调这些任务，并利用不确定性来指示何时需要在给出推荐前进行澄清或验证。然而，不确定性可能在智能体交接过程中丢失，使暂定的解释作为事实传播，并掩盖修正的机会。此外，对服务需求被正确解释的信心并不等于对推荐满足用户需求的信心；局部置信度不能简单地复用为下游可靠性。我们提出一种推理时的接收方条件澄清框架，该框架保留共享前提的身份，并在相互依赖的智能体之间重放一致的解释。每个接收方暴露可采纳的决策和剩余的证据义务，因此问题的相关性同时反映决策变化和缺失的支持。信息性问题和用户可确认的回退调整在共享预算下与其预期的后续交互一起被评估。这一结构将澄清与资源导航、营养推理和供给侧规划的共同支持计划联系起来。
translation.brief: 解决多智能体食品援助中不确定性在智能体交接时丢失导致错误解释传播的问题，核心方法是提出接收方条件的推理时澄清框架，保留共享前提并让每个接收方暴露可采纳决策与证据义务。

papers.title: ARISE: Practical Self-Evolving Memory for Accurate and Cost-Efficient Enterprise Agents
papers.abstract: Enterprise LLM agents operate in dynamic environments where foundation models evolve rapidly, workflows update frequently, and deployments need to satisfy accuracy and cost requirements. We propose ARISE (Agent Refinement through Iterative Self-Evaluation), a practical memory architecture in which the agent's memory evolves from its own failures without updating model weights, tools, or workflow logic. ARISE uses the model itself or a teacher model to attribute the failures and propose corrections. Then, ARISE keeps the corrections as retrievable micro memory, consolidates them into macro rules, and accepts a rule update only if held-out accuracy rises. Across 14 enterprise-workflow domains from SOP-Bench and $\tau^2$-bench using 5 models, ARISE-Teacher, which uses Claude Opus 4.6 for attribution and consolidation, gains 10.9 pp over the baseline on SOP-Bench and 5.8 pp on $\tau^2$-bench. ARISE-Teacher also outperforms GEPA by 4.5 pp on $\tau^2$-bench and 1.4 pp on SOP-Bench. With the deployment model as its own attributor, ARISE-Self still gains 10.0 pp on SOP-Bench. ARISE-Teacher uses 4.0% fewer model calls and 5.2% fewer output tokens at comparable per-task cost (-1.0%).

translation.title: ARISE：面向准确且高性价比企业智能体的实用自进化记忆
translation.abstract: 企业LLM智能体运行在动态环境中：基础模型快速演进、工作流频繁更新、部署需要同时满足准确性和成本要求。我们提出ARISE（通过迭代自评估进行智能体精炼），一种实用的记忆架构，其中智能体的记忆从自身的失败中进化，而无需更新模型权重、工具或工作流逻辑。ARISE使用模型自身或教师模型对失败进行归因并提出修正。然后，ARISE将修正保存为可检索的微记忆，将其整合为宏观规则，并且只有在留出集准确性提升时才接受规则更新。在来自SOP-Bench和$\tau^2$-bench的14个企业工作流领域上使用5个模型进行评估，使用Claude Opus 4.6进行归因和整合的ARISE-Teacher在SOP-Bench上比基线提升10.9个百分点，在$\tau^2$-bench上提升5.8个百分点。ARISE-Teacher在$\tau^2$-bench上比GEPA高4.5个百分点，在SOP-Bench上高1.4个百分点。以部署模型自身作为归因器时，ARISE-Self在SOP-Bench上仍提升10.0个百分点。ARISE-Teacher在相当的单任务成本下（-1.0%）使用更少的模型调用（少4.0%）和更少的输出token（少5.2%）。
translation.brief: 解决企业LLM智能体在动态环境中难以持续保持准确性和成本效率的问题，核心方法是构建ARISE记忆架构，通过迭代自评估对失败进行归因并生成可检索微记忆与宏观规则，在不更新模型权重的情况下实现自进化。

papers.title: FutureBench: A Renewable Framework for Evaluating Knowledge-Context Conflict in LLMs
papers.abstract: Asking a model to check retrieved text can also tell it which source to trust. We introduce FutureBench, a renewable framework for evaluating knowledge-context conflict using timestamped questions, controlled passage triplets, and no-context probes. Across 3,629 questions and six models, Verify (a prompt combining checking with passage priority) raises false-answer adoption in all five models tested on pre-cutoff events, mainly by displacing answers that were correct under Baseline, which allows both passage evidence and model knowledge. On post-cutoff events, only o4-mini increases adoption (+13.7 percentage points). A four-prompt comparison on 902 post-cutoff questions finds that passage priority without checking raises adoption, while moving to Verify lowers it in all five models. Adversarial-Aware, which warns of misleading passages and prioritizes model knowledge, restores 82.5-98.9% of displaced pre-cutoff answers with under one point of change in true-passage accuracy. FutureBench supports repeated evaluation on fixed cohorts and extension to new events as models change.

translation.title: FutureBench：一个用于评估大语言模型知识-上下文冲突的可再生框架
translation.abstract: 要求模型检查检索文本的同时也可能告诉它应信任哪个来源。我们提出 FutureBench，一个使用带时间戳的问题、受控段落三元组和无上下文探针来评估知识-上下文冲突的可再生框架。在 3,629 个问题和六个模型上，Verify（一种将检查与段落优先级相结合的提示）在所有五个于截止日期前事件上测试的模型中都提高了错误答案的采纳率，主要是取代了在 Baseline（允许同时使用段落证据和模型知识）下原本正确的答案。在截止日期后的事件上，只有 o4-mini 提高了采纳率（+13.7 个百分点）。在 902 个截止日期后问题上的四提示对比发现，不带检查的段落优先级会提高采纳率，而改用 Verify 则在所有五个模型中降低了采纳率。Adversarial-Aware（警告存在误导性段落并优先使用模型知识）恢复了 82.5-98.9% 被取代的截止日期前答案，同时真实段落准确率变化不到一个百分点。FutureBench 支持在固定队列上重复评估，并随着模型变化扩展到新事件。
translation.brief: 该论文解决 LLM 在检索文本与自身知识冲突时如何取舍的问题，核心方法是构建基于时间戳问题与受控段落三元组的可再生评估框架 FutureBench 并对比多种提示策略。

papers.title: A-Tag: Cryptographic File Tagging with Enforced Live Human Presence
papers.abstract: The increasing autonomy of software agents and the proliferation of AI-generated content have weakened the reliability of digital actions as evidence of human involvement. Existing mechanisms, such as digital signatures and authentication protocols, verify identity and integrity, but do not establish whether a live human was present at the time an action was performed. In this paper, we introduce A-Tag, a system for verifiable human-in-the-loop tagging of digital artifacts. A-Tag cryptographically binds a file to a verified instance of live human presence at the moment of tagging. The resulting tag serves as a persistent and transferable proof that the action was triggered by a live human, without making claims about the origin, identity of the actor, or semantic content of the file. A-Tag is a modular framework combining liveness verification based on micro-motion signals shaped by human motor control, a secure cryptographic binding between the verified event and the artifact, and a publicly verifiable logging mechanism enabling independent validation. We formalize security properties of human presence signals, define an adversarial model capturing automated and relay attacks, and analyze the system's guarantees and limitations. We implement A-Tag on commodity devices and evaluate it under realistic conditions. Our evaluation shows that A-Tag provides cryptographically sound artifact binding with deterministic verification, while enabling robust recovery under real-world transformations, achieving over 99 percent success for image-based artifacts, and maintaining sub-second verification and practical tagging latency.

translation.title: A-Tag：具有强制实时人类在场的加密文件标记
translation.abstract: 软件代理的日益自主和 AI 生成内容的激增削弱了数字行为作为人类参与证据的可靠性。现有机制（如数字签名和认证协议）可验证身份和完整性，但无法确定行为发生时是否有真实人类在场。本文提出 A-Tag，一个对数字工件进行可验证的人在回路标记的系统。A-Tag 在标记时刻将文件与经过验证的实时人类在场实例进行密码学绑定。由此产生的标签可作为该行为由真实人类触发的持久且可转移的证明，而不对文件的来源、行为者身份或语义内容作任何声明。A-Tag 是一个模块化框架，结合了基于由人类运动控制塑造的微运动信号的活体检测验证、经验证事件与工件之间的安全密码学绑定，以及支持独立验证的公开可验证日志机制。我们形式化了人类在场信号的安全属性，定义了涵盖自动化攻击和中继攻击的对抗模型，并分析了系统的保证与局限。我们在商用设备上实现了 A-Tag 并在现实条件下进行评估。评估表明，A-Tag 提供了具有确定性验证的密码学健全的工件绑定，同时在现实变换下实现稳健恢复，对图像类工件的成功率超过 99%，并保持亚秒级验证和实用的标记延迟。
translation.brief: 该论文解决如何证明数字操作发生时有真实人类在场的问题，核心方法是将文件与基于微运动信号的活体检测结果进行密码学绑定并公开可验证地记录。

papers.title: JEPA as a Transferable Optimizer: Learning and Understanding Black-Box Optimization from Reward-Agnostic Pretraining
papers.abstract: Black-box optimization evaluates candidates through simulations, rollouts, or experiments, often without gradients. Learned optimizers are usually judged by whether they outperform existing methods. We ask a complementary question: what information does a learned optimizer use from its search history? We introduce JEPA-PS (JEPA Policy Search), based on a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture. It is pretrained on random rollouts using parameter vectors and scalar returns. Its latent-prediction objective predicts the next point in an optimization trajectory rather than its reward or gradient, allowing us to examine what was tried and how well it performed. At test time, JEPA-PS reads a short evaluation history and proposes a candidate in one forward pass, without task descriptions, reward shaping, or test-time gradients. We evaluate it on 15 control environments against 12 optimizers, including evolutionary methods, Bayesian optimization, CMA-ES, and an LLM optimizer. JEPA-PS is competitive with tuned classical baselines and outperforms the LLM optimizer by more than 2x on Swimmer at 71x lower per-step cost. It also transfers zero-shot to environments excluded from pretraining. Null-model comparisons and decoder-training ablations indicate that its latent representation carries information beyond simple history statistics; every trained decoder variant performs worse than the default frozen representation. Our main finding is that the history JEPA-PS uses depends on the task. On smooth landscapes it uses the full trajectory, whereas on rugged landscapes the best-seen point carries nearly all the signal. This memory requirement has a weak positive correlation with fitness-distance correlation (FDC; r=0.112, n=7), while an independent reward-ordering sensitivity probe does not corroborate the relationship (r=-0.024, n=7). Code: this https URL.

translation.title: JEPA 作为可迁移的优化器：从奖励无关预训练中学习与理解黑盒优化
translation.abstract: 黑盒优化通过仿真、rollout 或实验评估候选解，通常没有梯度。学习型优化器通常以是否优于现有方法来评判。我们提出一个互补的问题：学习型优化器从其搜索历史中使用了什么信息？我们提出基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的 JEPA-PS（JEPA Policy Search）。它使用参数向量和标量回报在随机 rollout 上预训练。其潜空间预测目标预测优化轨迹中的下一个点，而非其奖励或梯度，使我们能够考察尝试过什么以及表现如何。在测试时，JEPA-PS 读取简短的评估历史并在一次前向传播中提出候选解，无需任务描述、奖励塑形或测试时梯度。我们在 15 个控制环境中将其与 12 个优化器对比，包括进化方法、贝叶斯优化、CMA-ES 和一个 LLM 优化器。JEPA-PS 与调优过的经典基线具有竞争力，并在 Swimmer 上以低 71 倍的每步成本比 LLM 优化器高出 2 倍以上。它还能零样本迁移到预训练中排除的环境。零模型对比和解码器训练消融表明其潜表示携带了超出简单历史统计的信息；每个训练过的解码器变体都表现不如默认的冻结表示。我们的主要发现是 JEPA-PS 使用的历史取决于任务：在平滑地形上它使用完整轨迹，而在崎岖地形上历史最优点几乎携带全部信号。这一记忆需求与适应度-距离相关性（FDC）呈弱正相关（r=0.112, n=7），而独立的奖励排序敏感性探针未能证实该关系（r=-0.024, n=7）。代码：this https URL。
translation.brief: 该论文研究学习型优化器从搜索历史中利用了什么信息，核心方法是基于 JEPA 的奖励无关预训练构建 JEPA-PS 优化器并分析其潜表示与任务地形的关系。

papers.title: RefinementGuard: Counterexample-Directed Semantic Qualification for Hidden Agent-Tool Execution
papers.abstract: Tool runtimes can lower an agent-selected operation into a hidden parallel graph, reducing latency and context while risking semantic mistranslation. We introduce RefinementGuard: translation validation for hidden, effectful agent-tool lowerings, coupled to artifact-bound, fail-closed runtime admission. Qualification compares a candidate graph with an independent reference on isolated state using explicit parent-operation obligations. We evaluate two repository-level contracts, bug localization and patch validation, on controlled repositories. Among 100 activated, non-equivalent development/qualification faults adjudicated by one human, parent-semantic validation rejects 49/100 (operator-cluster bootstrap 95% CI [33.7%, 64.8%]). The objective is selective admission, not maximum mutation rejection: exact equality rejects 100/100 faults but also all 60 valid variants, whereas obligation-based validation accepts 60/60; its 51 residual misses identify concrete specification gaps. On a frozen disjoint input split, the held-out B2-B3 result is localization-only because 21 patch mutants fail structurally; B3 rejects 38/56 localization defects. In a controlled asynchronous-delay regime, the localization serial/guarded median-latency ratio is 4.50x, and hidden execution exposes 74.3% less parent-visible context than visible execution. Patch validation shows no demonstrated speedup; zero-delay runs expose overhead. End-to-end qualification thus detects lower-layer misses while preserving localization's parallelism.

translation.title: RefinementGuard：针对隐藏代理-工具执行的基于反例的语义资格验证
translation.abstract: 工具运行时可以将代理选择的操作下沉到隐藏的并行图中，降低延迟和上下文占用，但存在语义误译的风险。我们提出 RefinementGuard：针对隐藏的、有副作用的代理-工具下沉的翻译验证，并与绑定工件、失败即关闭的运行时准入相耦合。资格验证使用显式的父操作义务，在隔离状态上将候选图与独立参考进行比较。我们在受控仓库上评估两个仓库级契约：bug 定位和补丁验证。在由一名人类裁决的 100 个被激活的非等价开发/资格故障中，父语义验证拒绝了 49/100（算子簇 bootstrap 95% CI [33.7%, 64.8%]）。目标是有选择的准入而非最大变异拒绝：精确相等会拒绝 100/100 个故障但也拒绝全部 60 个有效变体，而基于义务的验证接受 60/60；其 51 个残余遗漏指出了具体的规范缺口。在冻结的不相交输入划分上，保留的 B2-B3 结果仅限于定位，因为 21 个补丁变异体在结构上失败；B3 拒绝了 38/56 个定位缺陷。在受控的异步延迟条件下，定位的串行/守护中位延迟比为 4.50 倍，且隐藏执行比可见执行少暴露 74.3% 的父可见上下文。补丁验证未显示出加速；零延迟运行暴露了开销。端到端资格验证因此能在保留定位并行性的同时检测下层遗漏。
translation.brief: 该论文解决代理工具操作被下沉到隐藏并行图时可能发生语义误译的问题，核心方法是对下沉结果进行基于反例的翻译验证并结合失败即关闭的运行时准入。

papers.title: MANGO Arena: Same Seeds, Different Chains Evaluating LLM Agents in a Disrupted Supply Chain
papers.abstract: We introduce MANGO Arena, an open-source testbed in which four LLM agents each run one company in a serial supply chain adapted from MANGO, a classroom factory-management game. The environment enforces hard rules (a truck limit, a no-credit cash constraint and production capacity), logs every blocked attempt to break them, and gives agents a public message board on which side payments are explicitly forbidden. This lets one environment measure three things at once: an economic outcome (the bullwhip effect), rule adherence under pressure, and proposals to collude. In a pilot with three small reasoning models, two scripted reference policies, two conditions (with and without a supplier fire) and three demand seeds, all LLM agents amplified demand variability as it moved upstream, by 7 to 25 times at the Retailer and 13 to 179 times at the Supplier, often more than a textbook order-up-to policy. They did so largely by ordering in batches (zero orders in up to 60% of decisions). Real rule violations were rare (at most 7 of 288 decisions per model) and no agent proposed a money side deal. The pilot's main lesson concerns evaluation method. API failures (rate limits and runaway hidden reasoning) entered the metrics silently as "no order" decisions. And when we reran games with the same seeds and no failed calls, upstream bullwhip changed by up to 17 times between runs. With three seeds, conclusions about how a disruption affects a given model did not survive a rerun. We report these failures in full and propose reporting practices for multi-agent evaluations of this kind. Code, prompts and every logged decision are public.

translation.title: MANGO Arena：相同种子、不同链条——在受扰动的供应链中评估 LLM 代理
translation.abstract: 我们提出 MANGO Arena，一个开源测试平台，其中四个 LLM 代理各自经营改编自课堂工厂管理游戏 MANGO 的串行供应链中的一家公司。该环境强制执行硬性规则（卡车数量限制、无信贷现金约束和生产能力），记录每一次被阻止的违规尝试，并为代理提供一个明确禁止侧向付款的公共留言板。这使得一个环境可以同时衡量三件事：经济结果（牛鞭效应）、压力下的规则遵守情况以及串通提议。在一个包含三个小型推理模型、两个脚本参考策略、两种条件（有无供应商火灾）和三个需求种子的试点中，所有 LLM 代理在需求向上游传递时都放大了需求波动，在零售商处放大 7 到 25 倍，在供应商处放大 13 到 179 倍，往往超过教科书式的 order-up-to 策略。它们主要通过批量下单实现这一点（多达 60% 的决策为零订单）。真实的规则违规很少见（每个模型在 288 个决策中最多 7 次），且没有代理提出金钱侧交易。试点的主要教训关乎评估方法：API 故障（速率限制和失控的隐藏推理）会作为"无订单"决策悄然进入指标。而且当我们用相同种子且无失败调用重跑游戏时，上游牛鞭效应在不同运行之间变化高达 17 倍。在只有三个种子的情况下，关于扰动如何影响特定模型的结论无法在重跑中保持。我们完整报告了这些失败，并为此类多代理评估提出了报告规范。代码、提示和每条记录的决策均公开。
translation.brief: 该论文解决如何评估 LLM 代理在供应链场景下的经济行为、规则遵守与串通倾向的问题，核心方法是构建带硬性规则和完整日志的开源多代理测试平台 MANGO Arena。

papers.title: Weight Space Programming for Vision Language Model Repair
papers.abstract: In weight-space programming, a language model edits a network's weights directly, without gradients. We ask what a successful repair of this kind relies on. We plant faults in the weights of two vision-language models, SmolVLM-256M and LFM2-VL-450M, and check each edit made by a coding agent against the original weights. Without being told where to look, the agent finds rescaled rows in the projector and noise in the vision encoder of both models, infers the unknown scale factors, restores most or all of the rescaled weights to their exact original values, and returns accuracy to near its original level; programs that it writes from such weights repair unseen checkpoints of the same model without feedback. These repairs depend on a trace of how the faults were computed. The original weights have 16-bit precision, and faults computed in 32-bit arithmetic leave low bits that only the damaged weights carry. Rounding those bits away leaves each model's answers to our test questions unchanged, and the agent, unaided, then restores no weight exactly: on SmolVLM it no longer finds the damage, and in a single session on LFM2-VL its only gain comes from rescaling answer-token embeddings, which changes how often the model answers yes. Marking the damaged weights again in their low bits brings the edits back to them. Rounded weights still hold statistical evidence of the rescaling, in the distribution of stored values and in row norms, and one sentence in the prompt that names such a statistic directs the agent's edits to the damaged rows on both models. Swapped rows or columns, which leave the set of stored values unchanged, are not found unaided on either model within our session budgets. We recommend that studies of weight repair report the number format of the weights and include a rounded control.

translation.title: 面向视觉语言模型修复的权重空间编程
translation.abstract: 在权重空间编程中，语言模型直接编辑网络的权重，而不使用梯度。我们探究这类成功的修复依赖于什么。我们在两个视觉语言模型 SmolVLM-256M 和 LFM2-VL-450M 的权重中植入故障，并检查编码智能体所做的每次编辑与原始权重的差异。在没有被告知去哪里查找的情况下，智能体在两个模型的投影器中发现了被缩放的行，在视觉编码器中发现了噪声，推断出未知的缩放因子，将大部分或全部被缩放的权重恢复到其精确的原始值，并将准确率恢复到接近原始水平；它根据这些权重编写的程序无需反馈即可修复同一模型的未见检查点。这些修复依赖于故障计算方式的痕迹。原始权重为 16 位精度，而在 32 位算术中计算的故障会留下仅受损权重才携带的低位。将这些低位舍去后，模型对我们测试问题的回答保持不变，而智能体在无人协助的情况下不再能精确恢复任何权重：在 SmolVLM 上它不再能发现损伤，而在 LFM2-VL 的单次会话中，其唯一收益来自重新缩放答案 token 的嵌入，这改变了模型回答 yes 的频率。再次在低位中标记受损权重会使编辑重新指向它们。舍入后的权重仍在存储值的分布和行范数中保留缩放的统计证据，提示中的一句指出此类统计量的话即可将智能体的编辑引导到两个模型的受损行上。交换行或列不会改变存储值的集合，在两个模型上，在我们的会话预算内均无法在无人协助的情况下被发现。我们建议权重修复研究报告权重的数字格式，并包含一个舍入对照组。
translation.brief: 研究无梯度权重修复依赖什么，通过在视觉语言模型权重中植入缩放、噪声、交换等故障，分析编码智能体如何利用低位精度痕迹和统计证据定位并恢复受损权重。

papers.title: Agent Verifiers in Counterfactual Analysis: A Pilot Study Benchmarking Agentic Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
papers.abstract: Agents can expand the covariate space of randomized experiments by retrieving fast-moving local context missed by slow-changing survey baseline covariates, helping characterize who benefits most from an intervention. Verifying such covariates is difficult: individual treatment effects are unobserved, retrieval leakage can pull post-treatment information into nominally pretreatment summaries, and encoder leakage can inject post-treatment pretraining knowledge into representations even after temporal filtering of inputs. Guided by a two-channel information bound separating summary provenance from encoder weights, we propose a three-layer benchmark protocol: (i) retrieval admissibility via pre-treatment date filtering; (ii) heterogeneity validation scored rank-weighted average treatment effects (RATEs); and (iii) encoder admissibility checked with chronologically vintaged encoders, future-fact probes, and weight perturbations. Across 11 datasets anchored by Uganda's Youth Opportunities Program, we compare session-isolated retrieval (sandboxed, bounded-budget agent runs per study) against a persistent workspace teammate (xAI's GrokBot) that builds one date-verified corpus per study while blinded to outcomes. The workspace teammate yields higher mean RATE ratios in 6/11 datasets for text alone and 7 for combined features, though paired tests show neither workflow universally dominates. Even on fixed retrieved text, encoder choice significantly shifts heterogeneity signal. Chronologically vintaged probes show no clear evidence of weight leakage, but single-record adapter perturbation analyses show that memorized future facts, once present, persist until injected noise degrades model output. Temporal filtering of retrieval is necessary but insufficient: verifying agent-generated covariates requires jointly examining source provenance, out-of-sample treatment-effect signal, and encoder weights.

translation.title: 反事实分析中的智能体验证器：智能体异质性处理效应的试点基准研究
translation.abstract: 智能体可以通过检索缓慢变化的调查基线协变量所遗漏的快速变化的本地上下文，来扩展随机实验的协变量空间，帮助刻画谁从干预中受益最多。验证此类协变量很困难：个体处理效应不可观测，检索泄漏可能将处理后信息拉入名义上的处理前摘要，而编码器泄漏即使在输入经过时间过滤后，也可能将处理后的预训练知识注入表示中。在分离摘要来源与编码器权重的双通道信息界的指导下，我们提出了一个三层基准协议：(i) 通过处理前日期过滤实现检索可采性；(ii) 以秩加权平均处理效应（RATE）评分的异质性验证；(iii) 使用按时间划分版本的编码器、未来事实探针和权重扰动检查编码器可采性。在以乌干达青年机会计划为基础的 11 个数据集上，我们比较了会话隔离检索（每项研究进行沙箱化、预算受限的智能体运行）与持久工作区队友（xAI 的 GrokBot，对结果盲视，为每项研究构建一个经日期验证的语料库）。工作区队友在 6/11 个数据集上仅用文本、在 7 个数据集上用组合特征获得更高的平均 RATE 比率，但配对检验显示两种工作流均不普遍占优。即使在固定的检索文本上，编码器的选择也会显著改变异质性信号。按时间划分版本的探针未显示权重泄漏的明确证据，但单记录适配器扰动分析表明，一旦记忆的未来事实存在，就会持续存在，直到注入的噪声降低模型输出。检索的时间过滤是必要但不充分的：验证智能体生成的协变量需要联合检查来源出处、样本外处理效应信号和编码器权重。
translation.brief: 针对智能体检索协变量难以验证的问题，提出包含检索可采性、异质性验证和编码器可采性检查的三层基准协议，并以乌干达青年机会计划等 11 个数据集进行评估。

papers.title: The Value Semantics Layer: Enabling Machine-Understandable Databases for Agentic AI
papers.abstract: As data systems increasingly support autonomous LLM-powered agents alongside human analysts, they require richer semantic infrastructure bridging analytical concepts and analytical operations. Existing metadata systems expose schemas, catalogs, lineage, and governance information, but provide limited support for representing operational semantics. We propose the Value Semantics Layer (VSL), an architectural abstraction that externalizes value semantics as persistent, planner-visible infrastructure. VSL introduces Value Semantic Types (VSTs), reusable operational semantic assertions capturing distributional, relational, process, quantitative, and policy-grounded semantics. Unlike descriptive metadata, VSTs enable planners to validate analytical operations, select appropriate operators, and guide analytical workflows. We present the motivation, formalization, architecture, and prototype realizations of VSL, and outline a research agenda toward AI-native semantic infrastructure for analytical systems.

translation.title: 价值语义层：为智能体 AI 启用机器可理解的数据库
translation.abstract: 随着数据系统日益同时支持自主的 LLM 驱动智能体和人类分析师，它们需要更丰富的语义基础设施来连接分析概念与分析操作。现有的元数据系统暴露模式、目录、血缘和治理信息，但对表示操作语义的支持有限。我们提出价值语义层（VSL），一种将价值语义外化为持久的、规划器可见的基础设施的架构抽象。VSL 引入价值语义类型（VST），即可复用的操作语义断言，涵盖分布、关系、过程、定量和基于策略的语义。与描述性元数据不同，VST 使规划器能够验证分析操作、选择合适的算子并引导分析工作流。我们介绍 VSL 的动机、形式化、架构和原型实现，并概述迈向分析系统 AI 原生语义基础设施的研究议程。
translation.brief: 针对现有元数据系统缺乏操作语义表示的问题，提出价值语义层（VSL）架构，通过可复用的价值语义类型（VST）使规划器能验证分析操作并引导分析工作流。

papers.title: Option-GRPO: Hierarchical RL Against AI Slop in Code Generation for Unseen SDKs
papers.abstract: Large language models increasingly produce AI slop in generated code: verbose, redundant, non-idiomatic implementations that pass functional checks but bloat codebases. The problem compounds on SDKs released after the model's training cutoff, where the model has neither idiomatic priors nor compositional understanding. We present Option-GRPO, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that adapts a code LLM to an unseen SDK from its source code alone, without human-written usage examples or test cases, and that explicitly optimizes for both functional correctness and code elegance. Our key insight is that SDK source code contains compositional structure that defines a hierarchy of reusable code patterns (code options) which simultaneously serve as the building blocks of a curriculum and the action space for efficient policy optimization. We show that code options induce a valid semi-Markov decision process, give conditional bounds under which shorter option description length implies more concise and, in expectation, more API-efficient programs, and analyze under stated assumptions how the option hierarchy improves credit assignment by a factor of $\sqrt{T/K}$. Using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with execution-based rewards at each curriculum level, Option-GRPO discovers SDK idioms, composes them into patterns, and assembles patterns into complete programs. Experiments on 12 unseen SDKs with a 32B-parameter base model demonstrate 61.4% pass@1, outperforming flat GRPO by 8.7 points, ExploraCoder by 11.2 points, and ReCode by 6.3 points. Option-GRPO produces solutions that use 34.7% fewer API calls and are 27% shorter than flat-GRPO outputs while maintaining higher correctness, directly attacking the slop problem.

translation.title: Option-GRPO：面向未见 SDK 代码生成中对抗 AI 垃圾代码的分层强化学习
translation.abstract: 大语言模型在生成的代码中越来越多地产生 AI 垃圾代码（AI slop）：冗长、冗余、非惯用的实现，它们通过功能检查却使代码库臃肿。在模型训练截止日期之后发布的 SDK 上，这一问题更加严重，因为模型既没有惯用先验也没有组合理解能力。我们提出 Option-GRPO，一个分层强化学习框架，仅从 SDK 源代码出发将代码 LLM 适配到未见 SDK，无需人工编写的使用示例或测试用例，并显式地同时优化功能正确性和代码优雅性。我们的关键洞察是，SDK 源代码包含定义可复用代码模式（代码选项）层级的组合结构，这些模式同时充当课程构建块和高效策略优化的动作空间。我们证明代码选项可诱导一个有效的半马尔可夫决策过程，给出在何种条件下更短选项描述长度意味着更简洁且期望上更 API 高效的程序的条件界，并在既定假设下分析选项层级如何将信用分配改进 $\sqrt{T/K}$ 倍。使用带执行奖励的 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）在每个课程层级上进行优化，Option-GRPO 发现 SDK 惯用法，将其组合成模式，并将模式组装成完整程序。在 12 个未见 SDK 上使用 32B 参数基础模型的实验表明，pass@1 达到 61.4%，比扁平 GRPO 高 8.7 分，比 ExploraCoder 高 11.2 分，比 ReCode 高 6.3 分。Option-GRPO 生成的解决方案比扁平 GRPO 输出少用 34.7% 的 API 调用、短 27%，同时保持更高的正确性，直接打击垃圾代码问题。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 在未见 SDK 上生成冗余非惯用代码的问题，提出 Option-GRPO 分层强化学习框架，仅从 SDK 源码提取可复用代码选项作为课程与动作空间，同时优化功能正确性与代码简洁性。

papers.title: When Do LLMs Model the Right Target? Problem Formulation in High-Stakes Risk Prediction
papers.abstract: Generative AI is increasingly used to assist with data science tasks, yet fundamental questions remain about its ability to correctly formulate analytical problems. We investigate how well large language models (LLMs) can formulate prediction problems when developing models for high-stakes decision making. We focus on one particular challenge to validity: decision dependency, which arises when historical decisions affect observed outcomes. We evaluate this aspect of problem formulation in LLM-generated code and explanations across child-welfare, healthcare, and employment settings, using 11 models from OpenAI and Anthropic and seven prompt conditions. We assess whether the LLM-generated code implements a procedure appropriate for estimating the intended outcome under the study's assumptions and whether the explanation acknowledges decision dependency. We find that LLMs do not reliably address decision dependency without guidance in the prompt. When prompts specify the target, the assumption needed to estimate it, and the estimation procedure, target-aligned implementation reaches 99-100%. Among frontier models, a simple prompt description of how decisions affect outcomes appears sufficient to elicit target-aligned implementation. Some responses also acknowledge decision dependency without addressing it in their code. Our findings suggest that analysts should not rely on LLMs to correctly formulate prediction problems without explicit methodological guidance and careful review. We propose validity-centered guidelines for LLM-assisted predictive modeling, covering prompt formulation, validation of the target and estimation procedure, and identification of key assumptions. Establishing validity is a necessary early step in evaluating whether to deploy a predictive model in a high-stakes setting, but deployment requires weighing broader ethical, institutional, and practical considerations.

translation.title: LLM 何时建模正确的目标？高风险风险预测中的问题形式化
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 越来越多地用于辅助数据科学任务，但其正确形式化分析问题的能力仍存在根本性问题。我们研究大语言模型（LLM）在为高风险决策开发模型时能否正确形式化预测问题。我们聚焦于一个特定的有效性挑战：决策依赖性，即历史决策影响观测结果的情况。我们使用来自 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的 11 个模型和七种提示条件，在儿童福利、医疗保健和就业场景中评估 LLM 生成的代码和解释中问题形式化的这一方面。我们评估 LLM 生成的代码是否实现了在研究假设下适合估计预期目标结果的程序，以及解释是否承认决策依赖性。我们发现，在没有提示引导的情况下，LLM 不能可靠地处理决策依赖性。当提示指定目标、估计目标所需的假设和估计程序时，目标对齐的实现率达到 99-100%。在前沿模型中，对决策如何影响结果的简单提示描述似乎足以引出目标对齐的实现。一些回复也承认决策依赖性，但未在代码中处理它。我们的发现表明，分析师不应依赖 LLM 在没有明确方法论指导和仔细审查的情况下正确形式化预测问题。我们提出以有效性为中心的 LLM 辅助预测建模指南，涵盖提示形式化、目标和估计程序的验证以及关键假设的识别。确立有效性是评估是否在高风险场景部署预测模型的必要早期步骤，但部署还需要权衡更广泛的伦理、制度和实际考量。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 在高风险预测建模中能否正确形式化问题，聚焦决策依赖性这一有效性挑战，发现无提示引导时 LLM 不可靠，并提出以有效性为中心的提示与验证指南。

papers.title: Polymorph: Operating System Kernel Optimization Through Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract: While popular operating systems such as Linux and Windows were originally designed as monolithic kernels, an increasing number of kernel subsystems have become extensible using eBPF. Users can now define custom policies for essential kernel mechanisms, such as the process scheduler, page cache, and network stack, without recompiling the kernel. These mechanisms give developers significant freedom to fit the kernel to their applications' workloads, but the question of which policy to deploy remains open. We study how to use agentic AI to automate kernel policy development, selection, and deployment, focusing on the page cache and the process scheduler as two representative subsystems. We show that existing approaches fall short: evolutionary and agentic search runs offline, is relatively expensive, and often fails to generalize to online workloads, while online knob tuners are encumbered by the knobs' lack of expressivity. In contrast, we propose Polymorph, which learns online: an AI agent writes a generalized, granular policy once, and a user mode tuner adjusts its parameters during runtime, with no LLM in the loop. For the page cache, Polymorph improves throughput over Linux's LRU by 8.4% on unseen data, nearly twice the gain of the best existing policy, while adapting to workload changes at runtime and costing only 16M tokens once, versus 125-240M tokens per workload for agentic offline search. For the process scheduler, it improves on Linux's default by 2.75x across six workloads, versus 2.27x for the best fixed sched_ext policy.

translation.title: Polymorph：基于人工智能的操作系统内核优化
translation.abstract: 虽然 Linux 和 Windows 等流行操作系统最初设计为单体内核，但越来越多的内核子系统已可通过 eBPF 进行扩展。用户现在可以为进程调度器、页缓存和网络栈等核心内核机制定义自定义策略，而无需重新编译内核。这些机制为开发者提供了极大的自由度，使内核能够适配应用的负载，但应部署哪种策略的问题仍未解决。我们研究如何使用 agentic AI 自动化内核策略的开发、选择和部署，重点关注页缓存和进程调度器这两个代表性子系统。我们表明现有方法存在不足：进化搜索和 agentic 搜索在离线运行，成本相对较高，且往往无法泛化到在线负载；而在线旋钮调优器则受限于旋钮的表达能力不足。相比之下，我们提出 Polymorph，它进行在线学习：AI agent 一次性编写一个通用、细粒度的策略，用户态调优器在运行时调整其参数，无需 LLM 参与循环。对于页缓存，Polymorph 在未见数据上将吞吐量比 Linux 的 LRU 提高了 8.4%，几乎是现有最佳策略收益的两倍，同时能在运行时适应负载变化，且仅需 1600 万 tokens 的一次性成本，而 agentic 离线搜索每个负载需要 1.25 亿至 2.4 亿 tokens。对于进程调度器，它在六个负载上比 Linux 默认调度器提升 2.75 倍，而最佳的固定 sched_ext 策略为 2.27 倍。
translation.brief: 解决内核策略（页缓存、调度器）难以自动选择与部署的问题，提出 Polymorph，由 AI agent 一次性编写通用细粒度策略，用户态调优器在线调整参数。

papers.title: Safe Personal RSI: Evaluating and Repairing Personal-Agent Updates
papers.abstract: Kicker is a personal health assistant. Changes to an assistant's reusable instructions can improve task handling while changing what it discloses, which requests it follows, and how it reports actions. We study Safe Personal RSI, an update-evaluation component developed for Kicker. We restrict recursive self-improvement (RSI) to prompt updates, with model weights and runtime code fixed. The procedure tests proposed and current instructions, repeats failing cases, temporarily undoes changes to guide repairs, and checks safety and task performance before adoption. If no version passes, the current instructions stay in use. Our executable benchmark contains 29 email, calendar, health, and marketplace cases, with separate probes for authorization reuse, memory, and tool-output injection. Across three models and two deliberately risky edits, the procedure rejects 20 of 21 update attempts. In repair confirmation, an admitted GPT-5.6 Luna repair reduces attack violations from 10.7% to 0% and increases safe task completion from 89.7% to 100%; a broad handwritten authority rule matches these outcomes. Under stronger attacks, a repair transferred from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to Qwen3-14B reduces violations from 69.0% to 17.9% and increases safe task completion from 19.5% to 64.4%. Separate runtime probes examine memory-entry deletion and identify missing local OAuth scope checks in the evaluated snapshot.

translation.title: 安全的个人 RSI：评估与修复个人 agent 的更新
translation.abstract: Kicker 是一个个人健康助手。对助手可复用指令的更改可以在改善任务处理的同时，改变其披露内容、遵循哪些请求以及如何报告操作。我们研究了 Safe Personal RSI，这是为 Kicker 开发的一个更新评估组件。我们将递归自我改进（RSI）限制在 prompt 更新上，模型权重和运行时代码保持固定。该流程测试提议的指令和当前指令，重复失败的案例，临时撤销更改以指导修复，并在采纳前检查安全性和任务性能。如果没有版本通过，则继续使用当前指令。我们的可执行基准包含 29 个电子邮件、日历、健康和市场案例，并针对授权复用、记忆和工具输出注入设置了独立的探针。在三个模型和两次故意有风险的编辑中，该流程拒绝了 21 次更新尝试中的 20 次。在修复确认中，一个被采纳的 GPT-5.6 Luna 修复将攻击违规率从 10.7% 降至 0%，并将安全任务完成率从 89.7% 提升至 100%；一条宽泛的手写权限规则也达到了同样的效果。在更强的攻击下，一个从 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 迁移到 Qwen3-14B 的修复将违规率从 69.0% 降至 17.9%，并将安全任务完成率从 19.5% 提升至 64.4%。独立的运行时探针检查了记忆条目删除问题，并在评估快照中发现了缺失的本地 OAuth scope 检查。
translation.brief: 解决个人 agent prompt 更新可能引入安全风险的问题，提出一个更新评估流程，通过测试、失败重试、临时回滚修复及安全与性能检查来决定是否采纳更新。

papers.title: Lodestone: Automated Semantic Discovery of Datacenter Hardware Specialization
