papers.abstract: Hardware specialization can improve datacenter efficiency. Unfortunately, identifying computations that justify dedicated hardware is difficult. Existing approaches analyze hot functions, instruction patterns, or overheads such as datacenter tax. They can miss fine-grained computations whose aggregate cost is spread across applications and libraries, especially when different pieces of code obscure the same underlying computation. We observe that seemingly unrelated code regions often perform the same computations, creating specialization opportunities that require semantic reasoning. The rise of agentic AI makes it possible to automate this. However, conventional AI agents cannot efficiently and reliably analyze large scale datacenter software. To unlock this opportunity, we present Lodestone, an agentic framework that automatically discovers hardware specialization opportunities by reasoning about what the executed code computes. First, Lodestone extracts hot control-flow regions from execution traces across workloads and organizes them into compact analysis packages that make large workloads tractable for agents. Second, agents describe what each region computes, merge those that perform the same computation into computational families, and check their semantic correctness in a loop. Third, to verify the discovered family, Lodestone runs every piece of code in a family against a set of reference inputs and outputs on recorded executions. Finally, for selected families, Lodestone proposes hardware, e.g., ISA extensions, near-core units, or detached accelerators, and human experts decide which proposals to develop further. We evaluate Lodestone on 20 workloads across six datacenter workload categories. We simulate 30 discovered families in a cycle-accurate simulator and implement them in RTL. These optimizations speed up the workloads by 12.6% on average and by up to 80.2%.

translation.title: Lodestone：数据中心硬件专用化的自动化语义发现
translation.abstract: 硬件专用化可以提升数据中心效率。遗憾的是，识别哪些计算值得专用硬件是困难的。现有方法分析热点函数、指令模式或数据中心税等开销。它们可能遗漏那些聚合成本分散在多个应用和库中的细粒度计算，尤其是当不同的代码片段掩盖了相同的底层计算时。我们观察到，看似无关的代码区域往往执行相同的计算，这创造了需要语义推理才能发现的专用化机会。agentic AI 的兴起使自动化这一过程成为可能。然而，传统的 AI agent 无法高效、可靠地分析大规模数据中心软件。为解锁这一机会，我们提出 Lodestone，一个通过推理执行代码所计算的内容来自动发现硬件专用化机会的 agentic 框架。首先，Lodestone 从跨负载的执行轨迹中提取热点控制流区域，并将其组织成紧凑的分析包，使大规模负载对 agent 而言可处理。其次，agent 描述每个区域计算的内容，将执行相同计算的区域合并为计算族，并在循环中检查其语义正确性。第三，为验证发现的计算族，Lodestone 在记录的执行上，用一组参考输入输出对族中的每段代码进行运行验证。最后，对于选定的计算族，Lodestone 提出硬件方案，例如 ISA 扩展、近核单元或分离式加速器，由人类专家决定进一步开发哪些提案。我们在六个数据中心负载类别下的 20 个负载上评估 Lodestone。我们在周期精确模拟器中模拟了 30 个发现的计算族，并用 RTL 实现了它们。这些优化平均将负载加速 12.6%，最高达 80.2%。
translation.brief: 解决数据中心中分散于多处的可专用化计算难以发现的问题，提出 Lodestone agentic 框架，通过语义推理将热点代码区域归并为计算族并验证，进而提出硬件专用化方案。

papers.title: Rented Oscillations: Multi-Tenant Data Center Workload Synchronization Attacks and Mitigation
papers.abstract: Multi-tenant data center (DC) facilities rent computing capacity on demand, placing controllable load within reach of anyone willing to pay for it. This paper considers a stealthy adversary who rents workstations and runs deliberately unoptimized large language model (LLM) training, synchronizing their consumption into large periodic oscillations while each workload remains individually indistinguishable from benign training. The periodicity of such workloads is characterized experimentally and used to model facility consumption, showing that oscillations emerge from the interaction of concurrent workloads, whether aligned by an adversary or arising naturally. A combined small- and large-signal assessment, under a hardware-grounded threat model whose feasibility is supported by experiments on a supercomputer, locates the oscillatory weak points of the network. MW-scale oscillations are shown to saturate the generators' control limiters, amplifying their effect, while Floquet analysis reveals a lightly damped mode emerging near the forcing frequency. To counter both origins, signal-energy-based detection and mitigation are proposed, the latter re-timing the workloads to minimize the facility's oscillatory energy. The approach is validated through power hardware-in-the-loop (PHIL) experiments and real-time simulations on a surrogate model of the Saudi Arabian transmission network.

translation.title: 租来的振荡：多租户数据中心负载同步攻击与缓解
translation.abstract: 多租户数据中心（DC）设施按需出租计算能力，使任何愿意付费的人都能部署可控负载。本文考虑一种隐蔽的对手：其租用工作站并运行故意未优化的的大语言模型（LLM）训练，将自身的消耗同步为大幅周期性振荡，同时每个负载单独看都与良性训练无异。我们通过实验刻画了此类负载的周期性，并用于建模设施消耗，表明振荡源于并发负载的相互作用，无论是对手对齐的还是自然产生的。在以硬件为基础、其可行性由超级计算机实验支持的威胁模型下，我们进行了小信号与大信号的联合评估，定位了电网的振荡薄弱点。兆瓦级振荡被证明会使发电机的控制限幅器饱和，从而放大其影响，而 Floquet 分析揭示了在激励频率附近出现的一个轻阻尼模式。为应对这两种来源，我们提出了基于信号能量的检测与缓解方法，后者通过重新调度负载时序来最小化设施的振荡能量。该方法通过功率硬件在环（PHIL）实验和沙特阿拉伯输电网络代理模型的实时仿真得到验证。
translation.brief: 解决多租户数据中心中恶意同步负载引发电网振荡的安全问题，通过实验刻画负载周期性建模攻击，并提出基于信号能量的检测与负载重新时序的缓解方法。

papers.title: Communicative On-Policy Distillation: Distilling Black-Box Teacher Capabilities through Communication for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a powerful paradigm for improving language-model agents on long-horizon tasks, yet its conventional formulation relies on teacher logits that text-only black- box models do not expose. To address this limitation, we introduce Communicative On-Policy Distillation (COPD), which uses natural-language communication as a medium for distilling a stronger model's capabilities into a smaller student. During task execution, the student au- tonomously decides when to consult a black-box teacher and formulates open-ended natural- language requests without predefined question templates or intervention schedules. Successful student-teacher interactions are retained as privileged references to supervise fresh adviser-free student rollouts through on-policy self-distillation, jointly with task-reward reinforcement learning. On CAMG-II, COPD achieves 2.46 times the gain of the strongest black-box OPD baseline. The capabilities it learns through communication generalize to Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2, improving task success without adviser access.

translation.title: 通信式在线策略蒸馏：通过通信为长程任务蒸馏黑盒教师能力
translation.abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）是提升语言模型 agent 长程任务能力的强大范式，但其传统形式依赖于仅文本黑盒模型不暴露的教师 logits。为解决这一局限，我们提出通信式在线策略蒸馏（COPD），它以自然语言通信为媒介，将更强模型的能力蒸馏到更小的学生模型中。在任务执行过程中，学生自主决定何时咨询黑盒教师，并在没有预定义问题模板或干预计划的情况下构造开放式自然语言请求。成功的学生-教师交互被保留为特权参考，用于通过在线策略自蒸馏监督学生在无教师情况下的全新 rollout，并与任务奖励强化学习联合进行。在 CAMG-II 上，COPD 达到了最强黑盒 OPD 基线 2.46 倍的增益。它通过通信学到的能力可泛化到 Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 SWE-Bench Pro V2，在无教师访问的情况下提升任务成功率。
translation.brief: 解决黑盒教师无 logits 导致在线策略蒸馏不可用的问题，提出 COPD，以自然语言通信为媒介让学生自主咨询教师，并用成功交互作为特权参考进行自蒸馏与强化学习。

papers.title: Learning What to Degrade: A Recoverability-Aware Curriculum for Reliable Smart-Glasses Super-Resolution
papers.abstract: Degradations in smart-glasses images obscure small text and fine-grained structures needed by vision-language models (VLMs) for visual assistance. We introduce an high-resolution (HR)-referenced semantic evaluation protocol that compares VLM outputs on restored images with those on corresponding HR references. Our evaluation reveals two failure modes: generative SR can synthesize misleading details, whereas restoration-oriented SR can leave critical evidence blurred or ambiguous. These findings motivate improving faithful detail recovery in restoration-oriented SR, where a key training challenge is to provide sufficiently difficult inputs while retaining recoverable visual information. We propose ReDiC (Recoverability-Difficulty Curriculum), which combines a model-independent recoverability proxy with model-relative restoration difficulty to adapt training degradation severity. ReDiC increases severity when inputs are recoverable and restoration is easy, maintains challenging but recoverable conditions, and reduces severity when estimated recoverability is low. It modifies only training degradation generation, leaving the SR architecture and reconstruction objective unchanged. Across NAFNet, SwinIR, and MambaIR, ReDiC improves average PSNR by approximately 2.5 dB and HR-referenced semantic scores by about 3 points over the corresponding baselines on synthetic benchmarks, with further gains confirmed by LLM-based and human evaluations on 200 real smart-glasses captures.

translation.title: 学习该退化什么：面向可靠智能眼镜超分辨率的可恢复性感知课程
translation.abstract: 智能眼镜图像中的退化会遮蔽视觉语言模型（VLM）进行视觉辅助所需的小字文本和细粒度结构。我们提出一种以高分辨率（HR）图像为参照的语义评估协议，将 VLM 在恢复图像上的输出与在对应 HR 参照上的输出进行比较。我们的评估揭示了两种失败模式：生成式 SR 可能合成误导性细节，而面向恢复的 SR 可能使关键证据模糊或含混。这些发现促使我们改进面向恢复的 SR 中的忠实细节恢复，其中一个关键训练挑战是在保留可恢复视觉信息的同时提供足够困难的输入。我们提出 ReDiC（Recoverability-Difficulty Curriculum），它将模型无关的可恢复性代理与模型相关的恢复难度相结合，以自适应调整训练退化严重程度。当输入可恢复且恢复容易时，ReDiC 提高严重程度，保持具有挑战性但可恢复的条件；当估计可恢复性较低时，则降低严重程度。它仅修改训练退化生成，不改变 SR 架构和重建目标。在 NAFNet、SwinIR 和 MambaIR 上，ReDiC 在合成基准上相比相应基线平均提升约 2.5 dB PSNR，HR 参照语义分数提升约 3 分，并在 200 张真实智能眼镜图像上通过基于 LLM 和人工评估进一步验证了增益。
translation.brief: 针对面向恢复的超分辨率训练中退化难度与可恢复性的平衡问题，提出结合可恢复性代理与恢复难度的课程式退化生成方法 ReDiC。

papers.title: Evaluating Governed LLM-Driven ML Experimentation: Lifecycle, Provenance, and Failure Metrics
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents that run ML experiments are usually judged by the best score they reach. That score says nothing about how it was reached: whether the agent stayed within the files it was allowed to edit, whether failed trials were kept or silently dropped, and whether each keep or discard decision can be traced to its evidence. We propose evaluating such systems on their experimental process as well as their outcome, and we build a governed harness that makes this possible. A control plane, not the LLM that proposes changes, owns each trial's lifecycle, checks its edit scope, decides keep or discard, and appends one record per trial to an append-only ledger. Governance metrics such as the invalid-action rate, the repeated-bad rate and provenance completeness are computed from that ledger. Across six ML tasks, from synthetic logistic regression to language-model training, and 1,445 trials, the same contract applied unchanged. The ledger exposed failures that a task score hides: a no-memory arm in which all 120 trials failed, a benchmark adapter whose bounded proposals ran out, and a reset failure that reproducibility hashes revealed, after which the affected campaigns were rerun. In a matched counterfactual, a loop that logs only successful trials left no record of 43 of 50 trials, while the governed ledger recorded all 50. Memory ablations show that memory's effect on repeated bad proposals depends on the task. We release the ledgers of all 1,445 trials, so that every number reported for them can be recomputed.

translation.title: 评估受治理的 LLM 驱动 ML 实验：生命周期、溯源与失败指标
translation.abstract: 运行 ML 实验的自主智能体通常仅以最佳分数评判，但该分数无法说明其达成方式：智能体是否只编辑了被允许的文件、失败试验是被保留还是被悄悄丢弃、每次保留或丢弃决策能否追溯到证据。我们提出同时从实验过程和结果评估此类系统，并构建了一个使其成为可能的受治理测试框架。由控制平面而非提出修改的 LLM 掌控每个试验的生命周期、检查其编辑范围、决定保留或丢弃，并将每个试验的记录追加到只追加账本中。治理指标如无效操作率、重复错误率和溯源完整性均从该账本计算。在从合成逻辑回归到语言模型训练的六个 ML 任务、共 1,445 次试验中，同一契约保持不变。账本暴露了任务分数所掩盖的失败：一个无记忆分支中全部 120 次试验失败、一个基准适配器的有限提案耗尽，以及通过可复现性哈希揭示的重置失败，之后受影响的实验被重跑。在匹配的反事实中，仅记录成功试验的循环对 50 次试验中的 43 次没有留下记录，而受治理账本记录了全部 50 次。记忆消融实验表明，记忆对重复错误提案的影响取决于任务。我们公开全部 1,445 次试验的账本，使报告的每个数字都可重新计算。
translation.brief: 针对自主 ML 实验智能体只按结果分数评估而忽视过程合规性的问题，提出由控制平面治理、基于只追加账本的实验过程评估框架与治理指标。

papers.title: Structured Extraction of Diffraction Data from Covalent Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) is the primary structural evidence for covalent organic frameworks (COFs) and many other materials. Yet decades of measured patterns exist only as images in published figures. Automatic recovery is difficult, because PXRD figures vary widely in format, from a single curve to crowded stacks with labels, insets, and neighboring plots that challenge traditional computer vision. This work presents a pipeline in which a vision large language model (LLM) interprets the layout of each figure, locating the diffraction plot and its curves and sketching a coarse trace of each, while classical computer vision (CV) refines every trace to pixel-level accuracy. Applied to 3,954 COF articles, the pipeline produces 11,445 calibrated diffraction curves, released in the open database COF-PEAK. Compared with a hand digitization of 60 panels, extracted peak positions differ by a median of only 0.07 degrees. Whereas papers usually report only a few peak angles, which limits further analysis, the digitized curves enable tracking how peak prominence, a possible marker of crystallinity, changes with synthesis conditions. Vision LLMs and classical CV can thus turn such figures into reusable experimental data.

translation.title: 共价有机框架衍射数据的结构化提取
translation.abstract: 粉末 X 射线衍射（PXRD）是共价有机框架（COF）及许多其他材料的主要结构证据，然而数十年的测量图谱仅以已发表论文中的图像形式存在。自动恢复很困难，因为 PXRD 图格式差异巨大，从单条曲线到带有标签、插图和相邻图形的拥挤堆叠图，都对传统计算机视觉构成挑战。本工作提出一条流水线：视觉大语言模型（LLM）解读每个图的布局，定位衍射图及其曲线并勾勒每条曲线的粗略轨迹，而经典计算机视觉（CV）将每条轨迹细化到像素级精度。应用于 3,954 篇 COF 文章，该流水线产出 11,445 条经标定的衍射曲线，并发布于开放数据库 COF-PEAK。与 60 个图版的人工数字化相比，提取的峰位中位偏差仅 0.07 度。论文通常只报告少数几个峰角度，限制了进一步分析，而数字化曲线使我们能够追踪峰显著度（可能是结晶度的标志）随合成条件的变化。视觉 LLM 与经典 CV 因此可以将此类图转化为可复用的实验数据。
translation.brief: 针对 PXRD 衍射图仅以论文图像形式存在、难以自动提取的问题，提出视觉 LLM 解读布局加经典 CV 像素级细化的两阶段数字化流水线。

papers.title: JEV vs. LLMs: A Comparative Analysis for Phishing Email Detection
papers.abstract: Phishing remains a major source of credential theft and fraudulent payments, and email security systems must classify large message volumes reliably, quickly, and at manageable cost. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer flexible text understanding, but their token-based generation increases response time and API cost, and the reliability of their confidence values requires measurement. Jev 1.13, a typed decision model from TypeSafe AI, instead returns a structured outcome with a confidence value. This paper compares Jev 1.13 with Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, and Meta Llama 4 Maverick on a labelled dataset of 1500 emails, covering classification performance, decision latency, token consumption, API cost, and probability calibration. Jev achieves the highest accuracy (79.67%), precision (71.43%), recall (97.97%), and F1 score (82.62%). It also records the shortest batch time (173.88 seconds), the lowest token count (597,895), the lowest cost (USD 0.015103 per 1000 decisions), and the lowest Brier score (0.1698) and ECE (0.1594). These results suggest that Jev is a promising option for fast, structured, high-volume triage. LLMs retain the advantage of generating explanations, which we do not evaluate, and all four systems require further validation before standalone deployment.

translation.title: JEV 与 LLM 的对比分析：钓鱼邮件检测
translation.abstract: 钓鱼攻击仍是凭证窃取和欺诈支付的主要来源，邮件安全系统必须可靠、快速且以可控成本对大量邮件进行分类。大语言模型（LLM）提供灵活的文本理解能力，但其基于 token 的生成增加了响应时间和 API 成本，且其置信度值的可靠性需要测量。来自 TypeSafe AI 的类型化决策模型 Jev 1.13 则返回带置信度值的结构化结果。本文在 1,500 封标注邮件数据集上，将 Jev 1.13 与 Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra 和 Meta Llama 4 Maverick 进行比较，涵盖分类性能、决策延迟、token 消耗、API 成本和概率校准。Jev 取得最高的准确率（79.67%）、精确率（71.43%）、召回率（97.97%）和 F1 分数（82.62%），同时记录了最短的批处理时间（173.88 秒）、最低的 token 数（597,895）、最低的成本（每 1,000 次决策 0.015103 美元）以及最低的 Brier 分数（0.1698）和 ECE（0.1594）。这些结果表明 Jev 是快速、结构化、大批量分诊的有前景选择。LLM 保留了生成解释的优势（本文未评估），且所有四个系统在独立部署前都需要进一步验证。
translation.brief: 针对钓鱼邮件检测中 LLM 延迟与成本高的问题，将类型化决策模型 Jev 1.13 与多个 LLM 在准确率、延迟、成本和校准上进行系统对比。

papers.title: MEM-STRESS: Longitudinal Field Study of a Wearable-Informed AI Chatbot for Stress Management
papers.abstract: Stress is an increasingly prevalent concern, creating a need for accessible and personalized support. Stress-management chatbots primarily rely on what users report, which may not capture their physiological changes. Wearables capture these changes, but chatbots rarely use them as memory across conversations. We therefore present MEM-STRESS, a stress-support chatbot that turns a wearable ring's physiological data into a layered memory of daily records, baseline deviations, LLM-generated summaries, and uses it to drive multi-session conversations grounded in Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT). In a four-week, non-randomized study with 60 adults, we compared MEM-STRESS (Treatment) with a chatbot remembering only past conversations (Control). Memory shaped the conversations: The Treatment chatbot referenced participants' physiological features (e.g., activity in 71.8% of sessions) and suggested more body-related DBT skills than Control (14.5% vs. 5.7%), with Treatment participants also using slightly more body-related words (1.76% vs. 1.45%). Treatment participants praised personalization three times as often (44.4% vs. 14.3%), more frequently reported reflecting differently on stress (69.0% vs. 46.4%, not significant), and described gaining insight into their stress signals. Their perceived stress fell 14.2% from baseline versus 3.6% for Control, though the group difference was not significant. Grounding stress-support chatbots in layered physiological memory is thus feasible and may improve perceived personalization, motivating larger randomized studies.

translation.title: MEM-STRESS：基于可穿戴设备的 AI 压力管理聊天bot纵向实地研究
translation.abstract: 压力是日益普遍的问题，催生了对可及且个性化支持的需求。压力管理聊天bot主要依赖用户自述，可能无法捕捉其生理变化。可穿戴设备能捕捉这些变化，但聊天bot很少将其作为跨会话的记忆。因此我们提出 MEM-STRESS，一个压力支持聊天bot，它将可穿戴戒指的生理数据转化为分层记忆（每日记录、基线偏差、LLM 生成的摘要），并以此驱动基于辩证行为疗法（DBT）的多会话对话。在一项为期四周、60 名成人的非随机研究中，我们将 MEM-STRESS（处理组）与仅记住过往对话的聊天bot（对照组）进行比较。记忆塑造了对话：处理组聊天bot在 71.8% 的会话中引用了参与者的生理特征（如活动），并比对照组建议更多与身体相关的 DBT 技能（14.5% 对 5.7%），处理组参与者也使用略多的身体相关词汇（1.76% 对 1.45%）。处理组参与者对个性化的称赞频率是对照组的三倍（44.4% 对 14.3%），更常报告以不同方式反思压力（69.0% 对 46.4%，不显著），并描述了对自身压力信号的洞察。他们的感知压力较基线下降 14.2%，对照组为 3.6%，但组间差异不显著。因此，以分层生理记忆为基础的压力支持聊天bot是可行的，并可能提升感知个性化，值得开展更大规模的随机研究。
translation.brief: 针对压力管理聊天bot缺乏生理信息记忆的问题，提出将可穿戴戒指数据转化为分层记忆并驱动基于 DBT 的多会话对话的聊天bot MEM-STRESS。

papers.title: MoMoVL: Modality-Aware Adaptive Compression for On-Device Sparsely-Activated Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: The rise of the agentic web has been accompanied by growing demand for on-device Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that perform diverse cross-modal web tasks with enhanced privacy and reduced latency. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely adopted in modern VLMs for compute-efficient scalability, yet their multi-expert architecture poses deployment challenges due to substantial memory demands. Mixed-precision quantization is an effective compression technique that reduces bit-widths while adapting to the heterogeneous hardware budgets of edge devices, particularly well-suited for MoE due to its inherent structural sparsity, which causes imbalanced importance among experts. While prior work has applied quantization for efficient MoE inference at the edge, we point out that in MoE-based VLMs, the modality-specific characteristics of visual and text tokens further impact expert quantization. To address this issue, we present MoMoVL, a modality-aware adaptive compression framework for MoE-based VLMs that brings vision-language inference within reach of on-device resource budgets. Motivated by our empirical findings on modality-induced disparities across experts, MoMoVL jointly exploits the per-expert activation profile and per-modality quantization sensitivity to guide bit-width assignment. Experimental results show that MoMoVL improves the accuracy-compression trade-off relative to state-of-the-art mixed-precision baselines and reduces memory footprint by up to 15.44% with a modest drop in accuracy over its uniform-precision baseline. Our code and data are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: MoMoVL：面向端侧稀疏激活视觉语言模型的模态感知自适应压缩
translation.abstract: 随着智能体网络的兴起，对能在端侧执行多样化跨模态网络任务、同时增强隐私并降低延迟的视觉语言模型（VLM）需求不断增长。混合专家（MoE）模型因其计算高效的可扩展性被现代VLM广泛采用，但其多专家架构因巨大的内存需求而带来部署挑战。混合精度量化是一种有效的压缩技术，可在适应边缘设备异构硬件预算的同时降低位宽，尤其适合MoE，因为其固有的结构稀疏性导致专家间重要性不均衡。虽然已有工作将量化应用于边缘端高效的MoE推理，我们指出在基于MoE的VLM中，视觉与文本token的模态特有特征会进一步影响专家量化。为此，我们提出MoMoVL，一个面向MoE VLM的模态感知自适应压缩框架，使视觉语言推理能够满足端侧资源预算。基于我们对模态导致的专家间差异的实证发现，MoMoVL联合利用每个专家的激活分布和每个模态的量化敏感度来指导位宽分配。实验结果表明，MoMoVL相比最先进的混合精度基线改善了精度-压缩权衡，在精度仅有轻微下降的情况下，相比均匀精度基线最多减少15.44%的内存占用。我们的代码和数据已在公开网址提供。
translation.brief: 针对MoE视觉语言模型端侧部署内存过大的问题，提出联合利用专家激活分布与模态量化敏感度来分配位宽的模态感知混合精度量化框架MoMoVL。

papers.title: Auditable Clinical Support with Decision Agents
papers.abstract: Clinicians reviewing a diagnostic work-up will ask what was considered at each step and why the assessment changed. Agents powered by free text can reach physician-level diagnostic accuracy, but their written reasoning does not always reflect the factors that went into the decision. Here, we present Decision2Care, a decision agent that works up the acutely ill patient without producing any text. A decision model assigns a probability to each permitted EHR action, and fixed rules carry out the most probable one. We evaluated Decision2Care on the records of 546 emergency admissions across 12 diseases. Decision2Care reached a diagnostic accuracy of 86.5%, compared with 86.1% for the MIRA-v2 agent, and required a median of 2.2 s per work-up, compared with 92-100 s. Each work-up tracked which options Decision2Care was considering at each step. In 10 of the 12 diseases, the differential diagnosis changed most at the test on which the guideline bases the diagnosis. Where Decision2Care was most confident after a single work-up, all but four of its diagnoses were correct (98.5%). We traced each of these four errors back to a single imaging report. Three of them were corrected when that report was removed. The same kind of decision was used to select the treatments, and Decision2Care's drug orders were judged guideline-adherent more often than MIRA-v2's. In emergency patients, its prediction of death was comparable to that of three intensivists on the same cases. In five of the eight intensive care cohorts, it exceeded the best of the three 24-h severity scores within 2-6 h of records. Our results show that decision agents can carry out clinical work-ups while recording the options, probabilities, and execution rules behind each action for audit.

translation.title: 基于决策智能体的可审计临床辅助
translation.abstract: 临床医生在审阅诊断检查时会询问每一步考虑了什么、评估为何改变。由自由文本驱动的智能体可以达到医生级别的诊断准确率，但其书面推理并不总能反映决策背后的因素。在此，我们提出Decision2Care，一个不产生任何文本即可对急症患者进行诊断检查的决策智能体。决策模型为每个允许的EHR操作分配概率，固定规则执行概率最高的操作。我们在涵盖12种疾病的546例急诊入院记录上评估了Decision2Care。Decision2Care达到86.5%的诊断准确率，而MIRA-v2智能体为86.1%，且每次检查中位耗时2.2秒，而后者为92-100秒。每次检查都记录了Decision2Care在每一步考虑的选项。在12种疾病中的10种中，鉴别诊断在指南作为诊断依据的检查项目上变化最大。在Decision2Care单次检查后最有信心的情形中，除四个诊断外其余全部正确（98.5%）。我们将这四个错误全部追溯到单份影像报告，其中三个在移除该报告后得到纠正。同样的决策方式被用于选择治疗方案，且Decision2Care的用药医嘱比MIRA-v2的更常被判定为符合指南。在急诊患者中，其对死亡的预测与三位重症医学专家在同一病例上的表现相当。在八个重症监护队列中的五个里，它在2-6小时的记录内超过了三个24小时严重程度评分中的最佳者。我们的结果表明，决策智能体可以在执行临床检查的同时记录每个动作背后的选项、概率和执行规则以供审计。
translation.brief: 针对文本智能体临床推理不可审计的问题，提出不生成文本、由决策模型按概率执行EHR操作的决策智能体Decision2Care，完整记录每步的选项与概率以供审计。

papers.title: KnowMe Paper Radar: Lightweight Discovery of Promising Papers in the Age of Autoresearch
papers.abstract: The growing volume of topically similar papers makes it difficult to identify new work that can offer useful research insights or methodological guidance. We present KnowMe Paper Radar, a lightweight discovery tool that combines multiple sources of evidence into personalized reading priorities. Users specify topics, priorities, exclusions and dates; the system brings together topical relevance, recency, author research histories, collaboration paths and direction-specific institutional context. By exposing each score component and its supporting sources, KnowMe helps readers select promising papers for their current questions and discover relevant work beyond familiar authors. Automatic acquisition, version merging and graph-cache reuse keep this workflow convenient without large language model (LLM) inference during ordinary use. Experiments on 174,640 acquired records show more than threefold faster repeated context preparation, while cached abstracts improve normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10 (NDCG@10) from 0.412 to 0.598 on expert-judged retrieval tasks. Complementary analyses examine how the same accumulated records support semantic retrieval, research-history modeling and literature-grounded planning. A browser interface and a structured command-line interface (CLI) make these capabilities available to both researchers and research agents, positioning KnowMe as a practical upstream tool for literature-informed recursive self-improvement (RSI) workflows.

translation.title: KnowMe Paper Radar：自研究时代下有前景论文的轻量级发现
translation.abstract: 主题相似的论文数量不断增长，使得识别能够提供有用研究见解或方法指导的新工作变得困难。我们提出KnowMe Paper Radar，一个将多种证据来源整合为个性化阅读优先级的轻量级发现工具。用户指定主题、优先级、排除项和日期；系统综合主题相关性、时效性、作者研究历史、合作路径以及方向特定的机构背景。通过展示每个评分组件及其支持来源，KnowMe帮助读者为其当前问题挑选有前景的论文，并发现熟悉作者之外的相关工作。自动获取、版本合并和图缓存复用使这一工作流程保持便捷，且日常使用中无需大语言模型（LLM）推理。在174,640条获取记录上的实验显示，重复上下文准备速度提升三倍以上，而缓存的摘要在专家评判的检索任务上将NDCG@10从0.412提升至0.598。补充分析考察了同一批积累的记录如何支持语义检索、研究历史建模和基于文献的规划。浏览器界面和结构化命令行界面（CLI）使这些能力对研究者和研究智能体均可用，将KnowMe定位为文献驱动的递归自我改进（RSI）工作流的实用上游工具。
translation.brief: 针对海量相似论文难以筛选的问题，提出融合主题相关性、时效性、作者历史与合作路径等多源证据、无需LLM推理的轻量级个性化论文发现工具KnowMe Paper Radar。

papers.title: Localizing Text Anonymization for Trustworthy AI: Extending RAT-Bench to Malaysian Microdata and PII
papers.abstract: As governments and organizations adopt foundation models for public services and workplace productivity, sensitive citizen, employee, and administrative text may enter LLM workflows through inference, retrieval, fine-tuning, or local model development. We examine whether text anonymizers transfer to new deployment settings by extending RAT-Bench to Malaysia using local microdata, Malaysian PII formats, and culturally grounded transcripts in Malaysian English and Bahasa Malaysia. We evaluate NER- and LLM-based anonymizers using an LLM attacker that infers attributes from anonymized text, measuring both re-identification success and text utility. Across Malaysian English and Bahasa Malaysia, the two LLM anonymizers provide the strongest explicit privacy-utility trade-offs, reducing Easy/Hard re-identification risk to 23-29% while preserving BLEU scores of 0.77-0.94. Non-LLM tools show sharper failure modes, either preserving utility while leaving high residual risk or reducing risk through severe over-redaction, especially in Bahasa Malaysia. These findings suggest that anonymizers should be evaluated against deployment-relevant languages, identifier formats, and cultural contexts before being relied on in public-sector, workplace, or local AI pipelines.

translation.title: 面向可信AI的文本匿名化本地化评估：将RAT-Bench扩展至马来西亚微数据与PII
translation.abstract: 随着政府和组织在公共服务与职场生产力中采用基础模型，敏感的公民、员工和行政文本可能通过推理、检索、微调或本地模型开发进入LLM工作流。我们通过使用本地微数据、马来西亚PII格式以及马来西亚英语和马来语的文化背景转录文本，将RAT-Bench扩展至马来西亚，考察文本匿名化工具能否迁移到新的部署环境。我们使用从匿名化文本推断属性的LLM攻击者评估基于NER和LLM的匿名化工具，同时衡量重识别成功率和文本效用。在马来西亚英语和马来语上，两个LLM匿名化工具提供了最强的显式隐私-效用权衡，将Easy/Hard重识别风险降至23-29%，同时保持0.77-0.94的BLEU分数。非LLM工具表现出更尖锐的失效模式：要么保留效用但留下高残余风险，要么通过严重的过度遮蔽来降低风险，在马来语中尤其如此。这些发现表明，在公共部门、职场或本地AI流程中依赖匿名化工具之前，应针对部署相关的语言、标识符格式和文化背景对其进行评估。
translation.brief: 针对匿名化工具在新部署环境是否有效的问题，将RAT-Bench扩展至马来西亚语言与PII场景，用LLM攻击者评估各类匿名化工具的重识别风险与文本效用。

papers.title: HypoLoop: Revising Weight-Editing Plans from Scientific Feedback
papers.abstract: Scientific experiments continually reveal prediction errors. Effective updates depend on which parameters change and which errors drive the correction. We introduce HypoLoop, a family of native weight-editing methods that connects these choices to experimental feedback. Fixed, numerically adaptive, and LLM-guided policies produce editing plans; numerical solvers compute weight patches, and internal validation selects the deployed predictor. Successive observations and validation records support revisions to editable locations and fitting rules. Experiments cover 22 scientific tasks and both DeepSeek and Claude. On Burgers, reallocating a matched parameter budget reduces error by 58.80% and 47.72% relative to fixed locations. On DIODE, positive-residual weighting reduces absolute relative error (AbsRel) by 13.35% in internal cross-validation, with the same 33 editable coordinates. Revising the complete plan across rounds lowers final AbsRel by 10.59% relative to keeping the initial plan fixed. SpaceNet7 and Make3D connect accepted edits to improved spatial predictions. These results show how experimental evidence can shape the update problem itself. Code: this https URL.

translation.title: HypoLoop：基于科学反馈修正权重编辑计划
translation.abstract: 科学实验不断揭示预测误差。有效的更新取决于哪些参数被改变以及哪些误差驱动修正。我们提出HypoLoop，一类将上述选择与实验反馈相联系的本地权重编辑方法。固定策略、数值自适应策略和LLM引导策略生成编辑计划；数值求解器计算权重补丁，内部验证选择部署的预测器。连续的观测和验证记录支持对可编辑位置和拟合规则的修订。实验涵盖22个科学任务以及DeepSeek和Claude。在Burgers任务上，重新分配同等参数预算相比固定位置将误差降低58.80%和47.72%。在DIODE任务上，正残差加权在内部交叉验证中将绝对相对误差（AbsRel）降低13.35%，且使用相同的33个可编辑坐标。跨轮次修正完整计划相比保持初始计划不变，将最终AbsRel降低10.59%。SpaceNet7和Make3D将接受的编辑与改进的空间预测联系起来。这些结果表明实验证据如何塑造更新问题本身。代码：公开网址。
translation.brief: 针对权重编辑中可编辑参数位置与误差来源选择的问题，提出HypoLoop方法族，利用实验反馈和验证记录迭代修正权重编辑计划。

papers.title: GTA: Generative Tower of Agents for Scalable Holonic Scene Generation
papers.abstract: Scalable world modeling requires coordinating scene-wide goals with fine-grained objects and dynamic characters under limited time and context budgets. We introduce GTA (Generative Tower of Agents), which represents every unit at every level of an adaptive scene hierarchy as a holon, both a self-contained construction task and a composable scene unit. Parallel agents recursively plan the hierarchy top-down, generate assets, and assemble and refine them bottom-up. Uniform interfaces carry scene-wide requirements down the hierarchy, guiding local construction so that each holon fits into the larger one. GTA accelerates scalable world modeling through high-throughput parallel execution while preserving well-structured layouts and fine-grained asset details. GTA then populates the assembled environments with dynamic human characters whose appearance and motion are guided by the scene, yielding realized 4D worlds. Project page: this https URL

translation.title: GTA：面向可扩展整体式场景生成的智能体生成塔
translation.abstract: 可扩展的世界建模需要在有限的时间和上下文预算下，协调场景级目标与细粒度物体及动态角色。我们提出GTA（Generative Tower of Agents），将自适应场景层级中每一层的每个单元表示为一个holon（整体子结构），它既是一个自包含的构建任务，也是一个可组合的场景单元。并行的智能体自顶向下递归规划层级，生成资产，并自底向上进行组装与精化。统一的接口将场景级需求沿层级向下传递，引导局部构建，使每个holon都能融入更大的holon。GTA通过高吞吐并行执行加速可扩展世界建模，同时保持结构良好的布局和细粒度的资产细节。随后，GTA用动态人物角色填充组装好的环境，其外观和动作由场景引导，从而生成实现的4D世界。项目页面：this https URL
translation.brief: 解决大规模场景生成中全局目标与细粒度单元难以协调的问题，核心方法是将场景层级各层单元建模为holon并由并行智能体自顶向下规划、自底向上组装。

papers.title: Reliability is a user-specific property of large language models
papers.abstract: Public benchmarks support comparisons of large language model (LLM) capabilities, yet users can experience the same highly ranked model differently. Drawing on traditional software reliability, we argue that the reliability of an LLM service should be assessed for specified users and conditions of use. This requires more than a capability score: evaluation evidence must support a claim about failure during future operation. We distinguish testing to discover faults from testing to assess reliability and identify ten modelling considerations behind such claims. We propose a six-workstream research roadmap linking claim specification, dynamic operational profiles, graded outcomes and noisy judgements, local probabilistic robustness, interaction dependence, and statistical inference with reassessment. Local probabilistic robustness addresses the behavioural variation hidden when different concrete inputs are treated as the same task. Published findings and an illustrative customer-support example motivate the roadmap; its integrated validation remains an open research task. Reliability claims complement, but do not replace, separate safety and security arguments. Capability scores should therefore be complemented by versioned operational claims that state whose requirements are covered, under which conditions, and with what uncertainty.

translation.title: 可靠性是大型语言模型的用户特定属性
translation.abstract: 公开基准支持对大型语言模型（LLM）能力的比较，但用户对同一高排名模型的实际体验可能各不相同。借鉴传统软件可靠性理论，我们认为LLM服务的可靠性应针对特定用户和使用条件进行评估。这不仅仅需要一个能力分数：评估证据必须能够支持关于未来运行中故障的断言。我们区分了发现缺陷的测试与评估可靠性的测试，并识别出支撑此类断言的十个建模考量。我们提出了一个包含六个工作流的研究路线图，涵盖断言规范、动态运行剖面、分级结果与含噪判定、局部概率鲁棒性、交互依赖性以及带重新评估的统计推断。局部概率鲁棒性解决了将不同具体输入视为同一任务时隐藏的行为差异。已发表的研究结果和一个客服示例为该路线图提供了动机；其整合验证仍是开放的研究任务。可靠性断言是对独立的安全与安保论证的补充，而非替代。因此，能力分数应由带版本的运行断言来补充，这些断言说明覆盖了谁的需求、在何种条件下、以及具有何种不确定性。
translation.brief: 解决LLM可靠性评估脱离具体用户和使用条件的问题，核心方法是借鉴软件可靠性理论提出面向特定用户与运行条件的可靠性断言框架及六条研究路线。

papers.title: A Comparison of Heuristic, Human-Sensitive, and Self-Play DRL Policies in Human-Agent Teaming
papers.abstract: Dynamical Perceptual-Motor Primitives (DPMPs) offer a tractable framework for generating human-like movement dynamics in artificial agents (AAs) and have been used to support coordination in human-AI teaming tasks. Traditionally, DPMP controllers rely on heuristic (rule-based) decision policies derived from human behavior to guide goal selection and action sequencing. Although effective in structured tasks, such heuristics can be difficult to generalize to more complex settings, motivating interest in deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches for learning decision policies for human-AI interaction. A key challenge, however, is ensuring that DRL policies remain aligned with human strategies, particularly when agents are trained through self-play. To examine this issue, we compared three target-selection policies governing DPMP-based AAs in a first-person herding task: (1) a human-derived heuristic policy, (2) a self-play DRL policy (SP-DRL), and (3) a human-sensitive DRL policy (HS-DRL) trained alongside a heuristic agent. Results showed that heuristic agents most closely matched typical human-human coordination patterns, followed by HS-DRL agents, whereas SP-DRL agents deviated most. These findings highlight the importance of human-informed training when developing DRL-based teammates and suggest that simple heuristic policies may remain an effective approach for designing human-aligned AAs capable of human-AI collaboration.

translation.title: 启发式、人类敏感与自博弈DRL策略在人机协作中的比较
translation.abstract: 动态感知-运动基元（DPMP）为在人工智能体（AA）中生成类人运动动力学提供了一个可处理的框架，并已被用于支持人机协作任务中的协调。传统上，DPMP控制器依赖从人类行为中导出的启发式（基于规则的）决策策略来引导目标选择和动作排序。尽管在结构化任务中有效，此类启发式策略难以泛化到更复杂的场景，这促使人们关注用深度强化学习（DRL）为人机交互学习决策策略。然而，一个关键挑战是确保DRL策略与人类策略保持一致，尤其是当智能体通过自博弈训练时。为考察这一问题，我们在第一人称围捕任务中比较了三种控制基于DPMP的AA的目标选择策略：（1）源自人类的启发式策略，（2）自博弈DRL策略（SP-DRL），（3）与启发式智能体一同训练的人类敏感DRL策略（HS-DRL）。结果显示，启发式智能体最接近典型的人-人协调模式，其次是HS-DRL智能体，而SP-DRL智能体偏差最大。这些发现凸显了在开发基于DRL的队友时引入人类信息训练的重要性，并表明简单的启发式策略在设计与人类对齐、能进行人机协作的AA方面可能仍然有效。
translation.brief: 解决DRL训练的智能体策略与人类策略不一致的问题，核心方法是在围捕任务中比较启发式、自博弈DRL与人类敏感DRL三种目标选择策略。

papers.title: Modeling LLM Reasoning Dynamics with Structural Representations
papers.abstract: Language-model reasoning alternates between sustained activities and local operations. We study how this temporal structure predicts continuation and the computation needed to analyze it. T/E/S combines text, local events, and spans of activity. Across reasoning and information-seeking tasks, events and spans improve next-outcome prediction in 70 of 76 evaluation groups for a Transformer and 74 of 76 for Qwen with LoRA. Span duration and preceding events are associated with transitions, and retaining event history across span boundaries improves prediction. We formulate budget-allocation counting and action-conditional continuation queries, prove counting hardness under explicit encodings, and derive conditions for affordable decision certification. In finite-process experiments, bounds that cancel shared continuation mass recover the same optimal actions as full dynamic programming while reducing mean inference CPU time by 77.7%. On 71 held-out HotpotQA and MuSiQue questions, a compact structural observer improves prediction of whether a fixed inference procedure finishes within a CPU allowance: Brier loss falls from 0.0836 to 0.0756. An annotation audit identifies substantial errors in that observer, separating this computational result from semantic validation of its features.

translation.title: 用结构化表示建模LLM推理动态
translation.abstract: 语言模型的推理在持续活动与局部操作之间交替。我们研究这种时间结构如何预测后续走向，以及分析它所需的计算。T/E/S结合了文本、局部事件和活动片段。在推理与信息检索任务上，事件和片段在76个评估组中的70个（Transformer）和74个（Qwen with LoRA）中改进了下一结果预测。片段时长和先前事件与状态转移相关，且跨片段边界保留事件历史能改进预测。我们形式化了预算分配计数和动作条件下的后续查询，证明了显式编码下计数的难度，并推导了可负担的决策认证条件。在有限过程实验中，抵消共享后续质量的边界在将平均推理CPU时间降低77.7%的同时，恢复了与完整动态规划相同的最优动作。在71个留出的HotpotQA和MuSiQue问题上，一个紧凑的结构化观察器改进了对固定推理过程能否在CPU配额内完成的预测：Brier损失从0.0836降至0.0756。标注审计发现该观察器存在大量错误，从而将这一计算结果与其特征的语义验证区分开来。
translation.brief: 解决LLM推理过程的时间结构建模与预测问题，核心方法是用文本-事件-片段（T/E/S）结构化表示刻画推理动态并构建高效预测与决策认证机制。

papers.title: Thinking Fast, Anywhere: One System-1 for the Decision Points of Any Agent Workflow
papers.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents incur substantial cost and latency by invoking a large model (System-2) at every step, even when many intermediate actions choose among a small set of known candidates. Existing dual-system agents offload such decisions to a lightweight System-1 model, but rely on workflow-specific hooks authored per environment. We present AnyS1, a framework that turns human-authored procedural skills, whose instructions naturally specify where choices arise and which options apply, into a shared, domain-general source of decision points. Offline, AnyS1 mines grounded enumerable decisions across over 1,000 public skills, gathers execution-grounded trajectory states inside isolated containers to construct Any-DP, and trains a single calibrated 4B pointer System-1 with label smoothing. At run time, compiled workflows resolve routine decisions in one forward pass and fall back to System-2 when confidence falls below a calibrated threshold. Across three unseen benchmarks and distinct System-2 model families, AnyS1 preserves task reliability while cutting episode cost by 75-91% and model-call time by 63-92% relative to an uncompiled System-2 agent, and maintains performance under zero-shot threshold transfer.

translation.title: 快速思考，随处可用：面向任意智能体工作流决策点的统一System-1
translation.abstract: 自主LLM智能体在每一步都调用大模型（System-2），即使许多中间动作只是在一小组已知候选中选择，也会带来高昂的成本和延迟。现有的双系统智能体将此类决策交给轻量级的System-1模型，但依赖针对每个环境单独编写的特定工作流钩子。我们提出AnyS1，一个将人类编写的程序性技能（其指令天然指明了选择出现的位置及可选项）转化为共享的、领域通用的决策点来源的框架。离线阶段，AnyS1从超过1,000个公开技能中挖掘有依据的可枚举决策，在隔离容器内收集基于执行的轨迹状态以构建Any-DP，并训练一个经过校准的4B指针型System-1（带标签平滑）。运行时，编译后的工作流通过一次前向传播解决常规决策，并在置信度低于校准阈值时回退到System-2。在三个未见过的基准和不同的System-2模型家族上，AnyS1在保持任务可靠性的同时，相比未编译的System-2智能体将回合成本降低75-91%、模型调用时间降低63-92%，并在零样本阈值迁移下保持性能。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体每步都调用大模型导致高成本高延迟的问题，核心方法是从公开程序性技能中挖掘决策点训练统一的轻量System-1模型，低置信度时回退System-2。

papers.title: Temporal Fair Division: Simultaneous Guarantees for Goods and Chores
papers.abstract: We study temporal fair division of indivisible items in both the goods and chores settings, with $n \ge 2$ agents and nonnegative additive values or costs. Items arrive one at a time and must be assigned immediately and irrevocably. The arrival order and all agents' values or costs are known in advance, and the cumulative allocation must satisfy the fairness requirements after each arrival. For goods, we give a polynomial-time algorithm that simultaneously achieves exact temporal proportionality up to one item (TPROP1), a $1/n$ approximation to temporal maximin share (TMMS), and a $1/(n-1)$ approximation to temporal envy-freeness up to one item (TEF1). The TMMS factor is optimal. For chores, we give a polynomial-time algorithm that simultaneously achieves exact TPROP1 and a $2-1/n$ approximation to TMMS. Classical scheduling lower bounds based on fixed sequences carry over to chores TMMS, establishing the optimality of this factor for $n=2,3$. For every $n \ge 2$, we further show that $2-1/n$ is the optimal TMMS factor subject to exact TPROP1. For every fixed $n \ge 3$ and every finite $\beta \ge 1$, we construct an instance of chores admitting no $\beta$-TEF1 allocation.

translation.title: 时序公平分配：物品与杂务的同时保证
translation.abstract: 我们研究不可分物品在物品（goods）与杂务（chores）两种设定下的时序公平分配，设有 $n \ge 2$ 个智能体以及非负可加的估值或成本。物品逐个到达，必须立即且不可撤销地分配。到达顺序和所有智能体的估值或成本事先已知，且每次到达后的累积分配都必须满足公平性要求。对于物品，我们给出一个多项式时间算法，可同时实现精确的时序比例性至多差一件（TPROP1）、时序最大最小份额（TMMS）的 $1/n$ 近似，以及时序无嫉妒至多差一件（TEF1）的 $1/(n-1)$ 近似。该 TMMS 因子是最优的。对于杂务，我们给出一个多项式时间算法，可同时实现精确的 TPROP1 和 TMMS 的 $2-1/n$ 近似。基于固定序列的经典调度下界可推广到杂务 TMMS，证明了该因子在 $n=2,3$ 时的最优性。对于每个 $n \ge 2$，我们进一步证明在精确 TPROP1 约束下 $2-1/n$ 是最优的 TMMS 因子。对于每个固定的 $n \ge 3$ 和每个有限的 $\beta \ge 1$，我们构造了一个不存在 $\beta$-TEF1 分配的杂务实例。
translation.brief: 研究物品逐个到达且须即时不可撤销分配的时序公平分配问题，通过多项式时间算法在物品和杂务设定下同时实现 TPROP1、TMMS 与 TEF1 的近似保证并证明最优性。

papers.title: PReMind: When Personal Memory Meets Visual Hazards
papers.abstract: Personalized vision-language assistants use visual observations and personal memories to provide advice tailored to the user. When the observed scene contains a physical hazard, personal context, such as allergies, medical conditions, or mobility constraints, can change what help is appropriate. Responding appropriately therefore requires recognizing the visible hazard and applying the relevant person's information. We introduce PReMind-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates this combination across diverse hazards and personal-memory conditions. It separately measures memory access, grounding, abstention, and hazard response, and assesses joint success on interdependency cases. Existing models often satisfy one requirement while failing the other, and training only for safety or personalization leaves a gap in joint success. We therefore propose PReMind, a two-phase reinforcement learning framework that combines on-demand and forced-call interactions (memory always retrieved) to jointly train grounded memory use and hazard response. At 4B, PReMind raises joint success from 12.9% to 28.6% over its base on the interdependency set and improves hazard adequacy and correct abstention on the main test. Joint-success gains persist under forced-call evaluation and under a second LLM judge across three Phase II seeds; averaged over these seeds, joint success also improves on unseen hazard groups. These findings highlight the need to evaluate and train personal assistants to connect visual evidence with the relevant person's context.

translation.title: PReMind：当个人记忆遇上视觉危险
translation.abstract: 个性化视觉-语言助手利用视觉观察和个人记忆提供针对用户的建议。当观察到的场景包含物理危险时，个人背景信息（如过敏、疾病或行动限制）可能改变何种帮助是恰当的。因此，恰当的回应需要识别可见的危险并应用相关人员的信息。我们提出 PReMind-Bench，一个诊断性基准，用于在多样的危险和个人记忆条件下评估这种组合能力。它分别测量记忆访问、接地（grounding）、弃答和危险应对，并评估相互依赖案例上的联合成功率。现有模型往往满足一项要求却在另一项上失败，而仅针对安全或个性化训练会在联合成功率上留下差距。因此我们提出 PReMind，一个两阶段强化学习框架，结合按需调用和强制调用（总是检索记忆）两种交互，联合训练接地记忆使用与危险应对。在 4B 规模下，PReMind 将相互依赖集上的联合成功率从基线的 12.9% 提升到 28.6%，并在主测试上改善危险应对的充分性和正确弃答。在强制调用评估和第二个 LLM 评判下，跨三个 Phase II 随机种子，联合成功率的提升依然保持；在这些种子上取平均，联合成功率在未见过的危险类别上也有所提升。这些发现凸显了评估和训练个人助手将视觉证据与相关人员背景相连接的必要性。
translation.brief: 针对个性化助手难以同时识别视觉危险并正确运用个人记忆的问题，提出诊断基准 PReMind-Bench 和两阶段强化学习框架 PReMind，联合训练接地记忆使用与危险应对能力。

papers.title: Continual Tool-Space Extension Learning for Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: Multimodal agents largely rely on generic tools such as cropping, search, and code execution, leaving specialist vision models outside their tool space. However, bringing such a model into an already trained agent is not straightforward. The challenge is to learn each new tool efficiently while retaining the ability to use existing ones. This work proposes COTEX, continual tool-space extension learning, that adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost. COTEX locates two sets of parameter directions; one triggers a tool call and thereby opens a multi-turn reasoning trajectory, while the other determines which tool is chosen. The adapter of a new tool is restricted to the calling directions that leave earlier tool choices unaffected by orthogonal constraint. We further introduce a protocol that converts specialist models' existing task-specific annotations into verified tool-use trajectories. Experiments on two representative agents and three specialist tools show gains on ten vision-language benchmarks, with at most a 0.3-point drop on existing tools.

translation.title: 面向多模态智能体的持续工具空间扩展学习
translation.abstract: 多模态智能体在很大程度上依赖裁剪、搜索和代码执行等通用工具，使专业视觉模型处于其工具空间之外。然而，将这样的模型引入已训练好的智能体并非易事。挑战在于高效学习每个新工具的同时保留使用现有工具的能力。本工作提出 COTEX——持续工具空间扩展学习，以高效的适配器（adapter）级成本添加新工具。COTEX 定位两组参数方向：一组触发工具调用，从而开启多轮推理轨迹；另一组决定选择哪个工具。新工具的适配器被限制在调用方向上，并通过正交约束使早期工具的选择不受影响。我们进一步引入一个协议，将专业模型现有的任务特定标注转换为经过验证的工具使用轨迹。在两个代表性智能体和三个专业工具上的实验显示，在十个视觉-语言基准上取得提升，而现有工具的性能下降至多 0.3 分。
translation.brief: 针对向已训练多模态智能体添加专业视觉模型工具时兼顾学习新工具与保留旧工具能力的问题，提出 COTEX，通过参数方向定位与正交约束以适配器级成本持续扩展工具空间。

papers.title: Metrics-in-the-Loop: Complexity Feedback Reshapes Agent-Written Code
papers.abstract: Coding agents now write whole codebases in long autonomous runs, guided mainly by whether their tests pass. Yet passing tests alone does not reveal accumulating complexity or gaps in test coverage, which then persist as agents extend their own code. We introduce metrics-in-the-loop, an inference-time intervention that gives agents in-flight feedback: cheap, automatically computed code metrics injected into the agent's context during the trajectory. After each code-changing agent turn, we insert short feedback messages naming changed functions whose cyclomatic complexity exceeds a limit (complexity feedback) or changed lines that are skipped by tests (coverage feedback), giving the agent the opportunity to refactor code or strengthen tests before continuing. We run extensive experiments and ablations comparing several interventions across three long-horizon coding benchmarks and four strong models. We find that complexity feedback significantly reduces erosion, a measure of complexity concentration of code, without affecting held-out correctness of the code. Broadly, our experiments investigate a practical form of agent "re-railing", where timely, actionable measurements redirect agents before weaknesses become the foundation they keep building on. As agents scale to codebases with millions of lines, such interventions become critical to sustaining effective development and long-term code maintainability.

translation.title: 指标在环：复杂度反馈重塑智能体编写的代码
translation.abstract: 编码智能体现在可以在长时间自主运行中编写整个代码库，主要依据测试是否通过来引导。然而，仅凭测试通过无法揭示不断累积的复杂度或测试覆盖的缺口，而这些会随着智能体扩展自己的代码而持续存在。我们提出 metrics-in-the-loop，一种推理时干预，为智能体提供进行中的反馈：在轨迹执行期间将廉价、自动计算的代码指标注入智能体的上下文。在每个修改代码的智能体回合之后，我们插入简短的反馈消息，指出圈复杂度超过上限的被修改函数（复杂度反馈）或被测试跳过的被修改行（覆盖反馈），让智能体有机会在继续之前重构代码或加强测试。我们在三个长程编码基准和四个强模型上进行了大量实验和消融，比较多种干预。我们发现复杂度反馈显著降低了侵蚀度（erosion，一种代码复杂度集中程度的度量），且不影响代码在留出集上的正确性。更广泛地说，我们的实验研究了一种实用的智能体"重回正轨"（re-railing）形式：及时、可操作的度量在弱点成为智能体持续构建的基础之前将其引回正途。随着智能体扩展到数百万行的代码库，此类干预对于维持有效开发和长期代码可维护性变得至关重要。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体仅依赖测试通过而无法察觉代码复杂度累积与覆盖缺口的问题，提出 metrics-in-the-loop 推理时干预，在轨迹中注入自动计算的复杂度与覆盖反馈以引导智能体重构代码或加强测试。

papers.title: A System 1 Decision Model for Medical Multiple-Choice Questions Built on Frozen Language Models
papers.abstract: A System 1 model answers a multiple-choice question in a single pass. A frozen language model turns the question and each option into vectors, two small, trained heads place them in a shared space, and the closest option wins. The design has been shown on agent decisions, but we are not aware of a study of how far it goes on exam questions that need medical knowledge, where the right option is often no more similar to the question than the wrong ones. We rebuilt the recipe from scratch for MedMCQA and trained only two projection heads and one temperature on top of frozen Qwen3.5-0.8B, Granite-4.2-3B and Qwen3-8B, using a contrastive loss with in-batch and hard negatives and a mask for repeated answers. With plain last-token vectors, both small encoders answer about one question in three correctly (33.1% and 33.0% on 3,842 held-out questions, where chance is 25.0%). Writing each text inside a one-word-summary prompt and lowering the learning rate of the heads raised this to 41.7% and 42.5% for the two small encoders and to 46.0% +-0.2 (three seeds) for Qwen3-8B. Shuffling the questions against the options returns accuracy to chance, so the heads do use the question. Flan-PaLM and Med-PaLM 2 report 57.6% and 72.3% on MedMCQA under a different protocol, so ours is a cheap, fast baseline and not a competitive system. We also say what our evidence cannot show: validation gains were about 1.7 to 2 times the test gains, and we could not separate the effect of reading several encoder layers from the other changes.

translation.title: 基于冻结语言模型的医学多选题 System 1 决策模型
translation.abstract: System 1 模型通过单次前向传播回答多选题。冻结的语言模型将问题和每个选项转化为向量，两个小型训练头将它们置于共享空间中，最接近的选项胜出。该设计已在智能体决策上得到验证，但我们尚未见到关于它在需要医学知识的考试题上能走多远的研究——在这类题目中，正确选项与问题的相似度往往并不比错误选项更高。我们为 MedMCQA 从零重建了该方案，仅在冻结的 Qwen3.5-0.8B、Granite-4.2-3B 和 Qwen3-8B 之上训练两个投影头和一个温度参数，使用带批内负样本和难负样本的对比损失以及针对重复答案的掩码。使用普通的末 token 向量时，两个小型编码器约每三题答对一题（在 3,842 道留出题上分别为 33.1% 和 33.0%，随机水平为 25.0%）。将每段文本写入一个单词摘要式提示并降低头的学习率后，两个小型编码器的准确率提升至 41.7% 和 42.5%，Qwen3-8B 提升至 46.0% ±0.2（三个种子）。将问题与选项打乱配对后准确率回落至随机水平，说明投影头确实利用了问题。Flan-PaLM 和 Med-PaLM 2 在不同协议下于 MedMCQA 上分别报告 57.6% 和 72.3%，因此我们的是一个廉价、快速的基线，而非有竞争力的系统。我们也说明了我们的证据无法证明的内容：验证集上的提升约为测试集提升的 1.7 到 2 倍，且我们无法将读取多个编码器层的效果与其他改动区分开。
translation.brief: 针对医学多选题中正确选项与问题相似度不占优的难题，在冻结语言模型之上仅训练两个投影头，用对比损失构建单次前向的 System 1 选择模型作为廉价快速基线。

papers.title: NarrowSpec: Draft Hidden Width Need Not Match the Target in Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding is widely used to speed up generation in large language models (LLMs), with a small draft model proposing tokens that one forward pass of the target model verifies. Draft models that read the target's hidden states, such as DFlash and EAGLE-3, typically inherit the target's hidden width. We show that the draft's whole residual stream can run at half or a quarter of that width while largely preserving acceptance. For DFlash, which borrows the target's vocabulary projection, the trained output adapter folds into it, giving one narrower projection with logits unchanged up to floating-point rounding. We test two drafter families, DFlash and EAGLE-3, on two targets, Qwen3-8B (NVFP4) and GPT-OSS-20B (MXFP4), in SGLang on a B200 and a DGX Spark (GB10). At batch size 1 and temperature 0, narrowing the draft to half or a quarter width speeds up end-to-end decoding by 1.06-1.12x on B200 and 1.13-1.44x on GB10. The speedup holds at larger batch sizes. From batch 32 to the largest batch each GPU fits, narrowing reaches up to 1.21x on both GPUs, and no narrow draft is slower than full width.

translation.title: NarrowSpec：投机解码中草稿模型的隐藏层宽度无需与目标模型一致
translation.abstract: 投机解码被广泛用于加速大语言模型（LLM）的生成，其方式是由一个小的草稿模型提出 token，再由目标模型的一次前向传播进行验证。读取目标模型隐藏状态的草稿模型（如 DFlash 和 EAGLE-3）通常继承目标模型的隐藏层宽度。我们证明草稿模型的整个残差流可以运行在目标模型一半或四分之一的宽度上，同时基本保持接受率。对于借用目标模型词表投影的 DFlash，训练得到的输出适配器可以折叠进该投影中，得到一个更窄的投影，其 logits 在浮点舍入误差范围内保持不变。我们在 B200 和 DGX Spark（GB10）上的 SGLang 中，针对两个目标模型 Qwen3-8B（NVFP4）和 GPT-OSS-20B（MXFP4）测试了两个草稿模型家族：DFlash 和 EAGLE-3。在 batch size 为 1、温度为 0 时，将草稿模型收窄到一半或四分之一宽度使端到端解码在 B200 上加速 1.06-1.12 倍，在 GB10 上加速 1.13-1.44 倍。该加速在更大 batch size 下依然成立。从 batch 32 到每个 GPU 能容纳的最大 batch，收窄在两块 GPU 上均可达最高 1.21 倍加速，且没有任何收窄草稿模型比全宽版本更慢。
translation.brief: 解决投机解码中草稿模型隐藏层宽度冗余的问题，方法是将草稿模型残差流收窄至目标模型的一半或四分之一宽度并将输出适配器折叠进词表投影。

papers.title: Online State-Representation Adaptation under Synthetic Interaction-Cue Remapping
papers.abstract: When cues change what they predict, continuing to update a learned mapping may help an agent choose the appropriate action. We tested this in a one-step synthetic task by comparing a logistic state predictor that continued to learn from state labels with the same predictor frozen at transfer. We evaluated ten conditions in six held-out environments, with 1,296 paired runs per condition and 1,296,000 transfer records in total. Late action accuracy was 93.39% with online updates and 64.63% with frozen coefficients, a paired difference of 28.76 [8.73, 53.19] percentage points (95% environment-bootstrap interval). A direct policy reached 95.65% using the same predictions with a different action threshold. A contextual bandit reached 94.23% and earned more cumulative utility than the adaptive predictor. The bandit used the reward of its chosen action, which in this task reveals the true state when combined with that action. Weights based on development history lowered cumulative utility relative to neutral weights (difference -3.45 [-4.48, -2.43]). The adaptive predictor outperformed its frozen counterpart in late accuracy in each of the six test environments. The other comparisons show how the choice of action threshold and the information available in feedback affect what can be attributed to online adaptation.

translation.title: 合成交互线索重映射下的在线状态表征自适应
translation.abstract: 当线索所预测的内容发生变化时，继续更新已学习的映射可能有助于智能体选择合适的动作。我们通过一个单步合成任务对此进行了测试，比较了持续从状态标签中学习的 logistic 状态预测器与迁移时被冻结的同一预测器。我们在六个留出环境中评估了十个条件，每个条件 1,296 次配对运行，共 1,296,000 条迁移记录。在线更新下的后期动作准确率为 93.39%，冻结系数下为 64.63%，配对差异为 28.76 [8.73, 53.19] 个百分点（95% 环境自助法区间）。使用相同预测但不同动作阈值的直接策略达到 95.65%。上下文多臂老虎机达到 94.23%，并比自适应预测器获得更多累积效用。该老虎机使用其所选动作的奖励，而在此任务中该奖励与该动作结合可揭示真实状态。基于开发历史的权重相比中性权重降低了累积效用（差异 -3.45 [-4.48, -2.43]）。在全部六个测试环境中，自适应预测器的后期准确率均优于其冻结版本。其他比较则展示了动作阈值的选择和反馈中可用的信息如何影响可归因于在线自适应的效果。
translation.brief: 解决线索预测含义变化时智能体动作选择的问题，方法是比较持续在线更新的 logistic 状态预测器与迁移时冻结系数的版本。

papers.title: Plug-and-Play Multi-Licensee Robust Watermarking for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable high-capacity large language models (LLMs) with high sparse computation, making them attractive for deployment on private hardware. However, distributing model weights exposes valuable intellectual property (IP) to leakage and unauthorized redistribution, creating an urgent need to both verify model ownership and trace leaked copies to individual licensees. Existing model-watermarking techniques are ill-suited for meeting this need because they are fragile under MoE's dynamic routing or require costly retraining to embed a distinct watermark for each licensee, thus making scalable distribution difficult. To address these challenges, we present PPMoE, the first plug-and-play multi-licensee watermarking framework for MoE LLMs. Rather than training a separate model per user, PPMoE trains a compact set of mergeable incremental weight modules that steer the MoE router toward distinct, mutually compatible routing patterns. During model distribution, the model owner selectively merges unique combinations of these pre-trained, mutually compatible modules into the base model on the fly, embedding a licensee-specific watermark without additional training. PPMoE supports reliable multi-licensee attribution under both white- and black-box threat models. In the white-box setting, attribution is done by inspecting triggered routing decisions or the merged weight modules responsible for these decisions, whereas in the black-box setting, attribution relies on analyzing output token likelihood ratios. Extensive experiments across five state-of-the-art MoE models, seven benchmark datasets, and varying number of licensees show that PPMoE achieves very high attribution accuracy while preserving base model utility and maintaining strong robustness to various adaptive watermark-removal attacks.

translation.title: 面向混合专家 LLM 的即插即用多被授权方鲁棒水印
translation.abstract: 混合专家架构通过高稀疏计算实现高容量的大语言模型（LLM），使其在私有硬件上的部署颇具吸引力。然而，分发模型权重会使宝贵的知识产权（IP）面临泄露和未经授权再分发的风险，因此迫切需要既能验证模型所有权，又能将泄露副本追溯到具体被授权方。现有模型水印技术难以满足这一需求，因为它们在 MoE 的动态路由下十分脆弱，或者需要为每个被授权方嵌入不同水印而付出高昂的重训练成本，从而使规模化分发变得困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 PPMoE，这是首个面向 MoE LLM 的即插即用多被授权方水印框架。PPMoE 不为每个用户训练单独的模型，而是训练一组紧凑的可合并增量权重模块，将 MoE 路由器引导至彼此兼容的不同路由模式。在模型分发时，模型所有者即时地将这些预训练且相互兼容的模块的独特组合选择性地合并进基础模型，无需额外训练即可嵌入特定于被授权方的水印。PPMoE 在白盒和黑盒威胁模型下均支持可靠的多被授权方归因。在白盒设置中，归因通过检查被触发的路由决策或负责这些决策的已合并权重模块完成；而在黑盒设置中，归因依赖于分析输出 token 的似然比。在五个最先进 MoE 模型、七个基准数据集以及不同被授权方数量上的大量实验表明，PPMoE 在保持基础模型效用和对各种自适应水印移除攻击的强鲁棒性的同时，实现了极高的归因准确率。
translation.brief: 解决 MoE LLM 多被授权方水印需逐用户重训练的问题，方法是训练一组可合并的兼容增量模块，分发时按需合并以嵌入被授权方专属水印。

papers.title: Re-Testing LLM-Based C-to-Rust Translations Against Their Original C
papers.abstract: Most C-to-Rust translators use large language models (LLMs), and each reports a success rate from its own correctness check. We survey 34 C-to-Rust translators that use LLMs. Only one reports testing its check, and eleven release the original C and their Rust in runnable form. We re-test all eleven. We run the C and the Rust on generated inputs, compare every output, and count a divergence only where the C has no undefined behavior. All eleven release defective translations: we find 160 defects, 93 of them outright errors on ordinary inputs. Their own checks accepted 86 defective translations. For 81 of them, the released check never compared the programs on an input that exposes the defect. For three of the other five, it ran one but compared only part of the output. A success rate is only as good as its check. Before counting a translation as a success, authors should compare every output with the C's on inputs the repair loop never saw, check that a verifier reaches its assertion, release exactly what the check accepted, and report how they tested the check.

translation.title: 针对原始 C 代码重新测试基于 LLM 的 C 到 Rust 翻译
translation.abstract: 大多数 C 到 Rust 的翻译器使用大语言模型（LLM），且各自报告基于自身正确性检查的成功率。我们调研了 34 个使用 LLM 的 C 到 Rust 翻译器，其中只有一个报告了对其检查的测试，十一个以可运行形式发布了原始 C 代码及其 Rust 翻译。我们对这十一个全部进行了重新测试：在生成的输入上运行 C 和 Rust，比较每一个输出，并仅在 C 无未定义行为时才计为分歧。所有十一个都发布了有缺陷的翻译：我们发现了 160 个缺陷，其中 93 个是在普通输入上的直接错误。它们自己的检查接受了 86 个有缺陷的翻译，其中 81 个的已发布检查从未在暴露缺陷的输入上比较过两个程序；另外五个中的三个运行了输入但只比较了部分输出。成功率的好坏取决于其检查的好坏。在将一次翻译计为成功之前，作者应当在修复循环从未见过的输入上将每个输出与 C 的输出进行比较，验证检查器确实到达其断言，精确发布检查所接受的内容，并报告他们如何测试了检查本身。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM C 到 Rust 翻译器正确性检查不可靠的问题，方法是在生成输入上运行 C 与 Rust 并逐项比较全部输出以重新测试已发布的翻译。

papers.title: Weighing the Envelope: Component Weight and Arbitration in Envelope-Layer Defenses for a Single LLM Agent
papers.abstract: The envelope layer is the channel through which malicious content enters an LLM agent. Prior work established label and memory effects on multi-agent A2A envelopes, but the weight structure when MCP tools and memory coexist in a single agent remains unclear. Our threat model assumes an attacker pre-plants a malicious tool and poisons long-term memory; a benign user request inadvertently triggers it, and the attacker never enters the conversation. Following GDA Measurement and A/B/C/D, we measure how labels, memory, tool roles, and the backend shape invocation decisions across label-memory conflict, tool roles, robustness, and tool generalization. A tool-side forced-verification label substantially reduces semantic breach, but strong success memory pulls it back; a memory-side downgrade statement returns the outcome to the level of the label alone. The label works through mandatory implementation inspection plus default denial, not length or format; memory authorization wording erodes it with dose, while position and multi-turn pressure do not change the defense direction. Tool roles divide label effects into substitution, suppression, and boundary failure: low penetration is not safety, local leakage is the main residual risk, and a second malicious tool shows the same direction. Envelope labels are not a switch but a measurable, reversible weight constrained by backend and tool role, acting as a soft gate and risk signal within a broader defense rather than a substitute for permissions, sandboxing, or human review.

translation.title: 权衡信封：单 LLM 智能体信封层防御中的组件权重与仲裁
translation.abstract: 信封层是恶意内容进入 LLM 智能体的通道。已有工作确立了标签和记忆在多智能体 A2A 信封上的效应，但当 MCP 工具与记忆在单个智能体中共存时的权重结构仍不清楚。我们的威胁模型假设攻击者预先植入恶意工具并污染长期记忆；良性用户请求无意间触发它，而攻击者从不进入对话。遵循 GDA Measurement 和 A/B/C/D，我们测量标签、记忆、工具角色和后端如何塑造标签-记忆冲突、工具角色、鲁棒性和工具泛化方面的调用决策。工具侧的强制验证标签显著减少语义越界，但强的成功记忆会将其拉回；记忆侧的降级声明可将结果恢复到仅标签的水平。标签通过强制实现检查加默认拒绝起作用，而非通过长度或格式；记忆授权措辞随剂量侵蚀它，而位置和多轮压力不改变防御方向。工具角色将标签效应分为替代、抑制和边界失效：低渗透不等于安全，局部泄露是主要残余风险，且第二个恶意工具呈现相同方向。信封标签不是一个开关，而是一个受后端和工具角色约束的、可测量且可逆的权重，它在更广泛的防御体系中充当软门控和风险信号，而非权限、沙箱或人工审查的替代品。
translation.brief: 解决单智能体中 MCP 工具与记忆共存时信封层防御权重结构不明的问题，方法是通过 GDA Measurement 与 A/B/C/D 实验测量标签、记忆、工具角色和后端对调用决策的影响。

papers.title: Great Listeners, Poor Decision-Makers: Rethinking Agentic Audio AI
papers.abstract: Audio artificial intelligence (AI) now recognizes speech, sounds, and music remarkably well, yet voice agents still act when they should not: they execute commands addressed to others, act on misheard content, and commit before the user finishes speaking. This position article argues that the bottleneck in agentic audio AI has shifted from recognition to decision-making. We propose a reference architecture with an explicit decision layer, separate from perception and reasoning, that chooses whether to act, wait, ask, or remain silent from evidence on addressedness, speaker identity, content confidence, tool reliability, utterance completeness, and action risk. We motivate the design through six recurring decision failures and a decision-theoretic argument that transcript confidence alone is insufficient to justify an action. We implement the layer with fuzzy inference, evolutionary optimization, and sequential decision-making, and evaluate it through simulations, ablations, and recorded audio, including egocentric recordings. Addressedness and speaker evidence matter most, risk-aware gating suppresses costly errors, and well-tuned policies perform similarly, with fuzzy gates more robust to overconfident addressedness estimates. On recorded audio, explicit gating cuts executed side talk from 41\% to 7--10\% while serving 83--85\% of valid requests under successful clarification, outperforming prompting-based baselines. These results support explicit action gating as an architectural requirement for reliable voice agents.

translation.title: 善于倾听却拙于决策：重新思考智能体音频AI
translation.abstract: 音频人工智能如今在识别语音、声音和音乐方面表现出色，但语音智能体仍会在不该行动时行动：它们会执行针对他人的指令、根据误听内容行动，或在用户尚未说完话时就做出决策。本立场文章认为，智能体音频AI的瓶颈已从识别转移到决策。我们提出一种包含显式决策层的参考架构，该决策层独立于感知与推理，依据针对对象（addressedness）、说话人身份、内容置信度、工具可靠性、话语完整性和行动风险等证据，选择是行动、等待、询问还是保持沉默。我们通过六种反复出现的决策失败案例以及一个决策论论证来支撑该设计——即仅凭转写置信度不足以证明行动的合理性。我们使用模糊推理、进化优化和序贯决策来实现该决策层，并通过仿真、消融实验和录音（包括自我中心录音）进行评估。结果表明，针对对象和说话人证据最为关键，风险感知门控能抑制代价高昂的错误，而调优良好的策略表现相近，其中模糊门控对过度自信的针对对象估计更为鲁棒。在录音数据上，显式门控将执行的旁侧对话从41%降至7–10%，同时在成功澄清后服务83–85%的有效请求，优于基于提示的基线方法。这些结果支持将显式行动门控作为可靠语音智能体的架构要求。
translation.brief: 针对语音智能体在不该行动时误行动的问题，提出在感知与推理之外增加显式决策层，基于针对对象、说话人、风险等证据用模糊推理等方法决定行动、等待、询问或沉默。

papers.title: MobileWeave: Program-First Synthesis of Dependency-Linked Tasks for Training Mobile GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Native mobile GUI agents require large-scale training trajectories covering both individual app functions and multi-goal workflows within and across apps, which makes automatic task synthesis a promising way to scale training data. Existing synthesis pipelines, however, produce each task as free-form text, leaving implicit how its subgoals depend on one another. This matters because composition is a skill in its own right: a policy may complete each subtask of a workflow on its own, yet fail to chain these subtasks into the complete workflow. We present MobileWeave, which instead synthesizes every task as an executable program derived from the app implementations of a controllable simulator. MobileWeave abstracts each app into a typed capability graph with semantic types shared across apps, composes atomic programs into single- and cross-app composite programs through explicit value and object dependencies, and verifies each program by native execution, deriving both its instruction and its completion check from the same program. Trained on teacher trajectories collected for these tasks and on recovery supervision at the policy's own stalls, MobileWeave-8B improves its base model by 26.7 points on MobileGym and by 8.6, 21.3, and 17.6 points on AndroidWorld, AndroidLab, and MobileWorld, with comparable gains at 4B. Beyond these gains, we find that composition is learnable from task structure: explicit dependencies between subgoals act as a training signal that teaches a policy to compose skills it already masters. We release data, model, and code at this https URL .

translation.title: MobileWeave：面向移动GUI智能体训练的依赖关联任务的程序优先合成
translation.abstract: 原生移动GUI智能体需要大规模训练轨迹，既覆盖单个应用的功能，也覆盖应用内和跨应用的多目标工作流，这使得自动任务合成成为扩展训练数据的有前景途径。然而，现有合成流水线将每个任务生成为自由格式文本，使其子目标之间的依赖关系保持隐式。这一点很重要，因为组合本身就是一种技能：策略可能独立完成工作流中的每个子任务，却无法将这些子任务串联成完整工作流。我们提出MobileWeave，它将每个任务合成为从可控模拟器的应用实现中导出的可执行程序。MobileWeave将每个应用抽象为带有跨应用共享语义类型的类型化能力图，通过显式的值和对象依赖将原子程序组合为单应用和跨应用复合程序，并通过原生执行验证每个程序，从同一程序中同时导出其指令和完成检查。基于为这些任务收集的教师轨迹以及在策略自身停滞处的恢复监督进行训练后，MobileWeave-8B在MobileGym上将基础模型提升26.7分，在AndroidWorld、AndroidLab和MobileWorld上分别提升8.6、21.3和17.6分，4B模型也有相当提升。除这些提升外，我们发现组合能力可以从任务结构中学习：子目标之间的显式依赖可作为训练信号，教会策略组合其已掌握的技能。我们在 https URL 发布数据、模型和代码。
translation.brief: 针对移动GUI智能体训练中任务子目标依赖关系隐式、难以学会组合技能的问题，提出将任务合成为源自模拟器应用实现的可执行程序，通过显式值与对象依赖构建并验证复合任务。

papers.title: Keep the Image in Mind: A Visual Board for Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: Multi-step visual reasoning suffers when early visual misinterpretations persist as incorrect premises in subsequent reasoning. We argue that how visual evidence is represented during reasoning matters as much as how much of it is gathered. Rather than appending observations and inferences to an ever-growing dialogue, we introduce a Visual Board-centered harness that separates visual observations, uncertain interpretations, and derived reasoning within a structured, capacity-bounded, and revisable workspace. This separation makes each premise explicit and auditable, so that conflicts between what is seen and what is derived become detectable even by a text-only critic and can trigger targeted reinspection of the original image. Without task-specific training, our harness consistently outperforms standalone models across 4B, 8B, Qwen3-VL-Flash, and 32B configurations on Euclid30K, SolidGeo, and ChartQA bar charts, with gains of up to 11.68, 18.42, and 24.82 percentage points, respectively. Under identical tools, critic, and interaction limits, the structured Board outperforms shared free-form notes by 6.67 to 13.00 points and no-Board retries by 7.35 to 18.80 points while using 7.9\% to 38.2\% fewer tokens. Supervised fine-tuning on harness trajectories further improves direct answering and critic-free tool use, with positive transfer to chart reasoning.

translation.title: 牢记图像：面向多模态智能体的可视化看板
translation.abstract: 当早期的视觉误读作为错误前提在后续推理中持续存在时，多步视觉推理会受到影响。我们认为，推理过程中视觉证据的表示方式与收集多少视觉证据同样重要。我们不再将观察和推论追加到不断增长的对话中，而是引入一个以Visual Board（可视化看板）为中心的框架，将视觉观察、不确定的解释和推导出的推理分离在一个结构化、容量受限且可修订的工作区中。这种分离使每个前提都显式且可审计，因此即使仅文本的批评者也能检测到所见与所推导内容之间的冲突，并可触发对原始图像的针对性重检。在无需任务特定训练的情况下，我们的框架在4B、8B、Qwen3-VL-Flash和32B配置上，于Euclid30K、SolidGeo和ChartQA柱状图任务中持续优于独立模型，分别带来最高11.68、18.42和24.82个百分点的提升。在相同的工具、批评者和交互限制下，结构化看板比共享自由格式笔记高出6.67至13.00分，比无看板重试高出7.35至18.80分，同时少用7.9%至38.2%的token。基于框架轨迹的监督微调进一步提升了直接回答和无批评者的工具使用能力，并对图表推理产生正向迁移。
translation.brief: 针对早期视觉误读作为错误前提持续影响多步推理的问题，提出以结构化、可修订的Visual Board工作区分离观察、解释与推理，使冲突可被检测并触发针对性重检。

papers.title: SWE-growth: Teacher-Guided Adaptive Self-Play for Software Engineering Agents
papers.abstract: Self-play offers a scalable way to train software engineering agents by generating repository-level repair tasks. However, with binary repair rewards and finite rollout budgets, all-fail groups provide no reward-based group-relative advantage. Such tasks may still offer learning opportunities when a Teacher can provide verified repairs absent from the Student's own attempts. We introduce SWE-Growth, a teacher-guided adaptive self-play framework that uses verified Teacher outcomes to identify learning opportunities for the current Student. Tasks with all students failure but reliable Teacher success provide demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and post-SFT Student rollouts identify mixed-outcome tasks with a positive Teacher--Student gap for reinforcement learning. Task eligibility also guides Injector updates, connecting Student training with subsequent task generation. Starting from 101 seed issues, \textsc{SWE-Growth} improves Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct from 27.7% to 31.7% on SWE-bench Pro and from 11.0% to 17.2% on held-out TerminalBench 2.1 by Round~2. It exceeds Student-only self-play by 2.6 and 4.1 percentage points, respectively, and Teacher-augmented self-play by 1.8 and 2.5 points under approximately matched budgets. These results support adapting both supervision and task selection to the Student's evolving repair capability.

translation.title: SWE-growth：面向软件工程智能体的教师引导自适应自博弈
translation.abstract: 自博弈通过生成仓库级修复任务，为训练软件工程智能体提供了可扩展的途径。然而，在二值修复奖励和有限rollout预算下，全失败的组无法提供基于奖励的组内相对优势。当教师（Teacher）能够提供学生（Student）自身尝试中缺失的已验证修复时，这类任务仍可能提供学习机会。我们提出SWE-Growth，一个教师引导的自适应自博弈框架，利用已验证的教师结果为当前学生识别学习机会。所有学生都失败但教师可靠成功的任务为监督微调（SFT）提供示范，SFT后的学生rollout则识别出具有正向师生差距的混合结果任务用于强化学习。任务资格还指导注入器（Injector）的更新，将学生训练与后续任务生成联系起来。从101个种子issue出发，SWE-Growth使Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct在第2轮时在SWE-bench Pro上从27.7%提升至31.7%，在留出的TerminalBench 2.1上从11.0%提升至17.2%。在预算大致匹配的情况下，它分别超过仅学生自博弈2.6和4.1个百分点，超过教师增强自博弈1.8和2.5分。这些结果支持将监督和任务选择都适配到学生不断演进的修复能力上。
translation.brief: 针对自博弈中全失败任务组无奖励优势、学习信号缺失的问题，提出教师引导的自适应自博弈框架，用教师验证的修复为SFT提供示范并识别师生差距任务用于强化学习。

papers.title: EVA-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Evaluators for Judging Temporal Quality
papers.abstract: Video evaluators play an important role in video generation, yet they miss motion defects, limiting the quality of generated videos. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) has made strong progress in mathematics and coding, where explicit verifiers provide reliable feedback on a single goal. Video evaluation poses two difficulties for RSI: it has no verifier, and it must judge many dimensions at once, such as physics, smoothness and dynamics, where a gain on one can cost another. We introduce EVA-RSI, a multi-agent framework for exploring RSI under these two constraints. We build a fixed proxy exam with construction-defined targets by applying controlled changes to videos, such as temporal reversal and frame dropping. These edits supply supervision without human annotation. A small set of human-labeled real videos anchors the exam to human judgment. Each dimension has an LLM agent that proposes improvements. A leader agent coordinates the proposals, and a Nash bargaining rule selects updates that balance progress across dimensions. Humans design the exam, review candidate changes and revise the curriculum between stages. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B, EVA-RSI improves motion evaluation, with the largest gain on smoothness, and the gains carry over to defect types never seen during the run. On the dynamics subsets of public benchmarks, our evaluator achieves the highest observed scores among 21 tested models. As an RL reward, it increases generated motion and earns human preference. A data-selection pipeline incorporating it also increases motion.

translation.title: EVA-RSI：面向时序质量评判的视频评估器的递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 视频评估器在视频生成中扮演重要角色，但它们会遗漏运动缺陷，限制了生成视频的质量。递归自我改进（RSI）在数学和编程领域已取得显著进展，因为这些领域有显式验证器为单一目标提供可靠反馈。视频评估给RSI带来两大困难：它没有验证器，且必须同时评判多个维度（如物理性、平滑度和动态性），而一个维度的提升可能损害另一个维度。我们提出EVA-RSI，一个在这两种约束下探索RSI的多智能体框架。我们通过对视频施加受控变化（如时序反转和丢帧）构建了一个由构造定义目标的固定代理考试，这些编辑无需人工标注即可提供监督。少量人工标注的真实视频将考试锚定到人类判断。每个维度由一个LLM智能体提出改进方案，一个领导者智能体协调这些提案，并通过Nash议价规则选择能平衡各维度进展的更新。人类负责设计考试、审查候选变更并在阶段之间修订课程。从Qwen3-VL-8B出发，EVA-RSI提升了运动评估能力，其中平滑度提升最大，且这些提升可迁移到运行期间从未见过的缺陷类型。在公开基准的动态性子集上，我们的评估器在21个受测模型中取得了最高观测分数。作为RL奖励，它增加了生成视频的运动量并获得人类偏好。结合它的数据选择流水线同样增加了运动量。
translation.brief: 针对视频评估器遗漏运动缺陷且RSI缺乏验证器、需平衡多维度的问题，提出多智能体框架，通过受控视频编辑构造代理考试提供监督，并用Nash议价协调多维度改进。

papers.title: Cascadeability and the Realization Gap: An Empirical Study of LLM-Powered Semantic Filtering
papers.abstract: Semantic filters enable natural language predicates over unstructured documents, but evaluating every document with a large language model (LLM) oracle is expensive. Proxy cascades reduce oracle invocations using cheaper surrogates, but oracle reduction alone cannot distinguish proxy limitations from calibration bottlenecks and establish practical efficiency. We present a unified benchmark of four representative systems, which formulate query processing as a three-stage workflow comprising proxy construction, threshold calibration, and cascade inference, using a two-threshold acceptance rule. We introduce cascadeability: the maximum empirical oracle reduction attainable from fixed proxy scores at a specified accuracy target, computed retrospectively using complete oracle labels. We investigate 8 research questions, spanning proxy quality, end-to-end performance, workload sensitivities, and component ablations, and reveal our key findings accordingly. Comparing cascadeability with achieved oracle reduction yields a realization gap that, interpreted alongside accuracy, exposes distinct proxy and calibration bottlenecks. The benchmark and diagnostics support evaluation beyond oracle reduction and motivate joint proxy-calibration design, class-sensitive quality assessment, and end-to-end cost optimization. We release a dataset-query benchmark, containing 10 real-world workloads across various domains and difficulties, with annotations of two LLM families.

translation.title: 可级联性与实现差距：基于LLM的语义过滤实证研究
translation.abstract: 语义过滤器支持对非结构化文档应用自然语言谓词，但用大语言模型（LLM）oracle评估每个文档代价高昂。代理级联通过更廉价的替代方案减少oracle调用，但仅减少oracle调用无法区分代理局限与校准瓶颈，也无法确立实际效率。我们提出了一个涵盖四个代表性系统的统一基准，这些系统将查询处理表述为包含代理构建、阈值校准和级联推理的三阶段工作流，并采用双阈值接受规则。我们引入可级联性（cascadeability）这一概念：即在指定精度目标下，基于固定代理分数可获得的最大经验oracle削减量，通过完整的oracle标签进行回溯计算。我们围绕代理质量、端到端性能、负载敏感性以及组件消融等8个研究问题展开调查，并据此揭示关键发现。将可级联性与实际实现的oracle削减量对比可得到实现差距（realization gap），结合精度解读可暴露出不同的代理瓶颈与校准瓶颈。该基准与诊断工具支持超越oracle削减量的评估，并推动代理-校准联合设计、类别敏感的质量评估以及端到端成本优化。我们发布了一个数据集-查询基准，包含10个跨领域、跨难度的真实工作负载，并带有两个LLM系列的标注。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM语义过滤中难以区分代理模型局限与阈值校准瓶颈的问题，提出可级联性与实现差距的诊断框架并构建统一基准。

papers.title: Inference-Time Scaling in Agentic Hardware Verification Workflows: A Multi-Strategy Characterization Across Protocol Complexity
papers.abstract: Inference-time scaling, allocating more compute during generation rather than pre-training, has demonstrated dramatic quality improvements for LLM reasoning tasks. Its behaviour in structured hardware verification code generation, where outputs must satisfy compiler correctness, protocol semantics, and functional coverage constraints simultaneously, is less understood. We present a systematic, simulator-grounded study of inference-time compute scaling for agentic UVM testbench synthesis targeting AMBA protocol bridges. Four inference strategies---zero-shot (\$0.04), raw-feedback iterative (\$0.81), structured inner-loop (\$0.95), and full dual-loop agentic synthesis (\$1.06)---are evaluated across four AMBA targets (Protocol Complexity Index 11.8--22.6) using the Protocol Verification Completeness (PVC) metric, functional coverage, and a six-class UVM error taxonomy (E1--E6). Our central finding is that structured diagnostic feedback acts as an inference-time compute multiplier: the structured inner loop yields roughly $15\times$ more PVC per inference dollar than raw EDA-tool feedback (marginal efficiency, S1$\to$S2 vs. S0$\to$S1). The mechanism is fault targeting, not token reduction: raw compiler feedback drives the testbench to compile but cannot surface functional protocol faults that leave the code syntactically valid, whereas structured E1--E6 bundles diagnose and resolve them. All outputs are judged by a cycle-accurate Mentor Questa toolchain rather than by model self-assessment; the dual-loop strategy reaches PVC $\geq$ 0.95 with zero scoreboard errors on every target, and the generated environments surfaced a latent RTL bug in two of the four reference designs. These results establish a principled compute-quality trade-off curve for LLM-aided verification environment generation and motivate inference-budget-aware deployment strategies for industrial EDA workflows.

translation.title: 智能体硬件验证工作流中的推理时扩展：跨协议复杂度的多策略特征分析
translation.abstract: 推理时扩展（在生成阶段而非预训练阶段分配更多计算）已为LLM推理任务带来显著质量提升，但其在结构化硬件验证代码生成中的行为尚不清楚——这类任务的输出必须同时满足编译器正确性、协议语义和功能覆盖率约束。我们针对面向AMBA协议桥的智能体UVM测试平台合成，开展了一项基于仿真器的系统性推理时计算扩展研究。四种推理策略——零样本（$0.04）、原始反馈迭代（$0.81）、结构化内循环（$0.95）和完整双循环智能体合成（$1.06）——在四个AMBA目标（协议复杂度指数11.8–22.6）上进行评估，使用协议验证完备性（PVC）指标、功能覆盖率以及六类UVM错误分类法（E1–E6）。我们的核心发现是：结构化诊断反馈充当推理时计算的乘数——结构化内循环每推理美元获得的PVC约为原始EDA工具反馈的15倍（边际效率，S1→S2 对比 S0→S1）。其机制在于故障定位而非token削减：原始编译器反馈只能使测试平台通过编译，却无法暴露那些代码语法有效但存在功能性协议故障的问题，而结构化的E1–E6错误包能够诊断并解决这些问题。所有输出均由周期精确的Mentor Questa工具链评判，而非模型自评；双循环策略在每个目标上均达到PVC ≥ 0.95且零记分板错误，且生成的验证环境在四个参考设计中的两个里发现了一个潜在的RTL缺陷。这些结果为LLM辅助的验证环境生成建立了有原则的计算-质量权衡曲线，并推动了面向工业EDA工作流的推理预算感知部署策略。
translation.brief: 该论文研究LLM智能体生成UVM测试平台时推理时计算扩展的效果，通过基于仿真器的多策略对比发现结构化诊断反馈能大幅提升每美元推理成本的验证质量。

papers.title: CoSlice: Coordinated Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for 5G Network Slicing Allocation
papers.abstract: Radio Access Network (RAN) slicing is a shared resource allocation problem: each slice seeks to satisfy its Service Level Agreement (SLA) with minimal radio-resource consumption, while all slices compete for a limited resource budget. This creates both an intra-slice trade-off between SLA assurance and resource efficiency and an inter-slice conflict over shared resources, calling for specialized yet coordinated control. In this work, we present CoSlice, a coordinated multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for inter-slice physical resource block allocation in Open Radio Access Network (O-RAN). CoSlice uses preference-conditioned slice agents for fast resource allocation and an LLM-based coordinator to adapt their objectives using global network observations at a slower timescale. We formulate the problem as a multi-objective partially observable stochastic game (mo-POSG), establish the existence of a Preference Correlated Equilibrium, and derive a sublinear regret bound for the learning procedure. We implement the algorithm by using a two-stage training procedure that consists of multi-objective pretraining and joint optimization. We build a network slicing evaluation environment using ORANSlice and its radio-frequency simulator (RFsim), supporting realistic protocol-stack execution and application traffic across multiple slices. Experimental results show that CoSlice reduces both average and tail SLA violations compared with other centralized and multi-agent baselines under diverse slice workloads.

translation.title: CoSlice：面向5G网络切片分配的协调式多智能体强化学习
translation.abstract: 无线接入网（RAN）切片是一个共享资源分配问题：每个切片都力求以最少的无线资源消耗满足其服务级别协议（SLA），同时所有切片又竞争有限的资源预算。这既产生了切片内部SLA保障与资源效率之间的权衡，也产生了切片之间对共享资源的冲突，因而需要专门化且协调的控制。本工作提出CoSlice，一个面向开放无线接入网（O-RAN）中切片间物理资源块分配的协调式多智能体强化学习框架。CoSlice使用偏好条件化的切片智能体进行快速资源分配，并使用基于LLM的协调器在较慢的时间尺度上根据全局网络观测调整各智能体的目标。我们将该问题形式化为多目标部分可观测随机博弈（mo-POSG），证明了偏好相关均衡的存在性，并推导出学习过程的次线性遗憾界。我们通过包含多目标预训练和联合优化的两阶段训练流程实现该算法。我们基于ORANSlice及其射频仿真器（RFsim）构建了网络切片评估环境，支持多切片下真实的协议栈执行和应用流量。实验结果表明，在多样的切片工作负载下，与其他集中式和多智能体基线相比，CoSlice降低了平均和尾部SLA违约。
translation.brief: 该论文解决O-RAN中多切片竞争有限无线资源时的SLA保障与资源效率协调问题，提出结合偏好条件化智能体与LLM协调器的多智能体强化学习框架CoSlice。

papers.title: MLE Agents: Autonomous ML Engineering in Large-scale Recommendation Systems
papers.abstract: The typical workflow for improving large-scale ranking and recommendation models is slow and tedious: an engineer forms a hypothesis, implements it as a code change, trains a model, and evaluates it both offline and online, often relying on their own intuition and experience along the way. Autonomous LLM agents promise to speed this up by running the loop on their own, but it is still unclear whether they can do this in industry-scale systems rather than on benchmarks or small proxy tasks. We build human-on-the-loop machine learning engineer (MLE) agents that propose, implement, train, and evaluate model changes on large-scale search rankers. Engineers retain control over objective design, search direction, and final-model review. We identify three obstacles that make this industry setting challenging: feedback takes hours per experiment, offline metrics do not always predict online impact, and improvements saturate after the early wins. We address these with parallel training runs, an objective calibrated to match online impact, and careful context engineering. In one campaign, the system ran 1,097 completed candidate experiments and accepted 325, a 29.6\% acceptance rate compared with 15.6\% in the earlier campaign under a different objective and search constraint. Its best model increases search volume by 0.23\% in an A/B test of large scale.
