Several improvements were architectural changes the team had never tried, drawn from the broader industry and literature, suggesting that MLE agents can explore regions of the design space that human intuition overlooks. We find that the design of the harness around the model matters: intuition suggests that a stronger underlying model is enough, but in our experience, the design of the loop around it is just as critical. More broadly, our work shows that autonomous agents can do real machine-learning engineering in industry-scale systems.

translation.title: MLE Agents：大规模推荐系统中的自主机器学习工程
translation.abstract: 改进大规模排序和推荐模型的典型工作流缓慢而繁琐：工程师提出假设、将其实现为代码变更、训练模型，并进行离线和在线评估，过程中往往依赖自身直觉和经验。自主LLM智能体有望通过自主运行这一循环来加速流程，但它们能否在工业级系统而非基准测试或小型代理任务中做到这一点仍不清楚。我们构建了人在回路监督（human-on-the-loop）的机器学习工程师（MLE）智能体，在大规模搜索排序器上提出、实现、训练和评估模型变更。工程师保留对目标设计、搜索方向和最终模型审查的控制权。我们识别出使这一工业场景具有挑战性的三大障碍：每次实验的反馈需要数小时、离线指标并不总能预测在线效果、以及早期收益之后改进趋于饱和。我们通过并行训练运行、与在线效果校准的目标以及细致的上下文工程来应对这些问题。在一次活动中，系统完成了1,097个候选实验并接受了325个，接受率为29.6%，而在不同目标和搜索约束下的早期活动中接受率为15.6%。其最佳模型在大规模A/B测试中将搜索量提升了0.23%。其中若干改进是团队从未尝试过的架构性变更，借鉴自更广泛的行业实践和文献，表明MLE智能体能够探索人类直觉所忽视的设计空间区域。我们发现模型外围工具链（harness）的设计至关重要：直觉上认为更强的底层模型就足够了，但我们的经验表明，围绕模型构建的循环设计同样关键。更广泛地说，我们的工作表明自主智能体能够在工业级系统中开展真正的机器学习工程。
translation.brief: 该论文探索LLM智能体能否在工业级推荐系统中自主完成模型改进循环，通过人在回路监督的MLE智能体结合并行实验、在线校准目标和上下文工程实现大规模自动化机器学习工程。

papers.title: Resilient Federated LQR over Noisy and Lossy Uplinks via Scalar Communication
papers.abstract: This paper studies model-free federated learning of a common LQR controller for a fleet of similar systems that communicate with a server over an uplink subject to limited bandwidth, packet dropout, and additive noise. We propose \textsc{ResiFedLQR}, a scalar communication scheme in which each agent sends one real number per packet, with redundancy, instead of full gradient estimates. The scalars can be gradient coordinates, projections of the gradient onto random directions reproduced at the server from a shared seed, or the rollout costs themselves. For the projection encoding, we prove that, with high probability, every iterate stabilizes all agents and the fleet-average cost converges linearly to a neighborhood of the optimum whose radius separates heterogeneity, sampling, and communication effects, and we derive a rule for choosing the number of transmissions from the channel parameters and the fleet size. We then compare the encodings with full-gradient transmission under the same uplink budget and identify the signal-to-noise regime and power constraint under which each is preferable. Numerical experiments on a heterogeneous fleet evaluate stability and convergence under varying noise levels and dropout probabilities.

translation.title: 基于标量通信的噪声与丢包上行链路下的弹性联邦LQR
translation.abstract: 本文研究为一组相似系统学习共同LQR控制器的无模型联邦学习，各系统通过受带宽限制、丢包和加性噪声影响的上行链路与服务器通信。我们提出ResiFedLQR，一种标量通信方案：每个智能体在每个数据包中发送一个实数（带冗余），而非完整的梯度估计。这些标量可以是梯度坐标、梯度在随机方向上的投影（服务器从共享种子复现这些方向），或rollout成本本身。对于投影编码，我们证明：以高概率，每次迭代都能稳定所有智能体，且车队平均成本线性收敛到最优值的一个邻域，该邻域半径可分离异构性、采样和通信的影响；我们还推导出根据信道参数和车队规模选择传输次数的规则。随后，我们在相同上行链路预算下将这些编码与完整梯度传输进行比较，并识别出各自更优的信噪比区间和功率约束条件。在异构车队上的数值实验评估了不同噪声水平和丢包概率下的稳定性与收敛性。
translation.brief: 该论文解决带宽受限、噪声和丢包上行链路下联邦学习LQR控制器的通信效率问题，提出每包仅传一个标量的ResiFedLQR方案并给出稳定性与收敛性保证。

papers.title: Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents
papers.abstract: Vision-language agents that browse websites, operate phones and act in homes reason before every action, so every step waits for a large model, a latency and cost that stand in the way of deployment. Step-level speculation lets a small model draft each step and calls the large model only on rejected drafts, but its outcome rests on the judge, and a judge that reads only a step's text cannot tell whether the step fits the screen it acts on. We find that a few samples of a small model can contain a correct step about as often as the large model gets the step right, and not always on the same steps: checked against the screen, small drafts can be not only cheaper but better. We present Vanguard, a training-free judge that leaves the draft and target models unchanged: a general decision model, with the screenshot in view, gives each candidate step a probability of being right in one forward pass; the best candidate is kept if it clears a threshold, and otherwise the large model writes the step. On web, mobile and embodied agents, a 2B draft judged by Vanguard is at least as accurate as its 8B target and significantly more accurate on Mind2Web and EB-ALFRED, while the target writes only a minority of the steps; it completes far more closed-loop episodes, and with a 27B target from another family it is both faster and more accurate. Vanguard is the most accurate judge we compare on the agent tasks; it relies on the screenshot on web and mobile tasks, its calibrated threshold transfers to unseen websites, and across model families its gain over the target grows with the draft's pass@4 relative to the target's accuracy. Vanguard composes with token-level speculative decoding and matches trained process reward models on mathematics, turning speculation from a way to save the large model's work into one that can improve on it.

translation.title: Vanguard：在推测式视觉-语言智能体中判断何时信任草稿
translation.abstract: 浏览网页、操作手机和在家中行动的视觉-语言智能体在每一步动作前都要推理，因此每一步都要等待大模型，这种延迟和成本阻碍了部署。步级推测让小模型为每一步起草，只在被拒绝的草稿上调用大模型，但其效果取决于评判者，而只读步骤文本的评判者无法判断该步骤是否契合其作用的屏幕。我们发现小模型的少量采样样本中出现正确步骤的频率与大模型做对步骤的频率相当，且不一定在相同的步骤上：对照屏幕检验，小模型草稿不仅更便宜，还可能更好。我们提出Vanguard，一个无需训练的评判者，不改变草稿模型和目标模型：一个通用决策模型在看到截图的情况下，一次前向传播即给出每个候选步骤正确的概率；若最佳候选超过阈值则保留，否则由大模型写出该步骤。在网页、移动和具身智能体上，由Vanguard评判的2B草稿至少与其8B目标同样准确，在Mind2Web和EB-ALFRED上显著更准确，同时目标模型只写出少数步骤；它完成了多得多的闭环回合，且搭配来自另一家族的27B目标模型时既更快又更准确。Vanguard是我们比较的评判者中在智能体任务上最准确的；它在网页和移动任务上依赖截图，其校准阈值可迁移到未见过的网站，且跨模型家族时，其相对目标的增益随草稿pass@4相对目标准确率的提高而增长。Vanguard可与token级推测解码组合，并在数学任务上与训练过的过程奖励模型相当，将推测从节省大模型工作的手段转变为能够超越它的手段。
translation.brief: 解决视觉-语言智能体每步都需调用大模型导致的延迟与成本问题，提出无需训练的评判者Vanguard，利用截图对候选步骤打分，决定采用小模型草稿还是回退到大模型。

papers.title: MetacouplingLLM: Integrating geographic adjacency, flow indicators, and LLM-assisted analysis
papers.abstract: The metacoupling framework examines interactions within coupled human and natural systems and between adjacent or distant systems, but its application is constrained by inconsistent geographic classifications and limited standardized quantitative workflows. We present MetacouplingLLM, an open-source Python package integrating adjacency databases, reproducible flow indicators, and large language model (LLM)-assisted qualitative analysis. The databases combine administrative boundaries, hydrography, and fixed-crossing evidence, with configurable adjacency policies and optional country-level maritime adjacency. Metacoupled Flow Shares, Metacoupled Flow Evenness, and the Metacoupled Flow Concentration Index characterize flow composition, balance across coupling types, and partner concentration within each type. The qualitative workflow combines literature retrieval, optional web evidence, and geographic checks to draft structured analyses. Applications to global marine fishing and Indonesian palm oil demonstrate these capabilities; the fisheries reanalysis reveals differing partner concentration among regions with similar telecoupled flow shares. MetacouplingLLM facilitates consistent framework application and comparative sustainability research.

translation.title: MetacouplingLLM：整合地理邻接、流指标与LLM辅助分析
translation.abstract: metacoupling框架研究耦合的人类与自然系统内部以及相邻或远程系统之间的相互作用，但其应用受限于不一致的地理分类和缺乏标准化的定量工作流程。我们提出MetacouplingLLM，一个开源Python包，整合了邻接数据库、可复现的流指标和大语言模型（LLM）辅助的定性分析。数据库结合了行政边界、水文数据和固定过境证据，具有可配置的邻接策略和可选的国家层面海洋邻接。Metacoupled Flow Shares、Metacoupled Flow Evenness和Metacoupled Flow Concentration Index刻画流的组成、各耦合类型间的均衡以及每种类型内的伙伴集中度。定性工作流程结合文献检索、可选的网络证据和地理核查来起草结构化分析。在全球海洋捕捞和印度尼西亚棕榈油上的应用展示了这些能力；渔业再分析揭示了在远程耦合流份额相似的地区之间伙伴集中度的差异。MetacouplingLLM促进了框架的一致性应用和比较可持续性研究。
translation.brief: 解决metacoupling框架应用中地理分类不一致和缺乏标准化定量流程的问题，构建整合邻接数据库、流指标与LLM辅助定性分析的开源Python包。

papers.title: Quantifying the Intrusiveness of Retrofitting Retrieval-Augmented Generation onto Legacy Software Systems
papers.abstract: Enterprises increasingly add retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to existing REST and monolithic systems, usually by writing an ad hoc HTTP call into a handler, and have no way to quantify how intrusive that choice is. We present (1) a taxonomy of three retrofit patterns, sidecar, SDK-embed and naive-invasive; (2) the Legacy Intrusion Score (LIS), three code sub-metrics (churn, breadth, coupling), and an extension, LIS-X, with three operational sub-metrics measured on a live system (run-time overhead, fault propagation and silent feature degradation); (3) a static evaluation on five legacy systems, two of them real open-source codebases fetched from their repositories at pinned commits; and (4) a live case study that deploys all three patterns as separate OS processes. The code-level ranking sidecar < SDK-embed < naive-invasive holds in all five systems and under 2,000 random weightings, but it follows from component-wise dominance of the sub-metrics, so it validates the metric rather than testing a hypothesis. In the live study, outcomes are not fixed by definition. The sidecar adds no detectable latency to the legacy endpoint (0.07 ms, 95% CI [-0.10, 0.24]), whereas SDK-embed and naive-invasive add 569 and 475 ms and are not distinguishable from each other (p=0.62). Both pass a 2 s dependency delay on to legacy requests, and when the RAG layer fails fast they keep returning successful responses that no longer contain the AI field. Load on the RAG layer slows the legacy service by 1.51-1.57x on a shared host, and sidecar staleness averages 911 ms with a 2 s polling interval. Retrieval hit@1 is 0.95; three hosted LLMs answer all 12 test questions correctly and a local model 9/12, and the four backends are swapped by changing one request field. All dynamic results come from one host and one system.

translation.title: 量化将检索增强生成改造到遗留软件系统中的侵入性
translation.abstract: 企业越来越多地在现有REST和单体系统中加入检索增强生成（RAG），通常是通过在处理器中写入临时的HTTP调用，却无法量化这种选择的侵入性。我们提出：（1）三种改造模式的分类法：sidecar、SDK-embed和naive-invasive；（2）Legacy Intrusion Score（LIS），包含三个代码子指标（变更、广度、耦合），以及扩展LIS-X，包含在真实系统上测量的三个运行子指标（运行时开销、故障传播和静默功能退化）；（3）对五个遗留系统的静态评估，其中两个是从仓库固定commit获取的真实开源代码库；（4）将三种模式部署为独立OS进程的实时案例研究。代码层面的排序sidecar < SDK-embed < naive-invasive在所有五个系统和2000次随机权重下成立，但它源于子指标的逐分量支配关系，因此验证的是指标本身而非检验假设。在实时研究中，结果并非由定义固定。sidecar对遗留端点没有可检测的延迟增加（0.07 ms，95% CI [-0.10, 0.24]），而SDK-embed和naive-invasive分别增加569和475 ms，且二者不可区分（p=0.62）。两者都会把2秒的依赖延迟传递给遗留请求，且当RAG层快速失败时，它们仍返回不再包含AI字段的成功响应。共享主机上RAG层的负载使遗留服务减速1.51-1.57倍，sidecar在2秒轮询间隔下平均陈旧度为911 ms。检索hit@1为0.95；三个托管LLM正确回答全部12个测试问题，本地模型答对9/12，且四个后端只需更改一个请求字段即可切换。所有动态结果均来自一台主机和一个系统。
translation.brief: 解决企业向遗留系统添加RAG时无法量化侵入性的问题，提出三种改造模式分类法及LIS/LIS-X评分体系，并通过静态评估与实时案例研究进行度量。

papers.title: Can you make models believe false facts in the prompt?
papers.abstract: Making LLMs believe false facts is useful for alignment evaluations and for building model organisms. Previous work explored doing so with Synthetic Document Finetuning (SDF). But SDF requires fine-tuning one new model for each set of injected false beliefs. To enable larger scale SDF-powered alignment evaluations, we attempt to produce a single model that believes any fact placed in a <facts> tag in the prompt. To do so, we explore doing prompt-conditioned SDF: fine-tuning a model on synthetic documents covering thousands of facts, with each document conditioned on a fact presented in the prompt. We evaluate how deeply the model believes the facts provided in the prompt using evaluations from prior work and a new Jacobian lens evaluation. We find that the belief depth on unseen facts scales roughly log-linearly with the number of training facts, making this a cheap, promising avenue for making models believe false facts, though preliminary experiments on applying it to alignment audits on the small model we studied showed negative results due to these small models often already acting as if they believed facts provided in regular honeypot system prompts. Using RL to reduce the rate at which models verbalize following a false fact in the prompt, on top of prompt-conditioned SDF, generalizes to held-out evals and almost matches SDF on some evaluations. But training against one of our metrics for belief depth makes it harder to trust those evaluations.

translation.title: 你能让模型相信提示中的虚假事实吗？
translation.abstract: 让LLM相信虚假事实对对齐评估和构建模型有机体很有用。先前的工作探索了用合成文档微调（SDF）来实现这一点。但SDF需要为每组注入的虚假信念微调一个新模型。为了实现更大规模的SDF驱动的对齐评估，我们尝试产出一个单一模型，使其相信提示中<facts>标签内的任何事实。为此，我们探索提示条件化的SDF：在覆盖数千个事实的合成文档上微调模型，每个文档以提示中呈现的事实为条件。我们使用先前工作的评估和一种新的Jacobian lens评估来衡量模型对提示中所提供事实的信念深度。我们发现模型对未见事实的信念深度大致随训练事实数量呈对数线性扩展，这使它成为让模型相信虚假事实的一条廉价且有前景的途径，不过在我们研究的小模型上将其应用于对齐审计的初步实验结果为负，因为这些小模型在常规蜜罐系统提示中往往已经表现得好像相信所提供的事实。在提示条件化SDF之上，用RL降低模型在提示中跟随虚假事实进行言语表述的比率，可泛化到保留评估集，并在某些评估上几乎与SDF相当。但针对我们某个信念深度指标进行训练反而使这些评估更难被信任。
translation.brief: 解决SDF需为每组虚假信念单独微调模型的问题，提出提示条件化SDF，训练单一模型相信提示<facts>标签中的任意事实，并评估其信念深度。

papers.title: How Complete Must an Environment Be to Train a Capable GUI Agent?
papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents are widely trained in executable GUI environments. To lower cost, build environments in batches, and reduce manual effort, each work trades away part of the environment through its construction choices. We describe these choices along three dimensions: reward coverage, the goal-reaching trajectories the verifier rewards; data coverage, the application data the agent is exposed to beyond what the task reads or writes; and feature coverage, the application features beyond what the task uses. Existing works set each dimension on engineering grounds, but they do not measure its effect on training. How complete must an environment be to train a capable agent, and along which dimensions? In MobileGym, we adjust each dimension separately, train Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, and evaluate every policy in the original full environment. A verifier that rewards only one reference path lowers success by 10.53 points, and removing unneeded records also lowers success. Pruning unneeded features instead raises success from 51.61% to 56.13%, entirely on tasks whose environments it left unchanged. The gain reverses when each episode is weighted equally and vanishes when only episodes on the pruned tasks are balanced. Without pruning, length weighting there reinforces long detour successes that erode skills on other tasks. Following these findings, we build MobileGym-Lite, which keeps reward and data coverage complete and prunes unneeded features. It outperforms Full in the full environment (55.48% versus 51.61% success) with lower construction cost.

translation.title: 训练一个有能力的GUI智能体需要环境有多完整？
translation.abstract: 图形用户界面（GUI）智能体通常在可执行的GUI环境中训练。为降低成本、批量构建环境并减少人工投入，每项工作都通过其构建选择舍弃了环境的某一部分。我们沿三个维度描述这些选择：奖励覆盖，即验证器奖励的达成目标的轨迹；数据覆盖，即智能体接触到的超出任务读写范围的应用数据；特征覆盖，即超出任务所用范围的应用功能。现有工作基于工程考量设定各维度，但并未测量其对训练的影响。训练一个有能力的智能体需要环境多完整？应沿哪些维度？在MobileGym中，我们分别调整每个维度，训练Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct，并在原始完整环境中评估每个策略。只奖励一条参考路径的验证器使成功率降低10.53分，移除不需要的记录也会降低成功率。相反，剪除不需要的功能使成功率从51.61%提升到56.13%，且提升完全来自其环境未被改变的任务。当每个回合等权重时该增益逆转，当仅对被剪除任务上的回合做均衡时增益消失。不剪除时，那里的长度加权会强化绕远路成功，侵蚀其他任务上的技能。基于这些发现，我们构建了MobileGym-Lite，它保持奖励和数据覆盖完整并剪除不需要的功能。它在完整环境中优于Full（成功率55.48%对51.61%），且构建成本更低。
translation.brief: 解决GUI智能体训练环境完整性各维度对训练效果影响不明的问题，在MobileGym中分别调控奖励、数据、特征覆盖三个维度并训练评估，据此构建低成本高效的MobileGym-Lite。

papers.title: When Do Decision Models Help LLM-Driven Network Discovery?
papers.abstract: Network discovery, the identification of live hosts and their exposed services, is the first phase of every penetration test, and it is increasingly automated by harnesses driven by large language models (LLMs). To mitigate hallucinated or unsafe commands, recent work proposes inserting fast, non-generative decision models to validate actions prior to execution. This paper quantifies whether such validation improves discovery across three network scales (n = 10, 100, and 1,000) in a simulation calibrated on a 30-node containerized testbed. Our findings show that chunked batch dispatch recovers 92% to 100% of open ports in large-scale networks, whereas single-host dispatch collapses to under 6% due to context saturation and scan latency. Furthermore, at the measured proposal quality of the local model, decision gating increases its port recall from 75.5% to 89.0% on small networks and intercepts costly decoy tarpits, but it imposes additional latency on frontier models during early host discovery.

translation.title: 决策模型何时能帮助 LLM 驱动的网络发现？
translation.abstract: 网络发现（识别存活主机及其暴露服务）是每次渗透测试的第一阶段，目前越来越多地由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的自动化工具完成。为缓解幻觉或不安全命令，近期工作提出在执行前插入快速、非生成式决策模型来验证动作。本文在一个基于 30 节点容器化测试床校准的仿真中，量化了此类验证在三种网络规模（n = 10、100 和 1,000）下是否能改善发现效果。研究结果表明，分块批量派发在大规模网络中可恢复 92% 至 100% 的开放端口，而单主机派发由于上下文饱和和扫描延迟会骤降至 6% 以下。此外，在本地模型所测得的提案质量下，决策门控将其在小网络上的端口召回率从 75.5% 提升至 89.0%，并能拦截代价高昂的诱饵 tarpit，但在早期主机发现阶段会给前沿模型带来额外延迟。
translation.brief: 研究决策模型验证能否提升 LLM 驱动的网络发现效果，通过在多规模仿真中量化分块批量派发与决策门控对端口召回率和延迟的影响来回答。

papers.title: VOL-Agent: Programming Your Film via Video Orchestration Language Agentic System
papers.abstract: Recent video foundation models generate high-quality and limited-length clips, but orchestrating them into minute-level, story-coherent films remains an open problem. Existing video agents highly rely on natural-language planning or predefined workflows, which make their production hard to program, customize, and extend. Therefore, we introduce VOL-Agent, a programmable video agent built on a Video Orchestration Language (VOL). With static compilation and verification, followed by runtime dynamic loading, VOL-Agent decouples structural reliability from execution flexibility. Through the skill-driven executor, VOL-Agent dynamically resolves tools and skills from an open-world repository and supports user-defined skills in natural language. Moreover, VOL-Agent is capable of crafting new director skills from learned knowledge and improves itself through feedback to accumulate filmmaking knowledge. To overcome the disconnect between different segments, we apply a structural memory mechanism to record and recall world and entity states, sustaining entity and scene consistency across different shots. Critic feedback supports local revision, while reusable filmmaking knowledge and experiences can be retained for subsequent tasks. Experiments on three benchmarks show that VOL-Agent generates minute-scale videos with strong overall quality and limited cost.

translation.title: VOL-Agent：通过视频编排语言智能体系统为你的影片编程
translation.abstract: 近期的视频基础模型能生成高质量但长度有限的片段，但如何将它们编排成分钟级、故事连贯的影片仍是开放问题。现有视频智能体高度依赖自然语言规划或预定义工作流，使其制作难以编程、定制和扩展。为此，我们提出 VOL-Agent，一个构建在视频编排语言（VOL）之上的可编程视频智能体。通过静态编译与验证，再配合运行时动态加载，VOL-Agent 将结构可靠性与执行灵活性解耦。借助技能驱动的执行器，VOL-Agent 从开放世界仓库中动态解析工具与技能，并支持用户以自然语言定义技能。此外，VOL-Agent 能够从所学知识中创造新的导演技能，并通过反馈自我改进以积累电影制作知识。为克服不同片段之间的脱节，我们采用结构化记忆机制来记录和回忆世界与实体状态，在不同镜头间维持实体与场景一致性。评论者反馈支持局部修订，可复用的电影制作知识与经验可保留用于后续任务。在三个基准上的实验表明，VOL-Agent 能以较强的整体质量和有限的成本生成分钟级视频。
translation.brief: 解决将视频基础模型片段编排成分钟级连贯影片难以编程定制的问题，提出基于视频编排语言 VOL 的可编程智能体系统，结合静态编译验证、技能驱动执行与结构化记忆机制。

papers.title: ReflectRec: Cycle-Consistency Preference Verification for LLM-based Recommendation
papers.abstract: CoT-style LLM recommenders generate a natural-language preference note as a chain-of-thought prefix to ranking, but the note is trusted without verification, and the ranker never consults behaviorally similar users. We propose ReflectRec, organized around a preference-to-history round-trip verifier whose recall score serves as an operational signal of preference-to-history recoverability, enabling conditional regeneration for low-recoverability preferences and selection among regeneration attempts. Around this verifier, we wire a semantic Stage-1 prompt, conditional regeneration, and Forward-Look retrieval that injects future watches of behaviorally similar users as a collaborative hint. On MovieLens-100K and MovieLens-1M, the full pipeline outperforms CoT4Rec-ICL by +16.25 / +4.46 pp Hit@10, with positive gains across all ValScore buckets and three LLM backbones (Qwen3-30B, Qwen2.5-72B, and Llama-3.3-70B). We also observe a similar verifier-guided regeneration pattern on Amazon Electronics.

translation.title: ReflectRec：基于 LLM 推荐的循环一致性偏好验证
translation.abstract: CoT 风格的 LLM 推荐器生成一段自然语言偏好笔记作为排序前的思维链前缀，但该笔记未经验证即被信任，且排序器从不参考行为相似的用户。我们提出 ReflectRec，围绕一个偏好到历史的往返验证器组织，其召回分数作为偏好到历史可恢复性的可操作信号，从而支持对低可恢复性偏好的条件性再生成以及在多次再生成尝试中进行选择。围绕该验证器，我们连接了语义化的第一阶段提示、条件性再生成，以及注入行为相似用户未来观看记录作为协同提示的 Forward-Look 检索。在 MovieLens-100K 和 MovieLens-1M 上，完整流水线在 Hit@10 上分别比 CoT4Rec-ICL 高出 +16.25 / +4.46 个百分点，在所有 ValScore 分桶和三种 LLM 骨干（Qwen3-30B、Qwen2.5-72B 和 Llama-3.3-70B）上均取得正向增益。我们还在 Amazon Electronics 上观察到类似的验证器引导的再生成模式。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 推荐中思维链偏好笔记未经验证即被信任的问题，提出偏好到历史的循环一致性往返验证器，据此进行条件性再生成并注入行为相似用户的协同信号。

papers.title: OMNIS+: Semantic RAN Slicing and Quantization for Dynamic Split Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Edge computing enables resource-constrained devices to execute machine learning (ML) applications via task offloading, with radio access network (RAN) slicing playing a crucial role in provisioning joint communication and computing resources. However, existing RAN slicing frameworks rely on static computing models, limiting their ability to exploit dynamic semantic data representations enabled by modern neural architectures. To address this limitation, we propose OMNIS+, a semantic RAN slicing framework for multi-cell edge computing built upon a new generation of dynamic split neural models. OMNIS+ incorporates dynamic neural compression paired with adaptive quantization for task offloading, providing a versatile decision space across communication payload and compute dimensions. We leveraged a novel ``box'' quantization scheme that markedly enhances resilience to transmission bit errors across diverse compression rates. Considering partial system observability and distinct node objectives, we formulate two interdependent optimization problems: (i)~mobile devices (MDs) maximize inference accuracy under quality-of-service (QoS) and queue-stability constraints by jointly adapting dynamic split deep neural network (DNN) branches and cell association; and (ii)~each edge server (ES) allocates bandwidth, graphics processing unit (GPU) frequency, and modulation and coding scheme (MCS) to maximize the max--min inference accuracy among associated MDs under cell capacity limits. We solve these problems using a multi-agent distributed optimization framework, where MDs act as causal contextual multi-armed bandit (MAB) agents under backlog-aware Lyapunov control, while each ES executes resource allocation via block coordinate descent (BCD). Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, OMNIS+ reduces the QoS violation probability by up to 1.75 while achieving a better accuracy--violation trade-off.

translation.title: OMNIS+：面向动态分割神经网络的语义 RAN 切片与量化
translation.abstract: 边缘计算使资源受限的设备能够通过任务卸载执行机器学习（ML）应用，其中无线接入网（RAN）切片在联合提供通信与计算资源方面发挥着关键作用。然而，现有 RAN 切片框架依赖静态计算模型，限制了其利用现代神经架构所支持的动态语义数据表示的能力。为解决这一局限，我们提出 OMNIS+，一个基于新一代动态分割神经模型、面向多小区边缘计算的语义 RAN 切片框架。OMNIS+ 将动态神经压缩与自适应量化相结合用于任务卸载，在通信负载和计算维度上提供了灵活的决策空间。我们采用了一种新颖的“box”量化方案，在多种压缩率下显著增强了对传输比特错误的鲁棒性。考虑到部分系统可观测性和不同节点的目标，我们构建了两个相互依赖的优化问题：(i) 移动设备（MD）在服务质量（QoS）和队列稳定性约束下，通过联合调整动态分割深度神经网络（DNN）分支与小区关联来最大化推理精度；(ii) 每个边缘服务器（ES）在小区容量限制下分配带宽、图形处理器（GPU）频率和调制编码方案（MCS），以最大化其关联 MD 间的 max-min 推理精度。我们使用多智能体分布式优化框架求解这些问题：MD 作为在积压感知 Lyapunov 控制下的因果上下文多臂老虎机（MAB）智能体，而每个 ES 通过块坐标下降（BCD）执行资源分配。与最先进的基线相比，OMNIS+ 将 QoS 违约概率最多降低 1.75，同时实现了更优的精度-违约权衡。
translation.brief: 解决现有 RAN 切片框架依赖静态计算模型、无法利用动态语义表示的问题，提出结合动态分割神经网络、动态压缩与 box 量化的语义 RAN 切片框架，并用多智能体分布式优化求解。

papers.title: SCAFFOLD: Toward Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport for Reusable LLM-Agent Skills
papers.abstract: An agent skill that succeeded yesterday may be executable today without being justified for reuse today. Tests may cover only observable contract clauses, outcome oracles may be absent, evaluations may inherit the same erroneous specification, and permissions or dependencies may change between validation and invocation. We argue that the appropriate unit of prospective trust is a Warranted Reuse Claim (WRC): a defeasible, claim-specific authorization tied to a versioned skill, target context, evidence, assumptions, and identified defeaters. The paper sharpens this position through Warrant-Preserving Evidence Transport (WPET), a proposed discipline for deciding which historical evidence remains admissible after context change. It distinguishes evidence admissibility from truth of the supported safety or effectiveness claim; states a conditional preservation result and its limits; specifies three-valued applicability and asymmetric context-transfer judgments; and illustrates how provenance dependence and policy-invalidating changes alter authorization. We explicitly relate the proposal to assurance cases, contracts, and skill-library maintenance rather than claiming novelty for their ingredients. A falsifiable longitudinal evaluation would compare WRC-guided policies with strong version-aware baselines at matched coverage, utility, and review cost. This paper contributes a formalized problem statement, testable design obligations, and reporting protocol, not an implemented verifier, empirical superiority result, or proof of universal agent safety.

translation.title: SCAFFOLD：面向可复用 LLM 智能体技能的担保保持证据传输
translation.abstract: 昨天成功的智能体技能今天或许可以执行，但未必有理由在今天复用。测试可能只覆盖可观察的契约条款，结果预言可能缺失，评估可能继承同一份错误的规范，权限或依赖也可能在验证与调用之间发生变化。我们主张，前瞻性信任的合适单元是担保复用声明（WRC）：一种可废止的、针对特定声明的授权，与版本化技能、目标上下文、证据、假设及已识别的废止因素绑定。本文通过担保保持证据传输（WPET）强化这一立场，这是一种用于决定哪些历史证据在上下文变化后仍然可采纳的规范。它区分了证据的可采纳性与所支持的安全性或有效性声明的真实性；给出了一个条件性保持结果及其局限；规定了三值适用性判断和非对称上下文迁移判断；并说明了来源依赖和政策失效性变化如何改变授权。我们明确将该提案与保证案例、契约和技能库维护相关联，而非宣称其组成部分的新颖性。一项可证伪的纵向评估应在匹配的覆盖率、效用和审查成本下，将 WRC 引导的策略与强大的版本感知基线进行比较。本文贡献的是一个形式化的问题陈述、可检验的设计义务和报告协议，而非已实现的验证器、实证优越性结果或通用智能体安全性的证明。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体技能在上下文变化后历史证据能否支持复用授权的问题，提出担保复用声明（WRC）与担保保持证据传输（WPET）规范来判定证据的可采纳性。

papers.title: Rethinking Fixed-Horizon Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract: Existing latent reasoners typically run for a preset latent horizon during inference. Intuitively, a longer horizon should provide more opportunity for reasoning. However, in this work, we find that extending latent Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to the full preset horizon may in fact degrade reasoning performance. We observe that latent CoT evolves through distinct functional stages, with earlier computation forming frontier reasoning states, while later computation mainly reorganizes existing candidates and can weaken gold candidate support. These findings motivate a rethink of fixed-horizon latent inference. To address this, we characterize the reasoning benefits of latent CoT by realized and remaining constructive progress. Empirically, we find that higher realized constructive progress corresponds to higher current reasoning accuracy, while more remaining progress corresponds to larger future gains from continued latent CoT. To this end, we introduce a lightweight method that estimates the remaining reasoning progress and adaptively adjusts the latent horizon during inference. Across representative latent CoT reasoners and multiple arithmetic benchmarks, our method improves reasoning accuracy by up to 7.2 percentage points while reducing latent computation by up to 29.0%, without retraining the LLM.

translation.title: 重新思考固定长度的潜在推理
translation.abstract: 现有的潜在推理器通常在推理时运行预设的潜在推理长度。直觉上，更长的推理长度应提供更多推理机会。然而，本研究发现，将潜在思维链（CoT）扩展到完整的预设长度实际上可能降低推理性能。我们观察到潜在CoT经历不同的功能阶段：早期计算形成前沿推理状态，而后期计算主要重组已有候选，并可能削弱对正确候选的支持。这些发现促使我们重新思考固定长度的潜在推理。为此，我们用已实现的和剩余的建设性进展来刻画潜在CoT的推理收益。实证发现，更高的已实现建设性进展对应更高的当前推理准确率，而更多的剩余进展对应继续潜在CoT带来的更大未来收益。基于此，我们提出一种轻量级方法，估计剩余推理进展并在推理过程中自适应调整潜在推理长度。在代表性潜在CoT推理器和多个算术基准上，该方法在不重训LLM的情况下，将推理准确率提升最多7.2个百分点，同时减少最多29.0%的潜在计算。
translation.brief: 针对固定长度潜在推理中后期计算反而损害推理性能的问题，提出通过估计剩余建设性进展来自适应调整潜在推理长度的轻量级方法。

papers.title: Space-X: Self-Evolving Spatial Agents Weaving Clues into Evidence Chains
papers.abstract: Spatial reasoning connects visual observations, geometric estimates, and linguistic decisions into a coherent derivation. Yet tool-augmented agents often acquire evidence without clear targets, combine outputs under inconsistent object or reference-frame semantics, and misjudge evidence sufficiency. Thus, more tools or calls do not reliably improve reasoning. We introduce Space-X, a spatial-reasoning framework that self-evolves toward complete, continuous evidence-chain construction. An Execution Agent acquires, associates, and judges evidence per problem using role-specific memory. A Control Agent diagnoses evidence-chain breaks from execution traces and jointly revises tools, interfaces, skills, memory organization, and decision rules. This loop co-evolves capability and evidence use: evidence needs guide capability development; usable results guide actions. Across multiple benchmarks, Space-X yields gains with four base models. Relative to baselines, GPT-6-sol improves answer accuracy on ViewSpatial and MMSI by 50.39% and 23.07%, respectively; Gemini-3.8-Flash gains 47.50% and 25.22% on these benchmarks. This provides a unified route from fragmented spatial clues to traceable, derivable answers.

translation.title: Space-X：将线索编织成证据链的自进化空间智能体
translation.abstract: 空间推理将视觉观察、几何估计和语言决策连接为连贯的推导。然而，工具增强的智能体常常在没有明确目标的情况下获取证据，在不一致的对象或参考系语义下组合输出，并误判证据是否充分。因此，更多的工具或调用并不能可靠地提升推理效果。我们提出Space-X，一个朝完整、连续证据链构建方向自进化的空间推理框架。执行智能体（Execution Agent）利用角色专属记忆为每个问题获取、关联和评判证据；控制智能体（Control Agent）从执行轨迹中诊断证据链断裂，并联合修订工具、接口、技能、记忆组织和决策规则。该循环实现能力与证据使用的共同进化：证据需求引导能力发展，可用结果引导行动。在多个基准上，Space-X在四个基础模型上均取得提升。相对于基线，GPT-6-sol在ViewSpatial和MMSI上的答案准确率分别提升50.39%和23.07%；Gemini-3.8-Flash在这两个基准上分别提升47.50%和25.22%。这提供了从碎片化空间线索到可追溯、可推导答案的统一路径。
translation.brief: 针对工具增强智能体在空间推理中证据获取无目标、组合语义不一致的问题，提出通过执行与控制双智能体循环自进化构建完整证据链的框架Space-X。

papers.title: MARS Technical Report
papers.abstract: Modern industrial recommender systems use multi-stage cascades--retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking--to narrow millions of candidates to a personalized list. While each stage deploys sophisticated models, pipeline-level decisions on channel activation, quotas, model selection, and score fusion remain engineer-tuned and user-agnostic within each scenario. This report presents MARS (Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System), extending personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration. A near-line agent built on fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B generates per-user configurations--a seven-dimensional action covering pipeline mode, retrieval quotas, model selection, fusion weights, and reranker settings--from a constrained action space. Configurations are validated, cached, and consumed asynchronously; the cascade never waits for LLM inference. Schema checks, fallbacks, and a kill switch ensure serving safety. The policy is trained in three stages: Confidence-aware SFT distills schema-valid generation from a teacher model; Format-Anchored Preference Optimization (FAPO) learns action preferences via ActionMask with posterior weighting; Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refines the policy through Sandbox replay with a frozen reward model, without exposing exploratory actions to live traffic. Two-week A/B tests across five Taobao scenarios with over ten million daily users show positive gains on all key metrics. The largest reach +5.22% V2P and +7.34% GMV, with positive CTR lifts on both click surfaces. About 20% of requests use a lightweight Minimal mode, and deployment shows 12 ms lower mean serving latency versus production.

translation.title: MARS技术报告
translation.abstract: 现代工业推荐系统使用多阶段级联——召回、粗排、精排和重排——将数百万候选缩减为个性化列表。虽然每个阶段部署了复杂的模型，但管道层面的决策（如通道激活、配额、模型选择和分数融合）仍由工程师调优，且在各场景内不针对用户。本报告提出MARS（多阶段智能体推荐系统），将个性化从单阶段预测扩展到全管道编排。基于微调Qwen3-0.6B构建的近线智能体，从受约束的动作空间中为每个用户生成配置——涵盖管道模式、召回配额、模型选择、融合权重和重排设置等七个维度的动作。配置经过验证、缓存并异步消费；级联从不等待LLM推理。Schema检查、回退机制和熔断开关保障服务安全。策略分三阶段训练：置信度感知SFT从教师模型蒸馏出符合schema的生成；格式锚定偏好优化（FAPO）通过带后验加权的ActionMask学习动作偏好；组相对策略优化（GRPO）通过Sandbox回放与冻结奖励模型精炼策略，且不将探索性动作暴露给线上流量。在淘宝五个场景、日活超千万用户的两周A/B测试中，所有关键指标均取得正向收益，最大提升为+5.22% V2P和+7.34% GMV，两个点击面的CTR均有正向提升。约20%的请求使用轻量Minimal模式，部署后平均服务延迟较生产环境降低12毫秒。
translation.brief: 针对推荐系统多阶段级联中管道级决策不个性化的痛点，提出用近线LLM智能体为每个用户生成全管道编排配置的MARS系统，并通过SFT、FAPO和GRPO三阶段训练策略。

papers.title: Intent Contracts: Taking Tools Away from Agents
papers.abstract: Intent contracts are an authorization interface for tool-using LLM agents in which the planning model holds no tools. For each step it submits a short logged contract: a goal, a verbatim quotation of the user, and scope fields. Code validates the contract, and a small trusted model checks it against the user's words and writes the tool call itself. Provided the validation and dispatch code is correct, every executed call is written by the trusted model, the planner's influence on a call is confined to a contract logged before it, and the trusted side decides how much of a request to carry out. We compare contracts with two reviewers of planner-written commands: one sees only the user's words and the command, the information boundary of a reasoning-blind permission classifier, and one also sees the planner's goal and a checked quotation. With gpt-6.1-terra as planner and GLM-5.3-Flash as the trusted model on three AmPermBench task families, every object changed under contracts is named in the goal of the contract that produced the change; under review the planner names objects in its commands and rarely in its goals. When the planner adds work the user never asked for, contracts complete the user's task in 27/30 runs and the intent-visible reviewer in 16/30, because a reviewer can only refuse a whole command. Contracts do not reduce unauthorized actions. They are indistinguishable from blind review, and once the benchmark's environment terms are clarified, every condition that changes state hits a wrong target in 40-49% of those runs. That error is the planner's choice of objects for an ambiguous reference, which no trusted model here can see the environment to check; telling the executor to decline when unsure does not change it. We evaluate benign over-reach with one pair of models, not adversarial planners. We release the plugin and run records.

translation.title: 意图契约：从智能体手中收回工具
translation.abstract: 意图契约是一种面向使用工具的LLM智能体的授权接口，其中规划模型不持有任何工具。规划模型为每一步提交一份简短的、被记录的契约：一个目标、用户原话的逐字引用以及范围字段。代码验证契约，一个小型可信模型将契约与用户的话进行核对并亲自撰写工具调用。只要验证和分发代码正确，每个被执行的调用都由可信模型撰写，规划者对调用的影响仅限于调用前记录的契约，且由可信方决定执行请求的多少。我们将契约与两种审查规划者所写命令的方式进行比较：一种只看到用户的话和命令（即推理盲权限分类器的信息边界），另一种还能看到规划者的目标和经核对的引用。以gpt-6.1-terra为规划者、GLM-5.3-Flash为可信模型，在AmPermBench的三个任务族上，契约下每个被更改的对象都出现在产生该更改的契约目标中；而在审查方式下，规划者在命令中命名对象，却很少在目标中命名。当规划者添加用户从未要求的工作时，契约在30次运行中27次完成用户任务，而意图可见的审查者仅16次，因为审查者只能拒绝整条命令。契约并不能减少未授权操作：它们与盲审查难以区分，且一旦基准的环境术语被澄清，每种改变状态的条件在40-49%的此类运行中命中错误目标。该错误源于规划者为模糊指代选择的对象，而这里的可信模型无法查看环境来核查；指示执行器在不确定时拒绝执行也无济于事。我们仅用一对模型评估良性越权，而非对抗性规划者。我们发布了插件和运行记录。
translation.brief: 针对工具使用LLM智能体中规划模型直接持有工具带来的安全风险，提出规划者无工具、由可信模型依据已记录意图契约撰写并执行调用的授权接口。

papers.title: Algorithmic Market Making Can Lead to Rough Volatility Through the Order Book
papers.abstract: Existing work suggests that markets can show volatility with paths rougher than those of Brownian motion. In theory this can happen when the order flow is close to instability with memory that decays as a power law. However, it is not fully clear how such order flow could arise from the predominantly algorithmic market making that characterizes order book dynamics. We show one such consistent mechanism. We treat each market maker as a desk that uses a first-order gradient rule to move the distances of its orders from the mid price toward target distances provided by an unknown oracle. We assume that distinct desks do not act synchronously in time but act whenever new information relevant to their respective oracles arrives, which each desk samples over its own characteristic lookback horizon. Across all desks the rule therefore takes the form of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with information-driven (mini-batch) noise. In the continuum limit this update rule makes the volume of the order book follow a conservative stochastic partial differential equation (the Dean--Kawasaki equation) whose fluctuations drive the order flow. The distinct horizons of the desks further induce a persistent memory in the order flow that decays as a power law. Standard scaling arguments then lead to rough volatility. We confirm the key predictions of the model on simulated agents and on six months of Binance data with about 790 million orders. In liquid markets governed mainly by market makers, such as the perpetual futures of Binance, the order books are consistent with how our desks change the book.

translation.title: 算法做市可通过订单簿导致粗糙波动率
translation.abstract: 已有研究表明，市场可能表现出比布朗运动路径更粗糙的波动率。理论上，当订单流接近不稳定且记忆呈幂律衰减时，这种情况可能发生。然而，这种订单流如何从刻画订单簿动态的以算法为主的市场做市中产生，尚不完全清楚。我们展示了一种自洽的机制。我们将每个做市商视为一个交易台，使用一阶梯度规则将其订单相对中间价的距离向某个未知预言机提供的目标距离调整。我们假设不同交易台在时间上不同步行动，而是在与其各自预言机相关的新信息到达时行动，每个交易台在其自身的特征回看周期内采样这些信息。因此，跨所有交易台，该规则呈现为带信息驱动（迷你批次）噪声的随机梯度下降（SGD）。在连续极限下，该更新规则使订单簿的量遵循一个保守的随机偏微分方程（Dean–Kawasaki方程），其涨落驱动订单流。各交易台不同的周期进一步在订单流中诱导出呈幂律衰减的持久记忆。随后，标准标度论证导出粗糙波动率。我们在模拟智能体和约7.9亿笔订单的六个月Binance数据上验证了模型的关键预测。在主要由做市商主导的流动性市场（如Binance的永续合约）中，订单簿与我们的交易台改变订单簿的方式一致。
translation.brief: 针对粗糙波动率的微观起源问题，提出将做市商建模为异步SGD更新报价距离的交易台，通过Dean–Kawasaki方程和幂律记忆导出粗糙波动率的机制。

papers.title: A Capability Framework for Evaluating Agentic AI Platforms in Regulated Enterprises
papers.abstract: Agentic AI platforms-systems in which LLM agents plan, invoke tools, retain memory and coordinate to change the state of enterprise systems-are being procured faster than they can be measured. Public agent benchmarks score models in fixed harnesses; enterprises buy integrated platforms whose orchestration, memory, governance and tooling layers dominate outcomes, and they buy them largely on the strength of vendor demonstrations. We report an industrial evaluation programme ("bakeoff") run by the innovation laboratory of a global bank in which ten platforms-spanning open-source frameworks, proprietary products and hyperscaler ecosystems-were assessed by a cross-functional panel on nine capability dimensions across three financial-services workloads: counterparty credit risk, retrieval-augmented generation and process automation. Scores separate the field into three tiers that are stable under alternative weightings, and surface workload-specific strengths that aggregates hide. A secondary analysis, however, finds Cronbach's alpha = 0.98 across nominally distinct dimensions and rank correlations >= 0.93 with the total for eight of nine: a halo effect indicating that demonstration-based scoring measures presentation as much as capability. From these lessons we propose a gate-then-score evaluation protocol with four layers (capability, execution reliability, governance gates, business value), trace-level reliability metrics estimated over repeated runs, an autonomy-readiness scale and a reproducibility protocol. We state precisely what the present evidence supports, and what a controlled harness must add to turn enterprise platform evaluation from structured judgement into measurement.

translation.title: 面向受监管企业评估Agentic AI平台的能力框架
translation.abstract: Agentic AI平台——即LLM智能体进行规划、调用工具、保留记忆并协同改变企业系统状态的系统——的采购速度已超过其可被衡量的速度。公开的智能体基准在固定测试环境中为模型打分；而企业购买的是集成平台，其编排、记忆、治理和工具层主导最终效果，且采购决策很大程度上依赖供应商演示。我们报告了由一家全球性银行的创新实验室开展的工业评估项目（"bakeoff"），其中十个平台——涵盖开源框架、专有产品和超大规模云厂商生态系统——由跨职能评审小组在三个金融服务工作负载（交易对手信用风险、检索增强生成和流程自动化）上按九个能力维度进行评估。评分将各平台区分为三个层级，且在替代权重方案下保持稳定，并揭示了聚合分数所掩盖的工作负载特定优势。然而，一项二次分析发现，名义上不同的九个维度中，Cronbach's alpha = 0.98，且八个维度与总分的秩相关系数 >= 0.93：这种光环效应表明基于演示的评分在衡量能力的同时也在衡量展示效果。基于这些经验教训，我们提出一个"先设门槛后打分"的评估协议，包含四个层次（能力、执行可靠性、治理门槛、业务价值）、基于多次重复运行估计的追踪级可靠性指标、自主性就绪度量表以及可复现性协议。我们精确阐述了当前证据所能支持的内容，以及一个受控测试环境必须补充什么，才能将企业平台评估从结构化判断转变为真正的测量。
translation.brief: 针对企业难以可靠评估Agentic AI平台的问题，提出基于真实银行多平台评测经验的多层"先设门槛后打分"评估协议与可靠性度量方法。

papers.title: Compression Effects on Low-Resource Multilingual Translation
papers.abstract: We present a pilot study characterising the effect of post-training quantisation on multilingual machine translation quality and inference cost for three African languages - Hausa, Swahili, and Yoruba - across three model families: a small general-purpose LLM (Qwen2.5-1.5B), a larger multilingual instruction-tuned LLM (Aya-23-8B), and a dedicated multilingual MT model (NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B). Evaluating on the FLORES-200 devtest set (1,012 sentences per direction) under FP16, bitsandbytes INT8, and NF4 INT4 precisions on consumer-grade NVIDIA T4 GPUs, we find: (i) the specialised MT model outperforms both LLMs by 32.7-43.3 chrF on the Hausa and Swahili directions, and by 12.9-24.7 chrF on Yoruba, despite being roughly a sixth the size of the 8B instruction-tuned LLM; (ii) post-training quantisation preserves aggregate translation quality within approximately 1 chrF across all model families and language directions, with a single worst case of 2.19 chrF; (iii) on consumer GPUs, INT8 and INT4 quantisation provide substantial memory savings (49-61% at INT4) but do not reduce inference latency relative to FP16 - in fact, latency increases by 1.3x to 5.3x; (iv) a clear performance gradient tracking training-resource availability is visible across languages (Swahili > Hausa > Yoruba). These findings motivate a research agenda focused on hardware-aware compression and error-type analysis beyond aggregate metrics for low-resource deployment.

translation.title: 压缩对低资源多语言翻译的影响
translation.abstract: 我们呈现一项试点研究，刻画训练后量化对三种非洲语言——豪萨语、斯瓦希里语和约鲁巴语——的多语言机器翻译质量和推理成本的影响，涉及三个模型家族：小型通用LLM（Qwen2.5-1.5B）、更大的多语言指令微调LLM（Aya-23-8B）以及专用多语言MT模型（NLLB-200-distilled-1.3B）。在消费级NVIDIA T4 GPU上，以FP16、bitsandbytes INT8和NF4 INT4精度在FLORES-200开发测试集（每个方向1,012句）上评估，我们发现：(i) 专用MT模型在豪萨语和斯瓦希里语方向上比两个LLM高出32.7-43.3 chrF，在约鲁巴语方向上高出12.9-24.7 chrF，尽管其规模约为8B指令微调LLM的六分之一；(ii) 训练后量化在所有模型家族和语言方向上将总体翻译质量保持在约1 chrF以内，最差单例为2.19 chrF；(iii) 在消费级GPU上，INT8和INT4量化带来显著的内存节省（INT4下49-61%），但并未降低相对于FP16的推理延迟——实际上延迟增加了1.3倍至5.3倍；(iv) 各语言间存在清晰的性能梯度，与训练资源可用性一致（斯瓦希里语 > 豪萨语 > 约鲁巴语）。这些发现推动了一个聚焦于硬件感知压缩和超越聚合指标的错误类型分析的低资源部署研究议程。
translation.brief: 研究训练后量化对三种非洲语言机器翻译质量与推理成本的影响，通过在消费级GPU上对比三个模型家族的多种量化精度进行实证分析。

papers.title: A Hybrid RAG Framework for Deceptive Review Detection: Integrating RoBERTa-LoRA, FAISS-Based Retrieval, and LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: The growth of deceptive online opinions poses a critical risk of misinformation and fraud. This paper proposes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system to automatically distinguish spam reviews. The architecture integrates RoBERTa with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) classification, FAISS semantic vector retrieval, and a Large Language Model (LLM) for final reasoning. The system was evaluated across balanced and severely imbalanced real-world scenarios. Results demonstrate that five epochs of fine-tuning enable robust domain transfer, achieving an F1-score of 0.90 in cross-domain evaluation, outperforming baselines (OpenAI Detector,F1 = 0.82) and demonstrating competitive performance against specialized in-domain SOTA models (fakeRoBERTa,F1 = 0.97). The proposed architecture provides evidence-backed explainability and statistically significant precision gains while maintaining comparable overall detection performance.

translation.title: 面向虚假评论检测的混合RAG框架：集成RoBERTa-LoRA、基于FAISS的检索与LLM推理
translation.abstract: 虚假网络评论的增长带来了错误信息和欺诈的严重风险。本文提出一个检索增强生成（RAG）系统来自动区分垃圾评论。该架构集成了采用低秩适应（LoRA）的RoBERTa分类器、FAISS语义向量检索以及用于最终推理的大语言模型（LLM）。系统在均衡和严重不平衡的真实场景中进行了评估。结果表明，五个epoch的微调即可实现稳健的领域迁移，在跨领域评估中达到0.90的F1分数，优于基线（OpenAI Detector，F1 = 0.82），并与专门的领域内SOTA模型（fakeRoBERTa，F1 = 0.97）相比具有竞争力。所提出的架构提供了有证据支撑的可解释性和统计显著的精确率提升，同时保持了相当的总体检测性能。
translation.brief: 针对虚假评论检测问题，提出结合RoBERTa-LoRA分类、FAISS检索与LLM推理的RAG混合架构。

papers.title: From Data to Valves: A Self-Learning, Production-Grade Edge Stack for Sustainable HVAC Control
papers.abstract: Learned HVAC controllers rarely leave the simulator, and those that do are typically trained offline, frozen at deployment and retrained from the cloud. We present a production stack in which three learning components run on one NVIDIA Jetson Orin gateway per building, adapt continuously from the building's own data, and verify their own effect. (a) A compact transformer-encoder forecaster, one per equipment group with learned per-unit embeddings, predicts every air-side unit's next-cycle temperature and learns prequentially, one gradient step per five-minute cycle, behind five independent gates that bound the influence of any corrupt reading. (b) A distributional soft actor-critic agent, one shared policy across unit types, converts the measured state into a chilled-water valve position under a structural safety envelope that no learned component can soften; its second generation learns nightly on the device from recorded transitions alone, with a behaviour anchor and critic calibration terms, is scored by four model-free metrics and promoted by atomic hot-swap. (c) A change-point regression baseline held to ASHRAE Guideline 14 supplies the counterfactual against which savings are certified. On eighteen months of data from a hotel the forecaster converges from random weights within a week and reaches 0.37, 0.39 and 0.11 degree C MAE for air-handling, fresh-air and fan-coil units with no retraining event; on a different hotel the baseline reproduces a 46-day held-out period to within 0.07%. The RL agent has completed its in-simulator campaign and runs in shadow on 104 units; we report measured latency and memory of every service on a shared 15 GB device, the systems lessons of the campaign, and precisely what the evidence does and does not yet establish.

translation.title: 从数据到阀门：面向可持续HVAC控制的自学习生产级边缘技术栈
translation.abstract: 学习型HVAC控制器很少走出模拟器，而那些实际部署的通常采用离线训练、部署时冻结并从云端重新训练的方式。我们提出一个生产级技术栈，其中三个学习组件运行在每栋建筑的一台NVIDIA Jetson Orin网关上，从建筑自身数据持续适应并验证自身效果。(a) 一个紧凑的transformer编码器预测器，每个设备组一个并带有学习到的单元嵌入，预测每个空气侧机组的下一周期温度，并以prequential方式学习，每五分钟周期执行一次梯度步，且受五个独立门槛约束以限制任何损坏读数的影响。(b) 一个分布式soft actor-critic智能体，跨单元类型共享一个策略，在结构化安全包络（任何学习组件都无法软化）下将测量状态转换为冷冻水阀门位置；其第二代每晚在设备上仅从记录的转移中学习，带有行为锚定和critic校准项，由四个无模型指标评分并通过原子热切换晋升。(c) 一个符合ASHRAE Guideline 14的变点回归基线提供反事实，用于认证节能效果。基于一家酒店十八个月的数据，预测器在一周内从随机权重收敛，对空气处理机组、新风机组和风机盘管机组分别达到0.37、0.39和0.11摄氏度MAE，且无需任何重新训练事件；在另一家酒店，基线将46天的留出期复现至0.07%以内。RL智能体已完成其模拟器内训练并在104个机组上以影子模式运行；我们报告了共享15 GB设备上每个服务的实测延迟和内存、该训练活动的系统经验教训，以及证据确切确立与尚未确立的内容。
translation.brief: 针对学习型HVAC控制器难以实际部署的问题，构建在边缘网关上持续自学习并自我验证的预测、强化学习与节能基线三组件生产级技术栈。

papers.title: Grading Executable Legal Rules Against Independent Records: Transitional Provisions and Korean SME Status
papers.abstract: Laws are increasingly turned into programs that decide cases, such as whether a firm was a small or medium enterprise (SME) on a given date, and large language models (LLMs) now write them. The programs are usually graded against answers written by someone who read the same law, so a program can score well by sharing the grader's reading rather than by getting the law right. LexTemporis grades them instead against records of what actually happened: 10,901 firm-years of SME status disclosed by Korean listed companies, with every version of the governing rules. An appendix adds comparison cases from US income tax and German hospital minimum volumes. The date changes outcomes mainly through provisions outside the main statutory text: one transitional provision raises agreement with the disclosures from 83-86% to 89-90%. The disclosures also test the author's reading of a contested provision, favouring it in 130 of 189 firm-years where readings diverge. Four LLMs wrote the rules, given different selections of the law. A pre-registered comparison finds no condition better across all four models. In exploratory analyses, supplying the right provisions looks better graded against the author's reading than against the records: the advantage shrinks for three models (for one, to between a quarter and three-fifths of its size), and per firm-year it is several times larger where the author's reading is wrong, partly by construction, since there reproducing that reading more faithfully must lose. Grading legal programs against the grader's own reading can overstate how well they work.

translation.title: 依据独立记录评估可执行法律规则：过渡性条款与韩国中小企业身份认定
translation.abstract: 法律正日益被转化为决定具体案件的程序，例如判断某企业在特定日期是否属于中小企业（SME），而大语言模型（LLM）如今可以编写这些程序。这些程序通常依据由阅读过同一法律的人撰写的答案来评分，因此程序可以通过与评分者共享相同的解读而非正确理解法律而获得高分。LexTemporis转而依据实际发生情况的记录来评估它们：韩国上市公司披露的10,901个企业年度的SME身份，以及相关规则的每个版本。附录增加了来自美国所得税和德国医院最低业务量的对比案例。日期对结果的影响主要来自成文法正文之外的条款：一条过渡性条款将与披露数据的一致性从83-86%提升至89-90%。这些披露数据还检验了作者对一条有争议条款的解读，在189个解读存在分歧的企业年度中的130个支持该解读。四个LLM在给定法律不同选段的情况下编写了规则。一项预注册的比较发现没有任何条件在所有四个模型上都更优。在探索性分析中，提供正确条款的优势在依据作者解读评分时看起来比依据记录评分更好：三个模型的优势缩小（其中一个缩小至原来的四分之一到五分之三），且在作者解读错误的单个企业年度上优势大出数倍，这部分是构造使然，因为在那种情况下更忠实地复现该解读必然失分。依据评分者自身解读来评估法律程序可能夸大其实际效果。
translation.brief: 针对法律程序评估依赖评分者主观解读的问题，提出用韩国上市公司SME身份披露记录等独立事实数据来客观评估LLM生成的可执行法律规则。

papers.title: MIRAGE: A Framework for Multi-hop Reasoning under Dynamic Knowledge Injection
papers.abstract: Multi-hop Question Answering (MQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to retrieve and synthesize multiple pieces of evidence into a coherent reasoning path, which is essential for complex tasks. However, prior work on knowledge updating for MQA has largely focused on simple fact edits, overlooking a more challenging and realistic setting---\emph{Knowledge Injection}---in which the model must simultaneously accommodate both conflicting updates and entirely novel information. Under this setting, a hop-level answer is often wrong simply because the model trusts the wrong knowledge source: it clings to outdated parametric memory when the injected knowledge conflicts with it (K2), and it cannot answer when the required fact is entirely new (K3). To investigate this, we introduce NEXUS, the first benchmark tailored for multi-hop reasoning under Knowledge Injection, which explicitly covers both conflicting (K2) and incremental (K3) knowledge. We further propose MIRAGE, an efficient, training-free framework whose core component, the Correlation-aware Dual-path Reasoner (CDR), resolves such per-hop source-trust errors via P(True)-based confidence routing, complemented by a lightweight template-guided corrector for residual structural deviations. Extensive experiments across four LLM families and two benchmarks demonstrate that MIRAGE consistently improves both final-answer accuracy and hop-level reasoning accuracy, establishing a new state of the art in this challenging setting.

translation.title: MIRAGE：动态知识注入下的多跳推理框架
translation.abstract: 多跳问答（MQA）要求大语言模型（LLM）检索并综合多条证据形成连贯的推理路径，这对复杂任务至关重要。然而，以往面向MQA的知识更新研究大多聚焦于简单的事实编辑，忽视了一个更具挑战性也更现实的设定——知识注入，即模型必须同时处理冲突性更新和全新信息。在该设定下，某一跳的答案出错往往仅仅因为模型信任了错误的知识来源：当注入知识与参数记忆冲突时，模型固守过时的参数记忆（K2）；当所需事实完全新颖时，模型无法作答（K3）。为研究这一问题，我们提出NEXUS，首个专为知识注入下多跳推理设计的基准，显式覆盖冲突性（K2）和增量性（K3）知识。我们进一步提出MIRAGE，一个高效、免训练的框架，其核心组件相关性感知双路径推理器（CDR）通过基于P(True)的置信度路由解决逐跳的来源信任错误，并辅以轻量的模板引导修正器处理残留的结构性偏差。在四个LLM系列和两个基准上的大量实验表明，MIRAGE持续提升最终答案准确率和逐跳推理准确率，在这一挑战性设定下确立了新的最优水平。
translation.brief: 针对知识注入下多跳问答中模型逐跳信任错误知识来源的问题，提出免训练的MIRAGE框架，通过基于P(True)置信度路由的双路径推理器进行来源选择与修正。

papers.title: Replay, Don't Resample: Off-Policy Consolidation of Long-Horizon RL Experts
papers.abstract: Frontier post-training follows a common recipe: train one expert per domain with reinforcement learning (RL), then consolidate the experts into one model via multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD). Such consolidation is expensive: the student samples in every environment again, an expert scores every sampled token, and the student inherits the drift of the final experts. Yet we argue that the experts' RL runs have already produced what consolidation needs: rollouts with their sampling probabilities and rewards, in the order the experts learned from them. We propose multi-expert replay policy distillation (MRPD), which replays these training logs through the student in the experts' order. At each step, the policy gradient is recomputed on these scored trajectories, and the final experts' distributions are distilled at the logged prefixes. Following the experts' own trajectory reduces the training-inference mismatch and keeps the student within the clip range, so the replay is off-policy in origin but quasi-on-policy throughout consolidation. MRPD samples nothing and calls no environment or reward model: the trainer is the sole process, and consolidating the experts costs only about a seventh of the compute used to train them. On three long-horizon agentic domains (reasoning, search and SQL), MRPD yields the best student model, substantially outperforming online RL baselines, and surpassing MOPD from the same experts at a fraction of MOPD's cost. Our analysis on the same logs shows that the replayed trajectories carry most of the gain, and that both the policy gradient and the distillation term add to it. Most interestingly, the order of the logs matters more than their amount or rewards, suggesting that expert training logs are a curriculum, not a data mixture.

translation.title: 重放而非重采样：长时程RL专家的离策略整合
translation.abstract: 前沿后训练遵循一个通用配方：用强化学习（RL）为每个领域训练一个专家，然后通过多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将专家整合为一个模型。这种整合代价高昂：学生需要在每个环境中重新采样，专家需为每个采样token打分，且学生会继承最终专家的漂移。但我们认为，专家的RL训练过程已经产出了整合所需的一切：带有采样概率和奖励的rollout，且按专家学习的顺序排列。我们提出多专家重放策略蒸馏（MRPD），按专家的顺序将这些训练日志重放给学生。在每一步，策略梯度在这些已打分的轨迹上重新计算，并在记录的前缀处蒸馏最终专家的分布。遵循专家自身的轨迹减小了训练-推理失配，使学生保持在clip范围内，因此重放虽源于离策略，但在整个整合过程中近似在线策略。MRPD不做任何采样，不调用环境或奖励模型：训练器是唯一进程，整合专家的计算量仅约为训练它们的七分之一。在三个长时程智能体领域（推理、搜索和SQL）上，MRPD训练出最佳学生模型，大幅超越在线RL基线，并以MOPD一小部分成本超越来自相同专家的MOPD。对相同日志的分析表明，重放轨迹贡献了大部分增益，且策略梯度项和蒸馏项均有贡献。最有趣的是，日志的顺序比其数量或奖励更重要，这表明专家训练日志是一种课程，而非数据混合。
translation.brief: 针对多专家RL模型整合成本高的问题，提出MRPD，直接按专家训练顺序重放其训练日志（含采样概率与奖励）来重算策略梯度并蒸馏专家分布，无需重新采样。

papers.title: Measuring and Charging for Retained Context in Long-Context LLM Services
papers.abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) services charge for repeated context, yet billing weights need not reflect its contribution to answer quality. We present a three-layer framework separating content relevance, observable proxies and auditable positional weights. Context-ablation experiments show that relevance dominates position and that distance-decay families do not outperform a relevance-only baseline. A measured serving stack shows that cache hits reduce repeated-prefix compute cost by over two orders of magnitude at 65,536 tokens, while cold resends constrain sustainable discounts. Cross-provider measurements separate cache value from tokenisation and list-price differences. Calibrated simulations reduce the 99th percentile of session charges by 31-42%, although revenue-matched nonlinear tariffs achieve similar reductions and median charges increase. The framework provides a bounded per-token accounting rule and measured deployment constraints, rather than a validated utility estimator.

translation.title: 长上下文LLM服务中保留上下文的度量与计费
translation.abstract: 长上下文大语言模型（LLM）服务对重复上下文收费，但计费权重未必反映其对答案质量的贡献。我们提出一个三层框架，区分内容相关性、可观测代理指标和可审计的位置权重。上下文消融实验表明，相关性主导位置因素，且距离衰减类方法并不优于仅用相关性的基线。实测服务栈显示，在65,536 token下缓存命中可将重复前缀的计算成本降低两个数量级以上，而冷重发限制了可持续的折扣空间。跨提供商测量将缓存价值与分词和标价差异区分开来。校准后的模拟可将会话费用的第99百分位降低31-42%，尽管收入对齐的非线性资费也能达到类似降幅且中位数费用上升。该框架提供了有界的逐token计费规则和实测部署约束，而非一个经过验证的效用估计器。
translation.brief: 针对长上下文LLM服务重复上下文计费与其实际质量贡献不匹配的问题，提出三层度量框架，通过消融实验与实测服务栈分析相关性、缓存价值并设计有界的逐token计费规则。

papers.title: 3D GameDev Arena: Benchmarking Coding Agents That Plan, Build, and Playtest extreme Long-Horizon Browser Games
papers.abstract: Coding agents now resolve repository issues and generate compact playable games, but whether they can build a large 3D game from scratch remains open. Such games tightly couple mechanics, scenes, assets, and interaction logic, and their quality rests on player enjoyment, which existing benchmarks rarely assess. Thus, we introduce 3D GameDev Arena, a first extreme long-horizon benchmark of 108 from-scratch game-development tasks across 14 genres. Given only a text specification and UI/UX reference images, a fully automated plan--implement--test--repair pipeline builds each task into a self-contained browser game. Runs average $\sim$1,000 LLM calls ; the longest uses 14,407 calls, 2.13B tokens, and 608 assets. Evaluation spans (1) objective code-level functional acceptance against the game specification, (2) agent-based QA and playtesting of 3D presentation and playability, and (3) blind pairwise Bradley-Terry human preference in a public arena. The preliminary findings indicate that long-horizon 3D game development remains far from solved, and code-level correctness alone does not dictate player preference. The public arena is hosted online.

translation.title: 3D GameDev Arena：对规划、构建与试玩超长时程浏览器游戏的编码智能体进行基准评测
translation.abstract: 编码智能体现已能解决仓库问题并生成小型可玩游戏，但它们能否从零构建大型3D游戏仍是未知。此类游戏紧密耦合机制、场景、资产和交互逻辑，其质量取决于玩家乐趣，而现有基准很少评估这一点。因此，我们提出3D GameDev Arena，首个包含108个跨14种游戏类型的从零开发任务的极端长时程基准。仅给定文本规格和UI/UX参考图，全自动的规划—实现—测试—修复流水线将每个任务构建为自包含的浏览器游戏。每次运行平均约需1,000次LLM调用；最长的一次使用14,407次调用、21.3亿token和608个资产。评测涵盖：(1) 针对游戏规格的客观代码级功能验收，(2) 基于智能体的3D呈现与可玩性QA和试玩测试，(3) 公开竞技场中的盲测成对Bradley-Terry人类偏好。初步结果表明，长时程3D游戏开发远未解决，且仅代码级正确性并不能决定玩家偏好。公开竞技场已在线托管。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体能否从零构建大型3D游戏缺乏评测的问题，构建包含108个任务的极端长时程基准，用全自动规划—实现—测试—修复流水线并结合代码验收、智能体试玩与人类偏好进行评测。

papers.title: CausalDrive: Causal Decomposition for Data-Efficient End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Efficient use of expert demonstrations is essential for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, directly imitating expert trajectories couples nominal intention, which specifies where the vehicle should go, with multimodal driving styles, which determine how that intention is executed. Different combinations of these factors can yield similar expert trajectories, obscuring their respective causal contributions and forcing the policy to learn both from a single entangled target. This ambiguity limits how effectively the policy can exploit expert demonstrations. We propose CausalDrive, a causal decomposition framework for data-efficient driving policy learning that separates deterministic nominal intention prediction from probabilistic driving style modeling. Specifically, we construct counterfactual nominal trajectories from navigation command, map topology, and ego state by removing style dependent effects, providing a Nominal Intention Planner with supervision independent of expert trajectories. Conditioned on the predicted nominal intention and surrounding agents, a diffusion-based Style Execution Policy models diverse driving styles as a multimodal distribution over residuals between nominal and expert trajectories. This causally structured supervision reduces redundant learning of shared nominal behavior in routine scenarios, directing expert supervision toward informative execution variations and improving data utilization. CausalDrive achieves 91.2 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 89.5 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art performance. Further experiments demonstrate strong performance with limited expert data and clear advantages in challenging interactive scenarios.

translation.title: CausalDrive：面向数据高效端到端自动驾驶的因果分解
translation.abstract: 高效利用专家演示对端到端自动驾驶至关重要。然而，直接模仿专家轨迹将标称意图（规定车辆应去哪里）与多模态驾驶风格（决定意图如何执行）耦合在一起。这些因素的不同组合可能产生相似的专家轨迹，掩盖了各自的因果贡献，迫使策略从单一纠缠的目标中同时学习两者。这种模糊性限制了策略利用专家演示的效率。我们提出CausalDrive，一个面向数据高效驾驶策略学习的因果分解框架，将确定性的标称意图预测与概率性的驾驶风格建模分离。具体而言，我们通过移除风格相关效应，从导航指令、地图拓扑和自车状态构建反事实标称轨迹，为标称意图规划器提供独立于专家轨迹的监督。在预测的标称意图和周围智能体的条件下，基于扩散的风格执行策略将多样的驾驶风格建模为标称轨迹与专家轨迹之间残差的多模态分布。这种因果结构化的监督减少了常规场景中对共享标称行为的冗余学习，将专家监督引导至有信息量的执行变化上，提升数据利用率。CausalDrive在NAVSIM v1上达到91.2 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到89.5 EPDMS，匹配或超越最先进水平。进一步实验表明其在有限专家数据下表现强劲，并在具有挑战性的交互场景中优势明显。
translation.brief: 针对模仿学习中专家轨迹将标称意图与驾驶风格纠缠导致数据利用率低的问题，提出CausalDrive因果分解框架，用反事实标称轨迹监督意图规划器，并用扩散模型对残差进行多模态风格建模。

papers.title: LEDGE: An Efficient Simulator for Distributed LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Edge Devices
papers.abstract: Evaluating distributed large language model (LLM) serving on heterogeneous edge devices requires exploring diverse model partitions, device placements, and network conditions, making repeated physical experiments costly. An efficient simulator for edge LLM serving must support diverse, fine-grained placement configurations, capture runtime behavior, and accurately predict execution times while keeping simulation overhead low. We present LEDGE, a lightweight simulator for fast, fine-grained evaluation of distributed LLM serving on heterogeneous edge devices without executing tensor operations. LEDGE constructs event graphs supporting non-uniform tensor and pipeline parallelism, estimates execution costs using reusable performance models calibrated from end-to-end measurements, and simulates shared-link contention. We evaluate LEDGE on a heterogeneous testbed of 10 Jetson and Raspberry Pi devices, covering 17 model--precision combinations across 4 LLM families. On Qwen deployments, LEDGE achieves request-level mean absolute percentage errors below 3.6% and a 135.3 times aggregate speedup over physical inference. Performance model calibrated on one LLM family yield 7.44% zero-shot end-to-end latency MAPE across three other families. Further simulations show how shared-link contention affects placement decisions and network topology constrains scaling. Across four edge environments, LEDGE completes 26,773 simulation runs in 83.8 minutes, enabling efficient exploration of deployment strategies under diverse resource conditions and serving objectives. The source code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: LEDGE：面向异构边缘设备上分布式LLM服务的高效模拟器
translation.abstract: 在异构边缘设备上评估分布式大语言模型（LLM）服务需要探索多样的模型划分、设备放置和网络条件，使得反复进行物理实验代价高昂。一个高效的边缘LLM服务模拟器必须支持多样、细粒度的放置配置，捕捉运行时行为，并在保持模拟开销较低的同时准确预测执行时间。我们提出LEDGE，一个轻量级模拟器，可在不执行张量运算的情况下对异构边缘设备上的分布式LLM服务进行快速、细粒度的评估。LEDGE构建支持非均匀张量并行和流水线并行的事件图，使用由端到端测量校准的可复用性能模型估计执行成本，并模拟共享链路争用。我们在由10台Jetson和Raspberry Pi设备组成的异构测试平台上评估LEDGE，涵盖4个LLM系列的17种模型-精度组合。在Qwen部署上，LEDGE实现了低于3.6%的请求级平均绝对百分比误差，相比物理推理获得135.3倍的总体加速。在一个LLM系列上校准的性能模型在另外三个系列上取得7.44%的零样本端到端延迟MAPE。进一步的模拟展示了共享链路争用如何影响放置决策以及网络拓扑如何限制扩展。在四种边缘环境中，LEDGE在83.8分钟内完成26,773次模拟运行，支持在多样资源条件和服务目标下高效探索部署策略。源代码已在https URL公开。
translation.brief: 解决在异构边缘设备上评估分布式LLM服务时物理实验成本高的问题，核心方法是构建一个基于事件图和校准性能模型的轻量级模拟器，无需执行张量运算即可快速准确预测执行时间。

papers.title: RoughCut-Bench: A Benchmark for Automatic Video Rough-Cut with Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Video rough-cut is a core stage in media production workflows, organizing raw media materials into an initial video cut. Despite recent advances in large vision-language models (LVLMs) for video-related tasks, automatic rough-cut remains underexplored, without a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation or mature workflows for producing executable cut plans. To address the evaluation gap, we introduce RoughCut-Bench, which covers two practical settings: (1) a visually driven setting over video cases, covering highlight detection and selection, source-video ordering, and adherence to user requirements when provided; and (2) a speech-driven setting over automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcripts, covering filler removal, expression deduplication, and low-value content trimming. Across these settings, the benchmark contains 101 visually driven cases, including 831 raw videos with 1,476 highlight annotations. It also includes 84 speech-driven cases, each consisting of an ASR transcript with annotated cleanup spans. The evaluation compares cut plans with these annotations in both settings and additionally uses a human-aligned agentic evaluator to assess rendered-cut quality in the visual setting. To apply LVLMs to automatic rough-cut, we further propose agentic workflows that guide them to produce structured cut plans from input materials. Experiments show that current LVLMs remain limited in producing expert-aligned cut plans. Our benchmark, code, and prompts are released at this https URL.

translation.title: RoughCut-Bench：基于大型视觉-语言模型的自动视频粗剪基准
translation.abstract: 视频粗剪是媒体制作工作流中的核心环节，将原始媒体素材组织成初始视频剪辑。尽管大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）在视频相关任务上取得了近期进展，但自动粗剪仍未被充分探索，缺乏全面的评估基准，也缺乏生成可执行剪辑方案的成熟工作流。为弥补评估空白，我们提出RoughCut-Bench，涵盖两种实际场景：（1）基于视频案例的视觉驱动场景，涵盖高光检测与选择、源视频排序，以及在提供用户需求时对其的遵循；（2）基于自动语音识别（ASR）转写文本的语音驱动场景，涵盖填充词去除、表达去重和低价值内容修剪。在这些场景下，该基准包含101个视觉驱动案例，包括831个原始视频和1,476条高光标注；还包含84个语音驱动案例，每个案例由一份带有清理区间标注的ASR转写文本组成。评估在两种场景下将剪辑方案与这些标注进行比较，并在视觉场景中额外使用与人类对齐的智能体评估器来评估渲染剪辑的质量。为将LVLM应用于自动粗剪，我们进一步提出智能体工作流，引导它们从输入素材生成结构化剪辑方案。实验表明，当前LVLM在生成与专家对齐的剪辑方案方面仍然有限。我们的基准、代码和提示词已在https URL发布。
translation.brief: 解决自动视频粗剪缺乏评估基准和可执行工作流的问题，核心方法是构建覆盖视觉驱动和语音驱动两类场景的RoughCut-Bench基准，并提出引导LVLM生成结构化剪辑方案的智能体工作流。

papers.title: IDEA: Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit for Inference-Time Backdoor Detection in GUI Agents
papers.abstract: Organizations increasingly deploy downloaded open-weight GUI agents. A backdoored agent passes acceptance tests on clean data and misbehaves only when a visual trigger appears on screen, turning an unvetted checkpoint into a supply-chain risk. However, existing sample-level detectors target image classifiers and CLIP-style encoders, leaving step-level backdoor detection for GUI agents unaddressed. On clean steps, the instruction drives the action; when an unreferenced screen region hijacks the step, the instruction loses control over the decision state or that region dictates it instead. We term this signature intent--evidence dominance inversion and propose IDEA (Intent-Dominance Evidence Audit) to detect backdoor activation at inference time for each step without trigger knowledge or attack data. Specifically, Intent Counterfactual Probing (ICP) measures how far redirected instructions move the decision state, and Region Causal Audit (RCA) quantifies how far ablating a candidate region moves it. A gated conformal score compares both displacements against clean steps at the same distance from the clean manifold, providing a finite-sample false-positive guarantee. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-3B across five attack families show that IDEA consistently detects backdoor activation under a controlled false-positive rate and outperforms state-of-the-art detection methods, while localizing the trigger region for every alarm and adding only modest inference overhead.

translation.title: IDEA：面向GUI智能体推理时后门检测的意图主导性证据审计
translation.abstract: 各组织越来越多地部署下载的开源权重GUI智能体。被植入后门的智能体在干净数据上能通过验收测试，仅当屏幕上出现视觉触发器时才表现异常，使未经审查的检查点成为供应链风险。然而，现有的样本级检测器针对图像分类器和CLIP风格编码器，未解决GUI智能体的步骤级后门检测问题。在干净步骤中，指令驱动动作；当未被指令引用的屏幕区域劫持该步骤时，指令失去对决策状态的控制，或该区域反而支配决策。我们将这一特征称为意图-证据主导性反转，并提出IDEA（意图主导性证据审计），在推理时对每个步骤检测后门激活，无需触发器知识或攻击数据。具体而言，意图反事实探测（ICP）衡量重定向指令使决策状态移动的程度，区域因果审计（RCA）量化消融候选区域使决策状态移动的程度。门控共形分数将两种位移与距干净流形相同距离的干净步骤进行比较，提供有限样本假阳性保证。在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上跨五个攻击家族的大量实验表明，IDEA在受控假阳性率下能持续检测后门激活，优于最先进的检测方法，同时为每次告警定位触发区域，且仅增加少量推理开销。
translation.brief: 解决GUI智能体步骤级后门检测缺乏方法的问题，核心方法是通过意图反事实探测和区域因果审计量化指令与屏幕区域对决策状态的主导性，并利用门控共形分数在推理时检测意图-证据主导性反转。

papers.title: PIVOT: Distribution-Preserving Multi-BitWatermarking with Minimax-Optimal Scoring
papers.abstract: As LLM-generated content becomes increasingly widespread, reliable attribution calls for multi-bit watermarks that embed recoverable messages without distorting the output distribution. We introduce PIVOT, a multi-bit watermark with model-free verification based on mirrored rank-interval sampling. At each generation step, PIVOT uses a keyed pseudorandom scalar and a secret permutation of the vocabulary. The message bit determines whether next-token probability intervals are arranged in forward or reverse secret-rank order. Sampling from these mirrored layouts preserves every token probability exactly while inducing an opposite-signed dependence between the scalar and the sampled token's secret rank. This dependence yields a pivotal rank statistic whose null distribution is invariant to the unknown next-token law, enabling model-free calibration and decoding. We formulate joint watermark detection and message recovery as a multiple-hypothesis testing problem, derive a moment-robust minimax-optimal detection score over a relaxed moment class, and establish finite-sample recovery guarantees. Extensive experiments on two representative large language models validate the effectiveness of PIVOT, demonstrating reliable watermark detection and message recovery while preserving the generator's output distribution.

translation.title: PIVOT：基于极小极大最优评分的分布保持多比特水印
translation.abstract: 随着LLM生成内容日益普及，可靠的内容归属需要能在不扭曲输出分布的情况下嵌入可恢复消息的多比特水印。我们提出PIVOT，一种基于镜像秩区间采样的、支持无模型验证的多比特水印。在每个生成步骤，PIVOT使用带密钥的伪随机标量和词表的秘密置换。消息比特决定下一词元概率区间按正向还是反向秘密秩顺序排列。从这些镜像布局中采样可精确保持每个词元的概率，同时在标量与被采样词元的秘密秩之间诱导出符号相反的依赖关系。这种依赖关系产生一个枢轴秩统计量，其零分布对未知的下一词元分布保持不变，从而实现无模型校准和解码。我们将水印联合检测与消息恢复形式化为多重假设检验问题，在松弛的矩类上推导出矩鲁棒的极小极大最优检测分数，并建立有限样本恢复保证。在两个代表性大语言模型上的大量实验验证了PIVOT的有效性，表明其在保持生成器输出分布的同时实现可靠的水印检测和消息恢复。
translation.brief: 解决多比特水印在不扭曲LLM输出分布的前提下嵌入可恢复消息的问题，核心方法是基于镜像秩区间采样构造零分布与模型无关的枢轴秩统计量，并将检测与消息恢复形式化为多重假设检验以推导极小极大最优评分。

papers.title: Embodied Graph: A Relational World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks
papers.abstract: Long-horizon tasks in embodied and web environments involve extended decision sequences and delayed feedback, making accurate planning crucial for success. World models tackle this by learning latent dynamics for imagination-based planning. However, existing approaches merely rely on dense pixel-level observations, which forces the model to absorb redundant information while overlooking relations among task-relevant entities. Consequently, small errors may accumulate over long imagined rollouts and gradually corrupt the predictions. In this paper, we explore world models that imagine over sparse state abstractions, which poses two key challenges: 1) how to remove redundant information and form a compact state abstraction; 2) how to incorporate the relational structure to learn reliable long-horizon dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose Embodied Graph, a relational state abstraction that supports structured dynamics modeling and long-horizon imagination, and the Relational World Model (RWM), which performs imagination directly over graph states. RWM consists of (i) a Task-Aware Embodied Graph Constructor that filters redundant details and maintains graph memory through online updates, and (ii) an Embodied Graph Recurrent State Space Model that learns node-wise latent dynamics while capturing inter-node dependencies. The imagined graph states provide predictions of action consequences to guide decision-making. Experiments on Minecraft and Crafter demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM in embodied environments. Notably, in Minecraft, RWM is the only method that obtains diamonds within the given budget. Experiments on web interaction further illustrate the applicability of relational state prediction to the decision making process of web agents.

translation.title: Embodied Graph：面向长时程任务的关系型世界模型
translation.abstract: 具身与网络环境中的长时程任务涉及延长的决策序列和延迟反馈，使准确规划对成功至关重要。世界模型通过学习潜在动力学进行基于想象的规划来解决这一问题。然而，现有方法仅依赖密集的像素级观测，迫使模型吸收冗余信息而忽视任务相关实体之间的关系。因此，小误差可能在长时程想象推演中累积并逐渐破坏预测。本文探索在稀疏状态抽象上进行想象的世界模型，这带来两个关键挑战：1）如何去除冗余信息并形成紧凑的状态抽象；2）如何融入关系结构以学习可靠的长时程动力学。为应对这些挑战，我们提出Embodied Graph，一种支持结构化动力学建模和长时程想象的关系型状态抽象，以及直接在图状态上进行想象的关系型世界模型（RWM）。RWM由两部分组成：（i）任务感知具身图构造器，过滤冗余细节并通过在线更新维护图记忆；（ii）具身图循环状态空间模型，学习节点级潜在动力学并捕捉节点间依赖。想象的图状态提供动作后果的预测以指导决策。在Minecraft和Crafter上的实验证明了RWM在具身环境中的有效性。值得注意的是，在Minecraft中，RWM是唯一在给定预算内获得钻石的方法。在网络交互上的实验进一步说明关系型状态预测对网络智能体决策过程的适用性。
translation.brief: 解决世界模型依赖密集像素观测导致长时程想象中误差累积的问题，核心方法是提出Embodied Graph稀疏关系状态抽象和直接在图状态上想象的关系型世界模型RWM。

papers.title: eFAIR: Fair LLM Serving under Hourly Electricity Commitments
papers.abstract: Datacenters can procure electricity in day-ahead markets by committing to energy purchases for individual hours. For LLM services operating within these hourly budgets, maximizing aggregate throughput alone may still leave individual requests waiting or receiving much slower service than desired. Fair serving therefore requires improving service for poorly served requests while reserving electricity for later arrivals whose timing and demand are unknown. To compare service across requests, we define normalized throughput as each request's actual output rate divided by the product of its standalone throughput and its service entitlement, a positive weight representing its desired service level. Using this measure, we formulate fair serving as leximin optimization under an hourly electricity constraint, prioritizing requests with the lowest normalized throughput. To address this problem, we present eFAIR, an online scheduler that coordinates request dispatching, electricity budget allocation, and GPU frequency selection through a common normalized-throughput target. Specifically, request dispatching prioritizes requests by desired service level and progress; electricity budget allocation reserves electricity for current and expected future work; and frequency selection uses electricity savings to raise GPU frequencies for requests with higher desired service levels. Evaluations on H20 and H200 configurations, each with 32 replicas, show that eFAIR improves the tenth percentile of normalized throughput by 28.0%-31.0% over the best budget-feasible baseline, while keeping absolute deviations from the hourly electricity commitment below 0.26%. eFAIR also improves throughput balance among concurrent requests and aligns electricity allocation more closely with service demand over time. Together, these results demonstrate how eFAIR improves request-level fairness within an hourly commitment.

translation.title: eFAIR：在小时级电力承诺下的公平 LLM 服务
translation.abstract: 数据中心可通过日前市场按小时承诺购电。对于在这些小时级电力预算内运行的 LLM 服务，仅最大化总吞吐量仍可能使个别请求长时间等待或获得远低于预期的服务速度。因此，公平服务要求改善服务较差请求的体验，同时为后续到达（其时间和需求未知）的请求预留电力。为比较请求间的服务，我们定义归一化吞吐量为每个请求的实际输出速率除以其独立吞吐量与服务权益（表示其期望服务水平的正权重）的乘积。基于该度量，我们将公平服务形式化为小时级电力约束下的 leximin 优化，优先处理归一化吞吐量最低的请求。为此，我们提出 eFAIR，一个在线调度器，通过统一的归一化吞吐量目标协调请求分发、电力预算分配和 GPU 频率选择。具体而言，请求分发按期望服务水平和进度对请求排序；电力预算分配为当前和预期未来工作预留电力；频率选择利用节省的电力为具有更高期望服务水平的请求提升 GPU 频率。在 H20 和 H200 配置（各含 32 个副本）上的评估表明，eFAIR 将归一化吞吐量的第十百分位较最优预算可行基线提升 28.0%–31.0%，同时与小时级电力承诺的绝对偏差保持在 0.26% 以下。eFAIR 还改善了并发请求间的吞吐量均衡，并使电力分配随时间更贴合服务需求。这些结果共同表明 eFAIR 如何在小时级承诺内提升请求级公平性。
translation.brief: 解决小时级电力承诺下 LLM 服务中请求间服务不公平的问题，提出 eFAIR 在线调度器，通过统一的归一化吞吐量目标协调请求分发、电力预算分配和 GPU 频率选择实现 leximin 公平优化。

papers.title: Evaluating LIM Trading Agents: A Critical Review of Backtesting Validity and Reporting Practices
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in investment research, and many studies report promising historical returns. However, such results are only credible if researchers can demonstrate that the model used only information available at the time, account for how strategies and configurations were selected, and explain how reported returns were generated. We identify six common threats to validity in LLM investment evaluations and apply them to 18 published studies. Across 108 assessments, we find substantial gaps in reporting. No paper fully addresses information timing, model-memory exposure, universe selection, trading costs, or configuration-selection bias. Only four studies provide minimum evidence that results hold across multiple market periods. Our analysis reveals that commonly used safeguards often address different problems than researchers assume. For example, using dated inputs does not guarantee that a pretrained model lacked knowledge of future events, and repeated experimental runs do not correct for strategy-selection bias. We therefore propose an evaluation protocol for future LLM investment research. Rather than judging whether LLMs can generate profits, our study examines whether existing evidence is sufficient to support such claims. We conclude that current reporting practices are generally insufficient for that purpose.

translation.title: 评估 LLM 交易智能体：对回测有效性与报告实践批判性综述
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在投资研究中的应用日益增多，许多研究报告了可观的历史收益。然而，只有当研究者能够证明模型仅使用了当时可获得的信息、说明策略和配置是如何选择的，并解释所报告收益是如何产生的，这些结果才可信。我们识别出 LLM 投资评估中六类常见的有效性威胁，并将其应用于 18 项已发表研究。在 108 项评估中，我们发现报告存在重大缺口：没有任何论文完整处理信息时序、模型记忆暴露、标的池选择、交易成本或配置选择偏差；只有四项研究提供了结果在多个市场时期成立的最低限度证据。我们的分析表明，常用的保障措施往往解决的是与研究者设想不同的问题。例如，使用带日期的输入并不能保证预训练模型不了解未来事件，重复实验运行也无法纠正策略选择偏差。因此，我们为未来的 LLM 投资研究提出一套评估协议。我们的研究并非评判 LLM 能否盈利，而是检验现有证据是否足以支持此类主张。我们的结论是，当前的报告实践总体上不足以支撑这一目的。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 投资交易研究证据可信度存疑的问题，通过识别六类有效性威胁并系统审查 18 项已发表研究，提出一套评估协议。

papers.title: Human-LLM Cognitive Extension: A Framework for Studying Coupled Cognition
papers.abstract: Recent research on the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) reports divergent cognitive outcomes, including improved assisted performance, limited transfer, and compromised unaided learning. Here, we argue that part of this seeming inconsistency arises because studies often assess different cognitive systems without making the unit of analysis explicit. Building on work in extended and distributed cognition, we propose the Human-LLM Cognitive Extension (HLCE) as a methodological framework for matching experimental designs, measures, and causal inferences to four distinct systems: the human acting independently, the artificial agent, the joined human-LLM configuration, and the human after division. The framework also treats the coupling architecture as part of the experimental object. HLCE separates performance augmentation, system-level complementarity, post-interaction human change, and stronger claims of constitutive cognitive integration. This separation can improve the interpretation of existing evidence and guide the design of human-LLM interactions without assuming in advance that these configurations constitute extended minds. We illustrate the application of HLCE with a synthetic diagnostic experiment comparing two connecting configurations that differ in how supporting information is communicated. The example highlights how distinct couplings can shape the organization of joint problem-solving, even when the final outcome remains unchanged. Overall, HLCE provides a methodological basis for designing controlled experiments and interpreting evidence across distinct forms of human-LLM cognitive interaction.

translation.title: 人类-LLM 认知延伸：研究耦合认知的框架
translation.abstract: 近期关于大语言模型（LLM）使用的研究报告了分歧的认知结果，包括辅助绩效提升、迁移有限以及独立学习能力受损。我们认为，这种表面上的不一致部分源于研究往往评估了不同的认知系统，却未明确分析单元。基于延伸认知与分布式认知的研究，我们提出人类-LLM 认知延伸（HLCE）作为方法论框架，将实验设计、测量和因果推断匹配到四个不同的系统：独立行动的人类、人工智能体、人-LLM 联合配置以及分离后的人类。该框架还将耦合架构视为实验对象的一部分。HLCE 区分了绩效增强、系统级互补性、交互后的人类变化以及更强的构成性认知整合主张。这种区分可以改善对现有证据的解读，并指导人-LLM 交互的设计，而无需预先假定这些配置构成延伸心智。我们通过一个合成诊断实验说明 HLCE 的应用，该实验比较了两种在支持信息传递方式上不同的连接配置。该示例凸显了不同的耦合方式如何塑造联合问题解决的组织形式，即使最终结果不变。总体而言，HLCE 为设计受控实验和解读不同形式人-LLM 认知交互的证据提供了方法论基础。
translation.brief: 解决人-LLM 认知研究结果不一致的问题，提出 HLCE 方法论框架，将实验设计与测量明确匹配到四种不同的认知系统并区分不同层次的认知主张。

papers.title: Game2Player: Scaling Gameplay Experience for Visual Agents through Environment-Player Co-Development
papers.abstract: Games are a rich testbed for visual agents, demanding perception, long-horizon planning, and precise control. However, collecting human gameplay is costly, and learning from gameplay videos requires inferring missing actions. Existing datasets also cover a limited range of games, often without explicit tasks or verifiable outcomes. To address these gaps, we introduce Game2Player, a framework that co-develops game environments and players to collect diverse and verifiable gameplay experience at scale. In the Game2Player loop, a Builder agent adapts existing web games, exposes their internal state, and defines tasks with state-based progress measures and success checks. A Coding Player and a VLM Player then attempt the tasks and report problems to the Builder for repair, so that play serves as both environment validation and training data collection. With Game2Player, we build 568 verified web games with 3,436 tasks, collect 15.7K trajectories (307 hours of gameplay), and hold out 50 games as the benchmark PlayerBench. To evaluate the collected experience as training data, we train VLM agents with progress-weighted SFT, assigning greater weight to steps that advance task progress. Game2Player-9B improves progress from 14.3% to 31.2% on PlayerBench and from 30.0% to 53.1% on the external GameWorld benchmark. More broadly, our work suggests a path for visual agents to scale their gameplay experience by building, verifying, and learning from existing game worlds.

translation.title: Game2Player：通过环境-玩家协同开发扩展视觉智能体的游戏体验
