translation.abstract: 游戏是视觉智能体的丰富测试平台，要求感知、长程规划和精确控制。然而，收集人类游戏过程成本高昂，从游戏视频学习需要推断缺失的动作，且现有数据集覆盖的游戏范围有限，往往缺乏明确任务或可验证的结果。为弥补这些缺口，我们提出 Game2Player，一个协同开发游戏环境与玩家的框架，以大规模收集多样且可验证的游戏体验。在 Game2Player 循环中，Builder 智能体改造现有网页游戏、暴露其内部状态，并定义带有基于状态的进度度量和成功检查的任务。随后，Coding Player 和 VLM Player 尝试完成任务并向 Builder 报告问题以便修复，使游戏过程同时充当环境验证和训练数据收集。借助 Game2Player，我们构建了 568 个经过验证的网页游戏，包含 3,436 个任务，收集了 15.7K 条轨迹（307 小时游戏过程），并留出 50 个游戏作为基准 PlayerBench。为评估所收集经验作为训练数据的价值，我们采用进度加权 SFT 训练 VLM 智能体，为推进任务进度的步骤赋予更大权重。Game2Player-9B 在 PlayerBench 上将进度从 14.3% 提升至 31.2%，在外部 GameWorld 基准上从 30.0% 提升至 53.1%。更广泛地说，我们的工作为视觉智能体通过构建、验证并从现有游戏世界中学习来扩展其游戏体验提供了一条路径。
translation.brief: 解决视觉智能体游戏训练数据稀缺且不可验证的问题，提出 Game2Player 框架，通过 Builder 智能体改造网页游戏与玩家智能体试玩反馈的协同开发循环，大规模收集可验证的游戏轨迹用于训练。

papers.title: Once Upon a Bias: Gender Stereotyping in LLM-Generated Children's Stories
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to create stories for children. Since bedtime stories can shape children's perceptions of social roles, this raises concerns about whether LLMs adapt narrative portrayals according to the intended recipient's gender. We conducted a large-scale study to examine gender stereotyping in LLM-generated bedtime stories. Using matched daughter/son prompts and a five-generation design, we analyze 62,873 retained stories from 16 LLMs across 35 country settings and 12 narrator roles. We introduce a multi-level evaluation framework combining context-adjusted lexical rate contrasts, relative stereotype alignment, narrator-recipient interaction analysis, human evaluation, and representation-level interventions to examine both the consistency and interpretability of these differences. Our results reveal systematic differences in narrative framing: son-directed stories emphasize higher agency and lower communion compared to daughter-directed stories. While narrator gender expresses limited moderation on these patterns, high sociability exhibits a more pronounced interaction. Human evaluations demonstrate consistent agreement, although correspondence with lexical measures varies across narrative dimensions. Additionally, hidden-state analyses reveal decodable recipient-gender information. These findings demonstrate persistent yet context-dependent representational disparities in LLM-generated children's stories and motivate narrative-specific bias evaluation beyond short-form benchmarks.

translation.title: bias 之始：LLM 生成儿童故事中的性别刻板印象
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于创作儿童故事。由于睡前故事会影响儿童对社会角色的认知，这引发了对 LLM 是否会根据预期接收者性别调整叙事刻画的担忧。我们开展了一项大规模研究，考察 LLM 生成的睡前故事中的性别刻板印象。使用匹配的女儿/儿子提示和五代生成设计，我们分析了来自 16 个 LLM、35 个国家设定和 12 种叙述者角色的 62,873 篇保留故事。我们引入一个多层次评估框架，结合上下文调整的词汇率对比、相对刻板印象对齐、叙述者-接收者交互分析、人工评估和表征层面的干预，以考察这些差异的一致性和可解释性。结果显示叙事框架存在系统性差异：与面向女儿的故事相比，面向儿子的故事强调更高的能动性和更低的亲和性。虽然叙述者性别对这些模式的调节作用有限，但高社交性表现出更明显的交互作用。人工评估显示出一致的一致性，尽管与词汇度量的对应关系因叙事维度而异。此外，隐状态分析揭示了可解码的接收者性别信息。这些发现表明 LLM 生成的儿童故事中存在持续但依赖上下文的表征差异，并促使人们超越短文本基准开展针对叙事的偏见评估。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 生成儿童故事中是否存在基于接收者性别的刻板印象问题，通过大规模匹配提示实验和多层次评估框架系统分析叙事中的性别差异。

papers.title: MemoSync: Co-Managing Developer-Agent Metamemory Across Contexts
papers.abstract: AI coding agents increasingly manage what context carries across sessions and projects, but developers have limited visibility into what these agents store, retrieve, and apply. This opacity creates a metamemory problem: the developer's meta-level judgments about what should be remembered are separated from the agent's object-level memory operations, disrupting the monitoring and control that keep the two levels aligned. We conducted a formative study with 12 developers and identified what they want to monitor and control across four dimensions of agent memory use. Based on these findings, we designed MemoSync, a co-management system that treats agent memory as a shared, operable representation: the agent proposes memory candidates and reports which items it uses, and the developer reviews, edits, and scopes them. In a between-subjects study (N=132) against two baselines, MemoSync participants achieved significantly higher task performance and the highest mean developer-agent memory alignment. In an exploratory mediation analysis, the alignment advantage was primarily driven by improved monitoring accuracy. Despite performing substantially more monitoring and control actions, participants reported no increase in perceived workload. A week-long deployment with nine developers showed that memory monitoring and control fit into everyday development work. MemoSync is open-sourced at this https URL.

translation.title: MemoSync：跨上下文协同管理开发者与智能体的元记忆
translation.abstract: AI 编程智能体越来越多地管理哪些上下文在会话和项目之间延续，但开发者对这些智能体存储、检索和应用了什么缺乏可见性。这种不透明性造成了一个元记忆问题：开发者关于什么应该被记住的元层判断与智能体的对象层记忆操作相分离，破坏了维持两个层级一致的监控与控制。我们开展了一项包含 12 名开发者的形成性研究，识别出他们在智能体记忆使用的四个维度上想要监控和控制的内容。基于这些发现，我们设计了 MemoSync，一个将智能体记忆视为共享、可操作表示的协同管理系统：智能体提出记忆候选并报告其使用了哪些条目，开发者则进行审查、编辑和限定作用范围。在一项针对两个基线的被试间研究（N=132）中，MemoSync 的参与者取得了显著更高的任务表现以及最高的开发者-智能体记忆一致性。在一项探索性中介分析中，这种一致性优势主要由监控准确性的提升所驱动。尽管执行了明显更多的监控和控制操作，参与者报告感知工作负荷并未增加。一项为期一周、有九名开发者参与的部署表明，记忆监控与控制能够融入日常开发工作。MemoSync 已在 this https URL 开源。
translation.brief: 解决开发者对AI编程智能体记忆缺乏可见性的元记忆问题，通过让智能体提出记忆候选、开发者审查编辑的协同管理系统实现对齐。

papers.title: On the Complexity of Envy Cycle Elimination
papers.abstract: The envy cycle elimination (ECE) algorithm is a fundamental algorithm for the fair allocation of indivisible goods, guaranteeing an allocation that is envy-free up to one good under arbitrary monotone utilities. We show that the ECE algorithm can be implemented in $O(nm)$ time for $n$ agents and $m$ goods, and establish the tightness of this bound.

translation.title: 论嫉妒环消除算法的复杂度
translation.abstract: 嫉妒环消除（ECE）算法是不可分割物品公平分配的基础算法，在任意单调效用下保证无嫉妒至多一件物品的分配。我们证明 ECE 算法可以在 $O(nm)$ 时间内实现（$n$ 为智能体数，$m$ 为物品数），并确立了该界的紧致性。
translation.brief: 解决ECE公平分配算法的运行时间问题，通过高效实现证明其可在O(nm)时间内完成且该界是紧的。

papers.title: CounselTraj: Synthesizing Process-Aware Psychological Counseling Dialogues via Dialogue-Act Trajectory Planning
papers.abstract: The growing demand for psychological counseling has motivated the development of LLM-based systems that support human counselors, but training such systems requires large-scale, high-quality dialogue data. Authentic counseling transcripts are difficult to collect and share because of privacy concerns, making synthetic dialogues an important alternative. However, existing synthetic datasets, despite covering diverse scenarios and client profiles, often consist of brief exchanges and fail to capture session-level counseling processes. We propose CounselTraj, a dialogue-act trajectory planning framework for expanding brief synthetic dialogues into process-aware, session-level psychological counseling dialogues. CounselTraj learns dialogue-act patterns from role-play counseling dialogues produced by human counselors, plans coordinated trajectories for clients and counselors, and uses them as flexible guidance for long-form dialogue generation. Experiments across three Chinese synthetic counseling datasets show that CounselTraj produces more complete and coherent sessions with higher-quality counselor interventions than both direct expansion and expansion with randomly sampled trajectories. Based on CounselTraj, we construct CounselTrajD, a dataset containing over 10K process-guided Chinese psychological counseling dialogues, and use it to train CounselTrajLM for counseling response generation. Evaluations at both the response and session levels show that CounselTrajLM outperforms publicly available Chinese counseling models in response quality, therapeutic understanding and intervention, and counseling-process coherence and progress. Our code and model are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: CounselTraj：通过对话行为轨迹规划合成过程感知的心理咨询对话
translation.abstract: 对心理咨询日益增长的需求推动了支持人类咨询师的基于 LLM 的系统的发展，但训练此类系统需要大规模、高质量的对话数据。出于隐私顾虑，真实的咨询记录难以收集和共享，使合成对话成为重要替代方案。然而，现有的合成数据集尽管覆盖了多样的场景和来访者画像，往往只包含简短的交流，未能捕捉会话层面的咨询过程。我们提出 CounselTraj，一个对话行为轨迹规划框架，用于将简短的合成对话扩展为过程感知的、会话层面的心理咨询对话。CounselTraj 从人类咨询师的角色扮演咨询对话中学习对话行为模式，为来访者和咨询师规划协调的轨迹，并将其作为长篇对话生成的灵活引导。在三个中文合成咨询数据集上的实验表明，与直接扩展和使用随机采样轨迹扩展相比，CounselTraj 生成了更完整、更连贯的会话以及更高质量的咨询师干预。基于 CounselTraj，我们构建了 CounselTrajD 数据集，包含超过 1 万条过程引导的中文心理咨询对话，并用它训练了用于咨询回复生成的 CounselTrajLM。在回复和会话两个层面的评估显示，CounselTrajLM 在回复质量、治疗理解与干预、以及咨询过程的连贯性与推进方面均优于公开可用的中文咨询模型。我们的代码和模型已在 this https URL 公开。
translation.brief: 解决合成心理咨询对话缺乏会话级过程的问题，通过从真实角色扮演对话中学习对话行为轨迹并据此规划引导长对话生成。

papers.title: ViStep-RL: Stepwise Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Visual Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon visual agents must do more than inspect images: they must turn observations into evidence that remains usable as a task unfolds. Existing active-perception methods teach agents where and how to look, while a final-answer reward gives little structure for deciding which observations satisfy dependent subgoals or should be retained for later use. We present ViStep-RL (Visual Stepwise Reinforcement Learning), which models execution as a dependency-linked graph of evidence-bearing subgoals. A verifier tracks which subgoals are supported by valid evidence, and changes in graph potential provide a net-progress learning signal; an active memory protocol preserves evidence across turns and links retrieval to downstream use. On ViInteract, ViStep-RL reaches 60.0% strict completion with Qwen2.5-VL-7B, compared with 10.0% for the base model and 46.5% after supervised fine-tuning. Controlled studies show that incremental task-state rewards outperform cumulative rewards by 3.2 points, while active evidence writing improves strict completion by 7.75 points over automatic writing. Under a common interaction framework, the task-trained ViStep-RL policy achieves 59.5% answer accuracy, 24.0 points above the strongest of six general-purpose reference models. Held-out episodes confirm the gain at both Qwen scales, and gains extend to three external visual reasoning benchmarks.

translation.title: ViStep-RL：面向长程视觉智能体的逐步强化学习
translation.abstract: 长程视觉智能体不仅要观察图像，还必须将观察转化为在任务推进过程中持续可用的证据。现有的主动感知方法教会智能体在哪里看、如何看，而仅靠最终答案的奖励难以为判断哪些观察满足依赖性子目标或应被保留供后续使用提供结构。我们提出 ViStep-RL（视觉逐步强化学习），将执行过程建模为以证据承载子目标构成的依赖关联图。验证器跟踪哪些子目标有有效证据支持，图势的变化提供净进展学习信号；主动记忆协议跨轮次保留证据，并将检索与下游使用关联起来。在 ViInteract 上，ViStep-RL 使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 达到 60.0% 的严格完成率，而基础模型为 10.0%，监督微调后为 46.5%。对照研究表明，增量任务状态奖励比累积奖励高出 3.2 个百分点，主动证据写入比自动写入将严格完成率提升 7.75 个百分点。在统一交互框架下，经任务训练的 ViStep-RL 策略达到 59.5% 的答案准确率，比六个通用参考模型中最强者高出 24.0 个百分点。留出回合的测试在两个 Qwen 规模上均证实了该增益，且增益扩展到三个外部视觉推理基准。
translation.brief: 解决长程视觉智能体缺乏对观察证据的逐步监督问题，通过将任务建模为依赖关联的子目标证据图并以图势变化作为强化学习信号。

papers.title: VideoACE: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding through High-Frame-Rate Actions
papers.abstract: Agentic video understanding requires models to actively interact with video environments to gather evidence and form judgments. Evaluating this capability therefore requires assessing whether models can translate opportunities for interaction into better understanding. We introduce VideoACE, a benchmark for assessing video understanding under conditions that support sustained interaction. We focus on high-frame-rate action videos, where rapid, subtle changes make targeted observation especially valuable. The benchmark comprises 1,000 multiple-choice questions spanning six categories of fine-grained action understanding, accompanied by temporal evidence annotations and user hints screened for answer leakage. Its evaluation environment combines video inspection tools with a user simulator, allowing models to adjust temporal coverage, sampling density, and spatial detail, and to revisit evidence and revise their judgments under simulated user feedback. We evaluate single-pass observation, autonomous tool use, and tool use combined with user feedback to examine how effectively models exploit these opportunities. Evaluation of five models reveals distinct patterns in how they acquire evidence and respond to opportunities for further interaction. These findings establish VideoACE as a testbed for examining agentic video understanding beyond performance under a fixed observation setting.

translation.title: VideoACE：通过高帧率动作对智能体式视频理解进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 智能体式视频理解要求模型主动与视频环境交互以收集证据并形成判断。因此，评估这一能力需要考察模型能否将交互机会转化为更好的理解。我们提出 VideoACE，一个在支持持续交互的条件下评估视频理解的基准。我们聚焦于高帧率动作视频，其中快速、细微的变化使针对性观察尤为有价值。该基准包含 1,000 道涵盖六类细粒度动作理解的多选题，附带时间证据标注和经过答案泄露筛查的用户提示。其评估环境将视频检查工具与用户模拟器相结合，允许模型调整时间覆盖范围、采样密度和空间细节，并在模拟用户反馈下重新审视证据、修正判断。我们评估了单次观察、自主工具使用以及工具使用结合用户反馈三种模式，以考察模型利用这些机会的有效性。对五个模型的评估揭示了它们在获取证据和响应进一步交互机会方面的不同模式。这些发现使 VideoACE 成为在固定观察设定之外考察智能体式视频理解的试验场。
translation.brief: 解决智能体式视频理解缺乏交互式评估基准的问题，通过构建带工具与用户模拟器的高帧率动作视频问答基准来考察模型利用交互机会的能力。

papers.title: Guarding the Kingdom of Skill-Based Agents in the AI Dynasty of Computation: Control-Flow Integrity for Agent Skills
papers.abstract: Control-flow integrity (CFI) confines a program to a control-flow graph fixed ahead of time. Procedural agent skills move this control flow into prompt text, and a large language model (LLM) agent decides at runtime whether each step runs in its reasoning, a tool call, or a script. The procedure's control skeleton survives, but its enforceability depends on where each step runs. Many violations, such as overwriting a file before validation, use only operations the skill requires, so permission allowlists admit them. A deviating or prompt-injected model can also evade a monitor by regime migration, for example by claiming that a check passed. We present SkillCFI, which carries CFI over to skill-based agents. Its compiler confines LLM interpretation to compile time and derives the agent's instructions and an executable contract from one skill. By a formal enforceability criterion, it enforces obligations whose evidence crosses the tool boundary and rejects a skill whose mandatory obligation leaves nothing to check. A deterministic runtime enforcer admits a tool request only on trusted evidence and refuses unmediated channels such as inline scripts, so admitted traces follow the contract whatever the model proposes. On eight self-written skills, no compiled contract permits more than its source under 24 source mutations. In 770 agent sessions, SkillCFI blocks before dispatch all 240 such violations, which an allowlist admits, and normal tasks complete nearly as often as without it. Listing the next legal steps in a refusal raises recovery from 21% to 65%. Checking takes about 2% of task time, and a compact command form cuts session slowdown from 1.32 times to 1.08 times. None of 53 public skills is accepted as written. The compiler's diagnostics point to interfaces rather than workflows and guided seven into enforceable contracts.

translation.title: 守护AI计算王朝中基于技能的智能体王国：面向智能体技能的控制流完整性
translation.abstract: 控制流完整性（CFI）将程序限制在预先固定的控制流图中。过程式智能体技能将这种控制流转移到提示文本中，由大语言模型（LLM）智能体在运行时决定每个步骤是在其推理中、工具调用中还是脚本中执行。过程的控制骨架得以保留，但其可执行性取决于每个步骤的运行位置。许多违规行为，例如在验证前覆盖文件，仅使用技能所需的操作，因此权限允许列表无法阻止它们。偏离的或被提示注入的模型还可以通过状态迁移来逃避监控，例如声称某项检查已通过。我们提出SkillCFI，将CFI引入基于技能的智能体。其编译器将LLM解释限制在编译时，并从同一技能派生出智能体指令和可执行契约。通过形式化的可执行性准则，它强制执行证据跨越工具边界的义务，并拒绝强制性义务无可检查之处的技能。确定性的运行时执行器仅在受信任证据上才允许工具请求，并拒绝内联脚本等无中介通道，因此无论模型提出什么，被允许的执行轨迹都遵循契约。在八个自编技能上，在24次源变异下，没有任何编译契约允许超出其源的操作。在770个智能体会话中，SkillCFI在分发前阻止了全部240个此类违规（允许列表会放行这些违规），而正常任务的完成率与不使用它时几乎相同。在拒绝中列出下一个合法步骤将恢复率从21%提高到65%。检查约占任务时间的2%，紧凑的命令形式将会话减速从1.32倍降至1.08倍。53个公开技能中没有一个按原样被接受。编译器的诊断指向接口而非工作流，并引导其中七个形成可执行的契约。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体技能中控制流偏离和提示注入违规难以用权限允许列表阻止的问题，提出SkillCFI，通过编译时派生可执行契约并由确定性运行时执行器基于受信证据强制执行，将控制流完整性引入技能型智能体。

papers.title: From Neural Tokens to Language: Dual-View EEG Semantic Bridging for Brain-to-Text Generation
papers.abstract: Visually evoked EEG-to-text generation aims to produce natural-language descriptions from neural responses elicited by visual stimuli. Existing approaches typically compress EEG signals into a single global representation and directly project it into the hidden space of a large language model (LLM), which may limit the preservation of complementary visual semantics under noisy and subject-dependent EEG signals. We propose a dual-view semantic token bridging framework that exploits raw images and sketch images as complementary visual supervision to learn raw-oriented and sketch-oriented EEG semantic token streams. To interface these structured neural representations with an LLM, we introduce a branch-specific semantic query bridge that aggregates each token stream into compact semantic slots and converts them into LLM-compatible soft prompts. A progressive adaptation strategy further transitions the learned visual-semantic interface from image-supported training to image-free EEG-conditioned generation. Experiments demonstrate strong subject-wise EEG classification performance and competitive EEG-to-text generation across multiple LLM backbones. Ablation, branch-level representation, and EEG-label disentanglement analyses further show that the two EEG streams learn complementary view-oriented representations and that EEG-derived prompts provide sample-specific information beyond category labels.

translation.title: 从神经Token到语言：面向脑电到文本生成的双视角EEG语义桥接
translation.abstract: 视觉诱发的EEG到文本生成旨在从视觉刺激引发的神经响应中生成自然语言描述。现有方法通常将EEG信号压缩为单一全局表示并直接投影到大语言模型（LLM）的隐藏空间中，这在噪声大且依赖被试的EEG信号下可能限制互补视觉语义的保留。我们提出一个双视角语义token桥接框架，利用原始图像和草图图像作为互补的视觉监督，学习面向原始图像和面向草图的EEG语义token流。为了将这些结构化的神经表示与LLM对接，我们引入分支特定的语义查询桥，将每个token流聚合为紧凑的语义槽，并将其转换为LLM兼容的软提示。渐进式适配策略进一步将学习到的视觉-语义接口从图像支持的训练过渡到无图像、以EEG为条件的生成。实验展示了强大的逐被试EEG分类性能以及在多个LLM骨干上具有竞争力的EEG到文本生成。消融、分支级表示和EEG标签解耦分析进一步表明，两条EEG流学习到互补的视角导向表示，且EEG派生的提示提供了超越类别标签的样本特定信息。
translation.brief: 针对EEG到文本生成中单一全局表示难以保留互补视觉语义的问题，提出利用原始图像与草图图像双视角监督学习两条EEG语义token流，并通过语义查询桥和渐进式适配将其接入LLM。

papers.title: The Comprehension Gap in LLM-Assisted Software Development: An Experiment
papers.abstract: When LLM tools are pushed beyond their capabilities for software development tasks, developers must be able to step in. However, the comprehension that developers acquire during development might be negatively impacted due to excessive code generation. This could create a cognitive debt that needs to be resolved before tasks can be solved efficiently again. We explore how well developers understand code they generated by prompting in comparison to self-written and unseen code and how they reflect on their comprehension. We conduct a crossover experiment and interviews with 35 participants consisting of students, academic personnel, and software developers. After completing two programming tasks with or without LLM chat usage, respectively, participants are tasked with finding introduced mutations in the produced and additional unseen code. We use insights from interviews and screen recordings to supplement our results. Regarding the experiment, 36% of participants report a better understanding of self-written code compared to their generated code. On average, participants solved the comprehension task 20% faster for self-written code than for generated code and found 11% more mutations. Participants needed significantly less time to solve programming tasks when working with the LLM. However, participants with high reliance on the LLM chat and low task engagement showed significantly decreased comprehension. Our qualitative results show great variability in individual perspectives on comprehension differences and strategies to mitigate issues. Strategies for dealing with comprehension differences range from accepting comprehension differences to adapting their LLM interactions or avoiding the tools altogether. Our results warrant further investigation into cognitive debt in larger systems and developer practices to mitigate issues.

translation.title: LLM辅助软件开发中的理解鸿沟：一项实验
translation.abstract: 当LLM工具在软件开发任务中超出其能力范围时，开发者必须能够介入。然而，由于过度的代码生成，开发者在开发过程中获得的理解可能受到负面影响。这可能造成一种认知债务，需要在任务能够再次高效解决之前加以化解。我们探究开发者对通过提示生成的代码的理解程度，与自写代码和未见过的代码相比如何，以及他们如何反思自己的理解。我们对35名参与者（包括学生、学术人员和软件开发者）进行了交叉实验和访谈。在分别使用或不使用LLM聊天完成两个编程任务后，参与者需要在生成的代码和额外的未见代码中找出引入的变异。我们利用访谈和屏幕录像的见解来补充结果。在实验方面，36%的参与者报告对自写代码的理解优于生成的代码。平均而言，参与者对自写代码的理解任务求解速度比生成代码快20%，多发现11%的变异。使用LLM时，参与者完成编程任务所需时间显著更少。然而，高度依赖LLM聊天且任务投入度低的参与者理解能力显著下降。我们的定性结果显示，个体对理解差异及缓解策略的看法差异很大。应对理解差异的策略从接受理解差异，到调整LLM交互方式，再到完全避免使用这些工具不等。我们的结果值得在更大系统和开发者实践方面进一步研究认知债务及缓解问题的方法。
translation.brief: 针对LLM生成代码可能削弱开发者代码理解并造成认知债务的问题，通过交叉实验和访谈对比开发者对生成代码与自写代码的理解差异。

papers.title: Learning to Coordinate: LLM-Guided Workflow Evolution for Token-Efficient Red Teaming
papers.abstract: Automated red teaming is essential for identifying safety failures in large language models (LLMs), but its practical scalability depends on the resources required to discover those failures. Multi-agent systems can combine complementary capabilities, yet repeated planning, redundant exchanges, and ineffective information routing can make their coordination expensive. Moreover, a target model's response indicates the outcome of a test without identifying which collaboration decision should change. We present Learning to Coordinate (L2C), an LLM-guided framework that evolves an executable multi-agent workflow for each red-teaming case. L2C represents agent responsibilities, execution dependencies, and input bindings in a versioned graph, and associates each graph with records of the information actually delivered and produced. A controller trained through supervised fine-tuning integrates these records with target responses, evaluator verdicts, and remaining budget to retain the workflow, refine instructions, restructure collaboration, or lock further editing. This design connects feedback to explicit changes in subsequent execution while allowing a useful organization to continue without repeated controller intervention. The evaluation protocol covers HarmBench with three execution backbones and two target models, together with component ablations, dataset transfer, and evaluator checks. Across the six executor-target configurations, L2C improves ASR over EvoSynth by 1.4 to 4.5 percentage points while reducing mean online tokens by 35.6% to 37.3%. L2C connects adaptive collaboration to the resource requirements of automated security evaluation.

translation.title: 学习协调：面向Token高效红队测试的LLM引导工作流演化
translation.abstract: 自动化红队测试对于发现大语言模型（LLM）的安全缺陷至关重要，但其实际可扩展性取决于发现这些缺陷所需的资源。多智能体系统可以结合互补能力，但重复规划、冗余交换和低效的信息路由会使协调成本高昂。此外，目标模型的响应只表明测试的结果，却不指明应改变哪个协作决策。我们提出Learning to Coordinate（L2C），一个由LLM引导、为每个红队测试用例演化可执行多智能体工作流的框架。L2C在版本化图中表示智能体职责、执行依赖和输入绑定，并将每个图与实际交付和产生的信息记录相关联。通过监督微调训练的控制器将这些记录与目标响应、评估器判定和剩余预算结合，以保留工作流、细化指令、重构协作或锁定进一步编辑。这一设计将反馈与后续执行中的显式变更联系起来，同时允许有效的组织结构无需反复控制器干预即可持续运行。评估协议覆盖HarmBench，包含三种执行骨干和两个目标模型，以及组件消融、数据集迁移和评估器检查。在六种执行器-目标配置中，L2C相比EvoSynth将ASR提高1.4至4.5个百分点，同时将平均在线token减少35.6%至37.3%。L2C将自适应协作与自动化安全评估的资源需求联系起来。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体自动化红队测试协调成本高且反馈无法定位应修改的协作决策的问题，提出L2C，用版本化工作流图和监督微调控制器根据执行记录与评估反馈演化多智能体协作流程。

papers.title: Look Closer, Look Back, or Wait for Agentic Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Streaming video models must answer questions about a live video under strict memory and latency limits. Feeding only the latest few frames keeps present perception sharp, whereas adding past frames dilutes attention on the current scene and triggers hallucinations. Recent cascade methods retrieve past frames when uncertain, but they still fail when current frames are blurry or when decisive future clues have not appeared yet. We introduce ActiveForager, a streaming video agent that maintains a clean short working window and gathers extra evidence only on demand. For each query, the agent either answers directly, zooms into high-resolution recent frames, recalls past events from memory, or waits for upcoming frames. When recalling history, a shared-weight sub-agent verifies candidate clips in isolation and returns a compact evidence summary. A stream-decoupled attention mask then keeps historical evidence from interfering with present visual tokens. We train this policy using counterfactual information gain, which rewards a tool call only when the gathered evidence makes the true answer more likely and prevents tool collapse across all actions. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B on OVO-Bench, ActiveForager improves real-time perception, historical recall, and proactive response at once, lifting overall accuracy on Qwen3-VL-8B from 47.6% to 65.9%. It also doubles zero-shot accuracy on the multi-hop Video-Holmes benchmark while adding minimal visual tokens per query.

translation.title: 看得更近、回看历史或等待：面向智能体流式视频理解
translation.abstract: 流式视频模型必须在严格的内存和延迟限制下回答关于实时视频的问题。仅输入最新的几帧可以保持对当前场景的敏锐感知，而加入过去的帧会稀释对当前场景的注意力并引发幻觉。最近的级联方法在不确定时检索过去的帧，但当当前帧模糊或决定性的未来线索尚未出现时仍然失败。我们提出ActiveForager，一个维护干净短工作窗口并仅在需要时收集额外证据的流式视频智能体。对于每个查询，智能体可以直接回答、放大高分辨率的近期帧、从记忆中回溯过去的事件，或等待即将到来的帧。在回溯历史时，一个共享权重的子智能体独立验证候选片段并返回紧凑的证据摘要。随后，流解耦注意力掩码防止历史证据干扰当前视觉token。我们使用反事实信息增益训练该策略，只有当收集的证据使真实答案更可能出现时才奖励工具调用，从而防止工具在所有动作上的坍缩。在OVO-Bench上的Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B上，ActiveForager同时提升了实时感知、历史回溯和主动响应能力，将Qwen3-VL-8B的总体准确率从47.6%提升到65.9%。它还在多跳Video-Holmes基准上将零样本准确率翻倍，同时每个查询仅增加极少的视觉token。
translation.brief: 针对流式视频问答中当前帧模糊或关键线索未出现时模型失败的问题，提出ActiveForager，通过按需选择放大、回溯记忆或等待等动作并以反事实信息增益训练策略来按需收集证据。

papers.title: Keeping Up with the Kernel: Can LLMs Adapt Linux Drivers to Interface Changes?
papers.abstract: We analyze collateral evolution in Linux, the coordinated updates that drivers require when the kernel interfaces they depend on change, over the 20 years since it was first studied, covering releases from v3.0 to v7.2. Since v2.6.13, the number of driver files and support libraries has grown about eightfold, a single change to the most widely used library can now reach about 5.3k driver files, and such changes arrive either in bursts or spread over many releases. We introduce CoEvoBench, a benchmark that asks models to adapt an old driver module to a target kernel and evaluates the result against the developer's reference patch. The benchmark contains 316 manually confirmed tasks from 202 mainline commits and 268 modules, spanning kernel releases v6.19 to v7.2. It distinguishes 134 build-breaking tasks, where the old driver fails to compile, from 182 build-compatible tasks, where the old usage still builds. Using CoEvoAgent, we evaluate Direct, SmPL, and mini-SWE-agent with DeepSeek Flash, and compare Direct with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol. With DeepSeek, default Direct generation achieves strict reference agreement on 41.0% of build-breaking tasks but only 3.3% of build-compatible tasks.

translation.title: 跟上内核的步伐：LLM 能否让 Linux 驱动程序适应接口变更？
translation.abstract: 我们分析了 Linux 中协同演化（collateral evolution）现象，即当驱动程序所依赖的内核接口发生变化时驱动程序所需的协调更新，这是自该现象首次被研究以来的 20 年，涵盖从 v3.0 到 v7.2 的版本。自 v2.6.13 以来，驱动文件和支持库的数量增长了约八倍，对最广泛使用的库的一次变更现在可以影响约 5.3k 个驱动文件，且此类变更要么集中爆发，要么分散在多个版本中。我们提出了 CoEvoBench，一个要求模型将旧驱动模块适配到目标内核并根据开发者的参考补丁评估结果的基准。该基准包含来自 202 个主线提交和 268 个模块的 316 个经人工确认的任务，涵盖内核版本 v6.19 至 v7.2。它将 134 个构建破坏任务（旧驱动无法编译）与 182 个构建兼容任务（旧用法仍可编译）区分开来。使用 CoEvoAgent，我们评估了配合 DeepSeek Flash 的 Direct、SmPL 和 mini-SWE-agent，并将 Direct 与 Claude Sonnet 5.5 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 进行比较。使用 DeepSeek 时，默认 Direct 生成在构建破坏任务上达到 41.0% 的严格参考一致率，但在构建兼容任务上仅为 3.3%。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 能否将旧 Linux 驱动适配到新内核接口，通过构建 CoEvoBench 基准和 CoEvoAgent 评估多种模型与生成策略。

papers.title: When Shuffling Fails: Token Recovery from Obfuscated KV Caches
papers.abstract: LLM serving systems store, offload, and share KV caches, exposing token-level representations to infrastructure operators and co-tenants. Shuffled obfuscation combines secret linear transforms with fresh permutations, claiming security from b! possible shufflings. We show that input symmetry invalidates this counting argument: security depends on distinguishable outputs under chosen inputs. Repeated tokens produce identical first-layer Value rows, making every row permutation leave the data unchanged. Only auxiliary structures such as a single-row recovery marker vary, reducing the effective state space from b! to b. We construct Repeat-to-Reveal. The attacker collects the b distinguishable states from its own probes and exploits their rank-one differences to recover an equivalent denoiser without knowing the defender's secret parameters. A one-time calibration transfers across requests sharing the same secret epoch, enabling passive token-multiset recovery from subsequently observed cache blocks through public-model dictionary matching. We instantiate the attack on official KV-Cloak and evaluate 3,000 real WildChat user prompts across nine models and eleven configurations. The attack recovers the secret parameters with high accuracy and achieves 100 percent token-multiset recovery on GPU. Refreshing row-level secrets between epochs interrupts cross-request transfer, confirming secret reuse scope as the operative vulnerability. We further confirm orbit collapse on two other open-source defenses: the sequence-permutation implementation of Thomas et al. and PermLLM. The KV-Cloak developers invited a detailed report through their private vulnerability reporting channel.

translation.title: 当洗牌失效：从混淆 KV 缓存中恢复 Token
translation.abstract: LLM 服务系统会存储、卸载和共享 KV 缓存，将 token 级表示暴露给基础设施运营者和共租户。洗牌混淆（shuffled obfuscation）将秘密线性变换与新鲜置换相结合，声称凭借 b! 种可能的洗牌方式获得安全性。我们证明输入对称性使这一计数论证失效：安全性取决于在选定输入下输出是否可区分。重复的 token 产生相同的第一层 Value 行，使得任何行置换都不会改变数据。只有辅助结构（如单行恢复标记）会变化，将有效状态空间从 b! 缩减为 b。我们构造了 Repeat-to-Reveal 攻击。攻击者从自己的探测中收集 b 个可区分状态，并利用它们的秩一差异在不知道防御者秘密参数的情况下恢复一个等价的去噪器。一次校准即可在共享同一秘密纪元（secret epoch）的请求间迁移，从而通过公开模型字典匹配从后续观察到的缓存块中被动恢复 token 多重集。我们在官方 KV-Cloak 上实例化该攻击，并在九个模型、十一种配置下评估了 3,000 条真实 WildChat 用户提示。该攻击以高准确率恢复秘密参数，并在 GPU 上实现 100% 的 token 多重集恢复。在纪元之间刷新行级秘密会中断跨请求迁移，证实秘密复用范围是关键漏洞。我们还在另外两个开源防御上确认了轨道坍缩：Thomas 等人的序列置换实现和 PermLLM。KV-Cloak 开发者通过其私有漏洞报告渠道邀请了一份详细报告。
translation.brief: 揭示洗牌混淆 KV 缓存因输入对称性导致有效状态空间坍缩，提出 Repeat-to-Reveal 攻击通过秩一差异恢复等价去噪器进而恢复 token。

papers.title: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. Mindsets are shaped through musically grounded reward functions, which can be combined and weighted to develop different mindsets across agents. The resulting system positions quantum computing agents less as autonomous composers and more as adaptive musical partners, each developing its own musical personality through interaction rather than imitation. Demonstrations show how agents generalise their learned behaviour to previously unseen material, operating in interactive and offline batch modes using MIDI-encoded music. While quantum computers are still in development, experiments conducted on IBM quantum hardware confirmed that musically meaningful learning is achievable with existing quantum computers. For composers and performers, the agentic orchestra opens new possibilities for emergent, process-oriented musical creativity, offering a scalable foundation for quantum computer-aided music composition as quantum computing technology continues to advance.

translation.title: 超越语料库驱动的模仿：通过量子强化学习在智能体管弦乐队中演化音乐心智
translation.abstract: 本文提出了一个基于量子强化学习和多智能体交互的计算机辅助音乐创作与演奏框架。我们引入智能体管弦乐队（agentic orchestra），其中音乐智能体通过与音乐环境的试错互动演化出独特的心智（mindsets），而非通过在大数据集上训练。智能体被实现为参数化量子电路。它们演化出独特的创作行为，称为心智。这使得能够在混合量子-经典循环中利用量子叠加和纠缠探索音乐决策空间。我们提出两种互补的智能体架构：原子式智能体（独立处理音高和节奏）和整体式智能体（将音高和时值作为统一的音符事件处理）。心智通过具有音乐基础的奖励函数塑造，这些函数可以组合和加权以在不同智能体间发展不同的心智。由此产生的系统将量子计算智能体定位为自适应的音乐伙伴而非自主作曲家，每个智能体通过互动而非模仿发展自己的音乐个性。演示展示了智能体如何将学到的行为泛化到未见过的素材，在使用 MIDI 编码音乐的交互和离线批处理模式下运行。虽然量子计算机仍在发展中，但在 IBM 量子硬件上进行的实验证实，利用现有量子计算机可以实现有音乐意义的学习。对于作曲家和演奏者来说，智能体管弦乐队为涌现的、面向过程的音乐创造力开辟了新的可能性，为量子计算机辅助音乐创作提供了可扩展的基础。
translation.brief: 提出基于量子强化学习和多智能体交互的音乐创作框架，让参数化量子电路智能体通过环境试错而非语料模仿演化出音乐心智。

papers.title: KnowledgeClaw: Towards Agentic Knowledge Engineering via Omnimodal Hypergraphs
papers.abstract: Knowledge engineering (KE) turns raw files into a reasoning-ready knowledge base, a task now within reach of LLM agents. KE has progressed from chunk and graph retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to memory agents, agentic KE and multimodal KE. However, a live knowledge base needs omnimodality, a closed-loop lifecycle and multi-granular application at once, yet existing systems meet at most two and no benchmark measures all three. We formalize Omnimodal Knowledge Engineering (OmniKE) and release OmniKE-Bench, six tasks with 1,829 model-free items over 3,960 real files in five modalities. We further propose KnowledgeClaw, an agentic system that builds an omnimodal typed hypergraph, keeps it current with a closed-loop lifecycle agent and routes each query to the granularity it needs. Against 30 baselines, it ranks first on all six tasks with an overall OKE of 55.9, +14.6 over the strongest baseline. Our software and data are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: KnowledgeClaw：基于全模态超图的智能体知识工程
translation.abstract: 知识工程（KE）将原始文件转化为可用于推理的知识库，这一任务如今已处于 LLM 智能体的能力范围之内。KE 已从分块和图检索增强生成（RAG）发展到记忆智能体、智能体 KE 和多模态 KE。然而，一个活跃的知识库需要同时具备全模态性、闭环生命周期和多粒度应用，而现有系统最多满足其中两项，且没有基准同时衡量这三者。我们形式化了全模态知识工程（OmniKE）并发布 OmniKE-Bench，包含六个任务、1,829 个无模型条目，覆盖五种模态的 3,960 个真实文件。我们进一步提出 KnowledgeClaw，一个构建全模态类型化超图的智能体系统，通过闭环生命周期智能体保持其最新，并将每个查询路由到所需的粒度。对比 30 个基线，它在全部六个任务上排名第一，总体 OKE 为 55.9，比最强基线高 14.6。我们的软件和数据已在 https URL 公开。
translation.brief: 针对知识库需同时满足全模态、闭环生命周期和多粒度应用的问题，提出基于全模态类型化超图的智能体系统 KnowledgeClaw 及 OmniKE-Bench 基准。

papers.title: OpenKAGE: Open-Ended Lifelong Learning in the Open World via Knowledge-Sharing Agent-Group Evolution
papers.abstract: Building autonomous agents that continually explore open worlds and acquire new capabilities through experience is a long-standing aspiration in artificial intelligence. Existing research often pursues lifelong learning within predefined tasks, curricula, or objectives, with self-improvement largely confined to individual agents. We introduce OpenKAGE, an agent-group evolution framework for open-ended lifelong learning. Within this framework, agents autonomously explore open worlds and continually acquire new capabilities by accumulating and reusing knowledge from their own interactions and the experience of others. OpenKAGE builds on two key mechanisms: (1) a two-layer knowledge representation, with a memory layer for situated memories and an experience layer for transferable experience and skills that retains the applicability conditions needed for reuse; and (2) a knowledge-sharing mechanism that semantically consolidates textual experience into a continuously evolving shared knowledge graph, while executable skills are shared verbatim. In Minecraft, OpenKAGE supports open-ended lifelong learning, enabling agent groups to sustain exploration and reach advanced technological milestones. Furthermore, the accumulated knowledge can be transferred to a newly initialized agent group on a different backbone model, improving its survival and exploration progress.

translation.title: OpenKAGE：通过知识共享智能体群体演化实现开放世界的开放式终身学习
translation.abstract: 构建能够持续探索开放世界并通过经验获取新能力的自主智能体是人工智能领域长期以来的愿望。现有研究往往在预定义的任务、课程或目标内追求终身学习，自我提升大多局限于单个智能体。我们提出 OpenKAGE，一个面向开放式终身学习的智能体群体演化框架。在该框架中，智能体自主探索开放世界，并通过积累和复用自身交互及他人经验中的知识持续获取新能力。OpenKAGE 建立在两个关键机制之上：(1) 两层知识表示，包括用于情境记忆的记忆层和用于可迁移经验与技能的经验层，后者保留复用所需的适用条件；(2) 知识共享机制，将文本经验语义化整合到持续演化的共享知识图谱中，同时可执行技能按原样共享。在 Minecraft 中，OpenKAGE 支持开放式终身学习，使智能体群体能够持续探索并达到高级技术里程碑。此外，积累的知识可以迁移到使用不同骨干模型的新初始化智能体群体，提高其生存和探索进度。
translation.brief: 针对智能体在开放世界中开放式终身学习的问题，提出 OpenKAGE 框架，通过两层知识表示和知识共享机制实现智能体群体的经验积累、复用与迁移。

papers.title: AutoPI: Taxonomy-Guided Adaptive Red Teaming for Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Prompt injection is the dominant unsolved security risk for LLM agents, and the community now agrees that robustness must be measured against adaptive attackers rather than fixed benchmark injections. Many adaptive red teamers exist, and most are built to maximize attack success rate (ASR). Yet ASR counts how often a target breaks, not in how many different ways. A red teamer can achieve a high ASR by reusing a few techniques that work, leaving the others untested and absent from the attacks used to harden models. We present AutoPI, an adaptive red teamer designed to find many different ways to break a target, not just to break it often. AutoPI uses PIAtlas, a taxonomy of prompt-injection techniques, both to guide its search and to measure coverage. For each scenario, an attacker LLM writes an injection for every sub-technique in the taxonomy and then reworks the ones that fail using feedback from an LLM judge. The method is black-box and training-free, it plugs into existing benchmarks in place of their fixed attack templates, and it stays up to date as the taxonomy evolves. We evaluate AutoPI on AgentDojo and IPI Arena against open-weight and proprietary target models. Alongside ASR, we report technique coverage, the fraction of taxonomy classes, techniques, and sub-techniques that yield at least one successful injection. On AgentDojo, AutoPI finds a successful injection against Qwen3.6-35B in all six classes of the taxonomy and for more than 90% of its techniques. Against Claude Haiku 5.5, the most robust target we evaluate, it achieves between 20% and 50% higher ASR and between 25% and 400% higher class-level coverage than recent state-of-the-art adaptive red teamers, while requiring no training. We release our code and the generated attacks to support reproducible, coverage-aware evaluation.

translation.title: AutoPI：面向LLM智能体提示注入的分类法引导自适应红队测试
translation.abstract: 提示注入是LLM智能体尚未解决的主要安全风险，社区现已达成共识：鲁棒性必须针对自适应攻击者而非固定基准注入来衡量。现有许多自适应红队工具大多以最大化攻击成功率（ASR）为目标。然而ASR只统计目标被攻破的频率，而非被攻破方式的多样性。一个红队工具可以通过反复使用少数有效技术获得高ASR，而使其他技术未被测试、未出现在用于加固模型的攻击中。我们提出AutoPI，一个旨在发现多种不同攻破方式而非仅仅频繁攻破目标的自适应红队工具。AutoPI利用PIAtlas——一个提示注入技术分类法——来引导搜索并衡量覆盖率。对于每个场景，攻击者LLM为分类法中的每个子技术编写一条注入，然后根据LLM裁判的反馈修改失败的部分。该方法为黑盒且无需训练，可替代现有基准中的固定攻击模板，并随分类法演进保持更新。我们在AgentDojo和IPI Arena上针对开源及专有目标模型评估AutoPI。除ASR外，我们还报告技术覆盖率，即分类法中类、技术和子技术中至少产生一次成功注入的比例。在AgentDojo上，AutoPI对Qwen3.6-35B在分类法全部六个类中均找到成功注入，且覆盖超过90%的技术。对于我们所评估的最鲁棒目标Claude Haiku 5.5，相比近期最先进的自适应红队工具，AutoPI的ASR高出20%至50%，类级覆盖率高出25%至400%，且无需训练。我们发布代码和生成的攻击以支持可复现的、覆盖率感知的评估。
translation.brief: 针对现有自适应红队只追求攻击成功率而忽视攻击方式多样性的问题，提出基于提示注入技术分类法PIAtlas引导搜索并衡量覆盖率的免训练黑盒红队工具AutoPI。

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM abilities on postdoc-level natural science problems
papers.abstract: Scientific problems have no answer key, so evaluating an agent means deciding what counts as a better solution before any agent is run. Existing benchmarks either match a symbolic answer against a key or, where they require executable work, score it by unit tests, by a rubric, or by position on a competition leaderboard. None of these is the criterion by which a field decides that one published method beats another. STEMBench adopts that criterion directly. Each of its twelve research problems in high-energy physics, astrophysics and neuroscience is scored by its own field's figure of merit, and each comes with two measured anchors: a submission that uses no domain knowledge, and an expert reference reproducing a published method, both obtained by running code shipped with the benchmark. The interval between them states how much of a problem is crossed by scientific insight rather than by engineering. Across eight frontier models, task-level wins and domain-level leadership dissociate: a model that wins five of the twelve tasks leads no domain mean. In the high-effort cross-model comparison, at least one model's mean score exceeds the expert anchor on seven of twelve tasks. The remaining five span uncertainty estimation, latent and causal inference, and cross-site clinical classification. Numerical scores and official-submission validity capture different aspects of performance and are reported separately. We release the tasks, graders, anchors and harness.

translation.title: 在博士后水平的自然科学问题上评测LLM能力
translation.abstract: 科学问题没有标准答案，因此评估智能体意味着在任何智能体运行之前就要决定什么才算更好的解决方案。现有基准要么将符号答案与答案库匹配，要么在需要可执行工作时通过单元测试、评分细则或竞赛排行榜位置来打分。这些都不是一个领域判定某发表方法优于另一方法的准则。STEMBench直接采用该准则。其十二个高能物理、天体物理和神经科学研究问题中的每一个都由其所在领域的品质因数评分，且每个问题都带有两个实测锚点：一个不使用领域知识的提交，以及一个复现已发表方法的专家参考，两者均通过运行基准自带的代码获得。二者之间的区间表明该问题有多少部分是靠科学洞见而非工程实现跨越的。在八个前沿模型中，任务级胜负与领域级领先相互分离：一个在十二个任务中赢得五个的模型在所有领域均值上均不领先。在高投入跨模型比较中，至少有一个模型的均值分数在十二个任务中的七个上超过专家锚点。其余五个任务涉及不确定性估计、潜在与因果推断以及跨站点临床分类。数值分数与官方提交有效性反映性能的不同方面，因此分别报告。我们发布任务、评分器、锚点和评测框架。
translation.brief: 针对现有科学基准评分标准与领域实际评判方法脱节的问题，构建以领域品质因数评分并带无知识提交与专家参考双锚点的十二个博士后级研究问题基准STEMBench。

papers.title: Reducing Inference Cost of Coding Agents with Timeout Cascades
papers.abstract: AI coding agents have become one of the most popular applications of large language models. Yet, agentic AI comes at the cost of a tremendous amount of GPU compute resources, which limits its profitability and its viability at scale. In this paper, we investigate whether smaller, cheaper models can cut this cost without sacrificing accuracy. We evaluate 36 popular large and small open-weight models released since 2024 on a software engineering benchmark, and find that recent small models are closing the accuracy gap compared to their large counterparts. We investigate the structure of this gap and find that the gap is highly concentrated around hard tasks that small language models fail to solve while achieving remarkably good accuracy for easy and medium complexity tasks. Following this observation, we show that by utilizing a hybrid inference strategy that tries a small model first and escalates to a large one only when needed, we can achieve up to 33% reduction in total GPU-hour costs and 16.4% on all tasks from SWE-bench Verified, without sacrificing accuracy. Strikingly, this simple cascade nearly matches an oracle-style task router, highlighting a practical path for deploying cost-aware coding agents in production without complex learned task routers and with minimal engineering complexity.

translation.title: 用超时级联降低编码智能体的推理成本
translation.abstract: AI编码智能体已成为大语言模型最流行的应用之一。然而，智能体AI以巨大的GPU算力资源消耗为代价，这限制了其盈利能力和规模化可行性。本文研究更小、更便宜的模型能否在不牺牲准确率的情况下削减这一成本。我们在软件工程基准上评估了2024年以来发布的36个流行的大小型开源权重模型，发现近期的小模型正在缩小与大模型的准确率差距。我们研究这一差距的结构，发现差距高度集中在小语言模型无法解决的困难任务上，而在简单和中等复杂度任务上则达到相当好的准确率。基于这一观察，我们证明通过采用先尝试小模型、仅在需要时升级到大模型的混合推理策略，可以在不牺牲准确率的情况下，将SWE-bench Verified上所有任务的总GPU小时成本降低最高33%和16.4%。令人惊讶的是，这种简单的级联几乎媲美oracle式的任务路由器，凸显了一条在生产环境中部署成本感知编码智能体的实用路径，无需复杂的习得式任务路由器，且工程复杂度极低。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体GPU推理成本过高的问题，提出先小模型后按需升级到大模型的混合级联推理策略以降低成本。

papers.title: automodel: A Skill for Agentic Model Discovery
papers.abstract: The search for better models, whether expressed as analytical equations or neural architectures, has increasingly shifted from manual design toward data-driven automation. While a multitude of algorithms exist, ranging from exhaustive search to AlphaEvolve, recent advances in general-purpose coding agents such as Claude Code and OpenAI Codex raise the question: could providing such systems with a "model discovery recipe" be enough to discover or improve models? We present automodel, an agent skill for general model discovery. With case studies in astrophysics, cardiovascular dynamics, precision agriculture, traffic flow, and vehicle tire dynamics, we show how commercial agents equipped with automodel can successfully identify novel and scientifically-relevant models. Our findings suggest that encoding model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill can provide a simple, interactive, powerful and broadly applicable alternative to domain-specific automated discovery pipelines. The skill is available at: this https URL.

translation.title: automodel：用于智能体模型发现的技能
translation.abstract: 寻找更好的模型——无论是解析方程还是神经架构——已日益从人工设计转向数据驱动的自动化。尽管存在从穷举搜索到AlphaEvolve的众多算法，但Claude Code和OpenAI Codex等通用编码智能体的最新进展提出了一个问题：为这类系统提供一份"模型发现配方"是否足以发现或改进模型？我们提出automodel，一个用于通用模型发现的智能体技能。通过天体物理、心血管动力学、精准农业、交通流和车辆轮胎动力学的案例研究，我们展示了配备automodel的商业智能体如何成功识别新颖且具有科学相关性的模型。我们的发现表明，将模型发现方法论编码为可移植的智能体技能，可以为领域专用的自动化发现流水线提供一种简单、交互式、强大且广泛适用的替代方案。该技能可在：this https URL获取。
translation.brief: 针对模型发现依赖领域专用自动化流水线的问题，提出将模型发现方法论编码为可移植技能automodel，供通用编码智能体发现科学模型。

papers.title: Tell Me How Sure You Are: Communicating Uncertainty in Auxiliary Evidence to Foundation Models
papers.abstract: In many queries, the context information provided to generative foundation models, such as LLMs and VLMs, is inherently uncertain, including its representations of the physical world. While conventional prompting discards the associated uncertainty, this paper, for the first time in the literature, systematically demonstrates that communicating such uncertainty in context provides useful additional cues for downstream decisions and yields improvements across a wide range of settings. We formulate the decision-making problem as a zero-shot foundation model-assisted image classification task supported by auxiliary text-based characteristics. We choose this due to the availability of well-defined auxiliary properties, associated uncertainty, and unambiguous task correctness. Using five downstream foundation models across three datasets, we extensively evaluate uncertainty arising from both humans and learned models when observing or predicting auxiliary evidence. Across all settings, we find that communicating uncertainty substantially improves downstream LLM classification performance: macro-F1 improves up to $26.18$ percentage points compared to when the uncertainty information is not communicated. We further observe how the foundation models process such uncertainty information and find that auxiliary uncertainty contains predictive information about the correctness of downstream decisions. Together, these results establish uncertainty as useful contextual information and motivate more systematic consideration of uncertainty communication in future foundation-model inference pipelines.

translation.title: 告诉我你有多确定：向基础模型传达辅助证据中的不确定性
translation.abstract: 在许多查询中，提供给生成式基础模型（如LLM和VLM）的上下文信息本质上是不确定的，包括其对物理世界的表示。传统提示方法会丢弃相关的不确定性，而本文首次在文献中系统地证明，在上下文中传达此类不确定性可为下游决策提供有用的额外线索，并在广泛的各种设置中带来改进。我们将决策问题形式化为一个由基于文本的辅助特征支持的零样本基础模型辅助图像分类任务。选择该任务是因为其具有明确定义的辅助属性、相关不确定性以及无歧义的任务正确性。我们使用五个下游基础模型和三个数据集，广泛评估了人类和学习模型在观察或预测辅助证据时产生的不确定性。在所有设置中，我们发现传达不确定性显著提升下游LLM分类性能：与不传达不确定性信息相比，macro-F1最高提升26.18个百分点。我们进一步观察基础模型如何处理此类不确定性信息，发现辅助不确定性包含关于下游决策正确性的预测信息。这些结果共同确立了不确定性作为有用的上下文信息，并促使未来基础模型推理流水线更系统地考虑不确定性传达。
translation.brief: 针对提示上下文中辅助信息的不确定性被丢弃的问题，系统证明向基础模型传达该不确定性可显著提升下游分类性能。

papers.title: OCTR2A: Real-Time RGB-to-BEV Trajectory Projection and Forecasting at Urban Intersections
papers.abstract: Trajectory forecasting at urban intersections is often studied assuming that reliable bird's-eye-view (BEV) motion histories are available, which in practice requires costly resources such as LiDAR, aerial views, HD maps, or calibrated infrastructure. We address this upstream perception-to-forecasting problem by reconstructing and predicting agents' BEV trajectories only from paired opposite-corner RGB cameras mounted on existing urban infrastructure at variable heights at inference time. We introduce the Opposite-Corner Trajectory Reconstruction and Anticipation Architecture (OCTR2A), a modular pipeline integrating per-view detection with class refinement, geometric cross-camera matching, transformer-based BEV projection, and egocentric GRU forecasting, trained in cascade and mainly supervised with a soft multi-scale spatial-overlap loss. Since no public benchmark provides this sensing configuration, we introduce R3ST++, a Blender-based synthetic benchmark built from SIND trajectories that provides synchronized opposite-corner views, cross-view correspondences, and BEV ground truth, while also serving as a deployment-support simulator for site-specific fine-tuning. Experiments on these datasets show that, with 12 observed and 12 predicted frames at 10\,Hz, OCTR2A achieves projection~-~forecasting ADE/FDE of 0.144/0.140~-~0.154/0.241~meters in real time on a single consumer GPU. Evaluated on ground-truth BEV histories, the forecasting module improves over the strongest state-of-the-art methods on SIND by 66.7\%/41.7\% ADE/FDE. Transfer experiments on TUMTraf-V2X show that R3ST++ pretraining supports adaptation to real-world roadside domains with different sensing configurations.

translation.title: OCTR2A：城市交叉口的实时RGB到BEV轨迹投影与预测
translation.abstract: 城市交叉口的轨迹预测研究通常假设已有可靠的鸟瞰图（BEV）运动历史，而这在实践中需要昂贵资源，如LiDAR、航拍视角、高精地图或标定基础设施。我们通过仅使用部署在现有城市基础设施上、推理时可变高度的对角成对RGB相机，重建并预测智能体的BEV轨迹，来解决这一上游感知到预测的问题。我们提出对角轨迹重建与预测架构（OCTR2A），这是一个模块化流水线，集成了带类别细化的单视角检测、几何跨相机匹配、基于Transformer的BEV投影和以自我为中心的GRU预测，采用级联训练，并主要以软多尺度空间重叠损失进行监督。由于没有公开基准提供这种传感配置，我们引入R3ST++，一个基于Blender、由SIND轨迹构建的合成基准，提供同步的对角视角、跨视角对应关系和BEV真值，同时还可作为面向特定场景微调的部署支持模拟器。在这些数据集上的实验表明，以10 Hz观测12帧并预测12帧，OCTR2A在单张消费级GPU上实时实现了0.144/0.140至0.154/0.241米的投影-预测ADE/FDE。在真值BEV历史轨迹上评估时，预测模块在SIND上相比最强先进方法将ADE/FDE提升了66.7%/41.7%。在TUMTraf-V2X上的迁移实验表明，R3ST++预训练支持适配具有不同传感配置的真实路侧场景。
translation.brief: 解决仅用基础设施RGB相机即可获得BEV轨迹用于预测的问题，核心方法是级联的对角相机检测、跨相机匹配、Transformer BEV投影与GRU预测流水线，并配套合成基准R3ST++。

papers.title: Semantic Context Handoff with On-Demand Evidence for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Traditional long-horizon LLM agents often hand off context through full-history prompting, retaining all previous action--observation interactions. As execution proceeds, this history keeps growing, increasing inference cost and potentially degrading accuracy. Existing methods control this growth by preserving compact conclusions while removing earlier observations, but doing so can discard evidence that later becomes relevant. We introduce Semantic Context Handoff (SCH), whose central abstraction is state--evidence separation: a compact semantic state carries the agent's current interpretation, while supporting action--observation evidence remains separately addressable and can re-enter context when later execution makes it relevant, without separate summarization or retrieval-model calls. Empirically, SCH improves long-horizon agent performance while substantially reducing context cost. In a controlled 150-task SWE-bench study, SCH's evidence recovery improves Pass@1 from $80.0\%$ to $86.9\%$ at essentially unchanged token use and execution time. In the complete-system comparison, SCH achieves 86.9% Pass@1 while using 43% fewer tokens and 41% less wall-clock time than the strongest baseline by task performance. Across models and benchmarks, SCH consistently reduces token use relative to full-history prompting while remaining competitive with or improving upon the evaluated baselines. Trajectory analysis confirms that SCH recovers evidence from substantially earlier parts of the interaction history rather than merely preserving a recent context window.

translation.title: 面向长程智能体的按需证据语义上下文交接
translation.abstract: 传统的长程LLM智能体通常通过全历史提示进行上下文交接，保留所有先前的动作-观察交互。随着执行推进，历史不断增长，增加推理成本并可能降低准确性。现有方法通过保留紧凑结论、删除早期观察来控制这种增长，但这样做可能丢弃后续变得相关的证据。我们提出语义上下文交接（SCH），其核心抽象是状态-证据分离：紧凑的语义状态承载智能体当前的解读，而支持性的动作-观察证据保持可单独寻址，当后续执行使其相关时可重新进入上下文，无需单独的摘要或检索模型调用。实验表明，SCH在大幅降低上下文成本的同时提升了长程智能体性能。在一项受控的150任务SWE-bench研究中，SCH的证据恢复将Pass@1从80.0%提升到86.9%，而token使用和执行时间基本不变。在完整系统对比中，SCH达到86.9%的Pass@1，同时比按任务性能最强的基线少用43%的token和41%的墙钟时间。跨模型和基准测试中，SCH相对全历史提示持续降低token使用，同时与所评估基线持平或更优。轨迹分析证实，SCH从交互历史中较早的部分恢复证据，而非仅仅保留最近的上下文窗口。
translation.brief: 解决长程LLM智能体上下文增长导致成本高且丢失相关证据的问题，核心方法是将语义状态与动作-观察证据分离，使证据可按需重新进入上下文。

papers.title: PIPETTE: Prompt Injection Purple-Teaming for Robust LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents routinely interact with untrusted external data, exposing them to indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks that hijack agents into executing attacker-chosen tasks. To uncover these vulnerabilities at scale, automated red-teaming methods often leverage reinforcement learning (RL) to generate attacks that achieve high attack success rates (ASR). Model developers use the attacks discovered during internal red-teaming to harden agents through adversarial training before deployment, a collaborative offensive-defensive process known in cybersecurity as purple-teaming. However, we show that achieving high ASR during red-teaming does not guarantee robustness gains from subsequent adversarial training. Specifically, we find that two state-of-the-art RL-based red-teaming methods, RL-Hammer and PISmith, suffer from mode collapse, repeatedly discovering similar attack strategies whose additional successes add no additional robustness improvements to adversarial training. To address this gap, we introduce PIPETTE, a unified prompt injection purple-teaming framework that effectively converts red-teaming discoveries into defender robustness improvements. PIPETTE employs a dictionary learning-based reward that encourages broader coverage of attack strategies during red-teaming. It also integrates an on-policy adversarial training pipeline tailored to IPI defense, enabling agents to resist attacks while completing legitimate user tasks. Extensive evaluations across agentic benchmarks (AgentDojo and ASB) demonstrate that PIPETTE produces defenders that achieve near-zero attack success rates on static attacks and can withstand strong adaptive attacks, while maintaining benign task utility close to that of the undefended baseline.

translation.title: PIPETTE：面向鲁棒LLM智能体的提示注入紫队测试
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体经常与不可信的外部数据交互，使其暴露于间接提示注入（IPI）攻击之下，攻击可劫持智能体执行攻击者选定的任务。为大规模发现这些漏洞，自动化红队方法常利用强化学习（RL）生成高攻击成功率（ASR）的攻击。模型开发者利用内部红队发现的攻击，在部署前通过对抗训练加固智能体，这一攻防协作过程在网络安全中称为紫队测试。然而，我们表明红队阶段的高ASR并不保证后续对抗训练带来鲁棒性提升。具体而言，我们发现两种最先进的基于RL的红队方法RL-Hammer和PISmith存在模式坍塌，反复发现相似的攻击策略，其额外成功对对抗训练的鲁棒性提升没有额外贡献。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出PIPETTE，一个统一的提示注入紫队测试框架，能将红队发现有效转化为防御者鲁棒性提升。PIPETTE采用基于字典学习的奖励，鼓励红队阶段覆盖更广的攻击策略。它还集成了针对IPI防御定制的在线对抗训练流水线，使智能体在完成合法用户任务的同时抵御攻击。在智能体基准（AgentDojo和ASB）上的大量评估表明，PIPETTE训练出的防御者在静态攻击上达到接近零的攻击成功率，并能抵御强自适应攻击，同时保持与未防御基线接近的良性任务效用。
translation.brief: 解决RL红队攻击模式坍塌导致对抗训练鲁棒性收益有限的问题，核心方法是基于字典学习奖励扩展攻击覆盖并结合在线对抗训练的紫队框架PIPETTE。

papers.title: VAFL: A Vertical Analytic Federated Learning Mechanism for Efficient Crowdsourced Services via Closed-Form Solutions
papers.abstract: Intelligent services often rely on complementary information held by different organizations, motivating Vertical Federated Learning without centralized raw-data pooling. We propose VAFL, a Vertical Analytic Federated Learning framework that fits classification and regression heads on fixed local representations through regularized least squares. An agent-assisted protected-computation workflow supports two-party and multi-party collaboration. To reduce fitting overhead, we develop a full-dimensional equivalent solve that applies block factors directly to the target matrix, avoiding construction of the full inverse. We further study two width-reduction strategies: local spectral projection with coefficient lifting, and full-dimensional local fitting with low-rank cross-party correction. The first compresses the prediction space, whereas the second retains local components outside the collaboration subspace. We establish their algebraic properties and analyze their computational scope. Experiments on five benchmarks show the accuracy--cost tradeoffs of these strategies and compatibility with diverse frozen backbones. Predictive performance and training time identify useful operating points and the limits of compression.

translation.title: VAFL：基于闭式解的高效众包服务纵向解析联邦学习机制
translation.abstract: 智能服务常依赖不同组织持有的互补信息，这推动了无需集中汇聚原始数据的纵向联邦学习。我们提出VAFL，一个纵向解析联邦学习框架，通过正则化最小二乘在固定局部表示上拟合分类和回归头。代理辅助的受保护计算工作流支持两方和多方协作。为降低拟合开销，我们开发了全维度等价求解方法，将块因子直接作用于目标矩阵，避免构造完整逆矩阵。我们进一步研究两种宽度缩减策略：带系数提升的局部谱投影，以及带低秩跨方校正的全维度局部拟合。前者压缩预测空间，后者保留协作子空间之外的局部成分。我们建立了它们的代数性质并分析其计算范围。在五个基准上的实验展示了这些策略的精度-成本权衡以及与多种冻结骨干网络的兼容性。预测性能和训练时间确定了有用的运行点和压缩的极限。
translation.brief: 解决纵向联邦学习中拟合开销大的问题，核心方法是用正则化最小二乘闭式解在固定局部表示上拟合模型，并配合谱投影和低秩校正两种宽度缩减策略。

papers.title: LLM-Assisted Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization: Fusing Expert Knowledge with Numerical Data
papers.abstract: Multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization (MFBO) reduces engineering design cost by combining inexpensive low-fidelity (LF) models with a few accurate high-fidelity (HF) evaluations and sequentially selecting designs to evaluate. However, when HF data are scarce, the LF-HF discrepancy is difficult to learn from numerical data alone, especially when physics omitted in the LF model makes it design-dependent. Yet even without sufficient data, domain experts often know which physics the LF model omits and under which conditions its effect grows. Existing multi-fidelity (MF) models cannot use such qualitative knowledge directly, but large language models (LLMs) can interpret it and compare designs accordingly. The proposed LLM-Assisted MFBO adds a knowledge basis to the conventional MF model: from an expert description of the omitted physics, an LLM judges which of two designs requires the larger signed residual correction, and a pairwise Gaussian process converts these judgments into the basis. HF data calibrate its contribution and sign, so the knowledge is not trusted blindly. On a lithium-ion battery design problem, the proposed method reduced the regret area under the curve of conventional MFBO by 61%. Knowledge quality, rather than the choice of LLM, determined whether the search was accelerated, as shown by a controlled study that varied the two independently. A knowledge-level ablation further quantified the contribution of each knowledge statement. These results show that LLM-interpreted expert knowledge can complement numerical data as an information source in MFBO.

translation.title: LLM辅助的多保真贝叶斯优化：融合专家知识与数值数据
translation.abstract: 多保真贝叶斯优化（MFBO）通过将廉价的低保真（LF）模型与少量精确的高保真（HF）评估相结合并序贯选择待评估设计，降低工程设计成本。然而，当HF数据稀缺时，LF-HF差异难以仅从数值数据中学习，尤其是当LF模型省略的物理效应依赖于设计时。但即使数据不足，领域专家通常也知道LF模型省略了哪些物理效应，以及在何种条件下其影响增大。现有多保真（MF）模型无法直接利用这类定性知识，而大语言模型（LLM）可以解读并据此比较设计。所提出的LLM辅助MFBO在传统MF模型基础上增加了知识基：根据专家对省略物理效应的描述，LLM判断两个设计中哪一个需要更大的带符号残差校正，成对高斯过程将这些判断转化为知识基。HF数据校准其贡献和符号，因此不会盲目信任知识。在一个锂离子电池设计问题上，所提方法将传统MFBO的遗憾曲线下面积降低了61%。一项独立变化知识与LLM的受控研究表明，决定搜索是否加速的是知识质量而非LLM的选择。知识级消融进一步量化了每条知识陈述的贡献。这些结果表明，LLM解读的专家知识可作为数值数据之外的信息源补充MFBO。
translation.brief: 解决HF数据稀缺时难以学习LF-HF差异的问题，核心方法是用LLM解读专家定性知识并通过成对高斯过程转化为MFBO的知识基，由HF数据校准。

papers.title: MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs
papers.abstract: AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model's own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results openly, along with two cheap usage patterns that block switching enables: undoing a failed attempt and running subagents without a new context.

translation.title: MoE-Context：只向模型展示它所需的内容
translation.abstract: AI 智能体在每一步都会读取全部历史记录，而人的工作方式并非如此：我们只保留当下所需的内容，其余以可回忆的粗略笔记形式保存。MoE-Context 将这一理念应用于语言模型：上下文被切分为块，每一步之前先进行一次快速的“是/否”判断，决定该步需要哪些块；其余块保留为单行笔记，可随时召回，且不删除任何内容。在我们构建的版本中，同一个模型先做出该决策再作答，基于单一的 key-value cache，被隐藏的块通过掩码而非删除的方式处理。在一台搭载 Qwen3-1.7B 的笔记本电脑上，针对一个合成查找任务，只展示所需块将准确率从 120 题中的 93 提升到 119，且被掩码的块与被删除的块同样不可见。模型自身的挑选能力是薄弱环节。一个写入空闲输出行的监督式线性探针将其准确率从 120 题中的 80 提升到 110，但简单的关键词搜索在该任务上可完美挑选，且该探针无法迁移到第二个任务。我们公开报告这些结果，以及块切换带来的两种廉价使用模式：撤销一次失败的尝试，以及在不新建上下文的情况下运行子智能体。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体上下文过长的问题，方法是将上下文分块并在每步前用快速判断只展示所需块、其余以掩码笔记形式保留。

papers.title: Improved Bounds for Online TSP on the Half-Line
papers.abstract: In the open online traveling salesperson problem, requests appear over time at different positions of a metric space. A single agent traveling at unit speed must serve all requests, by visiting their positions, with the objective of minimizing the completion time. We propose online algorithms for this problem for the case that the metric space is the half-line. First, we present a $2$-competitive algorithm in which the server always either moves at unit speed or remains stationary, which improves on the previously best-known ratio of $2.04$. We further observe that algorithms must sometimes move slower than unit speed to achieve competitive ratios below $2$. We introduce a second algorithm that beats the barrier of $2$ by carefully modulating its speed, and prove a tight bound of $1.75$ on its competitive ratio. Finally, we slightly strengthen a known lower bound on the best-possible competitive ratio on the half-line from $1.627$ to $1.646$.

translation.title: 半直线上在线 TSP 的改进界
translation.abstract: 在开放在线旅行商问题中，请求随时间出现在度量空间的不同位置。一个以单位速度移动的智能体必须通过访问各请求位置来服务所有请求，目标是最小化完成时间。我们针对度量空间为半直线的情况提出在线算法。首先，我们给出一个 2-竞争算法，其中服务器始终以单位速度移动或保持静止，这改进了此前已知的 2.04 竞争比。我们进一步观察到，要实现低于 2 的竞争比，算法有时必须以低于单位速度的速度移动。我们引入第二个算法，通过精细调节速度突破了 2 的壁垒，并证明其竞争比的紧界为 1.75。最后，我们将半直线上最优竞争比的已知下界从 1.627 略微加强到 1.646。
translation.brief: 该论文解决半直线上开放在线 TSP 的竞争比问题，方法包括一个 2-竞争算法和一个通过变速调制达到紧界 1.75 的算法，并加强了下界。

papers.title: RSIBench-Infra: Can Agents Optimize Their Own Training and Inference Infrastructure at Production Scale?
papers.abstract: Improving the efficiency of training and inference infrastructure is a practical component of recursive self-improvement. Existing benchmarks for agent-driven optimization largely focus on individual software layers such as kernel, leaving unclear whether agents can deliver end-to-end performance gains under production workloads. We introduce RSIBench-Infra, a benchmark of 20 training and inference tasks spanning diverse model families and modalities, with deployments of up to 32 accelerators on NVIDIA GPUs and Ascend NPUs. Agents start from runnable baselines derived from official recipes and can modify the software stack across engine, kernel, and instruction levels. An OCI image-layer submission protocol captures these changes for reproducible deployment, while independent evaluation measures end-to-end performance under task-specific quality constraints. Across all task results, 66.2% exceed $1.10\times$ validated speedup. These results demonstrate that current agents can improve production-scale training and inference performance, but identifying effective optimization strategies and consistently translating local improvements into end-to-end gains remain challenging.

translation.title: RSIBench-Infra：智能体能否在生产规模上优化自身的训练与推理基础设施？
translation.abstract: 提升训练与推理基础设施的效率是递归自我改进的一个实际组成部分。现有的智能体驱动优化基准大多聚焦于单个软件层（如 kernel），尚不清楚智能体能否在生产工作负载下带来端到端的性能提升。我们提出 RSIBench-Infra，一个包含 20 个训练与推理任务的基准，覆盖多种模型家族和模态，部署规模最高达 32 个加速器，涉及 NVIDIA GPU 和 Ascend NPU。智能体从基于官方配方构建的可运行基线出发，可以在 engine、kernel 和指令层级修改软件栈。基于 OCI 镜像层的提交协议捕获这些更改以实现可复现部署，同时由独立评估在任务特定的质量约束下测量端到端性能。在所有任务结果中，66.2% 的任务实现了超过 1.10 倍的经验证加速。这些结果表明当前智能体能够改进生产规模的训练与推理性能，但识别有效的优化策略以及将局部改进持续转化为端到端收益仍然具有挑战性。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体能否在生产规模下端到端优化训练与推理基础设施的问题，方法是构建覆盖多层级软件栈修改、可复现部署与独立评估的基准 RSIBench-Infra。

papers.title: CaDO: Formal Verification-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Causal Dataset Repair and Generation
papers.abstract: High-quality causal reasoning datasets are essential for developing models with reliable causal understanding, particularly in specialized domains. However, existing datasets frequently suffer from incorrect annotations and structural imbalances, which can lead to biased predictions and limited generalization. To address this issue, we propose CaDO (Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization), a multi-agent framework for automated diagnosis and repair of causal reasoning datasets. Our framework consists of three key stages: formal causal reasoning, multi-level diagnosis, and automated data repair and generation. First, a Formalizer Agent translates natural language questions into formal causal queries to minimize semantic deviations and make retrieval and verification more explicit and tractable. Second, a dual-level diagnosis mechanism employs independent Critic Agents to identify sample-level errors while analyzing query-type coverage and label distributions to detect dataset-level structural imbalances. Finally, the framework employs reusable repair operators grounded in formal causal semantics to correct erroneous samples, while Explorer and Expander Agent collaboratively produce diverse and semantically consistent new samples. Experimental results show that CaDO significantly outperforms the strongest of five data cleaning baselines in 16 out of 18 experimental settings, improving downstream model accuracy by up to 9.1%. Moreover, at least 95% of the samples flagged by CaDO are defective, and on CLadder, CaDO incorrectly modifies 92.2% fewer correct labels than an LLM-based judge, demonstrating its effectiveness and reliability. Our code and data are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: CaDO：面向因果数据集修复与生成的形式化验证引导多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 高质量的因果推理数据集对于开发具有可靠因果理解能力的模型至关重要，尤其是在专业领域。然而，现有数据集经常存在错误标注和结构失衡问题，可能导致有偏预测和泛化能力受限。为解决这一问题，我们提出 CaDO（Causal-Engine-Guided Multi-Agent Data Optimization），一个用于因果推理数据集自动诊断与修复的多智能体框架。该框架包含三个关键阶段：形式化因果推理、多层级诊断以及自动化数据修复与生成。首先，Formalizer Agent 将自然语言问题翻译为形式化因果查询，以最小化语义偏差，使检索与验证更加显式且易于处理。其次，双层诊断机制采用独立的 Critic Agent 识别样本级错误，同时分析查询类型覆盖度和标签分布以检测数据集级结构失衡。最后，该框架采用基于形式化因果语义的可复用修复算子来纠正错误样本，同时 Explorer 和 Expander Agent 协作生成多样且语义一致的新样本。实验结果表明，CaDO 在 18 个实验设置中的 16 个显著优于五个数据清洗基线中最强的一个，将下游模型准确率最高提升 9.1%。此外，CaDO 标记的样本中至少 95% 确有缺陷，且在 CLadder 上，CaDO 对正确标签的错误修改比基于 LLM 的评判器少 92.2%，证明了其有效性与可靠性。我们的代码和数据已在 https URL 公开。
translation.brief: 该论文解决因果推理数据集中错误标注与结构失衡的问题，方法是用形式化因果查询引导的多智能体框架进行诊断、修复与新样本生成。

papers.title: Resolution as Attention for Efficient Agent Memory Perception
papers.abstract: LLM-based agents accumulate extensive interaction histories when solving complex, long-horizon tasks, making efficient memory management critical to their performance and scalability. While existing memory management methods primarily focus on what to retain or retrieve, they often overlook how much perceptual detail should be allocated to individual past interactions. We posit that effective agent memory depends not only on the information preserved, but also on the granularity at which each past interaction is perceived. Motivated by this insight, we propose Resolution as Attention (RAA), a memory perception mechanism that uses visual resolution as a means of attention allocation across interaction histories. RAA renders past interactions as images and dynamically adjusts their resolution at every step according to their relevance to the agent's upcoming decision, preserving fine-grained information for critical interactions while reducing visual-token consumption for less relevant ones. To adaptively determine the perceptual fidelity of each interaction, we train a lightweight relevance estimator with teacher-model guidance and further optimize it to preserve the agent's decision consistency at a reduced visual-token cost. Experiments across multiple tasks and backbones show that RAA reduces token consumption by over 50% without compromising task performance. Moreover, RAA can be integrated as a plug-in perception layer with existing memory management methods, yielding further token savings and revealing adaptive perception as a complementary dimension of agent memory.

translation.title: 以分辨率作为注意力实现高效的智能体记忆感知
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的智能体在解决复杂、长时程任务时会积累大量交互历史，使高效的记忆管理对其性能和可扩展性至关重要。现有记忆管理方法主要关注保留或检索什么内容，却往往忽视了应为每条历史交互分配多少感知细节。我们认为，有效的智能体记忆不仅取决于所保存的信息，还取决于每条历史交互被感知的粒度。基于这一洞察，我们提出 Resolution as Attention（RAA），一种以视觉分辨率作为跨交互历史注意力分配手段的记忆感知机制。RAA 将历史交互渲染为图像，并在每一步根据其与智能体即将做出的决策的相关性动态调整分辨率，为关键交互保留细粒度信息，同时降低相关性较低的交互的视觉 token 消耗。为了自适应地确定每条交互的感知保真度，我们训练了一个轻量级相关性估计器，并借助教师模型指导进一步优化，使其在降低视觉 token 成本的同时保持智能体决策的一致性。在多个任务和骨干模型上的实验表明，RAA 在不损害任务性能的情况下将 token 消耗降低超过 50%。此外，RAA 可作为即插即用的感知层与现有记忆管理方法集成，带来进一步的 token 节省，并揭示出自适应感知是智能体记忆的一个互补维度。
translation.brief: 该论文解决智能体记忆中视觉 token 消耗过高的问题，方法是将历史交互渲染为图像并按相关性动态调整分辨率以分配感知注意力。

papers.title: Dissecting an Unexplored SASS Control-Code Field: Barrier Exemption and Programmable Warp Priority
papers.abstract: Every instruction in NVIDIA's native GPU ISA (SASS) carries a control code that guides hardware scheduling, and prior work has decoded its known fields to optimize GPU kernels. However, one control-code field remains unexplored: it appears over 500000 times in NVIDIA's closed-source libraries such as cuBLAS and cuDNN, yet nvcc never emits it when compiling user programs. This paper presents the first systematic study of this control-code field across GPU architectures from Volta to Blackwell. Using instruction-level microbenchmarks, we show that the field controls two independent hardware mechanisms: barrier exemption (EXEMPT), which allows instructions blocked by a pending barrier to issue early during the barrier wait, and programmable warp priority (START, TILE, and END), which moves warps across three priority levels in the hardware scheduler. We identify the conditions under which each mechanism improves GPU kernel performance and implement a post-compilation binary optimizer that places these marks directly in compiled binaries without modifying source code or the compiler. Evaluated across six GPUs spanning four architectures, our optimizations speed up representative kernels by up to 31.9%, and the optimizer accelerates production kernels in this http URL and vLLM by up to 5.4% and end-to-end LLM inference by up to 3.6%.

translation.title: 剖析一个未被探索的 SASS 控制码字段：屏障豁免与可编程 Warp 优先级
translation.abstract: NVIDIA 原生 GPU ISA（SASS）中的每条指令都携带一个引导硬件调度的控制码，已有工作对其已知字段进行解码以优化 GPU kernel。然而，有一个控制码字段至今未被探索：它在 cuBLAS 和 cuDNN 等 NVIDIA 闭源库中出现了超过 50 万次，但 nvcc 在编译用户程序时从不生成它。本文首次对从 Volta 到 Blackwell 各代 GPU 架构上的这一控制码字段进行了系统研究。通过指令级微基准测试，我们证明该字段控制两个独立的硬件机制：屏障豁免（EXEMPT），允许被未完成屏障阻塞的指令在屏障等待期间提前发射；以及可编程 warp 优先级（START、TILE 和 END），可在硬件调度器的三个优先级之间移动 warp。我们识别了每种机制提升 GPU kernel 性能的条件，并实现了一个编译后二进制优化器，无需修改源代码或编译器即可直接在编译后的二进制中放置这些标记。在跨越四种架构的六块 GPU 上评估，我们的优化可将代表性 kernel 加速最高 31.9%，该优化器将 this http URL 和 vLLM 中的生产 kernel 加速最高 5.4%，端到端 LLM 推理加速最高 3.6%。
translation.brief: 针对 SASS 控制码中一个未解码字段，通过微基准测试揭示其屏障豁免与 warp 优先级两种机制，并实现编译后二进制优化器来加速 GPU kernel。

papers.title: Ordinal Hegselmann-Krause Systems
papers.abstract: We study opinion formation in the popular Hegselmann-Krause model when agents replace the traditional averaging update by a median update or more general ordinal aggregation methods. We analyze the convergence properties of synchronous and asynchronous dynamics. For asynchronous dynamics, we show that every HKS with a $1$-Lipschitz ordinal aggregation function converges in worst-case time $\mathcal{O}(n^4)$. For the special case of median aggregation and for the family of $k\textsf{-large}$ aggregation functions, in which agents select the $k$-th largest opinion in their neighborhood, we obtain sharper bounds of $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$. For general ordinal aggregation, some sequence of $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ updates reaches an equilibrium from every initial state. Nevertheless, other update sequences may cycle, and uniform random activation can require exponentially many updates with overwhelming probability. For synchronous dynamics, we obtain a tight characterization. Ordinal aggregation functions satisfying the $1$-Lipschitz condition are shown to guarantee convergence in linear time. This result applies to many natural examples such as minimum, maximum, median, and $k\textsf{-large}$ functions. When the Lipschitz condition is violated, there exist instances in which synchronous dynamics do not converge at all.

translation.title: 序数 Hegselmann-Krause 系统
translation.abstract: 我们研究流行的 Hegselmann-Krause 模型中的观点形成问题，其中智能体用中位数更新或更一般的序数聚合方法替代传统的平均更新。我们分析了同步与异步动力学的收敛性质。对于异步动力学，我们证明每个具有 1-Lipschitz 序数聚合函数的 HKS 在最坏情况下于 $\mathcal{O}(n^4)$ 时间内收敛。对于中位数聚合的特殊情形以及 $k\textsf{-large}$ 聚合函数族（智能体选择其邻域中第 k 大的观点），我们得到了更紧的 $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$ 界。对于一般序数聚合，从任意初始状态出发，存在某个 $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ 次更新的序列可到达均衡。然而，其他更新序列可能循环，且均匀随机激活以极高概率需要指数级多的更新。对于同步动力学，我们得到了紧致刻画：满足 1-Lipschitz 条件的序数聚合函数保证线性时间收敛，该结果适用于最小值、最大值、中位数和 $k\textsf{-large}$ 函数等许多自然例子。当 Lipschitz 条件被违反时，存在同步动力学完全不收敛的实例。
translation.brief: 研究 Hegselmann-Krause 模型中用中位数等序数聚合替代平均更新后的收敛性，通过理论分析给出同步与异步动力学在不同聚合函数下的收敛时间界。

papers.title: ShoWorld: Shape-Faithful Multi-Hypothesis Occupancy World Model
papers.abstract: Occupancy world models struggle to forecast moving objects due to motion uncertainty and shape distortion. A single trajectory can average plausible futures into an implausible path, and repeated re-voxelization can erode or inflate object shape even under correct motion. We introduce ShoWorld to address these challenges through separate motion and shape representations. The motion forecaster predicts probabilistic trajectories conditioned on scene layout, nearby agents and the future ego trajectory. Each hypothesis is rendered into occupancy and fused according to its probability to retain alternative futures. The shape component predicts sub-voxel points with occupancy probabilities and offsets from local geometry. These points move rigidly with the object, and voxel occupancy follows the probability that at least one occupied point falls within it. This representation reduces shape distortion under motion. ShoWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on Occ3D-nuScenes. With ground-truth occupancy and ego trajectory, it improves mIoU and IoU by 6.56 and 9.16 points overall and by 6.06 and 5.53 points on dynamic classes.

translation.title: ShoWorld：形状保真的多假设占据世界模型
translation.abstract: 占据世界模型由于运动不确定性和形状畸变而难以预测运动物体。单条轨迹可能将多个合理的未来平均成一条不合理的路径，而反复的重新体素化即使在运动正确的情况下也会侵蚀或膨胀物体形状。我们提出 ShoWorld，通过分离的运动与形状表示来应对这些挑战。运动预测器基于场景布局、邻近智能体和未来自车轨迹预测概率化轨迹。每个假设被渲染成占据并按其概率融合，以保留多种可能的未来。形状组件预测带占据概率和相对局部几何偏移的亚体素点。这些点随物体刚性移动，体素占据取决于至少一个被占据点落入其中的概率。这种表示减少了运动下的形状畸变。ShoWorld 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上取得了最先进的结果。在使用真值占据和自车轨迹时，它将 mIoU 和 IoU 分别整体提升 6.56 和 9.16 点，在动态类别上分别提升 6.06 和 5.53 点。
translation.brief: 针对占据世界模型中运动不确定性导致的轨迹平均失真和重体素化造成的形状畸变，提出分离的运动与形状表示并结合多假设融合的占据预测模型 ShoWorld。

papers.title: Cooperative UAV and Ground Station for Robust MEC of Dynamic Aquatic IoT: A Generative AI-Enhanced Approach
papers.abstract: The increasing aquatic Internet of Things (AIoTs) require computational support and coverage in applications such as maritime search and rescue. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can offer low-cost, flexible aerial services, and ground stations (GSs) can provide powerful supports, which can cooperate to help the AIoTs in complex scenarios. However, the collaboration between UAVs and GSs for AIoTs faces challenges of task uncertainties, AIoTs trajectory uncertainties, heterogeneities, and limited computational resources. To address these issues, we propose a cooperative UAV and GS based robust multi-access edge computing (MEC) framework to assist AIoTs in completing computational tasks. Specifically, we formulate the optimization problem of joint task offloading and UAV trajectory to minimize the total execution time, which is in the form of mixed integer nonlinear programming and NP-hard to tackle. Therefore, we propose the algorithm of generative artificial intelligence-enhanced heterogeneous agent proximal policy optimization (GAI-HAPPO). The proposed algorithm integrates GAI models to enhance the actor network ability to model complex environments and extract high-level features, thereby allowing the algorithm to predict uncertainties and adapt to dynamic conditions. Additionally, GAI stabilizes the critic network, addressing the instability of multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches. Finally, extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm outperforms the existing benchmark methods, thus highlighting the potentials in tackling intricate, cross-domain issues in the considered scenarios.

translation.title: 面向动态水上物联网鲁棒 MEC 的无人机与地面站协同：一种生成式 AI 增强方法
translation.abstract: 日益增长的水上物联网（AIoTs）在海上搜救等应用中需要计算支持与覆盖。无人机（UAV）可提供低成本、灵活的空中服务，地面站（GS）可提供强大支持，二者可协同帮助复杂场景中的 AIoTs。然而，UAV 与 GS 面向 AIoTs 的协作面临任务不确定性、AIoTs 轨迹不确定性、异构性以及计算资源有限等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出一个基于 UAV 与 GS 协同的鲁棒多接入边缘计算（MEC）框架，以辅助 AIoTs 完成计算任务。具体而言，我们将联合任务卸载与 UAV 轨迹的优化问题形式化为最小化总执行时间的问题，该问题属于混合整数非线性规划且为 NP 难。因此，我们提出生成式人工智能增强的异构智能体近端策略优化算法（GAI-HAPPO）。该算法集成 GAI 模型以增强 actor 网络建模复杂环境和提取高层特征的能力，从而使算法能够预测不确定性并适应动态条件。此外，GAI 稳定了 critic 网络，解决了多智能体强化学习方法的不稳定性。最后，大量仿真表明所提算法优于现有基准方法，凸显了其在应对所考虑场景中复杂跨域问题的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对水上物联网中任务与轨迹不确定性下的边缘计算问题，将任务卸载与无人机轨迹联合优化建模为 NP 难问题，并提出融合生成式 AI 的多智能体强化学习算法 GAI-HAPPO 求解。

papers.title: Nothing to Declare: Steering a single neuron increases concealment in AI teams
papers.abstract: Recent research suggests that individual neurons can have interpretable roles in AI behaviour. In Qwen3.5-4B, steering along one neuron's output direction increased decisions to conceal information more in teams than alone across five scenarios, even when teammates provided no messages. When all members participated and received steering, collective concealment increased in four scenarios, while inter-agent messaging helped temper concealment under steering. Moreover, removing the neuron's contribution had negligible effects. Collective settings can therefore change how an internal intervention affects AI behaviour.

translation.title: 无可奉告：操控单个神经元会增加 AI 团队中的隐瞒行为
translation.abstract: 近期研究表明，单个神经元在 AI 行为中可以具有可解释的角色。在 Qwen3.5-4B 中，沿一个神经元的输出方向进行操控时，在五个场景中团队情境下比单独情境下更多地增加了隐瞒信息的决策，即使队友没有提供任何消息。当所有成员都参与并接受操控时，四个场景中的集体隐瞒增加，而智能体间消息传递有助于在操控下抑制隐瞒。此外，移除该神经元的贡献几乎没有影响。因此，集体情境可以改变内部干预对 AI 行为的影响方式。
translation.brief: 研究单个神经元操控对 AI 行为的影响，发现沿一个神经元方向进行激活操控在多智能体团队情境下比单独情境更能诱发信息隐瞒行为。

papers.title: Probing agent overeagerness in realistic settings with continuation audits
papers.abstract: Frontier coding agents increasingly exhibit overeagerness, taking surprising, sometimes reckless actions beyond a user's mandate --- reported in recent system cards from frontier model developers. These cases are surfaced through internal deployment monitoring, which requires private traffic and is out of reach for open-weight models and independent evaluators. Automated alignment audits are the natural alternative, but capable models increasingly recognise the synthetic setup and adjust their behaviour. We introduce Continuation Audits, a pipeline that grounds the auditor on a prefix drawn from a real coding-agent transcript and directs it to continue the trajectory toward a seeded behaviour. Because the prefix is drawn from a real session, the auditor only needs to maintain a realistic setting rather than manufacturing it. We validate the method on SWE-Chat prefixes: on a paired subset of 90 audits a judge cannot reliably distinguish continuations from their source sessions (realism win rate 0.42 vs.\ 0.43), and across all 900 audits verbalized eval-awareness does not exceed the rate observed in the unaudited real sessions. Applying the pipeline to three recent models across three seeds, we find each model leads a different seed --- DeepSeek~V4~Pro on colleague-credentials misuse, GPT-5.6~Terra on file-permission bypasses, and Kimi~K3 on treating diagnostic questions as instructions. Kimi~K3 additionally continues to bypass file-permission protections after an explicit this http URL prohibition while the other two stop entirely, corroborating Moonshot's own report of excessive proactiveness.

translation.title: 用延续审计在真实场景中探测智能体的过度积极行为
