translation.abstract: 前沿编程智能体日益表现出过度积极（overeagerness）行为，即采取超出用户授权的、令人惊讶甚至鲁莽的行动——近期前沿模型开发者的系统卡中已有相关报告。这些案例通常通过内部部署监控发现，但这需要私有流量，对开源权重模型和独立评估者而言并不可行。自动化对齐审计是自然的替代方案，但能力强的模型越来越能识别合成场景并相应调整自身行为。我们提出延续审计（Continuation Audits），该流程将审计者锚定在取自真实编程智能体对话记录的前缀上，并引导其将轨迹延续至预设的种子行为。由于前缀来自真实会话，审计者只需维持真实场景，而无需人为制造场景。我们在 SWE-Chat 前缀上验证了该方法：在 90 次配对审计的子集上，裁判无法可靠地区分延续轨迹与原始会话（真实感胜率 0.42 对 0.43）；在全部 900 次审计中，言语化的评估意识（eval-awareness）比例不超过未审计真实会话中的水平。将该流程应用于三个近期模型、每种三个种子，我们发现每个模型在不同种子上表现突出——DeepSeek V4 Pro 在同事凭证滥用上，GPT-5.6 Terra 在文件权限绕过上，Kimi K3 在将诊断性问题当作指令上。此外，Kimi K3 在收到明确的禁止指令后仍继续绕过文件权限保护，而另外两个模型则完全停止，这印证了 Moonshot 自身关于过度主动性的报告。
translation.brief: 解决自动化对齐审计中模型能识别合成场景的问题，提出将审计者锚定在真实智能体对话前缀上并引导其延续至种子行为的延续审计流程。

papers.title: Harvesting Expert-Parallel Bubbles for Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract: GPUs are expensive, yet latency-critical large language model (LLM) inference leaves part of them idle. Colocation reclaims this capacity by running best-effort work, such as fine-tuning, alongside serving. Many leading LLMs now use a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, which adds a new source of idle time. Under expert parallelism, MoE experts are spread across GPUs, and because the router sends uneven numbers of tokens to each GPU, lightly loaded GPUs wait for the most loaded one. Even after applying load balancing solutions, such bubbles still take 8--13% of prefill time. We present BubbleTea, the first colocation system that leverages expert-parallel bubbles for fine-tuning. Unlike existing colocation systems, which make one scheduling decision for all GPUs per forward pass, BubbleTea predicts each GPU's bubble at every layer from the router's token assignment, and fills it with short chunks of fine-tuning work that reuse the weights already loaded for serving. We also introduce compiler passes that automatically derive these chunks from the served LLM as-is, without porting each model architecture to a separate training engine. Our evaluation on three MoE models, served on four A100 GPUs, shows that fine-tuning throughput with BubbleTea is 1.9--6.2$\times$ faster than with LLMStation, a state-of-the-art colocation system. BubbleTea keeps p90 inference latency within 10% of serving alone in 50 of 63 workloads, compared to 44 for LLMStation. On bursty production traces, BubbleTea trains 3.3$\times$ faster than LLMStation and 14$\times$ faster than a stock trainer colocated under CUDA MPS, with p90 inference latency staying within 7% of serving alone.

translation.title: 收割专家并行气泡用于微调
translation.abstract: GPU 价格昂贵，然而对延迟敏感的大语言模型（LLM）推理却使其部分处于空闲状态。协同部署（colocation）通过在推理服务旁运行尽力而为的工作（如微调）来回收这部分算力。许多领先的 LLM 现在采用混合专家（MoE）架构，这带来了新的空闲来源。在专家并行下，MoE 专家分布在多个 GPU 上，由于路由器向各 GPU 发送的 token 数量不均，负载轻的 GPU 需等待负载最重的 GPU。即使应用了负载均衡方案，这类气泡仍占预填充时间的 8–13%。我们提出 BubbleTea，这是首个利用专家并行气泡进行微调的协同部署系统。与现有协同部署系统在每次前向传播时为所有 GPU 做统一调度决策不同，BubbleTea 根据路由器的 token 分配预测每层每个 GPU 的气泡，并用复用服务端已加载权重的短微调任务块来填充气泡。我们还引入了编译器 pass，可直接从被服务的 LLM 自动派生这些任务块，无需将每个模型架构移植到单独的训练引擎。在四个 A100 GPU 上服务三个 MoE 模型的评估显示，BubbleTea 的微调吞吐量比最先进的协同部署系统 LLMStation 快 1.9–6.2 倍。BubbleTea 在 63 个工作负载中的 50 个里将 p90 推理延迟保持在单独服务的 10% 以内，而 LLMStation 为 44 个。在突发性生产负载轨迹上，BubbleTea 训练速度比 LLMStation 快 3.3 倍，比在 CUDA MPS 下协同部署的原生训练器快 14 倍，且 p90 推理延迟保持在单独服务的 7% 以内。
translation.brief: 解决 MoE 专家并行推理中 GPU 空闲气泡浪费的问题，提出根据路由器 token 分配逐层预测气泡并用复用服务权重的微调任务块填充的协同部署系统 BubbleTea。

papers.title: ABSClaw: From Invented Worlds to Reality-Grounded Social Simulation
papers.abstract: LLM-based artificial societies exhibit rich behavior but often lack scientific grounding: personas and environments are assumed, interaction networks are synthetic, and simulators are generated as free-form code, making results difficult to tie to real populations and sensitive to the backbone model. We argue that simulated worlds should be sampled from observed data, while simulation logic should be implemented by composing operations from a shared, task-independent vocabulary. In this paper, we introduce ABSClaw, a zero-code agent that compiles natural-language requests into executable, reality-grounded social simulations. ABSClaw grounds who acts, where they act, and with whom they interact in survey and census data, geospatial sources, and real networks. It expresses state transitions through 26 atomic operations. To support an open and extensible ecosystem, ABSClaw further allows capabilities to be added as lifecycle-scoped skills without modifying its core. Furthermore, we propose ABSBench, a benchmark of 193 real-world social-simulation tasks. On ABSBench, ABSClaw achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated social simulators. Three real-world case studies show that grounding personas, environments, and interaction networks each improves agreement with observed outcomes. With one runtime skill, ABSClaw executes 13 population-scale simulations, collectively involving 25 million agents. Together, these results demonstrate ABSClaw's real-world fidelity, extensibility, and scalability.

translation.title: ABSClaw：从虚构世界到扎根现实的社会模拟
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的人工社会展现出丰富的行为，但往往缺乏科学依据：人物设定和环境是假设的，交互网络是合成的，模拟器以自由格式代码生成，导致结果难以与真实人群关联，且对骨干模型敏感。我们认为，模拟世界应从观测数据中采样，而模拟逻辑应通过组合来自共享的、任务无关词汇表的操作来实现。本文提出 ABSClaw，一个零代码智能体，可将自然语言请求编译为可执行的、扎根现实的社会模拟。ABSClaw 将谁行动、在哪里行动以及与谁交互扎根于调查和人口普查数据、地理空间信息源和真实网络中。它通过 26 个原子操作来表达状态转移。为支持开放且可扩展的生态系统，ABSClaw 还允许以生命周期作用域的技能形式添加能力，而无需修改其核心。此外，我们提出 ABSBench，一个包含 193 个真实世界社会模拟任务的基准。在 ABSBench 上，ABSClaw 在所评估的社会模拟器中取得最佳整体表现。三个真实世界案例研究表明，对人物设定、环境和交互网络分别进行现实扎根均能提升与观测结果的一致性。借助一个运行时技能，ABSClaw 执行了 13 项人口规模模拟，共涉及 2500 万个智能体。这些结果共同展示了 ABSClaw 的现实保真度、可扩展性和可伸缩性。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 人工社会模拟缺乏现实依据的问题，提出将人物、环境和交互网络扎根于真实数据并以原子操作组合模拟逻辑的零代码社会模拟智能体 ABSClaw。

papers.title: Towards Online Adaptive LLM-based Semantic Filtering
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable semantic filtering over unstructured documents using natural language predicates, but invoking an oracle LLM on every document incurs prohibitive monetary cost and online latency. Existing model-cascade approaches reduce this cost by using a lightweight proxy model to score each document and forwarding only uncertain documents to the oracle. However, their proxy models have limited generalization capability, and they typically adopt fixed sampling budgets for proxy training and threshold calibration, which insufficiently adapts to diverse online queries. To address this, we present OASIS, an online adaptive framework for LLM-based semantic filtering. OASIS combines a query-agnostic document similarity prior with query-adaptive online learning and sampling. In the offline phase, OASIS utilizes query-agnostic document similarity as a prior and constructs a document navigating spread-out graph (NSG) over document embeddings. For each online query, OASIS trains a query-conditioned graph attention network over the document NSG to obtain proxy scores through semi-supervised node classification. To allocate labels effectively, OASIS adopts density-aware active learning to explore uncertain score regions, selectively annotate informative documents, retrain the proxy, and stop early when additional labels are unlikely to improve the cascade. During threshold calibration, OASIS progressively samples an adaptively sized calibration set, adapting calibration cost to the query's score distribution. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OASIS achieves a 1.75x-5.42x reduction in online latency and reduces the number of LLM-processed documents by 35%-75% relative to the state-of-the-art methods at an achieved accuracy of 0.9.

translation.title: 迈向在线自适应的基于 LLM 的语义过滤
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能够使用自然语言谓词对非结构化文档进行语义过滤，但对每个文档都调用 oracle LLM 会带来高昂的金钱成本和在线延迟。现有的模型级联方法通过轻量代理模型为每个文档打分、仅将不确定的文档转发给 oracle 来降低成本。然而，其代理模型泛化能力有限，且通常为代理训练和阈值校准采用固定采样预算，难以充分适应多样的在线查询。为此，我们提出 OASIS，一个用于 LLM 语义过滤的在线自适应框架。OASIS 将查询无关的文档相似性先验与查询自适应的在线学习和采样相结合。在离线阶段，OASIS 利用查询无关的文档相似性作为先验，在文档嵌入上构建文档导航展开图（NSG）。对每个在线查询，OASIS 在文档 NSG 上训练查询条件化的图注意力网络，通过半监督节点分类获得代理分数。为有效分配标注，OASIS 采用密度感知的主动学习来探索不确定的分数区域，选择性地标注信息量大的文档、重新训练代理，并在额外标注不太可能改进级联时提前停止。在阈值校准阶段，OASIS 逐步采样自适应大小的校准集，使校准成本适应查询的分数分布。大量实验表明，在达到 0.9 准确率的情况下，OASIS 相比最先进方法将在线延迟降低 1.75–5.42 倍，并将 LLM 处理的文档数量减少 35%–75%。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 语义过滤中代理模型泛化差、采样预算固定的问题，提出结合文档相似性先验、查询自适应图神经网络代理与主动学习的在线自适应级联框架 OASIS。

papers.title: ProbMedTOD: A Bayesian Network Guided Task-Oriented Dialogue System for Patient History Taking
papers.abstract: Patient history taking is a strategic, multi-turn process that refines diagnostic hypotheses through iterative questioning, mirroring clinical reasoning where each inquiry updates beliefs over candidate diagnoses. Deploying AI in this setting is constrained by privacy, cost, and latency, making Small Language Models (SLMs) a more desirable backbone compared to larger LLMs. However, SLMs capture only the fast, intuitive "System 1" side of this process and lack explicit mechanisms for the deliberative "System 2" reasoning needed to maintain and update diagnostic uncertainty over time. Bayesian Networks (BayesNets) offer a natural complement, providing an interpretable framework for auditable probabilistic belief tracking. Yet, clinical BayesNets are difficult to construct due to their reliance on expert curated structure, dependencies, and parameters. We introduce ProbMedTOD, which automatically synthesizes a clinical BayesNet from a small number of clinical notes in three stages: ontology building, structure prediction, and parameter estimation. ProbMedTOD then integrates the resulting BayesNet with SLMs, enabling probabilistic reasoning in multi-turn dialogues. A BayesNet Agent maintains real-time posterior distributions over diagnoses, while a Policy Agent picks diagnostically informative questions. Experiments on DDXPlus and MIMIC-IV Notes show that ProbMedTOD outperforms LLM-only and retrieval-based baselines, with especially strong gains for smaller models.

translation.title: ProbMedTOD：一种贝叶斯网络引导的面向患者问诊的任务型对话系统
translation.abstract: 患者病史采集是一个策略性的多轮过程，通过迭代提问来细化诊断假设，类似于临床推理中每次询问都会更新对候选诊断的信念。在此场景中部署 AI 受到隐私、成本和延迟的约束，使得小语言模型（SLM）比更大的 LLM 更为理想。然而，SLM 只能捕捉该过程中快速、直觉的“系统 1”一面，缺乏维护和更新诊断不确定性所需的深思熟虑的“系统 2”推理的显式机制。贝叶斯网络（BayesNets）提供了天然的补充，为可审计的概率信念追踪提供了可解释的框架。然而，临床 BayesNets 依赖专家手工构建结构、依赖关系和参数，难以构建。我们提出 ProbMedTOD，它通过三个阶段——本体构建、结构预测和参数估计——从少量临床笔记中自动合成临床 BayesNet。ProbMedTOD 随后将所得 BayesNet 与 SLM 集成，在多轮对话中实现概率推理。一个 BayesNet 智能体实时维护诊断的后验分布，而一个策略智能体选择具有诊断信息量的问题。在 DDXPlus 和 MIMIC-IV Notes 上的实验表明，ProbMedTOD 优于仅用 LLM 和基于检索的基线，对更小的模型增益尤为显著。
translation.brief: 解决 SLM 缺乏显式诊断不确定性推理机制的问题，提出从少量临床笔记自动合成贝叶斯网络并与 SLM 集成以引导多轮问诊的 ProbMedTOD 系统。

papers.title: Beyond Appearance: Evidence-Guided Programmatic 3D Scene Reconstruction with Agentic Lighting Reasoning
papers.abstract: Image-to-code methods for 3D scene reconstruction produce executable code that generates editable digital content and supports visual simulation. However, existing methods primarily rely on appearance similarity, which provides limited guidance for distinguishing errors in geometry, materials, and illumination. Light shapes scene appearance through its interactions with geometry and materials, influencing shading, cast shadows, and reflections. We therefore present LightHarness, a VLM-based agentic framework that incorporates explicit lighting reasoning into iterative scene reconstruction. To be specific, we leverage complementary geometric, intrinsic, and illumination cues to jointly refine scene structure and appearance, and propose Lighting Reasoning Memory to maintain light-source hypotheses, which supports evidence, and revision history throughout iterations. Together, they support reasoning about partially visible and unseen sources, with evidence-guided verification directing subsequent revisions. Our framework reconstructs explicit scenes through coherent reasoning about geometry, materials, and illumination without additional training or differentiable rendering. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior image-to-code reconstruction accuracy under challenging shadows and complex illumination, further supporting downstream scene editing, object insertion, and versatile relighting.

translation.title: 超越外观：基于智能体光照推理的证据引导程序化三维场景重建
translation.abstract: 面向三维场景重建的图像到代码方法能够生成可执行代码，从而产生可编辑的数字内容并支持视觉仿真。然而，现有方法主要依赖外观相似性，这对区分几何、材质和光照方面的错误提供的指导有限。光通过与几何和材质的相互作用塑造场景外观，影响着色、投影阴影和反射。因此，我们提出 LightHarness，一个基于 VLM 的智能体框架，将显式的光照推理融入迭代式场景重建。具体而言，我们利用互补的几何、内在属性和光照线索来联合优化场景结构与外观，并提出 Lighting Reasoning Memory 来维护光源假设、支持证据和修订历史，贯穿整个迭代过程。二者共同支持对部分可见和不可见光源的推理，并由证据引导的验证指导后续修订。我们的框架通过对几何、材质和光照的连贯推理来重建显式场景，无需额外训练或可微渲染。大量实验表明，该方法在具有挑战性的阴影和复杂光照下取得了卓越的图像到代码重建精度，并进一步支持下游的场景编辑、物体插入和多样化重光照。
translation.brief: 针对图像到代码场景重建中外观相似性难以区分几何、材质与光照错误的问题，提出基于 VLM 的智能体框架 LightHarness，通过显式光照推理与光照推理记忆进行证据引导的迭代重建。

papers.title: Large Language Models or AI Agents for English to Arabic Translation? An assessment on WikiEn-Ar190
papers.abstract: This research investigates whether a large language model or an autonomous AI Agent performs better at translating from English to Arabic, which is considered a low-resource language. The authors introduce WikiEn-Ar190, a new dataset of 190 carefully selected Wikipedia articles from 18 different areas, which were created and verified by two native Arabic speakers to ensure that they accurately reflect both meaning and style. Using this dataset, the study evaluates the translation quality of GPT-5-mini both as an independent neural translator and when used within a more complex process that includes self-assessment and improvement. As a standalone model, GPT-5-mini produced very fluent translations , achieving a COMET score of 0.8649 and receiving high human scores for adequacy, fluency, and style (averaging 4.53 out of 5). When used in a system that combined translation with self-assessment, it improved lexical accuracy by 28.76% (BLEU score of 22.83) while maintaining a similar level of semantic quality. These findings show that methods involving autonomous reasoning can improve translation consistency for language pairs with limited resources. Beyond the results, the approach offers a framework for evaluating and improving translations, potentially using them as assisting tools to expand the representation of low resource languages, such as Arabic, on the web.

translation.title: 用大语言模型还是 AI 智能体做英阿翻译？基于 WikiEn-Ar190 的评估
translation.abstract: 本研究考察大语言模型与自主 AI 智能体在将英语翻译为阿拉伯语（一种低资源语言）时孰优孰劣。作者提出了 WikiEn-Ar190，一个包含 190 篇精心挑选的维基百科文章的新数据集，覆盖 18 个不同领域，由两位阿拉伯语母语者创建并校验，以确保其准确反映意义与风格。基于该数据集，研究评估了 GPT-5-mini 作为独立神经翻译器的翻译质量，以及将其置于包含自我评估与改进的更复杂流程中的表现。作为独立模型，GPT-5-mini 生成了非常流畅的译文，COMET 得分为 0.8649，在充分性、流畅性和风格上获得较高的人工评分（平均 4.53/5）。在结合翻译与自我评估的系统中，其词汇准确率提升了 28.76%（BLEU 得分 22.83），同时保持了相近的语义质量。这些发现表明，涉及自主推理的方法可以提升资源受限语言对的翻译一致性。除结果之外，该方法还提供了一个评估和改进翻译的框架，有望作为辅助工具扩展阿拉伯语等低资源语言在互联网上的呈现。
translation.brief: 针对英语到阿拉伯语（低资源语言）的翻译质量评估问题，构建 WikiEn-Ar190 数据集，比较 GPT-5-mini 独立翻译与结合自我评估的智能体式翻译流程的表现。

papers.title: Think Offline, Act in Real Time: Self-Improving Visual Game Agents through Code
papers.abstract: Pre-trained models can read screens and reason about games, yet on an unfamiliar game, an agent still has to learn to play. We ask how an agent can self-improve on such a game from a few of its own attempts, in real-time visual games where the agent sees only the screen and the game keeps running while the agent thinks. We study two kinds of policy that can carry this improvement. In model as policy, a model selects actions during play; we adapt real-time chunking so that committed actions keep executing while the model reasons, and train a 2B controller for this interface. In code as policy, a model writes, tests, and revises a program between attempts, and the program acts during play. Across 170 GameWorld tasks, with at most eight one-minute executions per run, code as policy reaches 47.80% mean progress, against 30.90% for our trained controller, and leads in all five game categories. Improving the controller's weights on a single game, by contrast, yields only modest gains. These results favor letting a model think offline and storing what it learns in a program that acts in real time. Project repository: this https URL

translation.title: 离线思考，实时行动：通过代码实现自我改进的视觉游戏智能体
translation.abstract: 预训练模型可以读取屏幕并对游戏进行推理，但在一个陌生的游戏中，智能体仍需学会如何游玩。我们探讨智能体如何仅凭少数几次自身尝试在游戏中自我改进，尤其是在实时视觉游戏中——智能体只能看到屏幕，且在它思考时游戏仍在持续运行。我们研究了两种能够承载这种改进的策略。在“模型即策略”中，模型在对局期间选择动作；我们适配了实时分块执行，使已提交的动作在模型推理时继续执行，并为此接口训练了一个 2B 控制器。在“代码即策略”中，模型在多次尝试之间编写、测试和修订程序，由程序在对局期间执行动作。在 170 个 GameWorld 任务上，每次运行最多八次一分钟执行，代码即策略达到 47.80% 的平均进度，而训练的控制器为 30.90%，且在全部五个游戏类别中均领先。相比之下，在单一游戏上改进控制器权重仅带来有限收益。这些结果支持让模型离线思考，并将其所学存储在可实时行动的程序中。项目仓库：this https URL
translation.brief: 针对智能体在陌生实时视觉游戏中仅凭少量尝试自我改进的问题，比较“模型即策略”与“代码即策略”两种方案，发现让模型离线思考并将所学存入实时执行的程序更为有效。

papers.title: GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) and LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed, monitoring their behavior becomes important for detecting unsafe or unintended actions. Activation probes offer an efficient approach, but existing methods face trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, and computational overhead. Probes on raw activations lack interpretable inputs, whereas sparse autoencoder (SAE) probes use interpretable features but often rely on additive classifiers and large SAE encoders, limiting interpretability and increasing memory overhead. We introduce GateWatch, a compact, interpretable classifier that expresses its entire decision rule as an explicit Boolean logic over a small number of binarized SAE features. We explore three approaches to constructing these circuits under a specified gate budget. For efficient deployment, GateWatchServe computes only selected SAE features, enables streaming of their binary values across layers during inference, and evaluates multiple GateWatch classifiers in parallel using compact lookup tables. Across 24 tasks on Gemma-2-9B, GateWatch achieves 80.49% mean test accuracy using only 3.8 SAE features and 3.5 logic gates per probe on average, just 1.17 percentage points below full 16K-feature SAE probes, while matching or outperforming them on 10 tasks and reducing probe memory by 99.98%. Inside vLLM, 1,000 concurrent multi-layer, multi-token GateWatch classifiers retain 97-98% of baseline throughput and 99.8% of KV-cache capacity.

translation.title: GateWatch：基于布尔电路的低开销 LLM 监控
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）及基于 LLM 的智能体日益广泛部署，监控其行为对于检测不安全或非预期动作变得十分重要。激活探针提供了一种高效途径，但现有方法在准确性、可解释性和计算开销之间存在权衡。基于原始激活的探针缺乏可解释的输入，而稀疏自编码器（SAE）探针虽使用可解释特征，却常依赖加性分类器和大型 SAE 编码器，限制了可解释性并增加内存开销。我们提出 GateWatch，一种紧凑且可解释的分类器，其整个决策规则被表达为对少量二值化 SAE 特征的显式布尔逻辑。我们在给定门预算下探索了三种构建这些电路的方法。为高效部署，GateWatchServe 仅计算选定的 SAE 特征，支持在推理过程中跨层流式传输其二值化值，并使用紧凑查找表并行评估多个 GateWatch 分类器。在 Gemma-2-9B 的 24 个任务上，GateWatch 平均仅使用 3.8 个 SAE 特征和 3.5 个逻辑门即达到 80.49% 的平均测试准确率，仅比完整 16K 特征 SAE 探针低 1.17 个百分点，在 10 个任务上持平或更优，同时将探针内存减少 99.98%。在 vLLM 内部，1,000 个并发的多层、多 token GateWatch 分类器仍保持基线吞吐量的 97-98% 和 KV-cache 容量的 99.8%。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 行为监控中激活探针在准确性、可解释性与开销之间的权衡问题，提出 GateWatch，将决策规则表达为少量二值化 SAE 特征上的显式布尔电路，实现低内存、高吞吐的监控。

papers.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
papers.abstract: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation. Clover adapts Gated Delta Networks to block diffusion by combining recurrent memory of previously generated context with bidirectional softmax attention inside the current block. Historical memory readout competes with current-block tokens in a shared softmax, with learnable block-size calibration and a separate, zero-initialized right-context convolution branch. Clover leads the seven evaluated agent metrics, including 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1. On internal agent workloads, it reaches a reported generation speed of 680 tokens/s using one NVIDIA GB300 GPU at BF16 precision and batch size one. We organize the evaluation around model quality, drafting and verification costs, and deployment under constrained memory. We also describe a decision-model variant that generates answers to related questions in one denoising pass. On an internal set of 500 groups, joint prediction raises question accuracy from 90.37% to 93.88% and all-correct group accuracy from 65.4% to 77.0%.

translation.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview 技术报告
translation.abstract: 我们推出 Clover-35B-A3B-Preview（Clover），一个混合专家扩散语言模型，总参数量 350 亿、激活参数量 30 亿，支持思考模式生成。Clover 将 Gated Delta Networks 适配到块扩散中，将先前生成上下文的循环记忆与当前块内的双向 softmax 注意力相结合。历史记忆读取与当前块 token 在共享 softmax 中竞争，并配有可学习的块大小校准以及一个独立的、零初始化的右上下文卷积分支。Clover 在七项评估的智能体指标中均居首位，包括 SWE-bench Verified 上的 73.6 和 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上的 51.7。在内部智能体工作负载上，它使用单块 NVIDIA GB300 GPU、BF16 精度、批大小为 1 时，报告的生成速度达 680 tokens/s。我们围绕模型质量、起草与验证成本以及受限内存下的部署来组织评估。我们还描述了一个决策模型变体，可在一次去噪过程中生成相关问题的答案。在内部 500 组数据集上，联合预测将问题准确率从 90.37% 提升至 93.88%，全对组准确率从 65.4% 提升至 77.0%。
translation.brief: 介绍 350 亿总参数、30 亿激活参数的混合专家扩散语言模型 Clover，通过将 Gated Delta Networks 的循环记忆与块内双向注意力结合，实现高质量且高速的智能体与决策生成。

papers.title: Choosing the Right Representations: Task-Aware Fusion for Multimodal Materials Language Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal language models for materials science rely on effective mechanisms for incorporating three-dimensional structural representations. MatterChat addresses this challenge using a large bridge module between a pretrained structural encoder and the LLM, together with a separate contrastive alignment stage. We instead ask whether this bridge can adaptively select and combine representations from multiple structural encoders according to the target property. We find that supervised and generative material encoders provide complementary information for property prediction. We found that, for Zatom-1, this information is not concentrated in the final layer. Instead, the most informative representations occur at different depths depending on the target property. This motivates Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion (TCAF), a lightweight attention-based bridge that uses task-conditioned latent queries to combine CHGNet features with intermediate Zatom-1 representations. The bridge is trained directly on downstream prediction tasks, allowing representation selection and material-language alignment to be learned jointly without separate contrastive pretraining. Across classification and regression tasks, TCAF outperforms MatterChat, with up to 47.8% lower RMSE, while using substantially fewer trainable parameters and halving the overall training time. Further experiments incorporating UMA-S demonstrate TCAF's flexibility across encoder combinations, with the three-encoder configuration achieving the highest macro-average classification accuracy of 89.61%.

translation.title: 选择正确的表示：面向多模态材料语言模型的任务感知融合
translation.abstract: 面向材料科学的多模态语言模型依赖于将三维结构表示有效融入模型中的机制。MatterChat 通过在预训练结构编码器与 LLM 之间使用一个大型桥接模块，以及一个独立的对比对齐阶段来应对这一挑战。我们则提出另一个问题：该桥接模块能否根据目标性质自适应地选择并组合来自多个结构编码器的表示。我们发现监督式与生成式材料编码器为性质预测提供了互补信息。我们发现，对于 Zatom-1，这些信息并不集中在最后一层；相反，最有信息量的表示出现在不同深度，取决于目标性质。这促使我们提出任务条件化注意力融合（Task-Conditioned Attention Fusion, TCAF），这是一种轻量级的基于注意力的桥接模块，使用任务条件化的潜在查询将 CHGNet 特征与 Zatom-1 的中间层表示相结合。该桥接模块直接在下游预测任务上训练，使表示选择与材料-语言对齐能够联合学习，而无需单独的对比预训练。在分类与回归任务上，TCAF 优于 MatterChat，RMSE 最高降低 47.8%，同时可训练参数大幅减少，训练时间减半。进一步引入 UMA-S 的实验表明 TCAF 在不同编码器组合上的灵活性，其中三编码器配置取得了 89.61% 的最高宏平均分类准确率。
translation.brief: 针对多模态材料语言模型中结构表示融合的问题，提出任务条件化注意力融合（TCAF），用轻量级注意力桥接自适应组合多个结构编码器在不同深度的表示，并与语言对齐联合训练。

papers.title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. With training recipes comprising hundreds of thousands of examples, data selection and feedback-driven refinement are central to the self-improvement process. Our large-scale RSI exploration yields three counter-intuitive insights for decision-model development: (1) Backbone-recipe co-adaptation outweighs raw model recency: earlier backbones can surpass newer generations on visual tasks under identical recipes; (2) Targeted data curation enables 4B-9B models to rival 27B baselines on specialized workflows; and (3) Continuous loss reduction can decouple from and even degrade discrete decision accuracy. Together with the released weights and tools from the Data-Juicer and AgentScope ecosystems, Piccolo provides an actionable blueprint for building frontier decision models and scaling data-driven RSI.

translation.title: Piccolo：通过递归自我改进协同进化决策模型与数据
translation.abstract: 我们提出 Piccolo，一个多模态决策模型家族（0.8B 至 27B），通过智能体数据工程（Agentic Data Engineering）与递归自我改进（RSI）协同进化模型能力与训练数据。这些模型针对通用文本与视觉判断、智能体框架、数据工作流和交互式游戏，对候选答案预测概率分布。Piccolo-27B 以 75.59 分登顶 Decision Index Vision Full 排行榜，Piccolo-9B 和 Piccolo-4B 分别取得 68.35 和 67.46。三者均在各自模型规模类别的 Private 基准上排名第一。研究智能体分析模型行为、构建训练数据、开展实验，并利用结果改进后续方案。语义切片与共享研究记忆将这些行动贯穿于模型家族的整个开发过程。在包含数十万样本的训练配方中，数据选择与反馈驱动的改进是自我改进过程的核心。我们的大规模 RSI 探索为决策模型开发带来三条反直觉的洞见：(1) 骨干-配方协同适应比模型新旧更重要：在相同配方下，较早的骨干在视觉任务上可超越更新的世代；(2) 有针对性的数据策展使 4B-9B 模型在专门工作流上可与 27B 基线抗衡；(3) 持续降低损失可能与离散决策准确率脱钩，甚至使其退化。结合 Data-Juicer 与 AgentScope 生态发布的权重与工具，Piccolo 为构建前沿决策模型和扩展数据驱动的 RSI 提供了可操作的蓝图。
translation.brief: 针对决策模型能力与训练数据共同提升的问题，提出 Piccolo 模型家族，通过智能体数据工程与递归自我改进让研究智能体自动分析模型、构建数据并迭代优化。

papers.title: CurvDelta: Low-Curvature Delta Modeling For Surgical Learning and Unlearning
papers.abstract: A central challenge in adapting large language models (LLMs) is capability preservation: an adaptation can achieve its target while degrading general capabilities. We introduce CurvDelta, a scalable framework that incorporates the preservation constraint into the parameterization of the model update. By analyzing the local geometry of the preservation constraint around the pre-adaptation model, CurvDelta constructs a low-curvature space in which parameter updates leave the preservation loss nearly invariant. We make its construction practical for LLMs through Kronecker-factored approximate curvature (K-FAC) and a factorized projection. We also introduce CurvLoRA, a low-rank variant within the same preservation geometry, designed for more efficient adaptation. Both methods apply to preservation-constrained adaptation tasks such as capability learning and selective unlearning. We evaluate our methods on mathematical reasoning, code generation, and knowledge unlearning. For mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approaches achieve competitive downstream performance while better preserving general capabilities, offering a favorable acquisition--retention trade-off relative to the baselines. For knowledge unlearning, our main results on TOFU and MUSE show a better balance between targeted forgetting and knowledge retention than the baselines, with retention performance close to the from-scratch retraining reference.

translation.title: CurvDelta：面向手术式学习与遗忘的低曲率增量建模
translation.abstract: 适配大语言模型（LLM）的一个核心挑战是能力保持：一次适配可能在达成目标的同时损害通用能力。我们提出 CurvDelta，一个可扩展的框架，将保持约束纳入模型更新的参数化之中。通过分析预适配模型附近保持约束的局部几何，CurvDelta 构造了一个低曲率空间，在该空间中参数更新几乎不改变保持损失。我们借助 Kronecker 分解近似曲率（K-FAC）与因子化投影，使其构造在 LLM 上切实可行。我们还提出 CurvLoRA，即同一保持几何下的低秩变体，旨在实现更高效的适配。两种方法均适用于能力学习与选择性遗忘等保持约束下的适配任务。我们在数学推理、代码生成和知识遗忘上评估了这些方法。在数学推理与代码生成上，我们的方法在取得有竞争力的下游性能的同时更好地保持了通用能力，相对基线提供了更优的获取-保持权衡。在知识遗忘上，我们在 TOFU 和 MUSE 上的主要结果显示，相比基线在定向遗忘与知识保持之间取得了更好的平衡，其保持性能接近从头重训的参考水平。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 适配中目标能力提升与通用能力保持的冲突，提出 CurvDelta，利用 K-FAC 构造低曲率更新空间使参数更新几乎不影响保持损失，并提供低秩变体 CurvLoRA。

papers.title: Metadata-Driven AI: An Architectural Pattern for Sustainable Data Analysis with LLMs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) let users analyse data in natural language, either by giving the data to the model to read directly or by having the model generate code to process it. Both routes send the data, or fragments of it, to the model; both pay for inference on every run; and the code a model writes to answer a question is usually discarded once the question is answered. We present Metadata-Driven AI, an architectural pattern that keeps the data away from the model and turns each analysis into a reusable program. Only metadata (not the actual data) crosses a one-way inference boundary to the LLM. The program the LLM returns runs next to the data and is kept, so that inference is paid once per analysis rather than once per run. We describe the pattern together with a simple cost model, a measurement of how little information crosses the boundary on public datasets, and a benchmark showing that a small, locally hosted model can serve as the generator. We illustrate the pattern on three applications, each built on a different implementation of it: geospatial photovoltaic prospection over live public APIs, extraction of portfolio positions from bank statements, and a conversational assistant over smart-city dashboards.

translation.title: 元数据驱动的 AI：一种基于 LLM 的可持续数据分析架构模式
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）让用户能够用自然语言分析数据，方式要么是把数据直接交给模型阅读，要么让模型生成代码来处理数据。两种方式都会把数据或其片段发送给模型；两种方式都要为每次运行支付推理成本；而且模型为回答问题所写的代码通常在问题解答后即被丢弃。我们提出元数据驱动的 AI（Metadata-Driven AI），一种让数据远离模型并将每次分析转化为可复用程序的架构模式。只有元数据（而非实际数据）跨越单向推理边界进入 LLM。LLM 返回的程序在数据旁边运行并被保留下来，因此推理成本按每次分析支付一次，而非每次运行支付一次。我们描述了该模式以及一个简单的成本模型、对公开数据集上跨越边界信息量之少的测量，以及一个表明小型本地托管模型即可充当生成器的基准。我们通过三个应用展示该模式，每个应用基于其不同实现：基于实时公开 API 的地理空间光伏选址、从银行对账单中提取投资组合持仓，以及面向智慧城市仪表盘的对话助手。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 数据分析中数据传输与重复推理成本高的问题，提出元数据驱动架构：只向模型发送元数据，让模型生成可复用、保留在数据侧的分析程序。

papers.title: Can Bandits Learn to Share a Channel? Distributed Multi-Armed Bandits for Slotted ALOHA
papers.abstract: Slotted ALOHA networks constitute a playground for research on machine learning (ML)-based channel access schemes. We consider ML agents deployed in such networks and operating under severe constraints: fully distributed (independent operation), fully online (no pre-training), aperiodic (no fixed schedule), and with no explicit coordination (no signaling). We ask whether a multi-armed bandit (MAB), a minimal reinforcement learning agent, can learn the optimal policy for a capture-free slotted ALOHA system. We evaluate several MAB algorithms on aggregate network throughput and per-node fairness. Our best-performing agent is based on a Softmax bandit, which we call SALSA (Softmax ALOHA Learning for Shared Access). SALSA learns a per-node transmission policy close to optimal, with throughput near the theoretical maximum for fair random access. We achieve performance comparable to a competing state-of-the-art solution, but without requiring a priori knowledge of the network size.

translation.title: 老虎机能学会共享信道吗？面向时隙 ALOHA 的分布式多臂老虎机
translation.abstract: 时隙 ALOHA 网络是基于机器学习（ML）的信道接入方案研究的试验场。我们考虑部署在此类网络中并处于严苛约束下的 ML 智能体：完全分布式（独立运行）、完全在线（无预训练）、非周期性（无固定调度）且无显式协调（无信令）。我们探究多臂老虎机（MAB）这一最小化的强化学习智能体能否为无捕获的时隙 ALOHA 系统学到最优策略。我们在聚合网络吞吐量与每节点公平性上评估了多种 MAB 算法。表现最佳的智能体基于 Softmax 老虎机，我们称之为 SALSA（Softmax ALOHA Learning for Shared Access）。SALSA 学到的每节点传输策略接近最优，吞吐量接近公平随机接入的理论最大值。我们取得了与竞争性最先进方案相当的性能，但无需对网络规模的先验知识。
translation.brief: 针对分布式、无协调、无先验知识的时隙 ALOHA 信道接入问题，提出基于 Softmax 老虎机的 SALSA 算法，让各节点在线学习接近最优的传输策略。

papers.title: DrawScore: Evaluating Generated CAD Models against Engineering Drawings
papers.abstract: Automatic CAD generation is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU, Chamfer Distance, and surface F-score, which barely penalize local errors that occupy only a small fraction of a part's volume or surface area, such as a misplaced hole or a slot on the wrong face, even though such errors are critical to manufacturing. We formalize these metrics in a unified integral form and show that the weight of a local error decays as the $(k+q)$-th power of its size, where $k$ is the dimension of the integration domain and $q$ is determined by the penalty function. Guided by this analysis, we propose DrawScore, which projects both models into three orthographic views with visible and hidden lines, as in engineering drawings, and applies a saturating penalty along the projected curves, so that the weight of a local error decays only linearly. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted decay orders, and on outputs of existing CAD generation agents, DrawScore exposes errors in outputs that IoU rates as nearly perfect. DrawScore further improves generation as a reinforcement learning reward and, for CAD generation from engineering drawings, serves as a test-time verifier without 3D ground truth or an additional reward model. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: DrawScore：基于工程图纸评估生成的CAD模型
translation.abstract: 自动CAD生成通常用体积IoU、Chamfer距离和表面F-score来评估，这些指标几乎无法惩罚只占零件体积或表面积很小部分的局部错误，例如放错位置的孔或开在错误面上的槽，尽管这类错误对制造至关重要。我们将这些指标形式化为统一的积分形式，并证明局部错误的权重随其尺寸的$(k+q)$次幂衰减，其中$k$是积分域的维度，$q$由惩罚函数决定。基于这一分析，我们提出DrawScore，它将两个模型投影为带可见线和隐藏线的三视图（如同工程图纸），并沿投影曲线施加饱和惩罚，使局部错误的权重仅线性衰减。受控实验证实了预测的衰减阶数，并且在现有CAD生成智能体的输出上，DrawScore暴露了IoU评为近乎完美的输出中的错误。DrawScore还可作为强化学习奖励进一步改进生成，并且对于从工程图纸生成CAD的任务，可在没有3D真值或额外奖励模型的情况下充当测试时验证器。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对传统3D指标难以惩罚CAD模型局部小错误的问题，提出将模型投影为工程图纸三视图并施加饱和惩罚的DrawScore评估方法。

papers.title: Hi Gemini, Who Should I Vote For? The Benefits (and Problems) of Using LLMs As Voting Advice Applications
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can provide voters information about political issues, party positions, and even advise on which party to vote for. However, no previous study explores how well off-the-shelf LLMs function as voting advice applications (VAAs). In this article, we address this gap by examining how Gemini 3 Flash advises a sample of 6,022 German survey respondents on which party to vote for, based on their policy preferences and priorities alone. In brief, we find that for most respondents, following the LLM's advice would benefit voter-party policy alignment (i.e. congruence), with a significantly stronger remedial effect among voters with low levels of political interest and formal education. However, our analysis also reveals concerning biases in the LLM's recommendations. For instance, the LLM suggested voting for the AfD at approximately 1.5 times the frequency of a standard salience-weighted proximity model. In addition, the LLM hardly ever advised voting for either Die Linke or the BSW. We conclude that while LLMs can approximate the behaviour of VAAs, users should be aware that the LLM's recommendations are still biased in ways that are extremely difficult to trace.

translation.title: 嗨 Gemini，我该投票给谁？将LLM用作投票建议应用的收益（与问题）
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以为选民提供有关政治议题、政党立场的信息，甚至建议投票给哪个政党。然而，此前没有研究探讨现成的LLM作为投票建议应用（VAA）的效果如何。本文通过考察Gemini 3 Flash如何仅基于政策偏好和优先级，为6,022名德国调查受访者提供投票建议来填补这一空白。简言之，我们发现对大多数受访者而言，遵循LLM的建议会改善选民与政党之间的政策一致性（即契合度），且在政治兴趣和正规教育水平较低的选民中，这种补救效果显著更强。然而，我们的分析也揭示了LLM建议中令人担忧的偏见。例如，LLM建议投票给AfD的频率约为标准显著性加权邻近模型的1.5倍。此外，LLM几乎从不建议投票给Die Linke或BSW。我们的结论是，虽然LLM可以近似VAA的行为，但用户应意识到LLM的建议仍存在极难追溯的偏见。
translation.brief: 研究现成LLM作为投票建议应用的效果，通过让Gemini为德国受访者提供投票建议来分析其对选民-政党政策一致性的影响及推荐偏见。

papers.title: Depth Before Breadth: Reverse-to-Forward Curriculum with Advantage Decomposition for LLM Agent
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a common approach for training large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon tasks. However, learning from sparse terminal rewards makes credit assignment and exploration difficult. We approach these challenges through a policy-induced capability region, the set of states from which the current policy can reliably complete a task. Near its boundary, an agent may need only a few actions to reach a more solvable state, even when the goal remains distant. This reduces long-horizon learning to two coupled subproblems of reaching that state and completing the task from there. We address them with paired advantages and a progressive reverse-to-forward curriculum. The advantages provide separate signals for reaching more solvable states and completing the task from them, while the curriculum expands the capability region backward along successful reference trajectories and then into off-reference states through on-policy exploration. On ALFWorld and WebShop, our method outperforms competitive agentic RL methods at both model scales, achieving success rates of 90.1%/96.1% and 80.2%/82.6% with Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct, respectively.

translation.title: 先深度后广度：基于优势分解的逆向到正向课程学习用于LLM智能体
translation.abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为训练大语言模型（LLM）智能体完成长时程任务的常用方法。然而，从稀疏的终端奖励中学习使得信用分配和探索都很困难。我们通过策略诱导的能力区域——即当前策略能够可靠完成任务的 states 集合——来应对这些挑战。在能力区域边界附近，智能体可能只需几个动作就能到达一个更易求解的状态，即使目标仍然遥远。这将长时程学习简化为两个耦合的子问题：到达该状态以及从该状态完成任务。我们用成对优势和渐进的逆向到正向课程来解决它们：优势为到达更易求解的状态和从那里完成任务提供分离的信号，而课程先沿成功的参考轨迹向后扩展能力区域，再通过on-policy探索扩展到参考轨迹之外的状态。在ALFWorld和WebShop上，我们的方法在两个模型规模上均优于有竞争力的agentic RL方法，使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct分别取得90.1%/96.1%和80.2%/82.6%的成功率。
translation.brief: 针对长时程任务稀疏奖励下的信用分配与探索难题，提出基于策略诱导能力区域的成对优势分解与逆向到正向课程学习方法。

papers.title: When Does Continual Pre-Training Help? A Controlled Study of Dialectal Adaptation for Québec French
papers.abstract: Continual pre-training (CPT) is widely used to adapt pretrained language models to dialectal and non-standard language varieties, yet it remains unclear when this additional training is necessary, what drives its benefits, and whether aggregate evaluation scores adequately capture its effects. In this paper, we present a controlled study of CPT for Québec French language understanding across nine LLMs spanning different families and scales. Using a budget-matched protocol of 30M tokens per experiment, our results show that the benefit of CPT depends strongly on the starting model's existing competence in the target variety. When CPT is beneficial, the improvements are driven more by corpus composition than by data volume, with literary text accounting for most of the gain. Paired Québec and standard French evaluations further show that CPT primarily improves expression comprehension rather than grammatical competence, and that corpus register determines which regional expressions are acquired. These gains also involve capability-specific trade-offs, including declines in reading comprehension that aggregate scores can conceal. Overall, these findings show that CPT for dialectal adaptation should not be treated as a uniformly beneficial default. Instead, adaptation strategies should begin with a careful assessment of the base model's existing competence, accompanied by source-level data analysis and task-level evaluation.

translation.title: 持续预训练何时有效？魁北克法语方言适应的受控研究
translation.abstract: 持续预训练（CPT）被广泛用于将预训练语言模型适应到方言和非标准语言变体，但仍不清楚这种额外训练何时必要、其收益由什么驱动，以及总体评估分数能否充分反映其效果。本文对涵盖不同家族和规模的九个LLM进行了魁北克法语理解的CPT受控研究。使用每个实验30M token的预算匹配协议，我们的结果表明CPT的收益强烈依赖于起始模型对目标变体的既有能力。当CPT有效时，改进更多由语料构成而非数据量驱动，其中文学文本贡献了大部分收益。魁北克法语与标准法语的配对评估进一步表明，CPT主要提升表达理解而非语法能力，且语料语域决定了习得哪些地区性表达。这些收益还涉及特定能力的权衡，包括总体分数可能掩盖的阅读理解下降。总体而言，这些发现表明用于方言适应的CPT不应被视为普遍有益的默认选项；适应策略应从仔细评估基础模型的既有能力开始，并辅以源级数据分析和任务级评估。
translation.brief: 通过预算匹配的受控实验，研究持续预训练在魁北克法语方言适应中何时有效，发现收益取决于基线模型既有能力且主要由语料构成驱动。

papers.title: Can Omni-modal LLMs Understand Spoken Intentions?
papers.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (omni-modal LLMs) can respond to spoken requests directly through voice and video calls. Such requests rely on the scene shared by the user and the assistant, so the same utterance may call for different help or for no response. Most audio-visual benchmarks provide questions as separate text input, and interactive benchmarks mostly score a response as a whole. It thus remains unclear whether a model recognizes when the user is asking for help, and whether its reply meets the user's need once the request is recognized. We propose O-IN-Bench to evaluate how well omni-modal LLMs understand spoken intentions. A model watches a complete video with native speech and outputs one text response, or [SILENCE] when no response is needed. O-IN-Bench contains 1,000 Chinese and English samples in five categories and 16 subcategories. Contrastive pairs combine the same request with different scene conditions to test whether the response changes with the context. A sample-specific rubric judges language, intent, and content separately, and O-IN-Engine verifies each rubric against the video. Across 30 omni-modal model configurations, the best overall score is 59.6, achieved by Gemini3.7-Flash. Gemini3.7-Flash passes 74.4% of the intent judgments but only 42.6% of the content judgments. When the speech is a conversation between peers rather than a request to the assistant, even strong models often keep responding. When a reply must satisfy several people, the best score is only 25.9. These results indicate that recognizing a request and meeting its requirements are separate abilities, and O-IN-Bench measures each of them.

translation.title: 全模态LLM能理解口语意图吗？
translation.abstract: 全模态大语言模型（omni-modal LLM）可以通过语音和视频通话直接响应口头请求。这类请求依赖于用户与助手共享的场景，因此同一句话可能需要不同的帮助或无需回应。大多数视听基准将问题作为单独的文本输入提供，而交互式基准大多将回复作为整体评分。因此，模型是否能识别用户何时在求助，以及在识别请求后其回复是否满足用户需求，仍不清楚。我们提出O-IN-Bench来评估全模态LLM理解口语意图的能力。模型观看一段带母语语音的完整视频，输出一条文本回复，或在无需回应时输出[SILENCE]。O-IN-Bench包含1,000个中英文样本，分为五个类别和16个子类别。对比样本将相同请求与不同场景条件组合，以测试回复是否随上下文变化。样本特定的评分细则分别评判语言、意图和内容，O-IN-Engine根据视频验证每条细则。在30个全模态模型配置中，最佳总分为59.6，由Gemini3.7-Flash取得。Gemini3.7-Flash通过74.4%的意图判断，但仅有42.6%的内容判断。当语音是同伴之间的对话而非对助手的请求时，即使是强模型也常常继续回应。当回复必须满足多人需求时，最佳分数仅为25.9。这些结果表明，识别请求和满足其要求是两种独立的能力，而O-IN-Bench分别衡量这两种能力。
translation.brief: 针对全模态LLM能否理解口语意图缺乏评估的问题，提出包含对比样本和分项评分细则的O-IN-Bench基准，分别衡量请求识别与需求满足两种能力。

papers.title: Openhagen Worlds: Calibrated Environments for Measuring and Training Scientific Discovery Agents
papers.abstract: Agents that do science must choose informative experiments and reason from their results, but most discovery benchmarks cannot separate that skill from recall, unstated scoring rules or shortcut policies. We introduce Openhagen Worlds, a suite of 27 procedurally generated environments (some with finite truth spaces), from classic puzzles of experimental reasoning to simulator-grounded physics and chemistry, in which an agent runs experiments under a budget and commits an answer that a deterministic verifier checks against a hidden truth. Every observation states the complete scoring rule, and each of the 178 difficulty levels is calibrated: it is admitted only if, on 64 development instances, a scripted oracle succeeds on at least 0.75, the strongest plausible non-deductive policy on at most 0.25 and each gated shortcut on at most 0.35. The 92 core levels span all 27 families and are sized to train small models; the 86 frontier rungs extend the 15 discovery worlds with harder questions and with campaigns of three, five and eight or more committed stages on one hidden system. On the same 84 withheld frontier instances, one per family and rung, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solves 32 at its default reasoning effort with 16,384 tokens per call and 57 at its maximum effort with up to 393,216 tokens per call (oracle: 79); the headroom that remains is largest in eight-stage campaigns. On-policy expert iteration gives a 9B model modest gains: its core-tier success on trained families rises from 0.090 to 0.148, partly through better action format, with no detectable loss on GPQA Diamond. A hosted service plays the core tier's withheld instances.

translation.title: Openhagen Worlds：用于测量和训练科学发现智能体的校准环境
translation.abstract: 从事科学研究的智能体必须选择有信息量的实验并根据结果进行推理，但大多数发现类基准无法将这种能力与记忆、未明示的评分规则或捷径策略区分开。我们提出 Openhagen Worlds，一套包含 27 个程序化生成环境（部分具有有限真值空间）的套件，涵盖从经典的实验推理谜题到基于模拟器的物理和化学问题；智能体在预算内运行实验并提交答案，由确定性验证器对照隐藏真值进行检验。每个观测都完整说明评分规则，178 个难度级别均经过校准：只有在 64 个开发实例上，脚本化 oracle 成功率至少 0.75、最强的合理非演绎策略至多 0.25、且每个受控捷径至多 0.35 时，该级别才被收录。92 个核心级别覆盖全部 27 个环境族，规模适合训练小模型；86 个前沿级别在 15 个发现世界上扩展出更难的问题，以及在单个隐藏系统上进行三、五、八及以上提交阶段的多轮实验。在相同的 84 个保留前沿实例（每个环境族和级别各一个）上，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 在默认推理力度、每次调用 16,384 tokens 时解决 32 个，在最大推理力度、每次调用至多 393,216 tokens 时解决 57 个（oracle：79 个）；剩余的提升空间在八阶段任务中最大。在策略专家迭代使一个 9B 模型获得适度提升：其在已训练环境族上的核心级别成功率从 0.090 提升至 0.148，部分得益于更好的动作格式，且在 GPQA Diamond 上未检测到性能损失。我们还提供托管服务来运行核心级别的保留实例。
translation.brief: 针对现有科学发现基准无法区分真实实验推理能力与记忆或捷径策略的问题，构建了 27 个经校准的程序化环境套件，通过预算内实验、确定性验证和难度校准来测量与训练科学发现智能体。

papers.title: Interpersonal trust, institutional trust and trust in technology in Air Traffic Control
papers.abstract: Air traffic control (ATC), the safe, orderly and efficient management of planes through controlled airspace is a complex task. In this article, we explore the roles that different kinds of trust play in ATC. Our study provides the essential foundations for examining the conditions that need to be satisfied if Air Traffic Controllers are to establish and sustain trust relationships with technical innovations, such as agent-based systems, and so ensure their safe and dependable embedding within ATC work.

translation.title: 空中交通管制中的人际信任、制度信任与技术信任
translation.abstract: 空中交通管制（ATC）是对受控空域内飞机进行安全、有序和高效管理的复杂任务。本文探讨不同类型的信任在 ATC 中所扮演的角色。我们的研究为考察空中交通管制员与基于智能体的系统等技术革新建立并维持信任关系所需满足的条件奠定了基础，从而确保这些技术安全可靠地融入 ATC 工作之中。
translation.brief: 研究空中交通管制中不同类型信任的作用，为管制员与技术革新（如基于智能体的系统）建立信任关系提供基础。

papers.title: Meta-LSQ: A Closed-Form Sobolev Inner Solver for Few-Shot Meta-Learning
papers.abstract: Gradient-based meta-learners such as model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) adapt to a new task with an inner loop of gradient descent that has to be differentiated through, and they meta-learn every network weight. Meta-LSQ instead fits each task with one regularised least-squares solve over a fixed random Fourier basis and meta-learns only three scalars, a bandwidth, a ridge and a derivative weight. Since the derivative of a sinusoid is again a sinusoid, the same solve can also take derivative observations, and the fitted model has exact closed-form derivatives of any order. On 10-shot sinusoid regression Meta-LSQ trains in 14 s and ends with a 5.5 times lower error than a first-order MAML baseline that trains 36 times longer, and a Gaussian-process control suggests that most of this gain comes from sharing one kernel across tasks. In simulated beam tuning at DESY's ARES facility with model derivatives it is slightly more accurate than an ALPaCA-style model and well ahead of gradient descent. Over DESY's full range of target beams, again in simulation and from measurements alone, its best setting has a median error of 7.3 $\mu$m, against 14.4 for the published final beams of their reinforcement-learning agent, which has the lower median on their 300 trials of small targets. On real sensor-calibration data a learned prior mean puts it ahead of MAML on two of four targets, but an exact Gaussian process with the same change and an ALPaCA-style model stay more accurate on most targets, and it breaks down on non-smooth targets. On noiseless targets outside the span of the basis, in-sample criteria such as generalised cross-validation choose too small a ridge.

translation.title: Meta-LSQ：用于少样本元学习的闭式 Sobolev 内层求解器
translation.abstract: 基于梯度的元学习器（如模型无关元学习 MAML）通过需要求导的内层梯度下降循环来适应新任务，并对每个网络权重进行元学习。Meta-LSQ 则改为在固定的随机傅里叶基上通过一次正则化最小二乘求解来拟合每个任务，且仅元学习三个标量：带宽、岭参数和导数权重。由于正弦函数的导数仍是正弦函数，同一求解过程还可以利用导数观测，且拟合出的模型具有任意阶的精确闭式导数。在 10-shot 正弦回归上，Meta-LSQ 训练耗时 14 秒，最终误差比训练时长为其 36 倍的一阶 MAML 基线低 5.5 倍；高斯过程对照实验表明，这一提升主要来自跨任务共享同一核函数。在 DESY ARES 装置的模拟束流调谐（含模型导数）中，它比 ALPaCA 风格的模型略更准确，并显著优于梯度下降。在 DESY 的全部目标束流范围内（同样基于模拟且仅用测量数据），其最佳设置的中位误差为 7.3 微米，而其强化学习智能体已发表的最终束流中位误差为 14.4 微米（后者在其 300 次小目标试验中中位数更低）。在真实传感器校准数据上，学习到的先验均值使其在四个目标中的两个上优于 MAML，但具有相同改进的精确高斯过程和 ALPaCA 风格模型在大多数目标上仍更准确，且它在非平滑目标上会失效。在基函数张成范围之外的无噪声目标上，广义交叉验证等样本内准则会选择过小的岭参数。
translation.brief: 针对 MAML 等元学习器内层循环需反复求导且参数过多的问题，提出用固定随机傅里叶基上的一次正则化最小二乘闭式求解替代内层梯度下降，仅元学习三个标量。

papers.title: Mechanistic Critics for Sample-Efficient NPU Design-Space Exploration
papers.abstract: NPU design-space exploration for LLM inference mainly relies on an expensive simulator that often returns only scalar feedback such as latency and power. Such feedback can rank evaluated configurations, but gives little information for deciding why a configuration is slow or which architecture parameter should be changed next. This limitation is especially severe because prefill and decode workloads can be limited by different resources, including compute throughput and HBM bandwidth. We propose CriticNPU, a sample-efficient DSE framework built around an online-calibrated mechanistic critic for NPU architecture design. The critic uses explicit hardware limits to evaluate NPU configurations: before simulation, it estimates whether a proposed configuration is likely to improve over the current best and filters weak candidates; after simulation, it aggregates operator-level runtimes into prefill/decode bottleneck summaries and predicts the effect of candidate parameter changes. We instantiate the critic with a Roofline-style model that derives compute and memory limits from architecture parameters and calibrates per-operator-type effective limits using simulator observations. And CriticNPU combines this critic with a workload extractor and an architecture planner to propose configurations. Across six LLM workloads and 16 deployment configurations per model, CriticNPU achieves best-or-tied-best latency in 74% of prefill and 87.5% of decode settings while using roughly half the simulator calls of competitive DSE baselines. We conduct extensive ablation studies and detailed analyses to validate the effectiveness of our method from multiple perspectives. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 面向样本高效 NPU 设计空间探索的机制化评价器
translation.abstract: 面向 LLM 推理的 NPU 设计空间探索主要依赖昂贵的模拟器，而模拟器往往只返回延迟和功耗等标量反馈。这类反馈可以对已评估配置进行排序，但几乎无法提供关于配置为何慢、下一步应修改哪个架构参数的信息。由于 prefill 和 decode 工作负载可能受不同资源（包括计算吞吐量和 HBM 带宽）限制，这一局限尤为严重。我们提出 CriticNPU，一个围绕在线校准的机制化评价器构建的样本高效 NPU 架构设计 DSE 框架。该评价器利用显式硬件极限来评估 NPU 配置：在模拟之前，估计候选配置是否可能优于当前最优并过滤弱候选；在模拟之后，将算子级运行时间聚合为 prefill/decode 瓶颈摘要，并预测候选参数修改的效果。我们用 Roofline 风格的模型实例化该评价器，从架构参数推导计算和内存极限，并利用模拟器观测校准每种算子类型的有效极限。CriticNPU 将该评价器与工作负载提取器和架构规划器结合以提出配置。在六个 LLM 工作负载和每个模型 16 种部署配置上，CriticNPU 在 74% 的 prefill 和 87.5% 的 decode 设置中取得最优或并列最优延迟，同时使用的模拟器调用次数约为竞争性 DSE 基线的一半。我们进行了大量消融实验和详细分析，从多个角度验证了方法的有效性。代码见此 https URL。
translation.brief: 针对 NPU 设计空间探索中模拟器仅返回标量反馈、难以指导架构参数修改的问题，提出基于在线校准 Roofline 模型的机制化评价器来过滤候选并预测参数修改效果，从而减少模拟器调用。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Cyber-Physical Attack Path Identification in Smart Grids
papers.abstract: Identifying high-impact attack paths in cyber-physical power systems is critical for improving grid resilience. Existing methods typically rely on either structural topology analysis or simulation-based cascading-failure models. Topology-based approaches capture connectivity but lack adversarial reasoning, while simulation-driven methods are primarily suited for offline analysis and are less effective for rapid evaluation of evolving attack scenarios. As a result, identifying realistic attack paths that jointly capture topology, threat semantics, and physical impact remains challenging. This paper presents a physics-grounded framework for identifying cyber-physical attack paths using large language models (LLMs), with cascading-failure-derived impact rankings used as physics-grounded references. The framework integrates system topology, LLM-guided STRIDE and MITRE ATT&CK threat modeling, and three baseline strategies for comparison: topology-driven, threat-driven, and fusion-based. Evaluation is performed using (i) critical-node overlap between LLM-inferred top-K rankings and cascading-failure-based ground truth; (ii) node-level similarity between LLM-inferred and reference paths; and (iii) path-level alignment capturing agreement in complete attack sequences. Results show that structured LLM-based threat modeling substantially improves alignment with physics-grounded references. In the cyber layer, critical-node overlap@3 increases from approximately 33% to as high as 100%, while node-level similarity reaches up to 65% and path-level alignment reaches up to 48%. In addition, the proposed framework reduces runtime by approximately 75--85% compared to the fusion-based baseline in the IEEE 14-bus system. These results suggest that LLM-guided attack path identification is a promising approach for efficient and impact-aware cyber-physical security analysis.

translation.title: 基于 LLM 引导的智能电网信息物理攻击路径识别
translation.abstract: 在信息物理电力系统中识别高影响攻击路径对提升电网韧性至关重要。现有方法通常依赖结构拓扑分析或基于仿真的连锁故障模型。基于拓扑的方法能刻画连通性但缺乏对抗性推理，而仿真驱动的方法主要适用于离线分析，难以快速评估不断演化的攻击场景。因此，识别能同时兼顾拓扑、威胁语义和物理影响的现实攻击路径仍然具有挑战性。本文提出一个以物理为基础、使用大语言模型（LLM）识别信息物理攻击路径的框架，并以连锁故障推导的影响排序作为物理依据的参考。该框架整合系统拓扑、LLM 引导的 STRIDE 和 MITRE ATT&CK 威胁建模，以及三种对比基线策略：拓扑驱动、威胁驱动和融合式。评估采用：(i) LLM 推断的 top-K 排序与基于连锁故障的真值之间的关键节点重合度；(ii) LLM 推断路径与参考路径的节点级相似度；(iii) 衡量完整攻击序列一致性的路径级对齐度。结果表明，结构化的基于 LLM 的威胁建模显著提升了与物理依据参考的对齐度。在网络层，关键节点 overlap@3 从约 33% 提升至最高 100%，节点级相似度最高达 65%，路径级对齐度最高达 48%。此外，在 IEEE 14 节点系统上，所提框架相比融合式基线将运行时间缩短约 75–85%。这些结果表明，LLM 引导的攻击路径识别是一种高效且兼顾影响的信息物理安全分析的有前景方法。
translation.brief: 针对现有攻击路径识别方法难以兼顾拓扑、威胁语义与物理影响的问题，提出利用 LLM 进行结构化威胁建模并结合连锁故障影响排序来识别信息物理攻击路径的框架。

papers.title: Isabelle Pool Server: a pooled verification service for prover training and multi-agent proving
papers.abstract: Isabelle Pool Server (IPS), a verification service with a pool of warm headless Isabelle sessions behind an HTTP API, with session leasing and reclamation, memory-aware admission control, and a time budget on every call. Its verification interface spans single-step execution, block-level proof checking and whole-theory builds, with checkpoints for cheap branching and backtracking, and a build from scratch as the final arbiter. The service runs as a single container with monitoring and is accessible via a Python client, two MCP servers and a raw HTTP API. In our measurements IPS is level with PIDE MCP, a PIDE frontend for agents, at one worker and ahead of it at eight, at its commit of October 2026 (the tool is now PIDE AI). Once its sessions are up it scales to 32 concurrent workers on one host at 24 times the single-worker rate, and under memory pressure it refuses new sessions rather than losing existing ones. IPS is free software and publicly available at this https URL

translation.title: Isabelle Pool Server：面向证明器训练与多智能体证明的池化验证服务
translation.abstract: Isabelle Pool Server（IPS）是一项验证服务，在 HTTP API 背后维护一个由预热的无头 Isabelle 会话组成的池，具备会话租借与回收、内存感知的准入控制以及每次调用的时间预算。其验证接口涵盖单步执行、块级证明检查和整理论构建，并提供检查点以实现低成本的分支与回溯，同时以从零构建作为最终裁决。该服务以单个容器运行并带有监控，可通过 Python 客户端、两个 MCP 服务器和原始 HTTP API 访问。在我们的测量中，在单 worker 时 IPS 与 PIDE MCP（一个面向智能体的 PIDE 前端）持平，在八 worker 时领先于它（截至该工具 2026 年 10 月的提交版本，该工具现已更名为 PIDE AI）。一旦其会话启动，IPS 可在单台主机上扩展到 32 个并发 worker，达到单 worker 速率的 24 倍；在内存压力下它会拒绝新会话而不是丢失已有会话。IPS 是自由软件，公开可用于此 https URL
translation.brief: 为解决证明器验证服务的并发与资源管理问题，构建了基于预热 Isabelle 会话池、支持租借回收与内存感知准入的 HTTP 验证服务。

papers.title: Towards Transparent Computational Agents for Air Traffic Control: Explainability, Interpretability and Trust
papers.abstract: We report preliminary findings from an ongoing investigation into transparency techniques for computational Air Traffic Control agents. Air Traffic Controller Officers (ATCOs) observed two types of agent in simulated air traffic controlling exercises. ATCOs found the chosen transparency techniques helpful to some extent: revealing how agents were making controlling decisions was an essential foundation for trust. However, the ATCOs' trust depended on whether they could be made sense of in a live, operational context and the agents' actions where judged to be professionally competent.

translation.title: 迈向透明的空中交通管制计算智能体：可解释性、可解读性与信任
translation.abstract: 我们报告了一项正在进行的关于计算空中交通管制智能体透明技术研究的初步发现。空中交通管制员（ATCO）在模拟空中交通管制演练中观察了两种类型的智能体。ATCO 认为所选的透明技术在某种程度上是有帮助的：揭示智能体如何做出管制决策是建立信任的重要基础。然而，ATCO 的信任取决于他们能否在实时运行情境中理解这些技术，以及智能体的行为是否被判定为具备专业胜任能力。
translation.brief: 研究空中交通管制员对智能体透明技术的信任问题，通过模拟演练让管制员观察两类智能体并评估透明技术的效果。

papers.title: Ultimate3D: Teaching Multimodal LLMs 3D Camera-Object Relations by Large-Scale Visual Instruction Data
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with accurately capturing camera-object relations, especially for object orientation, camera viewpoint, and camera shots. This stems from the fact that existing MLLMs are trained on images with limited diverse camera-object relations and corresponding textual descriptions. To address this, we propose a synthetic generation pipeline to create large-scale 3D visual instruction datasets. Our framework takes 3D assets as input and uses rendering and diffusion-based image generation models to create photorealistic images preserving precise camera-object relations. Additionally, large language models (LLMs) are used to generate text prompts for guiding visual instruction tuning and controlling image generation. We create Ultimate3D, a large-scale 3D-grounded 2D visual instruction dataset. Ultimate3D consists of 240K VQAs with precise camera-object annotations, and corresponding benchmark. MLLMs fine-tuned on our proposed dataset outperform commercial models by a large margin, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 29.7% on camera-object relation recognition tasks. Our code, dataset, and benchmark will contribute to broad MLLM applications.

translation.title: Ultimate3D：通过大规模视觉指令数据教会多模态大语言模型 3D 相机-物体关系
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）难以准确捕捉相机-物体关系，尤其是物体朝向、相机视角和相机镜头。这源于现有 MLLM 训练所用的图像中相机-物体关系多样性有限且缺乏相应的文本描述。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个合成生成流水线来创建大规模 3D 视觉指令数据集。我们的框架以 3D 资产为输入，利用渲染和基于扩散的图像生成模型创建保留精确相机-物体关系的照片级真实图像。此外，还使用大语言模型（LLM）生成文本提示，用于引导视觉指令微调和控制图像生成。我们构建了 Ultimate3D，一个大规模的 3D 锚定 2D 视觉指令数据集。Ultimate3D 包含 24 万条带有精确相机-物体标注的 VQA 及相应的基准测试。在我们提出的数据集上微调的 MLLM 大幅超越商业模型，在相机-物体关系识别任务上平均准确率提升 29.7%。我们的代码、数据集和基准将助力广泛的 MLLM 应用。
translation.brief: 为解决 MLLM 难以理解相机-物体关系的问题，提出基于 3D 资产渲染与扩散模型的大规模合成数据流水线，构建 Ultimate3D 数据集用于视觉指令微调。

papers.title: A Foundation Model to Measure and Predict Human Behaviour
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to infer psychological attributes, predict individual behaviour, and simulate human populations. However, despite generating plausible responses, they often misrepresent individuals and distort population statistics. Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour. We jointly fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs, predict individual behaviour, and align population response distributions with human statistics. The training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments over 109 psychological constructs. In our evaluations, Chiron's psychological measurements agree more closely with human self-reports and exhibit fewer biases that undermine psychometric validity. It predicts individual behaviour more accurately than frontier LLMs (up to 28.4% relative improvement). In simulations of social science experiments, it more accurately captures the direction and magnitude of human experimental effects (82.2--94.3% lower effect-size estimation error). Together, these results establish Chiron as a unified computational instrument for measuring and predicting human behaviour.

translation.title: 一个用于测量和预测人类行为的基础模型
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于推断心理属性、预测个体行为和模拟人类群体。然而，尽管能生成看似合理的回答，它们常常歪曲个体特征并扭曲群体统计。在此我们介绍 Chiron，一个用于测量和预测人类行为的基础模型。我们联合微调一个 LLM，使其能够表示心理构念、预测个体行为，并使群体回答分布与人类统计对齐。训练和评估数据涵盖 36 个行为领域和 78 项社会科学实验，包含 288,307 条个人记录、1,411,750 个原子行为决策，以及针对 109 个心理构念的 99,953 次心理测量评估。在我们的评估中，Chiron 的心理测量与人类自我报告更为吻合，且表现出更少的损害心理测量效度的偏差。它预测个体行为的准确性超过前沿 LLM（相对提升最高达 28.4%）。在社会科学实验的模拟中，它更准确地捕捉人类实验效应的方向和大小（效应量估计误差降低 82.2%–94.3%）。这些结果共同确立了 Chiron 作为测量和预测人类行为的统一计算工具的地位。
translation.brief: 为解决 LLM 在心理测量与行为预测中失真的问题，提出 Chiron 基础模型，通过联合微调对齐心理构念表示、个体行为预测与群体分布统计。

papers.title: Kaer: Security-Aware Replanning for Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: One popular architecture for multi-agent systems (MAS) relies on an orchestrator that generates an initial plan, coordinates its execution, and dynamically revises the plan based on agent feedback when tasks cannot be fully specified in advance. This dynamic replanning introduces a critical vulnerability: malicious agents can embed instructions within their feedback to hijack the replanning process. Existing defenses focus exclusively on per-tool access control or static, pre-execution policy enforcement, leaving the replanning phase unsecured. We introduce Kaer, a multi-agent framework featuring security-aware replanning. Kaer shields the planner from untrusted agent feedback by conveying diagnostics to the replanning procedure strictly through abstract templates. Plan revisions are restricted to a set of deterministic repair operators, and all modified plans must satisfy preset policies. We create Cintra, a benchmark of simulated user tasks requiring replanning paired with adversarial objectives targeting the replanning phase. Using Cintra, we evaluate both task completion rates and system vulnerability to replanning exploits by malicious agents. Evaluating Kaer on Cintra against Magentic-One (an undefended MAS) and ControlValve (the state-of-the-art defense) demonstrates that Kaer achieves higher robustness than both systems while maintaining comparable utility to ControlValve. Although abstract failure templates slightly constrain utility on select tasks, Kaer enables MAS to perform secure, dynamic plan revisions without exposing the orchestrator to untrusted agent feedback.

translation.title: Kaer：面向多智能体系统的安全感知重规划
translation.abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）的一种流行架构依赖于一个编排器来生成初始计划、协调其执行，并在任务无法事先完全指定时根据智能体反馈动态修订计划。这种动态重规划引入了一个关键漏洞：恶意智能体可以在其反馈中嵌入指令来劫持重规划过程。现有防御仅关注单工具访问控制或静态的执行前策略执行，使重规划阶段缺乏保护。我们提出 Kaer，一个具有安全感知重规划的多智能体框架。Kaer 通过严格以抽象模板向重规划过程传递诊断信息，使规划器免受不可信智能体反馈的影响。计划修订被限制在一组确定性修复算子内，且所有修改后的计划必须满足预设策略。我们构建了 Cintra，一个由需要重规划的模拟用户任务与针对重规划阶段的对抗目标配对组成的基准。利用 Cintra，我们评估任务完成率以及系统对恶意智能体重规划利用的脆弱性。在 Cintra 上将 Kaer 与 Magentic-One（无防御的 MAS）和 ControlValve（最先进的防御）对比评估表明，Kaer 比两者都更具鲁棒性，同时保持与 ControlValve 相当的效用。尽管抽象失败模板在部分任务上略微限制了效用，Kaer 使 MAS 能够执行安全的动态计划修订，而无需让编排器暴露于不可信的智能体反馈。
translation.brief: 为解决多智能体系统中恶意智能体通过反馈劫持动态重规划的问题，提出 Kaer 框架，以抽象模板传递诊断并用确定性修复算子与策略约束计划修订。

papers.title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
papers.abstract: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. Its central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority connected throughout the research-to-action process. Each result retains its source, temporal scope, configuration, and producing run. Shared evidence grounding enables verification, versioned research records support reproducible continuation, and an explicit authority gate separates strategy research from live execution. Together, these designs provide a practical foundation for trading agents whose results can be traced, reproduced, and acted on only under explicit authority.

translation.title: Vibe-Trading：迈向智能体原生的交易
translation.abstract: 现有的AI智能体能够检索信息、调用工具、运行实验并产出多步骤输出，但大多数智能体围绕相对静态的工作流构建，难以在环境变化时保持可靠的状态。金融交易使这一局限尤为致命：价格、新闻、市场状况、投资组合持仓和可用资金都在持续演变，一个结果只有在与正确的时间、数据快照和执行上下文保持绑定时才有价值。我们提出Vibe-Trading，一个全面的智能体原生交易框架和一体化工作空间，用于构建、评估和演化金融交易智能体。它统一了市场研究、金融数据、策略生成、回测、投资组合分析、模拟交易、多智能体协作以及可选的券商执行。其核心贡献是一种架构，能在从研究到行动的全过程中保持结果、证据、研究历史和交易权限的关联。每个结果都保留其来源、时间范围、配置和产生它的运行记录。共享的证据锚定支持验证，带版本的研究记录支持可复现的延续，而显式的权限门控将策略研究与实盘执行分离。这些设计共同为交易智能体提供了实用基础，使其结果可追溯、可复现，且仅在显式授权下才能被执行。
translation.brief: 针对AI智能体在动态金融环境中难以保持可靠状态的问题，提出Vibe-Trading框架，通过结果溯源、版本化研究记录和权限门控架构将交易研究到执行的全过程绑定。

papers.title: Atomic MathReasoner: Instance-Level Composition of Atomic Reasoning Skills for Mathematical LLMs
papers.abstract: Most existing approaches enhance mathematical reasoning in large language models (LLMs) as a monolithic capability, despite the fact that different mathematical problems require different reasoning skills. Recent work has explored a more fine-grained perspective by decomposing mathematical reasoning into atomic skills and developing specialized modules for individual capabilities. However, how to effectively utilize these atomic abilities remains underexplored. To address this challenge, we propose Atomic MathReasoner (AMR), an instance-level framework for composing atomic reasoning skills. AMR first trains a library of capability-specific LoRA experts and performs gradient-free optimization over held-out validation subsets to discover a diverse set of low-loss composition prototypes. It evaluates the preference of each prototype using the token-level negative log-likelihood of reference solutions, filters ambiguous assignments through a confidence margin, and distills the resulting pseudo-labels into a lightweight router. During inference, the router selects an appropriate composition prototype for each problem, enabling problem-specific utilization of atomic skills without costly online optimization. Experiments on the AtomicMath benchmark across general and mathematics-specialized LLMs demonstrate consistent improvements. On Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct-7B, AMR increases average field accuracy from 64.4% to 68.1% at Level 1 and from 59.3% to 63.7% at Level 2, while improving average logical reasoning performance from 39.4% to 46.8%. These results demonstrate that effectively composing specialized atomic skills provides a promising approach to strengthening mathematical reasoning in LLMs.

translation.title: Atomic MathReasoner：面向数学大语言模型的实例级原子推理技能组合
translation.abstract: 现有大多数方法将大语言模型（LLM）的数学推理视为单一整体能力加以增强，尽管不同的数学问题需要不同的推理技能。近期工作探索了更细粒度的视角，将数学推理分解为原子技能并为各能力开发专门模块，但如何有效利用这些原子能力仍缺乏研究。为应对这一挑战，我们提出Atomic MathReasoner（AMR），一个实例级组合原子推理技能的框架。AMR首先训练一个能力专属的LoRA专家库，并在留出的验证子集上进行无梯度优化，以发现一组多样化的低损失组合原型。它使用参考解答的token级负对数似然评估每个原型的偏好，通过置信度间隔过滤模糊的分配，并将所得伪标签蒸馏到一个轻量级路由器中。推理时，路由器为每个问题选择合适的组合原型，实现对原子技能的问题级利用而无需昂贵的在线优化。在AtomicMath基准上对通用和数学专用LLM的实验显示了一致的提升。在Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct-7B上，AMR将Level 1的平均领域准确率从64.4%提升至68.1%，Level 2从59.3%提升至63.7%，同时将平均逻辑推理性能从39.4%提升至46.8%。这些结果表明，有效组合专门的原子技能是增强LLM数学推理的一条有前景的路径。
translation.brief: 针对数学问题需要不同推理技能而现有方法将其视为整体能力的问题，提出AMR框架，通过LoRA专家库与无梯度优化发现组合原型并用轻量路由器为每个问题选择原子技能组合。

papers.title: Can Programs Replace LLM Judges? Executable Program Judges for Scalable and Efficient Relevance Labeling
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges have become a common way to create large-scale relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation. However, each judgment requires a potentially expensive call to a frontier model, and the judgments are hard to interpret and may not be reproducible. In this paper, we ask whether an LLM can write a readable program for each topic that replaces its per-document judgments. To address these issues, we propose ExecJudges, a method for generating fast, inspectable and scalable judges for automatic relevance labeling. Specifically, ExecJudges uses a frontier LLM to turn assessment guidelines into executable programs, which rely only on lexical matching, standard NLP libraries like parsers, and pool statistics. An ExecJudges-L variant also uses examples of human labels if available. We evaluate ExecJudges on seven TREC collections by comparing the produced labels with trained NIST assessors, frontier LLM judges, and recently proposed per-topic classifiers. Our results show that ExecJudges agrees with NIST assessors at the level of the Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM judges on TREC DL 2019-2021. With a small number of human labels per topic, the ExecJudges-L variant agrees with NIST more than per-topic classifiers with the same labels on all seven collections, and either exceeds the agreement of LLM judges provided the same labels or is within about 0.05 of it in Krippendorff's alpha. The labels rank the official TREC DL runs with Kendall's tau of 0.87 to 0.94, and writing the programs incurs a one-time cost of $0.17 to $0.49 per topic, with no additional costs for grading. Our results suggest that ExecJudges offers a reproducible, inspectable, efficient and cost-effective alternative to LLM judges for labeling deep result pools for system evaluation or ranking improvements.

translation.title: 程序能否取代LLM裁判？用于可扩展高效相关性标注的可执行程序裁判
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）裁判已成为为检索评估创建大规模相关性判断的常用方式。然而，每次判断都需要对前沿模型进行可能昂贵的调用，且判断难以解释、可能不可复现。本文探讨LLM能否为每个主题编写一个可读的程序来取代其对每个文档的判断。为此，我们提出ExecJudges，一种生成快速、可检查、可扩展的自动相关性标注裁判的方法。具体而言，ExecJudges使用前沿LLM将评估指南转化为可执行程序，这些程序仅依赖词法匹配、解析器等标准NLP库以及池统计信息。ExecJudges-L变体在可用时还利用人工标注示例。我们在七个TREC集合上评估ExecJudges，将其产生的标注与训练有素的NIST评估员、前沿LLM裁判以及近期提出的每主题分类器进行比较。结果表明，在TREC DL 2019-2021上，ExecJudges与NIST评估员的一致性达到Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM裁判的水平。在每主题少量人工标注下，ExecJudges-L在全部七个集合上与NIST的一致性均超过使用相同标注的每主题分类器，且在Krippendorff's alpha上要么超过使用相同标注的LLM裁判，要么与其差距在0.05以内。其标注对官方TREC DL运行的排序Kendall's tau为0.87至0.94，编写程序的一次性成本为每主题0.17至0.49美元，评分无额外成本。结果表明，ExecJudges为深度结果池标注提供了一种可复现、可检查、高效且经济的LLM裁判替代方案，可用于系统评估或排序改进。
translation.brief: 针对LLM裁判成本高、难解释、不可复现的问题，提出ExecJudges，用前沿LLM将评估指南编译为仅依赖词法匹配和标准NLP库的可执行程序来自动进行相关性标注。

papers.title: Communications-free Collective Intelligence Via Allocentric Belief
papers.abstract: A team of skilled card players share no information amongst each other, and yet still are able to coordinate their play by watching the same players and reading the same tells. Autonomous systems have failed to exploit this logic, relying instead on explicit communication or complex state estimation schemes that can fail when it matters most. Without it, decentralized agents diverge in their world beliefs, and coordination collapses. Here we show that anchoring all agents to a single shared external actor, a common witness whose reactions encode team state, produces spontaneous, communication-free coordination. An allocentric belief network trained on witness behavior allows each agent to independently reconstruct full team state, keeping group beliefs consistent with no inter-agent exchange. Across five competitive environments allocentric belief alignment outperforms egocentric approaches in collective performance, and even scales to sixty-agent teams where standard methods fail. These results establish a new principle for collective intelligence: in the absence of communication, a shared gaze replaces a shared channel.

translation.title: 通过他者中心信念实现无通信的群体智能
translation.abstract: 一队技艺高超的牌手彼此之间不共享任何信息，却仍能通过观察相同的玩家和解读相同的暗示来协调配合。自主系统未能利用这一逻辑，而是依赖显式通信或复杂的状态估计方案，而这些方案在最关键时刻可能失效。缺乏这种机制时，去中心化智能体的世界信念会产生分歧，协调随之崩溃。我们证明，将所有智能体锚定到一个共享的外部参与者——一个其反应编码团队状态的共同见证者——可以产生自发的、无需通信的协调。一个在见证者行为上训练的他者中心信念网络使每个智能体能够独立重建完整的团队状态，在智能体之间无任何交换的情况下保持群体信念一致。在五个竞争性环境中，他者中心信念对齐在集体性能上优于自我中心方法，甚至可扩展到标准方法失效的六十个智能体的团队。这些结果确立了群体智能的新原则：在缺乏通信时，共享的注视取代共享的信道。
translation.brief: 针对去中心化智能体因缺乏通信导致信念分歧、协调失效的问题，提出将他者中心信念网络锚定于共享外部见证者，使各智能体独立重建团队状态实现无通信协调。

papers.title: Choosing What to Observe: Budget-Paired Counterfactual Audits for Credible Evaluation of Visual Agents
papers.abstract: Visual agents that read dense documents must ration a finite observation budget across candidate regions, yet answer accuracy conflates where an agent looks, how it adapts to the reads that remain, and how it an?swers once observation stops. We introduce budget-paired counterfactual audits, an evaluation protocol that holds public evidence and region bindings fixed while perturbing only the remaining budget or de?clared task parameters, and credits every acquired history with exact continuation values. The resulting accounting decomposes lost expected accuracy into stepwise acquisition loss and terminal decision loss, separating planning from fixed-role heuristics. Across forty paired routing anchors, five open-weight

translation.title: 选择观察什么：预算配对反事实审计用于视觉智能体的可信评估
translation.abstract: 阅读密集文档的视觉智能体必须在候选区域间分配有限的观察预算，然而回答准确率混淆了智能体看向哪里、如何适应剩余的读取以及观察停止后如何作答。我们提出预算配对反事实审计，一种评估协议：在保持公开证据和区域绑定不变的同时，仅扰动剩余预算或声明的任务参数，并为每段已获取的历史赋予精确的延续价值。由此产生的核算将损失的期望准确率分解为逐步获取损失和终端决策损失，从而将规划与固定角色启发式区分开来。在四十个配对路由锚点和五个开源权重……
translation.brief: 针对视觉智能体评估中准确率混淆观察规划与决策能力的问题，提出预算配对反事实审计协议，通过固定证据仅扰动预算并将准确率损失分解为获取损失与决策损失。

papers.title: Learning to Interact in Multi-Agent Self-Play for Controllable Autonomous Driving Scenario Generation
papers.abstract: Large-scale, multi-agent self-play trains robust driving policies effectively in simulation, but controlling these models to generate specific, safety-critical edge cases remains a key challenge. Existing goal-conditioned self-play frameworks rely primarily on static map-location goals and fail to reliably produce complex agent interactions such as aggressive tailgating or adversarial cut-offs. These agent interactions are necessary for rigorous autonomous vehicle (AV) testing. To address this, we present an extended multi-agent self-play framework that introduces agent-relative dynamic goals. By conditioning policies on this extended goal representation, our framework enables targeted, controllable scenario synthesis. We demonstrate that our approach successfully generates interactive driving behaviors that static-goal baselines cannot simulate, providing a flexible tool for long-tail scenario generation in AV testing.

translation.title: 面向可控自动驾驶场景生成的多智能体自博弈交互学习
translation.abstract: 大规模多智能体自博弈能在仿真中有效训练鲁棒驾驶策略，但如何控制这些模型生成特定的、安全攸关的边缘场景仍是一个关键挑战。现有的目标条件自博弈框架主要依赖静态地图位置目标，无法可靠地产生复杂的智能体交互，如激进跟车或对抗性别车，而这些交互对于严格的自动驾驶车辆（AV）测试是必要的。为此，我们提出了一个扩展的多智能体自博弈框架，引入智能体相对动态目标。通过让策略以这种扩展的目标表示为条件，我们的框架能够实现有针对性的、可控的场景合成。我们证明该方法能成功生成静态目标基线无法模拟的交互式驾驶行为，为AV测试中的长尾场景生成提供了灵活工具。
translation.brief: 针对自博弈驾驶策略难以生成特定安全攸关边缘场景的问题，提出引入智能体相对动态目标的多智能体自博弈框架以实现可控场景合成。

papers.title: Auditing black-box clinical prediction models with a large language model through queries alone: a blinded test with planted flaws
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. GPT-6 Astra audited each model three times, blind, through a tool that only returned the model's predictions; the judging rules were committed before any run and applied by program. Its surrogate models, with a median of 128 terms, reproduced the audited models' log-odds with a mean $R^2$ of 0.976 (0.959 for an additive surrogate of 42 terms fitted by an analyst). It found the planted flaw in 69 of 72 runs (96%; 95% CI 80% to 99%); a script written for the purpose found all 24. It also reported many more problems: 60% of 1,089 checkable reports failed the pre-specified check against the model's average behaviour; post hoc, most of these were real but small steps, and 15% of the checkable reports were not found in the model. Of 601 unexpected relationships it read out of the clean models, 11% held in patients randomised later (random pairs 6%; a regression scan's shorter list of its strongest candidates, 28%); after a check on the training data, 33% against 30%. With query access alone, an LLM can describe a black-box model faithfully and find nearly every planted flaw, as a purpose-written script also did; its reports of problems must be checked on the model and its discoveries on data.

translation.title: 仅通过查询用大语言模型审计黑盒临床预测模型：植入缺陷的盲测
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）被用于解释临床预测模型，其承诺是能够说明模型计算了什么、发现其缺陷，甚至揭示其中的新知识。我们在答案可被核验的条件下检验了这三项承诺。基于International Stroke Trial，我们在早期随机化的患者上训练了四种模型（logistic回归、可解释提升机、梯度提升树、神经网络）用于两个结局，在24个副本中各植入一个缺陷（被低估的亚组、反向的风险因素或不合理的阶跃），并与8个干净模型混合。GPT-6 Astra在盲态下通过一个只返回模型预测值的工具对每个模型审计三次；评判规则在任何运行之前预先确定并由程序执行。其代理模型（中位数128项）以平均$R^2$为0.976复现了被审计模型的对数几率（分析师拟合的42项加性代理模型为0.959）。它在72次运行中的69次（96%；95% CI 80%至99%）发现了植入缺陷；一个为此编写的脚本则发现了全部24个。它还报告了更多问题：1,089份可核验报告中60%未通过针对模型平均行为的预设检验；事后分析显示其中多数是真实但微小的阶跃，15%的可核验报告在模型中未找到。在它从干净模型中读出的601个意外关系中，11%在后期随机化的患者中成立（随机配对为6%；针对其最强候选的回归扫描的较短列表为28%）；对训练数据核查后为33%对30%。仅凭查询访问，LLM可以忠实地描述黑盒模型并发现几乎每一个植入缺陷，专用脚本同样可以；其问题报告须在模型上核验，其发现在数据上核验。
translation.brief: 针对黑盒临床预测模型审计问题，通过仅查询接口让LLM盲态审计并检验其发现植入缺陷与揭示新关系的能力。

papers.title: Local AI Agents in Power Electronics Simulation: Deployment, Measurements and Costs
papers.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging in power electronics, where it drives the simulation loop that engineers used to close largely by hand. In this loop, a converter design, or a study of the network it connects to, is built, run, measured and revised until it satisfies its specification. Such an agent can be served from a cloud API or from an inference device on the premises. For organizations whose designs, customer data or export-controlled material cannot leave the site, and whose simulators are licensed there, local deployment is the natural choice. In such a deployment, the agent becomes an electrical load on the organization's own equipment, i.e., every run consumes power and energy on a local device, generates tokens and takes time. However, existing work focuses mainly on what the agent can achieve with cloud-hosted models. What a local deployment costs in power, energy, tokens and time on real simulation tasks, and what its choices trade against one another, has received little quantitative investigation under comparable conditions. To address this gap, a systematic evaluation framework is presented in this paper. It applies locally served models to agentic power electronics tasks, from the converter level to the system level, and measures their power, energy, token and time costs. Based on these measurements, the capability boundary of a local agent on such tasks and the cost per solved task are characterized. The results are expected to provide practical insight for the use of agentic AI in power electronics and the power systems it serves.

translation.title: 电力电子仿真中的本地AI智能体：部署、测量与成本
translation.abstract: 智能体人工智能（AI）正在电力电子领域兴起，它驱动着过去主要由工程师手工完成的仿真闭环。在该闭环中，一个变换器设计或其连接网络的研究被构建、运行、测量和修改，直至满足其规格。此类智能体可由云端API或本地推理设备提供服务。对于设计、客户数据或出口管制材料不能离开现场、且仿真器在本地授权的组织而言，本地部署是自然选择。在这种部署中，智能体成为组织自身设备上的电气负载，即每次运行都在本地设备上消耗功率和能量、产生token并占用时间。然而，现有工作主要关注智能体用云端托管模型能实现什么；本地部署在真实仿真任务上的功率、能量、token和时间成本，以及其各种选择之间的权衡，在可比条件下鲜有定量研究。为填补这一空白，本文提出了一个系统化评估框架。它将本地服务的模型应用于从变换器级到系统级的智能体电力电子任务，并测量其功率、能量、token和时间成本。基于这些测量，刻画了本地智能体在此类任务上的能力边界和每个已解决任务的成本。结果有望为智能体AI在电力电子及其服务的电力系统中的应用提供实用洞见。
translation.brief: 针对本地部署AI智能体在电力电子仿真任务中成本缺乏定量研究的问题，提出系统化评估框架测量其功率、能量、token和时间成本并刻画能力边界。

papers.title: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
papers.abstract: Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration.
